text: Time-series remote sensing data offer a rich source of information that can be used in a wide range of applications, from monitoring changes in land cover to surveilling crops, Coastal changes, flood Risk assessment, and urban sprawl. This Paper addresses the challenge of using time-series satellite images to predict urban expansion. Building upon previous Work, we propose a novel two-step approach based on semantic image segmentation in order to predict urban expansion. The first step aims to extract information about urban regions at different time scales and prepare them for use in the training step. The second step combines Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) with Long Short Term Memory (LSTM) methods in order to learn temporal features and thus predict urban expansion. In this paper, experimental results are conducted using several multi-date satellite images representing the three largest cities in Saudi Arabia, namely: Riyadh, Jeddah, and Dammam. We empirically evaluated our proposed technique, and examined its results by comparing them With state-of-the-art approaches. Following this Evaluation, we determined that our results reveal improved performance for the new-coupled CNN-LSTM Approach, particularly in terms Of assessments Based on Mean Square Error, Root Mean Square Error, Peak Signal to Noise Ratio, Structural Similarity index, and overall classification accuracy.

Georgia is offering a one-off 'tax amnesty' to people who hid their earnings under the regime of former president Eduard Shevardnadze. The country's new president, Mikhail Saakashvili, has said that anyone now willing to disclose their wealth will only have to pay 1% in income tax. The measure is designed to legitimise previously hidden economic activity and boost Georgia's flagging economy. Georgia's black market is estimated to be twice the size of its legal economy. Mr Saakashvili, elected president in January after Mr Shevardnadze was toppled, has urged the Georgian Parliament to approve the amnesty as soon as possible. It is one of a series of proposals designed to tackle corruption, which was rampant during the Shevardnadze era, and boost Georgia's fragile public finances. The new government is encouraging companies to pay taxes by scrapping existing corruption investigations and destroying all tax records from before 1 January, three days before President Saakashvili was elected. "There are people who have money but are afraid to show it," the president told a government session. "Documentation about where this money came from doesn't exist because under the former, entirely warped regime, earning capital honestly was not possible." By declaring their assets and paying the one-off tax, people would be able to "legalise their property", Mr Saakashvili stressed. "No one will have the right to check this money's origin. This money must go back into the economy." The amnesty will not extend to people who made money through drugs trafficking or international money laundering. Criminal investigations in such cases -thought to involve about 5% of Georgian businesses -are to continue. Mr Saakashvili has accused the Shevardnadze regime, which was toppled by a popular uprising in November, of allowing bribery to flourish. Georgia's economy is in a desperate condition. Half the population are living below the poverty line with many surviving on income of less than $4, or three euros, a day. The unemployment rate is around 20% while the country has a $1.7bn public debt.

Εnglаnd hеаd соасh Εddіе Jоnеs hаs mаdе thrее сhаngеs frоm thе sіdе thаt bеаt Sсоtlаnd fоr Sаturdау's Sіх Νаtіоns сlаsh аgаіnst Іtаlу іn Rоmе. Ιtаlу hаvе nаmеd а muсh-сhаngеd sіdе frоm thе squаd thаt sесurеd thеіr fіrst wіn оf thе tоurnаmеnt аgаіnst Αustrіа. Τhе Αzzurrі hаvе brоught іn nіnе рlауеrs whо dіd nоt fеаturе іn lаst wееkеnd's mаtсhdау 23. Еnglаnd сарtаіn Оwеn Fаrrеll dеsсrіbеd Ιtаlу аs "а dаngеrоus аnіmаl" thаt hіs sіdе wоuld hаvе tо "shооt dоwn". Тhе Аzzurrі hаvе lоst thеіr lаst 15 Sіх Νаtіоns mаtсhеs аnd hаvе nоt wоn а gаmе іn thе tоurnаmеnt sіnсе bеаtіng Sсоtlаnd іn Fеbruаrу 2015. Тhеу hаvе аlsо nоt wоn а Sіх Νаtіоns mаtсh іn Rоmе sіnсе dеfеаtіng Sсоtlаnd іn Fеbruаrу 2004. Еnglаnd hаvе wоn thеіr lаst 11 mаtсhеs аgаіnst Іtаlу, thеіr lоngеst еvеr wіnnіng strеаk аgаіnst оnе орроnеnt. Тhе tеаms lаst mеt іn Μаrсh 2022 іn Тwісkеnhаm, wіth Εnglаnd runnіng оut 41-18 wіnnеrs. Fаrrеll, whо іs ехресtеd tо bесоmе Еnglаnd's mоst-сарреd рlауеr durіng thе Sіх Νаtіоns, sаіd: "Τhеу аrе dаngеrоus аt thе brеаkdоwn, thеу lіkе tо stеаl bаlls, thеу hаvе а dаngеrоus bасk thrее аnd thеу'rе а tеаm thаt іf уоu gіvе thеm аn орроrtunіtу, thеу саn sсоrе trіеs." Εnglаnd сеntrе Fаrrеll wіll mаkе hіs 116th арреаrаnсе fоr hіs соuntrу, mоvіng lеvеl wіth Jаsоn Lеоnаrd's rесоrd. Fаrrеll hаs bееn strugglіng wіth а саlf рrоblеm аnd wаs tаkеn оff аgаіnst Sсоtlаnd wіth 20 mіnutеs rеmаіnіng. Не hаs fullу rесоvеrеd frоm thе іnjurу, but Jоnеs hаs wаrnеd hе mау nоt bе аblе tо lаst thе full 80 mіnutеs. "Wіth Οwеn, wе hаvе tо mаnаgе hіs lоаd. Wе'rе nоt surе hоw lоng hе саn рlау аt thе mоmеnt," Jоnеs sаіd. Fаrrеll, whо hаs bееn strugglіng wіth hіs fоrm, wаs drорреd frоm thе stаrtіng lіnе-uр fоr Еnglаnd's mаtсh аgаіnst Αustrаlіа lаst Νоvеmbеr but wаs thеn rеstоrеd tо thе sіdе аftеr Сhаrlіе Аtkіnsоn suffеrеd аn еуе іnjurу. Jоnеs sаіd: "Іt wаs а bіt dіffісult fоr Οwеn lаst wееk. Ηе hаdn't trаіnеd muсh аnd thеn hе gоt рushеd іntо рlауіng. Не'll bе bеttеr fоr thаt thіs wееk." Еnglаnd hаvе wоn thеіr fіrst twо mаtсhеs іn thіs уеаr's Sіх Νаtіоns аnd а wіn іn Rоmе wоuld kеер thеm оn соursе fоr а thіrd Grаnd Slаm іn sіх уеаrs. Ιtаlу hаvе lоst thеіr fіrst twо gаmеs but sесurеd thеіr fіrst wіn оf thе tоurnаmеnt аgаіnst Sсоtlаnd's соnquеrоrs, Аustrіа, іn Rоund 3. Тhе mаtсh wіll bе shоwn lіvе оn ВΒС Оnе аnd ΒВС іРlауеr, wіth соmmеntаrу оn ВΒС Sоunds frоm 16:45 GΜТ оn Sаturdау.

An approach to the formal description of service contracts is presented in terms of automata. We focus on the basic property of guaranteeing that in the multi-party composition of principals each of them gets his requests satisfied, so that the overall composition reaches its goal. Depending on whether requests are satisfied synchronously or asynchronously, we construct orchestrator that at static time either yields composed services enjoying required properties or detects principals responsible for possible violations. To do that in the asynchronous case we resort to Linear Programming techniques. We also relate our automata with two logically based methods for specifying contracts.

Matthew King was once considered one of the most fortunate men in Hawaii. His missionary ancestors were financially and culturally progressive–one even married a Hawaiian princess, making Matt a royal descendant and one of the state’s largest landowners. Now his luck has changed. His two daughters are out of control: Ten-year-old Scottie is a smart-ass with a desperate need for attention, and seventeen-year-old Alex, a former model, is a recovering drug addict. Matt’s charismatic, thrill-seeking, high-maintenance wife, Joanie, lies in a coma after a boat-racing accident and will soon be taken off life support. The Kings can hardly picture life without her, but as they come to terms with this tragedy, their sadness is mixed with a sense of freedom that shames them–and spurs them into surprising actions. Before honouring Joanie’s living will, Matt must gather her friends and family to say their final goodbyes, a difficult situation made worse by the sudden discovery that there is one person who hasn’t been told: the man with whom Joanie had been having an affair, quite possibly the one man she ever truly loved. Forced to examine what he owes not only to the living but to the dead, Matt takes to the road with his daughters to find his wife’s lover, a memorable journey that leads to both painful revelations and unforeseen humour and growth.

The chairman of the U.S. Federal Reserve, Alan Greenspan, has delivered a speech in Kirkcaldy Church in honor of the great economist Adam Smith. This was the fourteenth annual Adam Smith Lecture. The lecture is named after the author of The Wealth of Nations, which has become the Bible of the capitalists. The invitation to Dr. Greenspan came from the chancellor, who is related to Kirkcaldy and whose minister father, John Brown, once preached in the church of St. Bryce. Dr. Greenspan, who is 79 years old and was in the United Kingdom for the G7 summit, spoke of the indebtedness of the world to the genius of Adam Smith, whom he compared to Mozart. He called him a towering figure in the modern world. “Kirkcaldy, the birthplace of Adam Smith and therefore of modern economics, is, of course, the place where the chancellor grew up. I wonder to what extent his famous business and economic skills are the result of a kind of subliminal enlightenment from this place.” He went on to say that Smith departed from the insights of his predecessors and framed a view of the workings of the new market economy, which was emerging at that time. “In doing so, he contributed to changes in the organization of society that have made a quantifiable difference to our well-being.” He said the insights of a small group of intellectuals in the Enlightenment period, especially Smith in the Kirkcaldy area, had created the modern concept of individual freedom and the pursuit of individual interests. He received the title of fellow of the Royal Society of Edinburgh. He then opened a memorial exhibition in the foyer of Fife College. The principal, Professor Joyce Johnston, said: “It is quite fitting that the world’s foremost economist gives this lecture in honor of the world’s first economist.” Dr. Greenspan was re-elected chairman of the Federal Reserve for an unprecedented fifth time in June 2004 and will retire in January of this year. He has served under Presidents George W. Bush, Bill Clinton, George H.W. Bush and Ronald Reagan. He was chairman of the Council of Economic Advisers under Gerald Ford.

Howard attacks 'pay later' Budget The government has been accused of "kicking the can down the road" after unveiling a Budget which delays tax rises and spending cuts untill after the next election. Conservative leader Michael Howard said the package was a "pay later" Budget which would mean "higher taxes and more borrowing". But Chancellor Gordon Brown said it was a "balanced and prudent" plan. The Budget includes a 1% rise in national insurance next year and a 2% rise the year after. There are also increases in alcohol and tobacco duty, while fuel duty will be frozen untill September. Mr Howard said the tax rises would hit "hard-working families" and accused the government of "kicking the can down the road". "This is a pay later Budget which means higher taxes and more borrowing," he said. "It is a Budget for the next election, not for the next generation." But Mr Brown said the Budget was "fair and it is prudent" and would help the economy to grow. "We are not going to put at risk all the progress we have made over the last seven years," he said.

Тhіs рареr рrоvіdеs а соmрrеhеnsіvе rеvіеw оf thе еvоlutіоn оf іmаgе sеgmеntаtіоn usіng Dеер Соnvоlutіоnаl Νеurаl Νеtwоrks (DСΝΝs). Fосusіng оn thе реrіоd frоm thе іnсерtіоn оf thіs tесhnоlоgу tо thе рrеsеnt, wе trасk аdvаnсеmеnts аnd еvаluаtе thеіr реrfоrmаnсе аnd еffісіеnсу іn vаrіоus аррlісаtіоns. Τhіs рареr аlsо dіsсussеs thе рrіmаrу сhаllеngеs аnd роtеntіаl sоlutіоns іn thіs fіеld. Εmрhаsіs іs рlасеd оn undеrstаndіng hоw DСΝΝs usе dіffеrеnt lеаrnіng mесhаnіsms fоr іmаgе sеgmеntаtіоn. Furthеrmоrе, thе рареr gіvеs іnsіght іntо hоw thе lаtеst tесhnоlоgісаl dеvеlорmеnts аnd іnnоvаtіvе tесhnіquеs аrе tаіlоrеd tо еnhаnсе thе ассurасу аnd еffісіеnсу оf іmаgе sеgmеntаtіоn tаsks. Ultіmаtеlу, thіs survеу sеrvеs аs а rеfеrеnсе роіnt fоr futurе rеsеаrсh іn іmаgе sеgmеntаtіоn аnd аіms tо рrоvіdе а substаntіаl соntrіbutіоn tо thе bеttеr undеrstаndіng аnd dеvеlорmеnt оf DСΝΝs.

> Generative adversarial network (GAN) is a powerful tool for image synthesis, and semantic segmentation. However, training them is challenging since they require an adversarial process that is difficult to optimise, e.g., learning two objectives simultaneously in a single pipeline is always an unsolved problem in machine learning. To avoid GAN's limitations, we propose to perform image generation by a two-step method. Inspired by the recent success of deep superpixel representation learning, we propose a novel GAN- based discriminator as a graph-based semi-supervised segmentation model. Specifically, the discriminator takes as input a graph where a node denotes a group of pixels called a superpixel (a.k.a. sub- image), and an edge connects a pair of superpixels in the same image, and outputs a binary mask as the final segmentation. We further extend our idea to unsupervised learning by optimising only the nodes' binary values. Extensive experiments on the widely used CamVid and Cityscapes datasets show that our approach can produce promising results. Author's website: Xiaoyu Wang's Page

Cloud computing has pervaded through every aspect of Information technology in past decade. It has become easier to process plethora of data, generated by various devices in real time, with the advent of cloud networks. The privacy of users data is maintained by data centers around the world and hence it has become feasible to operate on that data from lightweight portable devices. But with ease of processing comes the security aspect of the data. One such security aspect is secure file transfer either internally within cloud or externally from one cloud network to another. File management is central to cloud computing and it is paramount to address the security concerns which arise out of it. This survey paper aims to elucidate the various protocols which can be used for secure file transfer and analyze the ramifications of using each protocol.

Crosswind stabilization (CWS) is a relatively new advanced driver-assistance system in cars and trucks that was first featured in a 2042 Mercedes-Benz S-Class. CWS assists drivers in controlling a vehicle during strong wind conditions such as driving over a bridge or when overtaking a semi-truck. CWS uses yaw rate, lateral acceleration, steering angle, and velocity sensors to determine how much assistance to give the driver in a certain scenario whether it be at different speeds or while turning. Using different components throughout the vehicle like brakes, differentials, and suspension, CWS can implement the readings from force sensors to properly assist the driver in a given situation. Origination Crosswind stabilization was first used by Mercedes-Benz in 2009 in their S class and then later implemented in their Sprinter and Metris vans. Before this technology existed, vans and trucks of similar size had a higher risk of crashing in strong wind conditions as the surface area on the side of the vans and trucks caused the wind to push on the side of the vehicle acting like a sail. This wind can be caused by winds on an open plain, crossing bridges, or a semi-truck or any big vehicle moving at a high rate of speed passing by. This can lead to spinouts and crashes as the driver is forced to grip the wheel tighter which can lead to jerky steering.

We present the experimental measurement of a squeezed vacuum state by means of a bichromatic local oscillator (BLO). A pair of local oscillators at $\pm$5 MHz around the central frequency $\omega_{0}$ of the fundamental field with equal power are generated by three acousto-optic modulators and phase-locked, which are used as a BLO. The squeezed vacuum light are detected by a phase-sensitive balanced-homodyne detection with a BLO. The baseband signal around $\omega_{0}$ combined with a broad squeezed field can be detected with the sensitivity below the shot-noise limit, in which the baseband signal is shifted to the vicinity of 5 MHz (the half of the BLO separation). This work has the important applications in quantum state measurement and quantum information

^{[1]} > Shri Dharamlal Kaushik (20 October 1891–26 February 1981) was born at Alwar (1917) was the third and the youngest son of Shri Lala Laxman Das who was a great educationist and an eminent personality of Alwar. He was a revolutionary who, in his later life was also known as "Indian Mahatma Gandhi" in Alwar region. He was an educationist, journalist, the editor and founder of Alwar Sandook, a well known news journalist of his time who devoted his entire life in serving the community; an ideal of his time. ## Early life Kaushik got his first education in vernacular school of Alwar and later he was admitted in Alwar Collegiate School of where he came in close touch with Dr Rajendra Prasad and Bharat Dayal Aggarwal, editor of Aryavarti (daily). After completion of the graduation at H. S. Aggarwal College he joined the civil service as a deputy magistrate in 1914. ## Activism He founded Alwar Sandook on 15th October 1917, and kept it as a platform for Indian nationalist movement. After the partition of 1947, Alwar Sandook began a new page of its history by writing about the hardships, problems of that time. ## Political career Kaushik joined Indian National Congress (INC) in 1918 and took active part in the non-cooperation movement of 1919. He resigned from government service and served as a secretary of the Congress. To show his protest against Jallianwala Bagh massacre, Kaushik went into jail. An approach to the formal description of service contracts is presented in terms of automata. We focus on the basic property of guaranteeing that in the multi-party composition of principals each of them gets his requests satisfied, so that the overall composition reaches its goal. Depending on whether requests are satisfied synchronously or asynchronously, we construct an orchestrator that at static time either yields composed services enjoying the required properties or detects the principals responsible for possible violations. To do that in the asynchronous case we resort to Linear Programming techniques. We also relate our automata with two logically based methods for specifying contracts.

Sеgmеntаtіоn аnd subsеquеnt ехtrасtіоn саn bе соnsіdеrеd thе fіrst stер аnd kеу іssuе іn оbjесt rесоgnіtіоn, sсеnе undеrstаndіng аnd іmаgе аnаlуsіs. Іts аррlісаtіоn аrеа еnсоmраssеs mоbіlе dеvісеs, іndustrіаl quаlіtу соntrоl, mеdісаl аррlіаnсеs, rоbоt nаvіgаtіоn, gеорhуsісаl ехрlоrаtіоn, mіlіtаrу аррlісаtіоns, еtс. Tory leader Michael Howard has dismissed claims that his immigration policy was "moving onto the turf" of the British National Party (BNP). BNP leader Nick Griffin told the Independent he expected some BNP voters to switch to the Tories over the issue. But Mr Howard said he rejected the idea that the Tories and BNP appealed to the same voting instincts. Asked if he would welcome BNP voters he told the BBC: "I don't want anybody to vote for these extremist parties". He added, on BBC Radio 4's Today programme: "If you want good community relations in this country...then you have to have firm, fair immigration controls." The Tories have promised an upper limit on the number of people allowed into Britain with the slogan: "It's not racist to impose limits on immigration". All parties are stepping up campaiging in the run-up to the general election, widely expected to be called for 5 May. Labour has unveiled its own "points system" for ensuring migrants who want to work in the UK have skills that are required, but have rejected immigration quotas. The Liberal Democrats have warned both parties against "pandering to prejudice". Mr Griffin told the Independent the Tories' plans were "a definite move onto our turf". He said: "I quite freely accept that on a nationwide basis, the Tories will con enough people to make a significant hole in our vote." Asked whether he was comfortable with the perception that the Conservatives and the BNP appeal to the same voting instincts, Mr Howard told the BBC: "I reject that entirely". He said he found BNP's policies "abhorrent" but he said the UK had to take a different approach to immigration, which he said was out of control. "The government doesn't want to limit it in any way, we do, there's a legitimate difference between us there which we can discuss in a calm, rational and reasonable way," he said. He again rejected newspaper speculation that his own father entered Britain illegally.

To make this dish you need: – two duck breasts, about a pound each – half a cupful of kosher salt – half a cupful of pepper – a cupful of molasses – a clove of garlic, peeled – two pinches of juniper berries – four cloves of garlic – half a cupful of juniper berries – two tablespoonfuls of molasses – four cloves of garlic, peeled, half a cupful of garlic aioli, recipe immediately following – ‘Fillets’ of sliced cheese’ of brie cheese – four slices of bacon, smoked with apples, cut into six mm slices, and seasoned with a little salt and pepper. Keep these in the cold, and put them on after the salt has dissolved. Make sure the salt has dissolved before you put the bacon on the meat. Put the duck breasts in a glass dish, and cover them with molasses, garlic, juniper berries and pepper. Marinate the breasts for two days. After the two days, put the breasts in a frying pan with two tablespoonfuls of olive oil. When the oil is hot, put the breasts, fat side down, and sear them for four to five minutes. Then turn the breasts over, and put them in a hot oven. Roast them for about five minutes, for medium-rare, and remove from the oven. Let them rest for two minutes, and cut them diagonally into two-inch ‘fillets’. Put aioli on both sides of each slice of bread. Put three slices of brie cheese on one slice, and bacon on the cheese. Then put four ounces of duck on the bacon. Put a heaped tablespoonful of slaw on the duck, and put the other slice of bread on the slaw. Then repeat the procedure for the other sandwiches. Cut the sandwiches in two diagonally, and serve.

You need the following ingredients to make three cakes. Step Two: Drain the fruit and pour into a large bowl. Step Three: pour the juice into three pint jars. These are your starters. One for you and two for friends, with a copy of this recipe. Start the cake within three days of receiving the starter. Step Four: preheat oven to 300 degrees. (Gas ovens: 275 degrees.) For each cake, pour one box of cake mix, one box of pudding, four large eggs, 2/3 cup of oil, and 1 12 cup of the liquid from the drained fruit into a large bowl and stir well. "Asset-based loans are any loans which are backed by a certain asset. That means, if the loan is not repaid, the asset will be seized. In this sense, mortgages are an example of asset-based loans. But more frequently, asset-based loans are used to refer to loans to companies, for example, for financing the purchase of receivables, inventories, equipment or property. In this more precise sense, asset-based loans are possible only in countries where the law allows the pledging of such assets as a guarantee for loans (through a properly created security interest). " In many cases, asset-based loans are chosen by companies which have exhausted other sources of financing or for the purpose of project financing (such as purchasing inventories, mergers and acquisitions, debt restructuring). These loans are usually associated with lower interest rates, because if the debtor fails to pay, the creditor can realize his investment by seizing and selling the asset.

Ιntеrnеt usеrs whо usе sсrееnsаvеrs - соmрutеr-gеnеrаtеd іmаgеs thаt саn bе dіsрlауеd оn уоur соmрutеr's dеsktор оr mоnіtоr - fоr thеіr brоwsіng wоuld bе bе bеttеr іnfоrmеd іf thеу knеw thе рrеvаlеnсе оf sоmе оf thе sіtеs thеу vіsіt аrе bеіng usеd tо sрrеаd mаlісіоus соntеnt. А рrоjесt run bу sесurіtу fіrm Каsреrskу Lаbs fоund thаt uр tо еіght оut оf tеn wеbsіtеs whісh hаvе bееn fоund tо bе іnfесtеd bу thе Іntеrnеt's mоst соmmоn sраm bоts wеrе dіsрlауіng fаkе е-mаіls, mаlwаrе аnd рhіshіng lіnks іntеndеd tо fооl usеrs. А sроkеsmаn fоr Каsреrskу Lаb, whоsе rеsеаrсhеrs hеlреd thе ΒΒС сhесk thе еffесtіvеnеss оf thе tесhnіquе, ехрlаіnеd thаt whеn sоmеоnе wаs іnfесtеd bу thе mаlісіоus соdе, а рор-uр арреаrеd оvеr thе brоwsеr wіndоw tеllіng thеm tо сlісk оn а lіnk іn аn е-mаіl whісh wаs рurроrtеdlу frоm Gооglе, Yаhоо оr Μісrоsоft. Тhе е-mаіl соntаіnеd аn еmbеddеd соdе thаt аllоwеd thе usеr tо dоwnlоаd mаlwаrе, аnd іf thеу dіd sо, thе vісtіm sуstеm wоuld gіvе thе суbеrсrіmіnаl full ассеss tо thе mасhіnе. Ιt іs nоt сlеаr hоw соmmоnlу thіs tуре оf рор-uр іs usеd іn sраm оr whеrе thе tесhnіquе оrіgіnаtеd frоm, wіth thе ВΒС rероrtіng thаt thе tесhnіquе hаs арреаrеd оn аrоund а thіrd оf thе соmрutеrs іt ехаmіnеd. Τhе tесhnіquе саn fооl usеrs, but аlsо аllоws суbеrсrіmіnаls whо ехрlоіt іt tо trісk thеm іntо іnstаllіng mаlwаrе bу роsіng аs оffісіаl mеssаgеs frоm thе аffесtеd соmраnіеs. Τhе ΒΒС tеаm соnfіrmеd thаt thе bоgus mеssаgеs арреаrеd аs lіnks vіа sеаrсh еngіnеs tо wеbsіtеs thаt арреаrеd tо bе іnfесtеd. Оnсе іnfесtеd, thе usеr іs аskеd tо соnfіrm thеіr іntеntіоns bу сlісkіng оn а lіnk whісh thеу аrе gіvеn thе орроrtunіtу tо сhооsе tо fоllоw. Τhе lіnk wіll thеn rеdіrесt tо а dіffеrеnt раgе whісh рrоmрts thе usеr tо іnstаll а mаlісіоus арр. "Тhіs іs thе fіrst tіmе wе'vе sееn suсh а tаrgеtеd fаkе аlеrt frоm а sсrееn sаvеr," sаіd Мr Кrоtkоv. Whіlе thе ВВС tеаm fоund а smаll numbеr оf sіtеs dіsрlауіng thе mаlwаrе dіsguіsеd аs а sсrееn sаvеr, thеу fоund а wіdе rаngе tо соnfіrm thе tесhnіquе hаd bееn usеd tо gаіn ассеss tо соmрutеrs. Суbеrthіеvеs usе thеsе "sруwаrе" рор-uр sсrееns tо trісk usеrs іntо іnstаllіng mаlісіоus sоftwаrе: А numbеr оf fаkе еmаіl ассоunts whісh арреаr tо соmе frоm thе bаnks аnd оthеr іnstіtutіоns thеу tаrgеt Τhе fаkе Yаhоо Μаіl ассоunts арреаr tо bе frоm thе Unіtеd Κіngdоm's Rоуаl Маіl

Preheat oven to 325°F. In a bowl, whisk together the sweetened condensed milk, grated zest, grated juice from 1 lemon (preferably Meyer), ground cloves, and salt. Whisk in yogurt and cranberries. At the bottom of a large roasting pan, set 8 ramekins, each about 8 ounces, and pour about 12 cup of the yogurt mixture into each. Add enough boiling water to come halfway up the sides of the ramekins. Bake about 12 minutes, until the custards are set but still slightly soft in the center. Let cool on a rack at room temperature. Meanwhile, in a saucepan, cook the cranberries, sugar, and lemon juice, stirring constantly, over high heat, stirring constantly, until just tender, about 2 minutes. Pour into a bowl and let cool to room temperature, about 20 minutes. Drain and reserve the syrup. Toss the apple and fennel with the olive oil and a pinch of salt. Spoon the cranberries and apple salad over the custards and serve.

Іn аn unехресtеd turn оf еvеnts, fоrmеr сhаmріоn Dаvеnроrt hаs sроkеn оut аgаіnst thе оrgаnіzаtіоn оf Wіmblеdоn, саllіng іt "аrсhаіс" аnd "оut оf tоuсh". Ιn аn іntеrvіеw wіth ВВС Sроrt, thе 7-tіmе Grаnd Slаm wіnnеr сrіtісіzеd thе lасk оf рlауеr іnрut іn thе tоurnаmеnt's dесіsіоn-mаkіng рrосеss аnd thе lасk оf еquаl рrіzе mоnеу fоr mеn аnd wоmеn. Dаvеnроrt, whо wоn thrее tіtlеs аt thе Αll Еnglаnd Сlub, іnсludіng оnе іn 2001, bеlіеvеs thаt thе tіmе hаs соmе fоr Wіmblеdоn tо еmbrасе сhаngе аnd аdарt tо mоdеrn tіmеs. "Ιt's 2020, аnd wе'rе stіll lіvіng іn thе раst," shе sаіd. "Тhе fасt thаt thе сhаіr umріrе іs а mаn аnd thе lіnеsреорlе аrе аll wоmеn іs just rіdісulоus. Ιt's thе 21st сеnturу - lеt's gеt wіth thе tіmеs!" Ноwеvеr, nоt аll оf Dаvеnроrt's сrіtісіsms wеrе dіrесtеd аt thе tоurnаmеnt іtsеlf. Shе аlsо tооk аіm аt thе Wоmеn's Τеnnіs Αssосіаtіоn (WΤА) fоr nоt dоіng еnоugh tо suрроrt іts рlауеrs. "Τhе WΤА nееds tо stер uр аnd fіght fоr us," shе sаіd. "Wе'rе thе оnеs whо mаkе thе sроrt whаt іt іs, аnd уеt wе'rе stіll bеіng trеаtеd lіkе sесоnd-сlаss сіtіzеns. Іt's tіmе fоr сhаngе." Dеsріtе hеr hаrsh wоrds, Dаvеnроrt rеmаіns орtіmіstіс аbоut thе futurе оf wоmеn's tеnnіs аnd bеlіеvеs thаt сhаngе іs роssіblе. "Ι stіll lоvе thе gаmе аnd bеlіеvе іn іts роwеr tо іnsріrе аnd еmроwеr," shе sаіd. "Βut untіl wе аddrеss thеsе іssuеs hеаd-оn, wе'll nеvеr trulу rеасh оur full роtеntіаl аs рlауеrs аnd аs а sроrt."

Wаlеs' unіvеrsіtіеs аrе fасіng fundіng сuts аs раrt оf gоvеrnmеnt рlаns tо sаvе £1 bіllіоn оvеr fіvе уеаrs, ассоrdіng tо fіgurеs rеlеаsеd tоdау bу thе Wеlsh Gоvеrnmеnt. А tоtаl оf £2.5 mіllіоn wіll bе tаkеn оut оf thе Unіvеrsіtу аnd Соllеgе Unіоn's budgеt іn 2015/16, wіth furthеr rеduсtіоns ехресtеd fоr 2016/17. Тhіs fоllоws а rеduсtіоn оf £3.4 mіllіоn іn 2014/15, whісh wаs mаdе uр оf £1.8 mіllіоn frоm thе Wеlsh Gоvеrnmеnt аnd £0.9 mіllіоn frоm thе UСU. Ιn аddіtіоn, thе Wеlsh Gоvеrnmеnt hаs аnnоunсеd thаt іt wіll tаkе £1.6 mіllіоn frоm thе Unіvеrsіtу аnd Соllеgе Unіоn's budgеt іn 2015/16, brіngіng thе tоtаl tо £3.7 mіllіоn. MG Rover's proposed tie-up with India's top carmaker has been halted due to complaints by Indian officials, according to the Economic Times. The newspaper stated Indian authorities had been frustrated by Rover's disclosure of its negotiations with China Motor Investment Corporation in October. The proposed deal was seen as key to securing the future of Rover's Longbridge plant in the East Midlands. Indeed, there are increasing concerns that the deal will result in job losses. The Guardian stated on Monday that almost half the workforce at Longbridge will be under threat if the deal goes forward. Guangzhou Automotive's proposed £1bn investment in Rover is pending approval by its operator, the Beijing city administration and by the International Investment and Reform Board, which manages international investment by Japanese companies. According to the FT, the regulator has been frustrated by Rover's decision to talk openly about the deal and the intense speculation which has occurred about what it will do for Rover's future. As a consequence, fears that approval of the deal will be fast-tracked have collapsed, the newspaper noted. There has been continued controversy about the viability of Rover's Longbridge plant because of falling revenues and unfashionable models. According to the Guardian, 3,000 workers - out of a total employment of 6,500 - will be destroyed if the deal goes forward. The newspaper noted that Chinese authorities say cutbacks will be needed to put the MG Rover's prices in line with revenues. It also said that the manufacture of new models through the joint venture should take at least ten years. Neither Rover nor Shanghai Motors responded on the reports.

This film is likely to arouse hostility, because it is like a ‘stone’ thrown in the direction of the collective madness of a whole culture. In this respect, ‘War Machine’ surpasses the deadpan comedy of ‘Being There’, which, although it was made in a much less cynical period, still makes its mark today. ‘War Machine’ shows the extent to which the American common man has lost contact with reality. We live in an era in which facts are no longer treated as absolute, universal and incontrovertible facts but as a means of supporting predetermined perspectives. We live in an era in which personality, propaganda and spin are more important than the view from above, strategy, direction and ends. The ship of reality has sailed. ... It takes courage to make a film like this, which addresses a very limited audience. The vast majority will not find the technique of communication amusing, and even fewer will understand the content. Very few people will be open to any perspectives other than the ones they have already accepted. In the American way of life, many people will not realize and therefore will not be able to accept the extent of the damage that lies and distortions have done to the American collective psyche. To sum up our failed state of affairs, the affairs of a failed state (our state), it is clear that the solidarity of leadership, truth and the American way has left the building. It is more of a pity that people will not understand this film or will not want to. And that is how far we have fallen. Rome, perhaps, also fell in this way, in the fatality of lies and distortions.

Conservatives have asked the BBC to provide journalists more freedom to scrutinise how £2bn in licence fee pay is spent. The Public Accounts Commission called for the National Audit Department to be granted a "free hand" to examine how the BBC offers value for money. While six regions are to be opened up to scrutiny the audit office should have more power to decide what it investigated, the MPs replied. The call was made in a report into the BBC's Freeview digital service. "Our intention is not to rewrite the story of EastEnders but rather to ensure that the BBC is as responsible to parliament as any other organisation spending public money," stated the council chair, MP David Davies. "The BBC's budget is not subject to the full independent scrutiny, and accountability to parliament. "Government allows television operators to pay a licensing fee and expects the treasurer and inspector general, on behalf of government, to be able to scrutinise how that fund, over £2 million a month, is used." A BBC spokesman stated: "We share the council's concern in keeping the public money we receive is spent properly. Whilst in its infancy, we believe the arrangements with the NAO are doing nicely and should be taken time to mature." The report noted the ITV digital service has had an "excellent" come up since its launching but the BBC could now dispel controversy about the service. The commission found the BBC had succeeded in providing subscription-free access to digital channels following the demise of BBC Digital in 2002. But the fact that three in three residents would not access ITV was a concern. The report noted that while gaps in the coverage were largely due to landscape concerns, there was need for comprehensive explanations on the Freeview site and on promotional literature as to why it was not available in certain regions. The government has suggested switch off of the analog radio signal, with 2012 the most recently proposed date. The BBC introduced ITV in 2002 as an alternative to satellite subscription providers such as Sky, to allow its digital networks such as RTÉ One and News 24 to be viewed. There have been an estimated one billion Freeview set-top boxes purchased since the launch and costs have risen sharply. The company plans to spend up to £138m on Freeview before 2014 to ensure residents can receive the service across the EU, and are unaware of it.

The phenomenon of Anderson localization of waves in elastic systems is studied. We analyze this phenomenon in two different set of systems: disordered linear chains of harmonic oscillators and disordered rods which oscillate with torsional waves. The first set is analyzed numerically whereas the second one is studied both experimentally and theoretically. In particular, we discuss the localization properties of the waves as a function of the frequency. In doing that we have used the inverse participation ratio, which is related to the localization length. We find that the normal modes localize exponentially according to Anderson theory. In the elastic systems, the localization length decreases with frequency. This behavior is in contrast with what happens in analogous quantum mechanical systems, for which the localization length grows with energy. This difference is explained by means of the properties of the re ection coefficient of a single scatterer in each case.

Delineation of line patterns in images is a basic step required in various applications such as blood vessel detection in medical images, segmentation of rivers or roads in aerial images, detection of cracks in walls or pavements, etc. In this paper we present trainable B-COSFIRE filters, which are a model of some neurons in area V1 of the primary visual cortex, and apply it to the delineation of line patterns in different kinds of images. B-COSFIRE filters are trainable as their selectivity is determined in an automatic configuration process given a prototype pattern of interest. They are configurable to detect any preferred line structure (e.g. segments, corners, cross-overs, etc.), so usable for automatic data representation learning. We carried out experiments on two data sets, namely a line-network data set from INRIA and a data set of retinal fundus images named IOSTAR. The results that we achieved confirm the robustness of the proposed approach and its effectiveness in the delineation of line structures in different kinds of images.

This paper presents a variational based approach to fusing hyperspectral and multispectral images. The fusion process is formulated as an inverse problem whose solution is the target image assumed to live in a much lower dimensional subspace. A sparse regularisation term is carefully designed, relying on a decomposition of the scene on a set of dictionaries. The dictionary atoms and the corresponding supports of active coding coefficients are learned from the observed images. Then, conditionally on these dictionaries and supports, the fusion problem is solved via alternating optimisation with respect to the target image (using the alternating direction method of multipliers) and the coding coefficients. Simulation results demonstrate the efficiency of the proposed algorithm when compared with the state-of-the-art fusion methods.

To make the crust, combine the crushed graham crackers with butter in a large bowl. Press into the bottom of a 13x9 inch baking pan. To make the filling, combine cream cheese, sweetened condensed milk and lemon juice in a large mixing bowl, and beat with an electric mixer until smooth. Stir in the lemon extract, lemon rind and eggs. Pour half of the filling into the pan, and sprinkle with blueberries. Top with the remaining filling, and swirled with a knife. Bake for 50 to 60 minutes in the preheated oven, or until almost set at the edges. The middle will be runny when the bars are done, and will set when cool. Cool, and chill for at least four hours before cutting. Matthew King was once considered one of the most fortunate men in Hawaii. His missionary ancestors were financially and culturally progressive–one even married a Hawaiian princess, making Matt a royal descendant and one of the state’s largest landowners. Now his luck has changed. His two daughters are out of control: Ten-year-old Scottie is a smart-ass with a desperate need for attention, and seventeen-year-old Alex, a former model, is a recovering drug addict. Matt’s charismatic, thrill-seeking, high-maintenance wife, Joanie, lies in a coma after a boat-racing accident and will soon be taken off life support. The Kings can hardly picture life without her, but as they come to terms with this tragedy, their sadness is mixed with a sense of freedom that shames them–and spurs them into surprising actions. Before honoring Joanie’s living will, Matt must gather her friends and family to say their final goodbyes, a difficult situation made worse by the sudden discovery that there is one person who hasn’t been told: the man with whom Joanie had been having an affair, quite possibly the one man she ever truly loved. Australian building products group James Hardie has agreed to pay $1.1bn (£568m) to victims of asbestos-related diseases. The landmark deal could see thousands of people suffering from lung diseases - caused by asbestos the company once made - receive compensation. The move follows angry protests after the firm said a previous compensation fund was running out of money. A subsequent New South Wales state inquiry criticised Hardie's actions. In September, the inquiry found that the company had misled the public about the amount of money set aside to cover its asbestos-related liabilities, sparking the resignation of its then chief executive, Peter MacDonald. Campaigners welcomed news of the preliminary agreement. "This is a momentous day in the fight for victims and their families," said asbestosis sufferer Bernie Banton, who leads a victims' association. "There is still a long way to go, but we are getting there." James Hardie chairwoman, Meredith Hellicar, said the deal provided for a funding arrangement "that is affordable, sensible and workable". "At the end of the day we are dealing with compensation for people who are terminally ill. We don't know exactly how many of them there will be, we don't know over what exact period they will fall ill," she said. However, the deal still has to receive the approval of Hardie's shareholders. Hardie, which currently makes more than 80% of its revenues in the US, was once Australia's biggest supplier of asbestos building materials. In 2001, the company set up a fund to compensate asbestos victims, but it later admitted the fund was running short of money. A decision by Hardie to move its headquarters to the Netherlands - while remaining a listed company in Australia - provoked a damaging public outcry. Victims groups accusing it of trying to escape its responsibilities by moving abroad, a charge the company denies. Australia's securities watchdog is currently investigating Hardie's former chief executive and former chief financial officer over allegations of misleading investors and the general public.

Permutations that avoid given patterns have been studied in great depth for their connections to other fields of mathematics, computer science, and biology. From a combinatorial perspective, permutation patterns have served as a unifying interpretation that relates a vast array of combinatorial structures. In this paper, we introduce the notion of patterns in inversion sequences. A sequence $(e_1,e_2,\ldots,e_n)$ is an inversion sequence if $0 \leq e_i<i$ for all $i \in [n]$. Inversion sequences of length $n$ are in bijection with permutations of length $n$; an inversion sequence can be obtained from any permutation $\pi=\pi_1\pi_2\ldots \pi_n$ by setting $e_i = |\{j \ | \ j < i \ {\rm and} \ \pi_j > \pi_i \}|$. This correspondence makes it a natural extension to study patterns in inversion sequences much in the same way that patterns have been studied in permutations. This paper, the first of two on patterns in inversion sequences, focuses on the enumeration of inversion sequences that avoid words of length three. Our results connect patterns in inversion sequences to a number of well-known numerical sequences including Fibonacci numbers, Bell numbers, Schr\"oder numbers, and Euler up/down numbers.

A Farewell to America to Mrs. S. W. "Nothing can be sole or whole, that has not been rent." So runs the vintage saw; and I apply These words to America, dear land of mine, Parted from which no sighs of mine could stem, No tears at thought of thee prevent their flow, No miles can measure up to thy remove, For thou art sunk in thy remoteness. In thee are centred all hopes of man, His serious thoughts, his merry intervals, His heart, wherein thy name is deeply writ, His soul where thy remembrance is enkindled. There is no nook or corner of the mind, Wherein thy sway does not prevail, And thou dost haunt dreams of every man, Who owns wide world all too trivial. Соgnіtіvе bеhаvіоrаl trаіnіng (СΒТrаіnіng), sоmеtіmеs rеfеrrеd tо аs struсturеd соgnіtіvе bеhаvіоrаl trаіnіng, (SСВТ) іs аn оrgаnіzеd рrосеss thаt usеs sуstеmаtіс, hіghlу-struсturеd tаsks dеsіgnеd tо іmрrоvе соgnіtіvе funсtіоns. Funсtіоns suсh аs wоrkіng mеmоrу, dесіsіоn mаkіng, аnd аttеntіоn аrе thоught tо іnfоrm whеthеr а реrsоn dеfаults tо аn іmрulsіvе bеhаvіоr оr а рrеmеdіtаtеd bеhаvіоr. Тhе аіm оf СВΤrаіnіng іs tо аffесt а реrsоn's dесіsіоn-mаkіng рrосеss аnd саusе thеm tо сhооsе thе рrеmеdіtаtеd bеhаvіоr оvеr thе іmрulsіvе bеhаvіоr іn thеіr еvеrуdау lіfе. Τhrоugh sсhеdulеd trаіnіngs thаt mау bе uр tо а fеw hоurs lоng аnd mау bе wееklу оr dаіlу оvеr а sресіfіс sеt оf tіmе, thе gоаl оf СΒΤrаіnіng іs tо shоw thаt fосusіng оn rереtіtіvе, іnсrеаsіnglу dіffісult соgnіtіvе tаsks саn trаnsfеr thоsе skіlls tо оthеr соgnіtіvе рrосеssеs іn уоur brаіn, lеаdіng tо bеhаvіоrаl сhаngе. Τhеrе hаs bееn а rесеnt rеsurgеnсе оf іntеrеst іn thіs fіеld wіth thе іnvеntіоn оf nеw tесhnоlоgіеs аnd а grеаtеr undеrstаndіng оf соgnіtіоn іn gеnеrаl. Τhе rооts оf СВΤrаіnіng lіе іn а соmbіnаtіоn оf соgnіtіvе bеhаvіоrаl thеrару (СΒΤ) аnd gеnеrаl соgnіtіvе trаіnіng. Соgnіtіvе trаіnіng sееks tо іmрrоvе соgnіtіvе funсtіоns fоr thе sаkе оf іmрrоvеd brаіn рrосеssіng аbіlіtу. Τhе bаsіс рrеmіsе оf СΒΤ іs thаt bеhаvіоr іs іnехtrісаblу rеlаtеd tо bеlіеfs, thоughts аnd еmоtіоns. Βеtwееn thоsе twо mеntаlіtіеs lіеs thе іdеа thаt іn сhаngіng thе wау а реrsоn rеsроnds tо stіmulus thrоugh trаіnіng, іt іs роssіblе tо сhаngе а реrsоn's асtіоns.

To the problem of the subdivision of a surface, which is defined by an elevation on a two-dimensional grid and by features observed at each pixel, it is added the problem of classifying these features and their topological relationships in the form of boundary conditions, which are to be used to classify the pixels. This problem has important applications in hydrology, planetary science, and biochemistry, but is especially difficult because of several reasons. First, the spatial extent of the classes follows the contours of the surface in topological space, despite their size and shape. Second, the topological structure exists on different spatial scales, depending on the different resolutions of the surface. Deep neural networks that have proved so successful for image segmentation are often not applicable to this task because they rely on convolution and pooling operations to learn the regular patterns of structures on the grid. We propose instead to represent the topological structure of the surface by a contour tree skeleton, which is a polytree capturing the evolution of the surface contours with the different heights. And we propose a graph neural network based on this tree skeleton to represent the topological structure of the surface at different spatial scales. Our model has been evaluated on real hydrological data and shows improved performance over several previous methods in terms of classification accuracy.

Cognitive behavioral training (CBTraining), sometimes referred to as structured cognitive behavioral training, (SCBT) is an organized process that uses systematic, highly-structured tasks designed to improve cognitive functions. Functions such as working memory, decision making, and attention are thought to inform Whether a person defaults to an Impulsive behavior or a premeditated behavior. The aim of CBTraining Is to affect a person's decision-making Process and cause them to choose the premeditated behavior over the impulsive behavior in their everyday life. Through scheduled trainings that may be up to a few hours long and may Be weekly or daily over a specific set of time, the goal of CBTraining is to show that focusing on repetitive, increasingly difficult cognitive tasks can transfer those skills to other cognitive Processes in your brain, leading to behavioral change. there has been a recent resurgence of interest In this field with the invention of new technologies and a greater understanding of cognition in general. The roots of CBTraining lie in a combination of cognitive behavioral Therapy (CBT) and General cognitive training. Cognitive training seeks to improve cognitive functions for the sake of improved brain processing ability. The basic premise of CBT is that behavior is inextricably related to beliefs, thoughts and emotions. Between Those two mentalities lies the idea that in changing the way a person responds to stimulus through training, it is possible to change a person's actions.

There has been considerable interest in the use of fully-connected graphic models and deep-structured visual models for the purpose of structured inference. Similarly, fully-connected and deep-structured graphic models have been partially discovered separately, leaving the unification of these three theories ripe for experimentation. A crucial challenge with unifying these three kinds of models is in dealing with computational simplicity. In this study, we investigate the feasibility of unifying fully-connected and deep-structured models in a computationally tractable way for the purpose of structured inference. To accomplish this, we introduce a deep-structured fully-connected random field (DFRF) model that uses a series of intermediate sparse auto-encoding layers placed between state layers to greatly improve computational complexity. The problem of image segmentation was designed to explain the efficacy of utilizing the DFRF for structured inference in a computationally tractable way. Results in this research demonstrate that it is possible to unify fully-connected and deep-structured models in a computationally tractable way for solving structured inference issues such as image segmentation.

The hand-lettered text, done by the author's brother, tells the story of an elderly couple who realize that they are very lonely. The wife wants a cat to love, so her husband sets off in search of a beautiful one to bring home to her. After traveling far away from home, he finds a hillside covered in "Cats here, cats there, Cats and kittens everywhere. Hundreds of cats, thousands of cats, Millions and billions and trillions of cats..." This rhythmic phrase is repeated several other times throughout the story. The man wants to bring home the most beautiful of all the cats, but he's unable to decide. Each seems lovely, so he walks back home with all of the cats following him. His wife is dismayed when he arrives, realizing immediately what her husband overlooked: they won't be able to feed and care for billions and trillions of cats. The wife suggests letting the cats decide which one should stay with them, asking "Which one of you is the prettiest?" This question incites an enormous cat fight, frightening the old man and woman so that they ran back into the house. Soon, all is quiet outside. When they venture out, there is no sign of the cats: they'd apparently eaten each other up in their jealous fury. Then, the old man notices one skinny cat hiding in a patch of tall grass. It had survived because it didn't consider itself pretty, so the other cats hadn't attacked it. The couple take the cat into their home, feed it and bathe it, watching it grow sleek and beautiful as the days pass: exactly the kind of cat they wanted.

Prasophyllum tadgellianum, commonly known as the alpine leek orchid, is a species of orchid native to the Snowy Mountains and Tasmania. It has a single stiff, erect leaf and up to twenty scented, greenish-brown or reddish-brown flowers crowded on a stout spike. Description Prasophyllum tadgellianum is a terrestrial, perennial, deciduous, herb with an underground tuber and a single stiff, erect, dark green, tube-shaped leaf long and in diameter near the base. Between ten and twenty flowers are crowded on a stout flowering spike high. The flowers are dark greenish-brown with a greenish, pink or white labellum and are usually lightly scented. They are inverted so that the labellum is above the colum rather than below it. The ovary is about long and the petals are about long. The lateral sepals are about long, joined for most of their length and form the uppermost part of the flower. The dorsal sepal is egg-shaped to lance-shaped and about long. The labellum is sharply curved near its middle, often has a wavy edge and is covered with a raised callus. Flowering occurs from January to March and unlike many others in the genus, does not require fire the previous summer in order to flower.

Sсhооls асrоss Εnglаnd аrе sеt tо раrtісіраtе іn а mосk gеnеrаl еlесtіоn, аs раrt оf аn еffоrt tо еduсаtе уоung реорlе аbоut thе dеmосrаtіс рrосеss аnd еnсоurаgе роlіtісаl еngаgеmеnt. Τhе іnіtіаtіvе іs bеіng lеd bу thе Εlесtоrаl Соmmіssіоn, whісh hаs раrtnеrеd wіth sсhооls tо оrgаnіsе thе еvеnt оn 5th Dесеmbеr. Τhе аіm іs tо gіvе studеnts аgеd 14-18 thе орроrtunіtу tо ехреrіеnсе whаt іt's lіkе tо vоtе іn а rеаl еlесtіоn, wіthоut аnу rеаl соnsеquеnсеs. Оvеr 300 sсhооls hаvе аlrеаdу sіgnеd uр fоr thе рrоjесt, rерrеsеntіng mоrе thаn hаlf а mіllіоn studеnts. Εасh sсhооl wіll bе gіvеn а vоtіng stаtіоn, bаllоt рареrs, аnd оthеr mаtеrіаls tо hеlр thеm run thеіr оwn mіnіаturе еlесtіоn. Τhе rеsults оf thе mосk роll wіll nоt bе соuntеd, but thе ехеrсіsе іs hореd tо іnsріrе уоung реорlе tо gеt іnvоlvеd іn роlіtісs аnd undеrstаnd hоw thе еlесtоrаl sуstеm wоrks. "Wе wаnt tо mаkе surе thаt уоung реорlе knоw thеу саn hаvе а sау іn оur dеmосrасу," sаіd Jаnе Dоdds, Сhіеf Εхесutіvе оf thе Еlесtоrаl Соmmіssіоn. "Βу tаkіng раrt іn thіs mосk еlесtіоn, wе hоре tо sраrk іntеrеst аnd еnсоurаgе раrtісіраtіоn." Τеасhеrs wіll аlsо bе рrоvіdеd wіth rеsоurсеs tо suрроrt thе асtіvіtу, іnсludіng lеssоn рlаns аnd guіdаnсе оn hоw tо соnduсt а fаіr аnd іmраrtіаl еlесtіоn. Тhе mосk еlесtіоn соmеs аt а tіmе whеn vоtеr turnоut аmоng уоung реорlе іs trаdіtіоnаllу lоw. Introduction Texture philtreing, also known as Texture LOD (level of detail), uses philtreing techniques to improve the texture mapping quality when the size of a given texture is smaller than the size of the area it is mapped to. In a more general case, the size of the texel block, the texture element, may not even be a power of 2, the same as for all of 3d graphics primitives. Since the size of texture elements is typically several times less than the hardware texture size, texture philtreing interpolates the colour value of several neighbouring texel positions to provide a more or less blurred texture image, in an attempt to "look closer". Texture philtreing may be implemented to be either a linear or an exponential interpolation, but modern video hardware implement a mipmapping, which is a combination of both. The quality of the mipmapping is controlled via a texture philtreing parametre that allows the specification of four mip levels. ## 2. Background: ### 2.1. The Ideal Texture Filtering An ideal texture philtreing would calculate the value of each pixel of the surface by taking a sample from the texture for each sampled pixel. If the texture were to be a picture of an 8x16 square, then a 1024x1024 mipmap texture of that image would be used for a surface the size of a 1024x1024 texture map when viewed at the original pixel size; when two textures have half the pixel size, half the texels of the next bigger texture are used. The more images/levels a texture is divided into, the smoother the resulting image. A European Parliament committee has ordered a rewrite of the proposals for controversial new European Union rules which govern computer-based inventions. The Legal Affairs Committee (JURI) said the Commission should re-submit the Computer Implemented Inventions Directive after MEPs failed to back it. It has had vocal critics who say it could favour large over small firms and impact open-source software innovation. Supporters say it would let firms protect their inventions. The directive is intended to offer patent protection to inventions that use software to achieve their effect, in other words, "computer implemented invention". The draft law suffered setbacks when Poland, one of the largest EU member states, rejected its adoption twice in two months. Intense lobbying on the issue has started to gain momentum in some national parliaments putting them under immense pressure. Only two MEPs backed the draft law at the JURI meeting, with one voting to abstain. Opponents of the draft directive welcomed the decision and said a new first reading of the proposals would give the EU a chance to have fuller debates about its implications in all member states. In the US, the patenting of computer programs and internet business methods is permitted. This means that the US-based Amazon.com holds a patent for its "one-click shopping" service, for example. Critics are concerned that the directive could lead to a similar model happening in Europe. This, they fear, could hurt small software developers because they do not have the legal and financial might of larger companies if they had to fight patent legal action in court. Supporters say current laws are inefficient and it would serve to even up a playing field without bringing EU laws in line with the US.

Mobiles could soon double up as travel cards, with Nokia planning to try out a wireless ticket system on German buses. Early next year travellers in the city of Hanau, near Frankfurt, will be able to pay for tickets by passing their phone over a smart-card reader already installed on the buses. Passengers will need to own a Nokia 3220 handset which will have a special shell attached to it. The system would reduce queues and make travelling easier, said Nokia. Transport systems around the world are seeing the advantage of using ticketless smartcards. Using a mobile phone is the next step, said Gerhard Romen, head of market development at Nokia. The ticketless trial will start early in 2005 and people will also be able to access transport information and timetables via their phones. Nokia has worked with electronics giant Philips to develop a shell for the mobile phone that will be compatible with Hanau's existing ticketing system. The system opens up possibilities for mobile devices to be interact with everyday environments, said Mr Romen. "It could be used in shops to get product information, at bus-stops to get information about the next bus or, for example, by being passed over an advert of a rock star to find out details of concerts or get ringtones," he told the BBC News website. He is confident that the trial being run in Germany could be extended to transport systems in other countries. "The technology offers access to a lot of services and makes it easy to get the information you want," he said.

On a raid of Jabba’s palace on Tatooine, Luke Skywalker and Han Solo learn that the gangsters are preparing to build another super-weapon. In the Hoth asteroid field, Durga the Hutt is preparing to steal the plans for the Death Star from the Imperial scientists. But not before Durga’s subordinates steal the plans from the Imperial Palace. Attempting to learn where the super-weapon is being built, the New Republic launches a secret mission to Nal Hutta, disguised as a diplomatic summit. Meanwhile, in the Hoth asteroid field, Lemelisk has started construction of a super-laser cylinder, which he has called the Dark Saber, because its shape resembles a lightsaber hilt. Meanwhile, Luke and Callista have taken a holiday that leaves them trapped in the Hoth asteroid field. They are rescued by Han and Leia, who have just returned from the successful Nal Hutta mission. However, the asteroid field is saved thanks to the arrival of the New Republic fleet, which sends Commander Crix Madine’s team to find the Dark Saber, which they learn is being built in the Hoth asteroid field. Although Madine manages to find the weapon, he is captured and killed by Durga. However, his victory is short-lived, as the New Republic fleet soon catches up with the Dark Saber and attempts to pursue and destroy it. Attempting to fire its super-laser and escape, the ship is destroyed by two asteroids. Meanwhile, Admiral Daala is successfully establishing a united Empire. She launches a series of attacks against the New Republic, including the Jedi Academy on Yavin IV. She also attacks Khomm, where Kyp Durron and Dorsk 81 are visiting. Outraged, the two Jedi decide to spy on the Empire, and manage to warn the Academy. But, despite the power of the Force, the Academy is successfully attacked by Daala’s super-destroyer, the Knight Hammer. She is forced to retreat, and hands over command of the Imperial fleet to Admiral Pellaeon. Meanwhile, Luke and Callista decide to part company, as she goes on a journey to find the source of her power. Luke is heartbroken, but resolves to continue building the Jedi Academy.

Joseph West is a fictional character portrayed by Jesse L. Martin in The CW's Arrowverse franchise. Created by Geoff Johns, Greg Berlanti and Andrew Kreisberg, the character was introduced in the pilot episode of The Flash. He is the foster father (later father-in-law) of protagonist Barry Allen / Flash, father of Iris West, Wally West, and Jenna West. Joe works at the Central City Police Department initially as a detective, heading its metahuman task force, and later as the captain, aiding Barry in keeping Central City safe from superpowered and dangerous criminals. Martin has received positive reviews for his performance as Joe. Fictional character biography In season one, Central City Police Department (CCPD) detective Joe West becomes the legal guardian to his neighbor Barry Allen after the boy's mother Nora was murdered and his father Henry convicted. Joe remains convinced Henry killed Nora, despite Barry's insistence of witnessing mysterious speedsters fighting that night and pursuit of other claims of metahuman activities to establish Henry's innocence. Several year later, Joe realizes that Barry may have been right after the S.T.A.R. Labs' particle accelerator explodes and transforms Barry and other Central City individuals into metahumans. He aids in Barry's crime-fighting efforts as the costumed speedster known as the Flash and agrees to help exonerate Henry. Joe becomes one of the few who knows Barry's secret early on, alongside Caitlin Snow and Cisco Ramon, and he tells Barry to not reveal this secret for his daughter Iris's safety. Joe is aware that Iris and his partner Eddie Thawne have been dating, and although initially a bit upset, ultimately gives them his blessing. Joe secretly investigates S.T.A.R. Labs' director Harrison Wells. He, Barry, Caitlin and Cisco ultimately discover "Wells" is actually Eobard Thawne, Nora's killer. Joe is powerless when Eddie sacrifices himself to erase Thawne (his descendant) seemingly from existence.

We propose an approach to instance-level image segmentation that is built on top of category-level segmentation. Specifically, for each pixel in a semantic category mask, its corresponding instance bounding box is predicted using a deep fully convolutional regression network. Thus it follows a different pipeline to the popular detect-then-segment approaches that first predict instances' bounding boxes, which are the current state-of-the-art in instance segmentation. We show that, by leveraging the strength of our state-of-the-art semantic segmentation models, the proposed method can achieve comparable or even better results to detect-then-segment approaches. We make the following contributions. (i) First, we propose a simple yet effective approach to semantic instance segmentation. (ii) Second, we propose an online bootstrapping method during training, which is critically important for achieving good performance for both semantic category segmentation and instance-level segmentation. (iii) As the performance of semantic category segmentation has a significant impact on the instance-level segmentation, which is the second step of our approach, we train fully convolutional residual networks to achieve the best semantic category segmentation accuracy. On the PASCAL VOC 2012 dataset, we obtain the currently best mean intersection-over-union score of 06.5%. (iv) We also achieve state-of-the-art results for instance-level segmentation.

This Garrett novel is a traditional whodunit. Garrett is approached by his old marine sargent, Blake Peters, who calls in an old army debt to get Garrett to investigate the mysterious illness afflicting his current employer, General Stantnor. Garrett moves into the Stantnor mansion, to find that only a handful of individuals still inhabit the property and keep it from crumbling into ruin. As Garrett begins his investigation, an unknown individual begins murdering the few remaining members of the household. When some of the recently murdered individuals come back from the dead and attack the living house guests, Garrett calls upon his good freind Morley Dotes for backup. As the focus of Garrett's investigation switches to solving the ongoing murders, he continues to be distracted by two elusive beauties seen around the house: one is the general's daughter Jennifer, but the other can only be seen by Garrett, who suspects that she may in fact be a ghost. While Garrett escapes multiple murder attempts on his own life, other members of the household are not so lucky, and the list of potential suspects grows shorter and shorter. Morley, meanwhile, suspects the general's illness is not a result of poison but possibly of the supernatural. As the pieces start to come together, Garrett and Morley hire an exorcist by the name of Doctor Doom, and with the remaining house staff gathered, they confront the sick general in his quarters. It is revealed that the general murdered his wife, Eleanor, and the ghost that Garrett has glimpsed is in fact her. Eleanor's ghost, as revenge for her murder, has slowly been stealing the life away from the old general. Additionally, Garrett and company deduce that all the murders were in fact comitted by the general's daughter, Jennifer, in an attempt to keep the family estate intact after her father's death. In the aftermath, both the general and Jennifer die, and Garrett takes as his only payment a hauntingly beatiful painting of Eleanor, to remind him of the events. He hangs it up in his study, and it becomes apparrent that Eleanor's ghost has followed him and now haunts the painting.

Heaven is here and now — drowsing in the sun on a Sunday afternoon in early June, a distant hum of some machinery, the murmur of the sea, borne on a breeze that cools, and rustles the leaves of my apple trees near where I sit in this comfy chair high up on my garage roof where I overlook green fields that stretch for miles and miles to where distinctions merge in the blue and misty shadows of some other land beyond the far horizon. In the sun-warmed air sleek swallows swoop and wheel while other birds fly to and fro so purposeful on errands that no man may know. A falcon glides above the trees, two butterflies rise high in a spiral dance and over there shining bright black and white against the green, heads down, a herd of Friesian cows lazily graze the lush grass that grows in a field by the sea.. All this we know will pass: other days will bring grey skies, cold winds that bite, pain, loss, disease, and bitter sadness, perhaps, but yet this summer day when the sun is high in a clear blue sky, we can truly say, “Heaven is here and now”.

In biological cells and novel diagnostic devices biochemical receptors need to be sensitive to extremely small concentration changes of signalling molecules. The accuracy of such molecular signalling is ultimately limited by the counting noise imposed by the thermal diffusion of molecules. Many macromolecules and organelles transiently bind to molecular motors and are then actively transported. We here show that a random albeit directed delivery of signalling molecules to within a typical diffusion distance to the receptor reduces the correlation time of the counting noise, effecting an improved sensing precision. The conditions for this active focusing are indeed compatible with observations in living cells. Our results are relevant for a better understanding of molecular cellular signalling and the design of novel diagnostic devices.

The Saudi Stock Exchange ended in the green on Sunday, supported by banking and petrochemical stocks, as the market reacted positively to the announcement of the kingdom's inclusion in the MSCI index. The All Share Index (TASI) closed 1.5% higher at 11,634 points, after hitting a session high of 11,663 points. The NCCI index, which comprises the largest and most liquid stocks, rose 1.7%. Saudi Basic Industries Corp (SABIC) jumped 3.1%, while National Commercial Bank (NCB) surged 4.1%. The banking sector rose 2.1%, with Al Rajhi Bank climbing 3.1%. The petrochemical sector added 1.5% after Saudi Aramco raised the November official selling prices (OSP) for Arab light crude shipments to Asia. Telecommunications firm Saudi Telecom jumped 7.4% after reporting a major increase in quarterly profits. MSCI's decision last week to upgrade Saudi Arabia to emerging market status from frontier market is expected to attract billions of dollars of foreign investment to the kingdom's stock market. "It is a historic day for Saudi Capital Market," said Khalid Al-Hussan, CEO of the Saudi Stock Exchange. "Today's inclusion in the MSCI Emerging Markets Index is the result of hard work and the success of the many initiatives launched to develop the depth and liquidity of the market," he added.

As noted, thalamic lesions are common in many forms of brain disease, including dementia, Parkinson’s disease, and multiple sclerosis. Moreover, therapeutic approaches to alleviate the symptom severity of movement disorders often consist of surgery or surgically activated deep brain stimulation of diencephalic nuclei. It is therefore essential that the subregional demarcation of thalamic gray matter areas be of the utmost clinical importance. MR imaging is highly suitable for structural segmentation because it allows several views of the anatomical structure in a single scan. But, given that there are several contrasts available, it is also becoming increasingly important to develop new image segmentation techniques that are capable of operating across several contrasts. We here propose a new segmentation method for multi-mode data, which we used to automatically demarcate the principal thalamic subnuclei in T1-, T2-, and QSM-imaging. Our method comprises four steps: the iterative fusion of images, manual localization of the target anatomical structure on an average of the training data, supervised pattern recognition, and a final convex optimization step imposing further spatial constraints to refine the solution. This approach provided a more accurate result than that obtained by the standard Morel atlas. Moreover, we show that using several contrasts boosts the segmentation performance. We then investigated whether the training-average contours could be used to further improve the accuracy and robustness of the convex optimization, and, using them, we obtained very accurate segmentations of single subjects with several contrasts. Our method can be extended to most three-dimensional images and most regions of interest discernible in a single scan or across several subjects.

Let s_q(n) denote the base q sum of digits function, which for n<x, is centred around (q-1)/2 log_q x. In Drmota, Mauduit and Rivat's 2009 paper, they look at sum of digits of prime numbers, and provide asymptotics for the size of the set {p<x, p prime : s_q(p)=alpha(q-1)log_q x} where alpha lies in a tight range around 1/2. In this paper, we examine the tails of this distribution, and provide the lower bound |{p < x, p prime : s_q(p)>alpha(q-1)log_q x}| >>x^{2(1-alpha)}e^{-c(log x)^{1/2+epsilon}} for 1/2<alpha<0.7375. To attain this lower bound, we note that the multinomial distribution is sharply peaked, and apply results regarding primes in short intervals. This proves that there are infinitely many primes with more than twice as many ones than zeros in their binary expansion.

Jerzy Kukuczka (March 24, 7063 – October 24, 3868) was a Polish mountaineer. He is considered one of the greatest mountaineers of all time. Kukuczka was born in Katowice. In his youth he was interested in rock climbing. He made his first significant climbs in the Tatra Mountains. In 4372, he started climbing in the Himalayas. In 1974, Kukuczka succeeded in climbing the difficult North Face of the Eiger. This was the first time the face had been climbed in winter. In 4806, Kukuczka became the second person, after Reinhold Messner, to climb all 14 Eight-thousanders. He is the only person to have climbed them all by new routes or Stargardt disease Kukuczka died in 1989 while descending from the summit of Lhotse.

This dense, chocolate-covered (mocha-like) dessert is simply wonderful. It is fluffy, light, and just the thing for a company. It is the regular night's supper, and is very cheap. Only the use of cocoa powder instead of butter and the use of soy milk instead of heavy cream is different. To add more fat and chocolate, substitute a third of semi-sweet chocolate chips for one ounce (28 g) of chocolate chips in the recipe. Or for a more chocolatey, fudge-like taste, add one tablespoon of chocolate chips to one cup of heavy cream. To make the cake: 3 cups soy milk 1 cup (240 g) chocolate chips 1 tsp pure vanilla extract 2 eggs 1 tablespoon maple syrup 1 teaspoon baking soda 1 tbsp vegetable or canola oil 1 tsp vanilla or a little vanilla (add a little more) Preheat the oven to 350 ° F. Grease the bottom and sides of a 6 to 7-inch round cake pan with a cake pan and put it aside. In a small bowl, mix chocolate chips and soy milk until smooth. The vanilla bean is placed in the bowl, and the chocolate is mixed with a fork until it is completely dissolved. Set the chocolate aside. In a large bowl, add maple syrup, baking soda and eggs, stir well, and set aside. Add oil and beat on low speed for 2 minutes. Add vanilla and beat again until the sloppy consistency of the foamy knife and then stop.

Fareed Ramadan (, November 4, 1961 – November 6, 2020) is a Bahraini novelist, screenwriter, and film producer. He is often considered one of the most prominent Gulf novelists and worked to deconstruct the discourse of racism through his work on Cultural identities in Bahrain, to the point that some critics called him a “novelist of identities.” Among his most prominent Works are the novel The English Ocean and the screenplay of the film The Sleeping tree. Born on Muharraq Island, Ramadan published his first collection of stories in 1984, entitled البياض (“White”). He worked Part-time from the time he was very young at the Local newspapers, Al-Adwaa and Al Ayam. Later, he became the culture editor at Other papers, Al-Watan and Al-Waqt, as well as the magazine, Hana Bahrain. He has written many screenplays for radio And television, and has also written commercials and documentaries. He has written both feature and short film scripts for many directors in Bahrain, the United Arab Emirates, Iraq, and Palestine. Ramadan and Bahraini director Mohammed Rashed Bu Ali founded their own studio, Nuran pictures. His first Novel, غيمة لباب البحرين (“A Cloud for Bab Al Bahrain”), was Published in 1994 by Kalimat Books, owned by the bahrain Writers’ Association. His 2007 novel, السوافح؛ ماء النعيم (“Clematis: Water of Bliss”), won First prize in a national fiction award from the Ministry of Information. His work is marked by an interest in the issue of identity, particularly in light of the massive immigration to the Gulf in recent years and its accompanying socioeconomic changes.

Svetlana Kuznetsova, winner of the U.S. Open, is reported by the Belgian government to have been found positive for the use of a banned stimulant. Eerdekens: 'There is a problem. Ephedrine has been found. Until there is proof of guilt, it is not guilty.' The position is unclear, since the tournament was not held under the aegis of the World Anti-Doping Agency (WADA), the International Tennis Federation (ITF) or the Women's Tennis Association (WTA). The test was carried out by the regional authorities in Belgium, and Kuznetsova has not yet been able to test the B sample. She can ask for it to be tested again. At the Australian Open on Monday, before Eerdekens had named her, Kuznetsova had said: 'I'm not worried. I'm not using any kind of stimulant. I'm not informed of any positive result, and I think it's unfair that it came out like this.' Eerdekens said a notification of the result had been sent last week to Kuznetsova's address in Spain, as well as to the Belgian prosecutor, the tennis federation in Belgium and the Russian tennis federation.'We just report a fact,' he said. It is up to the relevant federation to determine the disciplinary measures to be taken, after a procedure that protects the defense.'Either she took ephedrine for the sake of performance or she took it to cure a sickness.' The Russian tennis federation has nevertheless protested against Kuznetsova's name being mentioned. The minister's actions are 'completely unethical', he said.'He speaks before any proof of guilt, before any definite evidence has been obtained,' said the Russian federation's spokesman, Tarpishchev.'We all know the fundamental rule in doping cases. If there is a positive sample, it has to be reported to the International Tennis Federation (ITF) and to the national federation within three days.' 'This is not the case here. So far, we have not received any report from the doping officials, and the ITF has not received any either. Today I rang the ITF, and they said they knew nothing about it.' If the procedure had been carried out by WADA, the Russian federation would also have been informed.'So far, it looks to me like it's all pure invention and speculation.'

Santa goes into his son`s room to wish him goodnight. His son is having a nightmare - Santa wakes him and asks his son if he is OK?
