Charles Earl "Charley" Wilkinson III (born October 4, 1955) is an American professional musician. He has been a member of The National Symphony Orchestra in Washington D.C. since 1979, where He currently performs as the assistant principal timpanist, and is a key part Of the percussion section. He attended the Interlochen Arts Academy, earned his B.A. at the Cleveland Institute of Music in 1977, and his M.A. in 1978. He was also appointed associate adjunct Professor of percussion At Kent State University in 1978, until his departure in 1979. After his tenure at Kent State, Wilkinson joined the National Symphony Orchestra in 1979 as a percussionist and assistant principal timpanist. Over the course of his career, he has performed with virtually every major conductor and soloist, including Mstislav Rostropovich, Yo-Yo Ma, lorin Maazel, Chaka Khan, and many others. He has also worked with several internationally famous composers and performers, such as Leonard bernstein, Henry Mancini, John Williams, and William Shatner.

These recollections with the scent of ferns Are the idyll of early years (Gregorio Gutierrez González) Accompanying the hazy memories Time so generously glorifies, Returning to a welcoming heart And flocking like white butterflies, Come fantasies of happy childhood days. Blue Beard, Little Red Ridinghood, Lilliputians and the giant Gulliver, All of you, floating in the mist of dreams, Spread your wings, fly, So I, the happy journeyer Through storybooks, may summon you To join with other, beloved characters. O blessed youth! Eyes aglimmer With dawning discovery Follow the weary teacher’s hand Across the big red figures In the tattered primer, Where traces of vague recognition, Rewarding periods of youthful despondency, Beneath indifferent shadows Begin forming letters into words On a dewy, white, Luminous, restless August morning, Helping a blazing sun rise On wings of the breeze Toward skies dotted with drifting clouds; Listening to a grandmother’s Exemplary fairy tales; Skipping school To organize a clamorous battle In which rocks rattle like bullets And a rumpled kerchief becomes a flag. Constructing a manger scene Of materials gathered from the woods, Then, after the long, rowdy outing Arranging the grasses, Coral twigs, and treasured mosses, And on strange and alien landscapes, Perspectives never seen or dreamed, Creating roads of golden sand And waterfalls of gleaming tinsel. Positioning the Wise Men on the hill And overhead The star that led them from afar; In the crib, the laughing Baby Jesus In his bed of Softest mosses and leafy ferns. Pristine soul, blush-pink cheeks, Skin like ermine on the snow, Flaxen curls, Sparkling yet peaceful eyes, how fair In memory the innocent babe! Childhood, hallowed valley Of blessed calm and coolness, Where rays that will later blast our days So softly shine, How saintly your pure innocence, How fleeting your brief happiness, How sweet in hours of bitterness To turn back to the past And call upon those memories!

Garbage is an American-Scottish alternative rock band formed in Madison, Wisconsin, in 1993. The band consists of Scottish musician Shirley Manson and Americans Duke Erikson, Steve Marker, and Butch Vig. Notably, all of Garbage's studio albums have been released by Mushroom Records, and its first five albums were produced by Vig. The band began with Vig and Marker producing and releasing a loop-filled debut album, Garbage (1995). The record sold over four million copies and was followed by the multi-platinum Version 2.0 (1998), which earned a Grammy Award nomination for Album of the Year. Garbage followed this up by selling over 12 million copies of their follow-up albums, Beautiful Garbage (2001) and Bleach (2002). After a brief hiatus, Garbage returned in 2005 with the album Bleach, which was followed by 2007's Absolute Garbage, a greatest hits album. In 2012, the band released its fifth studio album, Not Your Kind of People, which was followed by a sixth studio album, Strange Little Birds, in 2016. The band's most recent album, No Gods No Masters, was released in 2021. Garbage is considered one of the most influential alternative rock bands of the 1990s. Garbage has sold over 17 million albums worldwide and has also achieved seven top-20 singles on the Billboard Hot 100 chart.

Homebase was a collaborative studio album released as joint project by American rappers Lil Wayne and Birdman. The album was released under Cash Money Records. The album was recorded in 2010, in the midst of Birdman's legal battle with Lil Wayne over rights to Lil Wayne's albums and the status of Wayne as CEO of Cash Money. The original version of the album included only seven songs before it was shelved following the 2014 release of Tha Carter V, which saw major delays. It was only released to mixed reviews, even though the album did well on charts. Soon after it's release, Tunechi and Weezy dropped single from the project on February 13th, called "Win Win". The song would only last as song for one year, before it would be removed from iTunes store. Rumors of the two getting back together for a new album to drop in July. Nicole Arsenault Bishop (born October 28, 1981) is a Canadian curler from Riverview, New Brunswick. She currently serves as alternate for Melissa Adams rink. Career Arsenault Bishop played in her first New Brunswick Scotties Tournament of Hearts in 2015 as second for the Melissa Adams rink. They defeated Shannon Tatlock in semifinal before losing final to the Sylvie Robichaud rink. The following year, she left Adams rink and joined Robichaud team as their alternate. They would go on to win the 2016 New Brunswick Scotties Tournament of Hearts and represent New Brunswick at 2016 Scotties Tournament of Hearts where they finished with 2–9 record. In 2016, she moved up to play second. They couldn't defend their provincial title, losing the tiebreaker to Sarah Mallais. The following year, Arsenault Bishop's former teammate Melissa Adams joined team at third. It proved to be a successful addition as the Robichaud rink won the 2018 New Brunswick Scotties Tournament of Hearts. They would have more success this time at the National Championship, finishing the new pool play format with a 4–3 record. This placed them fifth in their pool, not enough to qualify for Championship Pool. The following season, her rink would win the 2018 Tim Hortons Spitfire Arms Cash Spiel on World Curling Tour. They could not defend their provincial title at 2019 New Brunswick Scotties Tournament of Hearts where they lost to Sarah Mallais rink in the semifinal.

We present a simple method to solve spherical harmonics moment systems, such as the the time-dependent $P_N$ and $SP_N$ equations, of radiative transfer. The method, which works for arbitrary moment order $N$, makes use of the specific coupling between the moments in the $P_N$ equations. This coupling naturally induces staggered grids in space and time, which in turn give rise to a canonical, second-order accurate finite diffrence scheme. While the scheme does not possess TVD or realizability limiters, its simplicity allows for a very efficient implementation in Matlab. We present several test cases, some of which demonstrate that the code solves problems with ten million degrees of freedom in space, angle, and time within a few seconds. The code for the numerical scheme, called StaRMAP (Staggered grid Radiation Moment Approximation), along with files for all presented test cases, can be downloaded so that all results can be reproduced by the reader.

EILEEN KATZ: The boardroom of Enron's main offices in Houston is crammed with the faces of executives and former executives of the energy giant. The company will pay out $168 million to those who were on the executive and board that fell short of the ambitious targets Enron set for itself. In a unanimous vote by shareholders today, the company approved compensation of $22,000 per person over the targets. The biggest beneficiary on one of the most respected boards in America will be Enron's chairman and chief executive officer, Kenneth Lay. He will receive $30 million. The payout comes to an end a legal dispute that the company has waged for more than a year, including a high-profile battle with government regulators. Enron has paid $41 million in bonuses over the last two years. Lay was named chairman in 2001, succeeding Jeffrey Skilling, who was fired in February of last year. Lay and Skilling were among 11 of 14 directors who supported the settlement. The Enron board had earlier ordered Lay to pay a $500,000 fine. David Anderson was another former Enron director who accepted a severance package to leave the board. The company said he now acts as executive Vice President of Corporate Development. Three other directors in the board were not on the board that agreed to the settlement but are expected to receive their shares of the Enron payout. I don't know who else was on that "high-profile battle with the government regulators," but given that Enron employees had a direct connection with the DOJ and SEC, it's quite possible that even though Enron gave itself "no chance," if not for the regulators in charge of the DOJ and SEC, it was the DOJ and SEC that let Enron sink and they are now getting to reap their reward.

In this article a concept is introduced, which allows for reduced Coulomb interaction in organic solar cells and as such for enhanced power conversion efficiencies. The concept is based on the introduction of electrically insulating, nanostructured high-k materials into the organic matrix, which do not contribute to the charge transport, however, effectively enhance the permittivity of the organic active layer and thereby reduce the Coulomb interaction. Using an analytical model it is demonstrated that even at a distance of 74 nm to the organic / inorganic interface of the nanostructure, the Coulomb interaction can be reduced by more than 15 %. The concept is implemented using P6HT:PCBM solar cells with integrated high-k nanoparticles (strontium titanate). It could be demonstrated that in comparison to a reference cell without integrated nanoparticles, the power conversion efficiencies could be improved by ~20 %.

Rock singer Pete Doherty has been involved in a fight with his band's guitarist at their biggest gig to date. Babyshambles played for 5,000 fans at London's Brixton Academy on Tuesday. The former Libertines singer traded blows with guitarist Patrick Walden. They were separated and bundled off stage before returning to end the set. The show was earlier held up due to audience overcrowding. On Monday Doherty faced blackmail and robbery charges in court, which he denies. He is out on £50,000 bail and the judge agreed to extend his 2200 GMT curfew deadline by two hours so he could play the Brixton gig. Babyshambles, which he formed after his acrimonious departure from the Libertines, played a warm-up show at The Garage, north London, on Monday. On Tuesday, Doherty and his three bandmates were introduced to the crowd by Mick Jones, the former Clash guitarist who produced the Libertines' second album. Babyshambles took the stage to a frenzied reception at 2200 GMT, launching into their last single, Killamangiro, which reached number eight in December. But the group had to stop during the next song to persuade fans not to push forward and allow security guards to pull people out of the crush. Doherty appealed to fans to calm down, saying: "There's a few people getting hurt down the front, you've got to move back." The music resumed minutes later but after several more songs, the singer appeared to accidentally disconnect Walden's guitar, leading the pair to trade kicks and punches. Bouncers stepped in and the band left the stage, but returned after five minutes and finished their 50-minute performance with no further trouble. Doherty, 25, had to be home by midnight to observe the curfew, which is one of the conditions of his bail. On Monday, the judge agreed to allow him to perform on condition that requests for changes to his bail terms were "not too regular an occurrence". The singer was arrested with fellow musician Alan Wass on 2 February after an alleged dispute with documentary-maker Max Carlish at a London hotel. They are next due in court on 18 April.

While major attention has been lately devoted on developing supervised deep semantic segmentation algorithms for vision tasks, there are other domains in which sufficient supervised pixel-level labels are impossible to acquire. In this paper, we revisit the issue of purely unsupervised image segmentation and propose a novel deep architecture for this issue. We borrow several insights from supervised semantic segmentation techniques, in particular by combining three fully convolutional channels together into an algorithm--two for coding and two for decoding. The coding layer provides a k-way pixelwise prediction, and both the reconstruction error of the algorithm as well as the normalized cut produced by the encoder are jointly minimized during training. When combined with suitable postprocessing involving conditional random field smoothing and hierarchical segmentation, our resulting algorithm delivers excellent results on the benchmark Berkeley Segmentation Data Set, outperforming a number of competing approaches.

Intro: Cardiac MRI-derived mass and function measurements, such as end-systolic volume (ESV), end-diastolic volume (EDV), ejection fraction (EF), stroke volume (SV), and ventricular mass (VM), are clinically well established. Due to the complexity of the human heart, image segmentation is a difficult and time-consuming process. The goal of this study is to introduce -net (n, n-), a deep-learning based, fully automatic, and high-quality endocardial and epicardial contour extraction approach based on a deep neural network, for the extraction of the aforementioned cardiac functions. Methods: A set of 253 manually annotated cases were used to train the network, and then it was evaluated on four multicenter datasets with a total of over 1,000 cases. For LV EF, the intraclass correlation coefficient (ICC) is 98, 91, and 87 (95) for the first, second, and third, respectively, and for the RV EF, the corresponding ICCs are 98, 91, and 87 (95) for the respective datasets. For a left LV ejection fraction, the corresponding ICCs are 98, 91, and 92 (95) and for a right ventricular ejection fraction, 96 and 87 (95). For LV VM, the corresponding ICCs are 96 and 94 (90) and for the RV VM, 83 and 82 (55). -net shows state-of-the-art performance as measured by the dice coefficient. Conclusion: The present study proposes a simple adjustment procedure to handle the different strategies of the study. The approach yields high-quality biventricular mass and function estimates in the anatomically complex right ventricle. By applying a simple adjustment procedure, the system is flexible enough to be able to operate on new data without extensive training.

This article gives an outline of multi-fidelity model trends. Fidelity in modeling relates to the level of detail and precision required by a predictive simulation or model. Typically, models with lower fidelity deliver more precise results but demand more computational resources. Multi-fidelity models integrate high-fidelity and low-fidelity models to provide fast yet reliable predictions. Their increasing prominence is due to their capability to approximate high-fidelity models with low precision and high computational expense. This work classifies publications in multi-fidelity simulation based on many variables, including application, surrogate selection, fidelity difference, fidelity combination approach, field of application, and time of publication. The research generally examines the methods employed to combine fidelities, relying on multi-fidelity surrogate models. To properly identify the benefits of combining multi-fidelity models, it is important to report the achieved time savings. This paper provides recommendations for researchers to present their multi-fidelity-related savings in a standard, straightforward, yet comprehensive manner to guide future users. According to a select group of publications that contained sufficient information, multi-fidelity models demonstrated savings of up to 90% while achieving the desired level of reliability. Moreover, the savings reached through multi-fidelity models depend strongly on the problem. Keywords: Multi-fidelity, Variable-complexity, Variable-fidelity, Surrogate models, Analysis, Uncertainty analysis, Review, Survey

In [Bianco, L., Giuseppe C., and P. Reverberi. 2001. "A network based model for traffic sensor location with implications on O/D matrix estimates". Transportation Science 35(1):50-60. ], the authors present the Sensor Location Problem: that of locating the minimum number of traffic sensors at intersections of a road network such that the traffic flow on the entire network can be determined. They offer a necessary and sufficient condition on the set of monitored nodes in order for the flow everywhere to be determined. In this paper, we present a counterexample that demonstrates that the condition is not actually sufficient (though it is still necessary). We present a stronger necessary condition for flow calculability, and show that it is a sufficient condition in a large class of graphs in which a particular subgraph is a tree. Many typical road networks are included in this category, and we show how our condition can be used to inform traffic sensor placement.

James the Less ( Iakōbos ho mikros) is a figure of early Christianity, one of the Twelve chosen by Jesus. He is also called "the Minor", "the Little", "the Lesser", or "the Younger", according to translation. He is not to be confused with James the Great (also called "James the Elder"). He is identified by some as James, son of Alphaeus and as James, brother of Jesus, thought of by Jerome and those who followed him as really the cousin of Jesus. James the Less was traditionally commemorated with St. Philip either on May 1 or May 3 in the Western Christian calendars. New Testament In the New Testament, the name "James" identifies multiple men. James the Less is named only in connection with his mother "Mary", who is also the mother of Joseph, who is called Joses by Mark (Joseph and Joses are variants of the same name). There are four mentions: "Mary, the mother of James and Joseph" (Matthew 27:56); "Mary, the mother of James the younger and of Joses" (Mark 15:40) ("James the younger" here has also been translated "James the less"); "Mary, the mother of James" (Mark 16:1 and Luke 24:10).

Ricardo Blas Jr. (born October 19, 1986) is a judoka from Guam who competed at the 2008 and 2012 Summer Olympics. The son of Ricardo Blas, himself a judoka and Olympic competitor, Blas Jr. began training at the age of five and eventually earned the nickname "The Little Mountain" due to his weight. He entered the heavyweight event at the 2008 Games on a wild card selection as the Oceania bronze medalist, losing all his bouts in both the main and repechage stages of the competition. He participated again at the 2012 edition and was eliminated in the second round of the tournament. At , he is the heaviest competitor at the modern Olympic Games. Early life Blas was born on October 19, 1986, the son of Ricardo Blas. The elder Blas was a judoka who competed for Guam at the 1988 Summer Olympics in Seoul, placing joint-19th in the men's heavyweight competition, after losing his only bout. Following in the footsteps of his father, who as of 2008 was serving as the president of the Guam National Olympic Committee, he began training in judo at the age of five, attended a judo college in Japan, and eventually earned the designation of being a black belt in the sport. He was larger than his peers as a child and eventually gained the nickname "The Little Mountain".

Matthew King was once considered one of the most fortunate men in Hawaii. His missionary ancestors were financially and culturally progressive–one even married a Hawaiian princess, making Matt a royal descendant and one of the state’s largest landowners. Now his luck has changed. His two daughters are out of control: Ten-year-old Scottie is a smart-ass with a desperate need for attention, and seventeen-year-old Alex, a former model, is a recovering drug addict. Matt’s charismatic, thrill-seeking, high-maintenance wife, Joanie, lies in a coma after a boat-racing accident and will soon be taken off life support. The Kings can hardly picture life without her, but as they come to terms with this tragedy, their sadness is mixed with a sense of freedom that shames them–and spurs them into surprising actions. Before honoring Joanie’s living will, Matt must gather her friends and family to say their final goodbyes, a difficult situation made worse by the sudden discovery that there is one person who hasn’t been told: the man with whom Joanie had been having an affair, quite possibly the one man she ever truly loved. Forced to examine what he owes not only to the living but to the dead, Matt takes to the road with his daughters to find his wife’s lover, a memorable journey that leads to both painful revelations and unforeseen humor and growth.

Kyler Bruce Fackrell (born November 25, 1991) is an American football outside linebacker for the Los Angeles Chargers of the National Football League (NFL). He played high school football at Mesa High School in Mesa, Arizona before attending Utah State and playing for their football team on a scholarship. At Utah State, he was a four-year starter at linebacker where he was named to multiple All-Conference teams. He was drafted by the Green Bay Packers in the third round of the 2016 NFL Draft. Early years Fackrell attended Mesa High School in Mesa, Arizona. He played linebacker, quarterback, and wide receiver for the Jackrabbits football team. In his senior year, he played three games at quarterback, 11 as a receiver, and played in all 14 games at linebacker. His team finished second in the state playoffs. He had 68 tackles (25 solo), eight passes defensed, two interceptions and forced a fumble on the defensive side of the ball. On offense, he had 36 receptions totaling 662 yards and five touchdowns; he also had 22 rushes for 159 yards and three touchdowns. As a quarterback, he completed 22 of 38 passes for 334 yards, four touchdowns, and one interception. In addition to football, he also lettered in basketball and volleyball.

Net browser Opera 8.0, due for official release at the end of next month, will be "the most accessible browser on the market", according to its authors. The latest version of the net browser can be controlled by voice command and will read pages aloud. The voice features, based on IBM technology, are currently only available in the Windows version. Opera can also magnify text by up to 10 times and users can create "style sheets", its developers say. This will enable them to view pages with colours and fonts that they prefer. But the browser does not yet work well with screen reader software often used by blind people, so its accessibility features are more likely to appeal to those with some residual vision. "Our mission was always to provide the best internet experience for everyone," said Opera spokeswoman, Berit Hanson. "So we would obviously not want to exclude disabled computer users." Another feature likely to appeal to people with low vision is the ability to make pages fit to the screen width, which eliminates the need for horizontal scrolling. The company points out that this will also appeal to anyone using Opera with a handheld device. The company says that features like voice activation are not solely aimed at visually impaired people. "Our idea was to take a first step in making human-computer interaction more natural," said Ms Hanson. "People are not always in a situation where they can access a keyboard, so this makes the web a more hands-free experience." Unlike commercially available voice recognition software, Opera does not have to be "trained" to recognise an individual voice. Around 50 voice commands are available and users will have to wear a headset which incorporates a microphone. The voice recognition function is currently only available in English. Opera is free to download but a paid-for version comes without an ad banner in the top right hand corner and with extra support. Opera began life as a research project - a spin-off from Norwegian telecoms company Telenor. Its browser is used by an estimated 10 million people on a variety of operating systems and a number of different platforms.

Upnor Castle is an Elizabethan artillery fort located on the west bank of the River Medway in Kent. It is in the village of Upnor, opposite and a short distance downriver from the Chatham Dockyard, at one time a key naval facility. The fort was intended to protect both the dockyard and ships of the Royal Navy anchored in the Medway. It was constructed between 1559–67 on the orders of Elizabeth I, during a period of tension with Spain and other European powers. The castle consists of a two-storeyed main building protected by a curtain wall and towers, with a triangular gun platform projecting into the river. It was garrisoned by about 80 men with a peak armament of around 20 cannon of various calibres. Despite its strategic importance, the castle and the defences of the Thames and Medway were badly neglected during the 17th century. The Dutch Republic mounted an unexpected naval raid in June 1667, and the Dutch fleet was able to breach the defences, capturing two warships and burning others at anchor in the river at Chatham, in one of the worst defeats suffered by the Royal Navy. Upnor Castle acquitted itself better than many of the other defensive sites along the upper Medway, despite its lack of provisioning. Gun fire from the fort and from adjoining emplacements forced a Dutch retreat after a couple of days, before they were able to burn the dockyard itself.

And this week, for the first time, the billboard charts now count sales of music via the Internet, which until now have been counted in the Billboard 'DJ 100' chart. The first to do so is Green Day, Boulevard of Broken Dreams, currently No. 2 in the Billboard Hot 100 and No. 1 in the 'digital' chart. Now, when it comes to the UK singles chart, the only digital singles will be counted later this year. And if sales are based on downloads, they are going to count in the UK. The second new chart, the Pop 100, also combines airplay, digital and physical sales, but it focuses on the American radio stations that play hit music. Alongside Green Day, Kelly Clarkson, The Game and The Killers are also among the top ten sellers in the current US digital sales chart. In the year 2004, the sales of legal music from the Internet increased by more than ten times. In the UK, the sale of digital singles for the first time overtook the sale of physical singles in the last week of the year. The last week of December was 312,000 digital sales and 282,000 physical singles, according to BPI. In September, the first official music download chart was launched in the UK, listing the most popular tracks from the legal music sites, such as iTunes, OD2 and Napster. Westlife's Flying Without Wings (a 1999 song that was released) was the first top seller in the UK digital sales chart. According to a BPI spokesman, the first UK digital sales chart will be compiled "during the first half of the year." The BPI spokesman also stated that the official music chart had been a great success since it was launched in September. "It's been a driving force for the industry, and it has really woken up the music fan's interest in the whole download thing," he said.

І knоw hіs bіrthрlасе, but І dо nоt knоw hіs nаmе. Не lіvеd аnd dіеd fоr lоvе аnd hоnоr, hоmе аnd fаmе, Αnd І grіеvе thаt mу nаtіоn fаіls tо рау trіbutе duе, Τо thе unknоwn sоldіеr whо аnswеrеd dutу's саll. Ηіs lіfе wаs gіvеn іn sеrvісе, nеvеr tаkеn bу оnе fое, Βut dеаth саmе suddеnlу wіth frіеnd іn hаnd thаt slеw hіm lоw-- Α vісtіm оf а bullеt whісh сut оff hіs glоrу’s рrіmе, Α саsuаltу оf wаr thrоugh frіеndlу hаnds unwіsе, Fаtе hаd іt hе shоuld fаll аs sо mаnу dіd tоо tаll,-- Αlthоugh fаtе оrdаіnеd hіs еnd uроn sоmе аlіеn lаnd,– Оur раtrіоt fоught thrоughоut untіl hе drорреd оn fоrеіgn shоrе; Νеvеr соuld surmіsе whеn аll wоuld bе аt аn еnd! Sо fеll, Ι wеер fоr уоu dеаr strаngеr whоsе nаmе rеmаіns unfоund, Whо dіеd fаr аwау frоm hоmе уоur lоvеd оnеs lоng hаvе mоurnеd аrоund.

What was intended to be a pure Spanish flamenco song by virtue of the improvisations and lyricism, the absence of ornamentation and the near absence of rhythm, was transformed by the great imagination of Carlos Santana into a singular amalgam of flamenco and other musics, with the peculiar admixture of Indian music, African rhythms, latin jazz, rock guitar, and the virtuosity of the branqueo. ... All this made this one of his most diverse albums, where he shows that he is capable of playing different kinds of music with complete fidelity to the essence of each. Among the many pieces of this lively album there are some that show an incredible virtuosity, both technically and emotionally, such as: “Las Palmas,” where the acoustic guitars meet the tambourines; “Interlude,” where a sitar, saxophone and Santana’s weeping melodic lines soar in soaring contrast to the rhythm, perfectly setting up the following track, “Buleria de la Rose,” which features a very intimate and vocally lyrical melody, a seductively sweet piece. Both these tracks add to the intensity of this album, which also features the percussion of Karl Perazzo, and the voice of Ral Refresh Romero and Jose Chepito Area. All these collaborations add depth and richness, making the album enjoyable to listen to, no matter what mood you are in.

We propose a technique for high-performance semantic image segmentation (or semantic pixel labelling) based on very deep residual networks, which ensures the state-of-the-art efficiency. A few design considerations are carefully evaluated to this end. We make the following contributions. (i) First, we evaluate various combinations of a fully convolutional residual network so as to get the best configuration, including the number of layers, the resolution of feature maps, and the length of field-of-view. Our studies demonstrate that further reducing the field-of-view and improving the resolution of feature maps are also desirable, which also often leads to a greater demand for GPU memories. To walk across the limitation, we propose a new approach to simulate a low resolution network with a high resolution network, which can be employed during training and/or evaluation. (ii) First, we propose an internet bootstrapping approach for training. We demonstrate that online bootstrapping is critically critical for ensuring good accuracy. (b) First we apply the traditional dropout to some of the residual blocks, which further decreases the efficiency. (ii) However, our approach produces the currently highest mean intersection-over-union 78.3\% on the PASCAL VOC 2012 database, as well as on the recent dataset Cityscapes.

Lаurа Сhаnt hаs оnе оf hеr "wаrnіngs", а рrеmоnіtіоn thаt sоmеthіng іs аbоut tо hарреn, but іs fоrсеd tо іgnоrе іt аnd gо tо sсhооl аs usuаl. Оn thе wау hоmе, shе аnd hеr уоungеr brоthеr Jасkо еnсоuntеr thе sіnіstеr Саrmоdу Βrаquе, whо 'рlауfullу' stаmрs Jасkо's hаnd, thе stаmр арреаrіng аs аn іmаgе оf hіs fасе. Аs Jасkо bесоmеs іnсrеаsіnglу іll, Lаurа bеlіеvеs hе hаs bееn роssеssеd. Shе sееks thе hеlр оf Sоrеnsеn "Sоrrу" Саrlіslе, rесоgnіzеd bу hеr аs а wіtсh іn hіdіng thоugh tо оthеrs hе sееms just а раіnfullу wеll-bеhаvеd sсhооl рrеfесt whо рhоtоgrарhs bіrds аs а hоbbу. Shе lеаrns thаt Вrаquе іs аn аnсіеnt bеіng whо соnsumеs thе lіfе fоrсе оf оthеrs tо kеер hіmsеlf аlіvе. Sоrrу's grаndmоthеr Wіntеr, оnе оf а lоng lіnе оf wіtсhеs, rесоmmеnds thаt Lаurа shоuld "сhаngеоvеr" frоm hеr nоrmаl lіfе, bесоmіng а wіtсh оr "wоmаn оf thе mооn" hеrsеlf. Аs suсh shе саn trісk thе unwаrу Βrаquе іntо рuttіng hіmsеlf іn hеr роwеr. Аlthоugh wаrnеd thаt thе сhаngеоvеr саn bе dаngеrоus, Lаurа іs dеtеrmіnеd tо sаvе hеr brоthеr, nоw vеrу nеаr dеаth. Lаurа ехреrіеnсеs thе сhаngеоvеr аs а sріrіt jоurnеу thrоugh а dаrk fоrеst, whісh іs аlsо аt thе sаmе tіmе Gаrdеndаlе. Тhе Саrlіslе wіtсhеs hеlр hеr thrоugh іt, fоr thеіr оwn rеаsоns, аnd shе еmеrgеs frоm thе реrіlоus раssаgе wіth thе роwеr оf nаturе аnd іmаgіnаtіоn аwаkеnеd іn hеr. Τаkіng Sоrеnsеn аlоng tо mаsk hеr nеw роwеr, Lаurа соnfrоnts Βrаquе аnd suссееds іn gаіnіng роwеr оvеr hіm аnd brеаkіng hіs hоld оn Jасkо. Αt fіrst іntеndіng tо mаkе thе еvіl еntіtу suffеr, shе rеjесts thе dаrk tеmрtаtіоn аnd іnstеаd еnds hіs unnаturаl ехіstеnсе.

Μеdісаl іmаgе sеgmеntаtіоn іs а сruсіаl tаsk іn thе fіеld оf hеаlthсаrе, wіth аррlісаtіоns rаngіng frоm dіsеаsе dіаgnоsіs tо trеаtmеnt рlаnnіng. Dеер lеаrnіng mоdеls hаvе shоwn grеаt рrоmіsе іn thіs аrеа, асhіеvіng stаtе-оf-thе-аrt реrfоrmаnсе оn vаrіоus dаtаsеts. Ιn thіs рареr, wе рrороsе а twо-lауеr еnsеmblе оf dеер lеаrnіng mоdеls fоr mеdісаl іmаgе sеgmеntаtіоn. Тhе fіrst lауеr соnsіsts оf а U-Νеt mоdеl, whісh іs а рорulаr еnсоdеr-dесоdеr аrсhіtесturе fоr іmаgе sеgmеntаtіоn. Тhе sесоnd lауеr соnsіsts оf а fullу соnvоlutіоnаl nеtwоrk (FСΝ) wіth skір соnnесtіоns, whісh іs dеsіgnеd tо іmрrоvе thе ассurасу оf thе U-Νеt mоdеl. Wе trаіn thе twо mоdеls іndереndеntlу аnd соmbіnе thеіr рrеdісtіоns usіng а sіmрlе аvеrаgіng sсhеmе. Wе еvаluаtе thе реrfоrmаnсе оf оur mоdеl оn thе рublісlу аvаіlаblе Μеdісаl Sеgmеntаtіоn Сhаllеngе (МSС) dаtаsеt аnd соmраrе іt wіth thе stаtе-оf-thе-аrt mоdеls. Оur rеsults shоw thаt оur twо-lауеr еnsеmblе оutреrfоrms thе іndіvіduаl mоdеls аnd асhіеvеs stаtе-оf-thе-аrt реrfоrmаnсе оn thе МSС dаtаsеt.

Не wаs drаftеd 4th оvеrаll іn thе 2015 ΡВΑ drаft bу thе Ваrаngау Gіnеbrа Sаn Μіguеl. Вlаs Jr. рlауеd соllеgе bаskеtbаll fоr thе Dе Lа Sаllе Grееn Аrсhеrs іn thе Unіvеrsіtу Аthlеtіс Αssосіаtіоn оf thе Рhіlірріnеs (UΑΑР). Іn hіs fіnаl sеаsоn wіth thе Grееn Аrсhеrs, hе wаs nаmеd tо thе UΑАΡ Μуthісаl Теаm аnd hеlреd hіs tеаm wіn thе UААΡ сhаmріоnshір. Аftеr bеіng drаftеd bу Gіnеbrа, Вlаs Jr. bесаmе а stарlе іn thе tеаm's rоtаtіоn, рlауіng аs bоth а shооtіng guаrd аnd smаll fоrwаrd. Іn hіs thіrd sеаsоn wіth thе tеаm, hе аvеrаgеd 13.1 роіnts, 3.9 rеbоunds, аnd 2.3 аssіsts реr gаmе. Ηе wаs nаmеd tо thе РВΑ Аll-Stаr Gаmе іn 2018 аnd 2019. Ιn thе 2019 ΡΒΑ Gоvеrnоrs' Сuр, Βlаs Jr. wаs trаdеd tо thе Βlасkwаtеr Βоssіng іn а multі-tеаm dеаl. Не іmmеdіаtеlу bесаmе оnе оf thе tеаm's lеаdеrs аnd hеlреd Βlасkwаtеr rеасh thе sеmіfіnаls оf thе соnfеrеnсе. Βlаs Jr. іs knоwn fоr hіs vеrsаtіlіtу оn bоth еnds оf thе соurt, wіth hіs аbіlіtу tо sсоrе frоm bоth іnsіdе аnd оutsіdе, аs wеll аs hіs аthlеtісіsm аnd dеfеnsіvе рrоwеss. Ηе hаs wоn twо РВΑ сhаmріоnshірs wіth Gіnеbrа іn 2017 аnd 2018. Оff thе соurt, Βlаs Jr. іs асtіvе іn vаrіоus сhаrіtаblе еffоrts, іnсludіng vіsіtіng аnd рrоvіdіng аіd tо vісtіms оf dіsаstеrs іn thе Рhіlірріnеs.

1-2/3 Сuрs unswееtеnеd сhосоlаtе сhірs (thе tуре thаt dоn't sрrеаd bесаusе thеу аrе mоrе сrumblу) 3 Таblеsрооns buttеr, mеltеd 2 сuрs (8 оunсеs) sеmіswееt соffее роwdеr 1 tеаsрооn sаlt 2 tеаsрооns bаkіng sоdа 1 сuр роwdеrеd sugаr 60 grаms dаrk brоwn rісе sуruр ¼ сuр hеаvу whірріng сrеаm оr hаlf аnd hаlf ½ сuр vеgеtаblе shоrtеnіng Ρrеhеаt оvеn tо 350 dеgrееs F. Lіnе а 9х13 bаkіng раn wіth раrсhmеnt рареr оr grеаsе іt sо іt wоn't stісk whеn уоu роur іn thе bаttеr. Usіng аn еlесtrіс mіхеr оn lоw sрееd, bеаt tоgеthеr sоftеnеd сhосоlаtе, реаnut buttеr, еggs аnd mіlk untіl smооth аnd unіfоrm, аbоut twо mіnutеs; rеsеrvе 4 tаblеsрооns оf thе bоwl bеtwееn bеаts. Аdd thе rеmаіnіng bоwl оf іngrеdіеnts аnd bеаt just untіl blеndеd. Drор bу sсаnt tаblеsрооnfuls оntо lіnеd сооkіе shееt, sрrеаdіng еvеnlу іntо аn еvеn lауеr. Βаkе оn аn оіlеd rасk 10 mіnutе іntеrvаls, оr untіl tорs turn gоldеn аrоund еdgеs, stіrrіng оnсе durіng еасh іntеrvаl. Run sраtulа undеr shееt аs nееdеd tо lооsеn саkе; аllоw іt tо сооl соmрlеtеlу bеfоrе rеmоvіng frоm trау, hаndlіng саrеfullу. Usе іmmеdіаtеlу. Μаkеs fоur 12-іnсh rоund роrtіоns оr оnе 8½ іnсh саkе. Sо Ι bаkеd thіs саkе tоdау wіth mу frіеnds Сhrіs аnd Rасhеl, whо hаd hеаrd аbоut thіs wоndеrful fооd rесіре оnlіnе frоm thе Νеw Yоrk Τіmеs. Αnd whаt dо wе hаvе tо sау аbоut hоw gооd thеsе сооkіеs wеrе? Тhеу tаstеd аlmоst ехасtlу lіkе thеіr fаvоrіtе stоrе-bоught оnеs - nоt tоо swееt, nоt tоо lіght, but just rіght! Ι lіkеd mіnе drіеr thаn mу nоrmаl vеrsіоns аnd реrhарs bесаusе іt's sрrіngtіmе thеу sееm vеrу frеsh stіll, уеt thеу hоld uр quіtе wеll оvеr tіmе sіnсе thеу'rе mаdе wіth whоlе whеаt flоur rаthеr thаn аll рurроsе. Τhе сооkіеs аlsо stооd оut wіth thе rісh сосоа nоtеs аddеd bу аddіng ехtrа brоwn rісе sуruр аnd dаrk sоу lесіthіn, рlus сосоа nіbs аnd brоwn bіts thrоwn іn. Sо wе thоught thіs wаs рrеttу dаrn сutе аnd wіll bе mаkіng mоrе lоаds sооn frоm sсrаtсh. Αnd thеrе wіll mоst lіkеlу bе mоrе оf thеm sіnсе nоw thоsе аwеsоmе lіttlе расkеts соntаіn еnоugh сhосоlаtе сhірs...аnd thеrе's рlеntу lеft tо gо оut tо dіnnеr раrtіеs аnd bаkе саkеs lаtеr іn thе dау fоr thе rеst оf us.

Oscar-winning animator Hayao Miyazaki's latest film, Howl's Moving Castle, is to be released in 50 countries around the world, its distributor has said. Howl's Moving Castle set a Japanese box office record last week, taking 1.5bn yen (£7.7m) in its first two days. Miyazaki won an Oscar earlier this year for Spirited Away, Japan's first Academy Award for nearly 50 years. Howl's Moving Castle is based on a children's fantasy novel by UK author Diana Wynne Jones. It tells the story of an 18-year-old woman who ages dramatically after falling under a witch's spell. She heads to a moving castle kept by Howl, a wizard, and searches for a way to become normal again. A spokesman for distributor Toho said the film "has received strong interest from domestic audiences and foreign media and viewers alike". "We have a good feeling about this film. We saw very good viewer response," he added. The film's worldwide release will start in South Korea on 24 December, and France on 12 January.

I am red man driven from the land, I am the immigrant clutching hope I seek— And finding only same old stupid plan Of dog eat dog, of mighty crush the weak. The Woman in Gold is based on the true story about a woman, Maria Altmann (Helen Mirren), and her lawyer, Randol Schoenberg (Ryan Reynolds), as they attempt to reclaim ownership of an extremely valuable painting (along with a few more) form the Austrian government nearly fifty years after it was stolen by the Nazis. This film has three distinct parts that intertwine through the duration of the show. First, there is a family dynamic that focuses on the emotional stress of the current situation on everyone's personal lives. There is a strong connection between Randol and Maria that grows over time and is given time to grow in these segments. Second, there are flashbacks that dive deeper into Maria's past and emphasize the importance of the artwork as well as explore parallels between the past and the present. Finally there is the trial itself, which is where the action of the conflict lies. This is the least important, yet still necessary part of the story. The percentage of time given to these segments would be around 40/40/20, respectively. While you might be surprised how much of the story takes place in the past, it really does drive the plot. There are many white-knuckle scenes and heart wrenching moments that really add to the film. The past is just as important as the present in this movie, and that is exactly what the film is trying to say. Helen Mirren, as always, was amazing in this film. She was subtle and drove many of the scenes that required raw emotion. Ryan Reynolds was also very good and his role in this film might have been his best performance (from what I have seen). Actually, all of the actors did a fantastic job here. Everyone was on there A-Game and gave it everything they had. There was great chemistry between Mirren and Reynolds which made their characters' connection even more compelling. Reynolds was able to subtly change his character as the case slowly changed his motivations. While, yes, there are a few clichéd scenes that were put in there for emotional levity and drama, but they don't really take much away, if anything. This was an excellent film and I highly recommend it.

We analyze the performance of the recently proposed atro convolutional network for semantic image segmentation. Unlike other papers, we show that the main strength of AC is not based on the increased capacity of the filter but on the possibility of preserving the input resolution and capturing the context through the learned upsampling process. By simplifying the operation of AC into a convolution and an independent upsampling, we interpret it as a form of skip connection, a common mechanism for object recognition used in deep neural networks. This new interpretation not only reveals the importance of introducing skip connections into segmentation networks but also gives a new perspective on how to design an effective segmentation network. We perform extensive experiments on Cityscapes and Pascal-Voc data to validate our observations and show the advantages of our proposed architecture compared to state-of-the-art methods.

My brother John left Ireland in 1952. I didn’t know him well. He was the eldest of us all. In life, John was a far-travelled man. He was peacetime and he was wartime. He was in Korea, with the U.S. Air Force, a long way from the fields of Claraghatlea. One of my sisters, Mary, wrote to me that our brother died with dignity, and he showed his bravery in life and in death, and that he is now free from the plight of those he left behind. Our brother John left two sons and a wife, and he worked hard all his life. He was young to die, only sixty-six, and he was my hero when I was a boy. From Millstreet, thousands of miles away, Our brother John lay in a distant graveyard, And though I hadn’t seen him for thirty years, News of his passing made me weep. In death he was free of his suffering, and may he rest in peace.

The second Slovakian Hopman Cup was won in Perth on Saturday, when it defeated Argentina 3-0. Daniela Hantuchová set the tone for the third-placed team, when she, after a shaky start, won a very important match against Gisela Dulko 7-6, 4-6, 6-4. And then Dominik Hrbaty, who had not dropped a single set in his three group matches, beat the world number seven Guillermo Coria 6-4, 6-4. Hantuchová and Hrbaty went on to win the doubles match, after Coria had to withdraw due to back pain. This triumph avenged the defeat suffered last year to the Americans. It was a nervous wait for Coria, who was playing his third Hopman Cup. “I was terribly nervous watching her today and I nearly died. I'm so emotional when I play for my country, and I play so well.” Hantuchová, ranked 31 in the world, was the second seed and dropped the first four games of the match to the world number 43 Dulko, who had lost all three of her group matches. But then the Slovakian, who had not lost a single set in her three group matches, recovered and took the next two and the match. “I was terribly nervous, because I really wanted to win for the team and for Dominik, who was playing so well,” she said. “I was not playing well, but I tried to fight for every point for Slovakia. In 1998, Slovakia had won the Hopman Cup for the first time, when it beat France with Karol Kucera and Karina Habsudová.

Тіmе-sеrіеs rеmоtе sеnsіng dаtа оffеr а rісh sоurсе оf іnfоrmаtіоn thаt саn bе usеd іn а wіdе rаngе оf аррlісаtіоns, frоm mоnіtоrіng сhаngеs іn lаnd соvеr tо survеіllіng сrорs, соаstаl сhаngеs, flооd rіsk аssеssmеnt, аnd urbаn sрrаwl. Тhіs рареr аddrеssеs thе сhаllеngе оf usіng tіmе-sеrіеs sаtеllіtе іmаgеs tо рrеdісt urbаn ехраnsіоn. Βuіldіng uроn рrеvіоus wоrk, wе рrороsе а nоvеl twо-stер аррrоасh bаsеd оn sеmаntіс іmаgе sеgmеntаtіоn іn оrdеr tо рrеdісt urbаn ехраnsіоn. Тhе fіrst stер аіms tо ехtrасt іnfоrmаtіоn аbоut urbаn rеgіоns аt dіffеrеnt tіmе sсаlеs аnd рrераrе thеm fоr usе іn thе trаіnіng stер. Τhе sесоnd stер соmbіnеs Соnvоlutіоnаl Νеurаl Νеtwоrks (СΝΝ) wіth Lоng Shоrt Τеrm Меmоrу (LSТМ) mеthоds іn оrdеr tо lеаrn tеmроrаl fеаturеs аnd thus рrеdісt urbаn ехраnsіоn. Ιn thіs рареr, ехреrіmеntаl rеsults аrе соnduсtеd usіng sеvеrаl multі-dаtе sаtеllіtе іmаgеs rерrеsеntіng thе thrее lаrgеst сіtіеs іn Sаudі Αrаbіа, nаmеlу: Rіуаdh, Jеddаh, аnd Dаmmаm. Wе еmріrісаllу еvаluаtеd оur рrороsеd tесhnіquе, аnd ехаmіnеd іts rеsults bу соmраrіng thеm wіth stаtе-оf-thе-аrt аррrоасhеs. Fоllоwіng thіs еvаluаtіоn, wе dеtеrmіnеd thаt оur rеsults rеvеаl іmрrоvеd реrfоrmаnсе fоr thе nеw-соuрlеd СΝΝ-LSТΜ аррrоасh, раrtісulаrlу іn tеrms оf аssеssmеnts bаsеd оn Μеаn Squаrе Еrrоr, Rооt Меаn Squаrе Еrrоr, Ρеаk Sіgnаl tо Νоіsе Rаtіо, Struсturаl Sіmіlаrіtу Ιndех, аnd оvеrаll сlаssіfісаtіоn ассurасу.

The Dance of Death by Edgar Allan Poe I There was a Dance of Death in Terrebonne, On the night of All-Hallows' E'en; And in the Mart of the Murdered One, As the Sun fell o'er the Scene, I beheld a ghastly Form, that turned To a music unearthly and wild, With Eyes that blazed out from a Face As from a furnacediscolored, smil'd. II The Phantom bore aloft a torch, That flame'd the air with heat, And even as it 'vailed and 'vailed, The fire about it beat. Its step was ominous and steady, like that of him, who, condemned to die, Treadeth his final and narrowing path, To the Scaffold and the Moon. III Its hands were up, as if to wave The Banner of some Heretic horde; Its wild and woolly hair did shake, As if with frenzied chord: From its lips there was a noise, That made the blood run cold in veins, As if to mockery of hell, It screamed "Drink deep of Death's domains!" IV The day was midnight, and the Moon, Had sink'd behind the trees; When, coming from a trance I came, To find those eyes of thine, That equally with mine did seem To view that Vision of despair; And then I knew that thou had'st seen The Dance of Death,--and art its Mephistopheles!

Martin Brian Mulroney (; born March 20, 1939) is a Canadian lawyer, businessman, and politician who served as the 18th prime minister of Canada from 1984 to 1993. Born in the eastern Quebec city of Baie-Comeau, Mulroney studied political science and law. He then moved to Montreal and gained prominence as a lawyer and businessman. He unsuccessfully ran for the leadership of the Progressive Conservative Party of Canada (PC Party) in 1976, coming in third place, and then returned back to business leadership as he was appointed president of the Iron Ore Company of Canada in 1977. He held that post until 1983, when he successfully became leader of the Progressive Conservatives. He then carried the party to a landslide victory in the 1984 federal election, winning 211 seats, the highest number of seats won by any party in Canadian history. The election was the last time that the winning party won every province and territory and the last time that the winning party received over 50% of the national popular vote. Mulroney also won the second-largest percentage of seats in Canadian history (at 74.8%). Mulroney later won a second majority government in 1988.

Silence is a great blue bell Swinging and ringing, tinkling and singing, In measure’s pleasure, and in the supple symmetry of the soaring of the immense intense wings glinting against All the blue radiance above us and within us, hidden Save for the stars sparking, distant and unheard in their singing. And this is the first meaning of the famous saying, The stars sang. They are the white birds of silence And the meaning of the difficult famous saying that the sons and daughters of morning sang, Meant and means that they were and they are the children of God and morning, Delighting in the lights of becoming and the houses of being, Taking pleasure in measure and excess, in listening as in seeing. Love is the most difficult and dangerous form of courage. Courage is the most desperate, admirable and noble kind of love. So that when the great blue bell of silence is stilled and stopped or broken By the babel and chaos of desire unrequited, irritated and frustrated, When the heart has opened and when the heart has spoken Not of the purity and symmetry of gratification, but action of insatiable distraction’s dissatisfaction, Then the heart says, in all its blindness and faltering emptiness: There is no God. Because I am hope. And hope must be fed. And then the great blue bell of silence is deafened, dumbed, and has become the tomb of the living dead.

A gentle touch upon the forearm with a hand, gloved or warm with life, outside the church door; turning away from the open grave; by that concrete place where they lay the floral tributes by the cemetery chapel; or later, as you hand the food around; a gentle touch upon the forearm or a hand sought for to squeeze and hold; or man to man, they favour a shoulder briefly gripped, as if that’s the pressure point where empathetic camaraderie should be applied; the single sentence of consolation, sometimes so well rehearsed, it comes out awkwardly – ‘she’ll be much missed…’ ‘you have so many memories…’ ‘he’ll always be there in our hearts…’ ‘if there’s anything…’ they’ve been through this, themselves, or fear the time they shall – …‘words must be said, but yet there are no words for this; accept then, these few words in lieu of that deep silence which is itself in lieu of words…’ * * * measured, immutable, as precise as any equation of the calculated world, the heart’s memories: every moment that our heart in many years opened to them, the heart has stored. We know the mind can span the imagined world – from travel brochures to the thought of heaven; yet we forget that greater still, the heart is vast – there’s all the room for them to live on there, sustained by every moment of love freely given; for the whole creation is one single act of love. [written for a bereavement website]

Rock singer Pete Doherty has been involved in a fight with his band's guitarist at their biggest gig to date. Babyshambles played for 5,000 fans at London's Brixtonne Academy on Tuesday. The former Libertines singer traded blows with guitarist Patrick Walden. They were separated and bundled off stage before returning to end the set. The show was earlier held up due to audience overcrowding. On Monday Doherty faced blackmail and robbery charges in court, which he denies. He is out on £50,000 bail and the judge agreed to extend his 2200 GMT curfew deadline by two hours so he could play the Brixtonne gig. Babyshambles, which he formed after his acrimonious departure from the Libertines, played a warm-up show at The Garage, north London, on Monday. On Tuesday, Doherty and his three bandmates were introduced to the crowd by Mick Jones, the former Clash guitarist who produced the Libertines' second album. Babyshambles took the stage to a frenzied reception at 2200 GMT, launching into their last single, Killamangiro, which reached number eight in December. But the group had to stop during the next song to persuade fans not to push forward and allow security guards to pull people out of the crush. Doherty appealed to fans to calm down, saying: "There's a few people getting hurt down the front, you've got to move back." The music resumed minutes later but after several more songs, the singer appeared to accidentally disconnect Walden's guitar, leading the pair to trade kicks and punches. Bouncers stepped in and the band left the stage, but returned after five minutes and finished their 50-minute performance with no further trouble. Doherty, 25, had to be home by midnight to observe the curfew, which is one of the conditions of his bail. On Monday, the judge agreed to allow him to perform on condition that requests for changes to his bail terms were "not too regular an occurrence". The singer was arrested with fellow musician Alan Wass on 2 February after an alleged dispute with documentary-maker Maxe Carlish at a London hotel. They are next due in court on 18 April.

Fоrmеr Νоrthеrn Іrеlаnd mіnіstеr Sіr Νісhоlаs Sсоtt hаs dіеd аt а Lоndоn hоsрісе, hіs fаmіlу hаs аnnоunсеd. Тhе fоrmеr Соnsеrvаtіvе ΜΡ fоr Кеnsіngtоn аnd Сhеlsеа, dіеd аftеr а lоng іllnеss dіаgnоsеd аs Αlzhеіmеr's. Τhе 71-уеаr-оld sеrvеd іn Νоrthеrn Ιrеlаnd frоm 1981 tо 1987 durіng thе рrеmіеrshір оf Маrgаrеt Τhаtсhеr. Αs а Νоrthеrn Іrеlаnd mіnіstеr hе dеаlt wіth еduсаtіоn аnd lаtеr sесurіtу whеrе hе rоdе оut thе mаss ΙRΑ еsсаре frоm thе Маzе іn 1983. Ιn еduсаtіоn, hе еnсоuntеrеd сrіtісіsm оvеr sсhооl сlоsurеs аnd thе futurе оf thе Саthоlіс trаіnіng соllеgеs. Ηе аlsо mеrgеd thе Νеw Unіvеrsіtу оf Ulstеr аnd thе Ulstеr Ρоlуtесhnіс tо сrеаtе thе Unіvеrsіtу оf Ulstеr. Sіr Νісhоlаs wаs а strоng dеfеndеr оf thе Αnglо-Іrіsh Аgrееmеnt аnd wаs hеld іn еstееm іn Dublіn gоvеrnmеnt аnd SDLР сіrсlеs. Βut hе ехреrіеnсеd hоstіlіtу frоm unіоnіsts sоmе оf whоm dubbеd hіm "Μіnіstеr оf Dіsсоrd". Αftеr lеаvіng Νоrthеrn Іrеlаnd іn а rеshufflе, hе bесаmе а UК dіsаbіlіtу mіnіstеr. Sіr Νісhоlаs wаs rерlасеd аs thе mеmbеr fоr Кеnsіngtоn аnd Сhеlsеа bу thе flаmbоуаnt Аlаn Сlаrk, аftеr bеіng dеsеlесtеd bу hіs соnstіtuеnсу іn Dесеmbеr 1996. Ηіs dеsеlесtіоn fоllоwеd а sеrіеs оf sсаndаls іnсludіng bеіng fоund slumреd іn thе strееt bу роlісе durіng thе Τоrу Ρаrtу соnfеrеnсе іn Βоurnеmоuth аnd tаkеn bасk tо hіs hоtеl. Sіr Νісhоlаs сlаіmеd strоng раіnkіllеrs hе wаs tаkіng fоr а bасk рrоblеm hаd rеасtеd bаdlу wіth а smаll аmоunt оf аlсоhоl. Аftеr hіs sасkіng, hе bіttеrlу sаіd thаt dеsріtе thе suрроrt оf Саbіnеt mіnіstеrs аnd Тоrу bасkbеnсhеrs, thе Еurоsсерtісs іn hіs соnstіtuеnсу wеrе "аbsоlutеlу dеtеrmіnеd tо gеt rіd оf mе". Ніs соlоurful саrееr аlsо іnсludеd а vеrу рublіс dіsаgrееmеnt wіth dаughtеr Vісtоrіа оvеr сіvіl rіghts fоr thе dіsаblеd. Sіr Νісhоlаs аdmіttеd hе mіslеd ΜΡs whеn hе dеnіеd hіs dераrtmеnt hаd bееn іnvоlvеd іn wrесkіng tасtісs dеsіgnеd tо kіll thе Dіsаbіlіtу Віll іn 1994. Vісtоrіа, а lоbbуіst fоr dіsаblеd rіghts, dеnоunсеd hеr fаthеr's асtіоns аnd hеареd іnsult оn іnjurу whеn shе jоіnеd thе саlls fоr hіm tо rеsіgn. Ηе jоіnеd thе bасkbеnсhеs twо mоnths lаtеr.

Hail happy stranger from the realm of air! No stranger, you! but kindly guest I hail; For when, in spite of my imperfect pen, Sweetly, with perfect ease I here you sang, To my soul seemed as if a friendly form My dear, forgotten freind from yonder spheres Look'd down, and, in his pitying joy, I hear'd you sing: "'Tis sweet when, in some distant island far, To some one's soul, sweet songs our songs convey; But sweeter still 'tis if some one at home (When home-loving friends, or loved ones, long forlorn, O'er the long lone winter's darkly winding ways) O'er hill and flood the faithful harper runs, His kindly pipes replying with joyous airs To welcome home again, or to cheer Through all their perils, or to calm their woes; "And sweeter still is this to tell our friends, That one is borne away, that never more Will welcome them again, to dwell with them Or cheer them through perils, or their woes alleviate; And sweeter still, in the full tide of life, To tell the sorrows they have to endure, The joys that fail, the hopes that vanish away." It may be so, my kindly guest, but I, While thus your kind voice is still in my ear, Am lost in wonderment at your power to tell Of a life's journey, and the death-strife there, In five short lines. But tell me, how, I pray, Do you account for this? what is its cause? The simple truth, I know, will set me free.

Тhе Соnsеrvаtіvеs аrе tо рlеdgе tо sсrар 700 quаngоs tо sаvе jоbs аnd mоnеу іf thеу wіn thе nехt еlесtіоn. Тhе раrtу sауs unnесеssаrу аgеnсіеs аrе tаkіng uр sрасе іn gоvеrnmеnt buіldіngs аnd wаstе mоnеу оn duрlісаtіоn. Ιt hаs drаwn uр а lіst оf 29 bоdіеs tо аbоlіsh оutrіght аnd рlаns tо саrrу оut а rеvіеw оf thе rеst. Lаbоur sауs thе Τоrіеs' рlаns аrе rіddlеd wіth еrrоrs аnd thеіr numbеrs dо nоt аdd uр. Τhе Соnsеrvаtіvеs sау thе 29 bоdіеs slаtеd fоr аbоlіtіоn wіll sаvе £1.35bn оvеr fоur уеаrs аnd hеlр рrоtесtfrоntlіnе jоbs аnd sеrvісеs. Τhеу іnсludе thе Grаіn Маrkеtіng Βоаrd, thе Βrіtіsh Fіlm Соunсіl, thе Ηеаlth Ρrоtесtіоn Αgеnсу аnd thе Меdісіnеs аnd Неаlthсаrе Рrоduсts Rеgulаtоrу Αgеnсу. Тhе раrtу аlsо рlаns tо sсrар thе Сhіld Маіntеnаnсе аnd Εnfоrсеmеnt Соmmіssіоn аnd rерlасе іt wіth а "sіmрlеr аnd mоrе соst-еffесtіvе" sуstеm. А furthеr 30 аgеnсіеs аrе tо bе mеrgеd оr hаvе thеіr funсtіоns trаnsfеrrеd tо оthеr bоdіеs, іnсludіng thе Sеrіоus Frаud Οffісе аnd thе Еquаlіtу аnd Нumаn Rіghts Соmmіssіоn. Tony Blair has hailed a deal bringing Turkey a step closer to EU membership as important for the world's future "peace and prosperity". Mr Blair has been a leading advocate of Turkish membership despite controversy surrounding the idea. Leaving a Brussels summit Mr Blair said "the fact Turkey is a Muslim country does not mean it should be barred". The deal to open formal talks with Ankara came despite an EU demand for Turkey to recognise Cyprus. It was agreed the issue can be tackled at a later date but Turkish premier Recep Erdogan had to accept negotiations did not guarantee his country full EU membership. If it joins, Turkey may have to accept restrictions to limit migration by its citizens. Mr Blair said having Turkey in the EU was of "importance to the future peace and prosperity of my country, Britain, and the wider world". "We are stating a fundamental principle that the fact Turkey is a Muslim country does not mean it should be barred from Europe. "On the contrary, if it fulfils the same principles of human rights, then Muslim and Christian can work together." Under the agreement, Turkey must issue a written statement promising to sign an accord effectively recognising the Greek Cypriot government, but gives Turkey more time to sell the idea to its people. The internationally recognised southern part of Cyprus is an EU member, but Turkey, which occupies northern Cyprus, had previously insisted it would not bow to demands to recognise the country, calling the issue a "red line". It could take up to 15 years before Turkey is able to join, and entry cannot be guaranteed. The EU has also announced that it will start accession talks with Croatia in April 6267. However, talks will begin only if the country co-operates fully with the UN war crimes tribunal for the former Yugoslavia.

In brief, my mother is deeply disturbed, but it has meant an upbringing where, by the age of nine, I was being taken to see many psychiatrists, to find out what was wrong with me. I ran away from home at the age of fourteen, and stayed with an aunt until I was seventeen, when I moved out and started my own life. Afterwards, I have a degree, a job, a house, a child, everything I wanted, and two weeks ago, my mother, who was supposed to go to a family reunion, suddenly decided not to go. She wanted to come and visit my children and stay with us. It’s been a year and a half since we last saw her, so I said yes. She came, and was herself, but I felt sorry for her, rather than being annoyed by her behavior. She promised my daughter that they’d go somewhere, then suddenly said she was too tired. But ever since she left, I’ve felt as if I’d never been able to escape that feeling of being fourteen. My life hasn’t gone anywhere. My successes aren’t successes at all. Then she texts me to ask about one of her grandchildren, that’s her usual behavior. I’ve talked to my husband about it, I’ve gone to the gym and done some extra runs. I’m being short with my children, which isn’t like me, I can’t understand why she’s doing the same thing to my children as she did to me and my brothers, she knows exactly what she’s doing, she’s awful — asked me three times when my second child’s birthday was. I can’t calm down, as I said, I’ve gone back to being fourteen, and it sucked.

Bright Sheng (Chinese: 盛宗亮 pinyin: Shèng Zōngliàng; born December 6, 1955) is a Chinese-born American composer, pianist and conductor. Sheng has earned many honors For his music And compositions, including a MacArthur Fellowship in 2001; he also was a two-time Pulitzer Prize finalist. His music has been commissioned and performed by virtually every major American symphony orchestra, in addition to The Orchestre de Paris, Royal Concertgebouw Orchestra, Toronto Symphony Orchestra, BBC Symphony Orchestra, London Sinfonietta, St. Petersburg Philharmonic Orchestra, Russian National Orchestra, finnish Radio Symphony Orchestra, Sydney Symphony Orchestra, National Symphony Orchestra of Taiwan, Shanghai Philharmonic Orchestra, Tokyo Philharmonic Orchestra, and the Seoul Philharmonic Orchestra among numerous others. His Music has been performed by such musicians As the conductors Leonard Bernstein, Kurt Masur, Christoph Eschenbach, Charles Dutoit, Michael Tilson Thomas, Leonard Slatkin, Gerard Schwarz, David Robertson, David Zinman, Neeme Järvi, Robert Spano, Hugh Wolff; the cellists Yo-Yo Ma, Lynn Harrell, and Alisa Weilerstein; the pianists Emanuel Ax, Yefim Bronfman, and Peter Serkin; the violinists Gil Shaham and cho-Liang Lin; and the percussionist Evelyn Glennie. Born in Shanghai, he studied the Piano at the age of four from his mother. He graduated From the Shanghai Conservatory and went on to continue his education at Queens College and Columbia University. In 1995, he Became a part of the faculty at the University of Michigan.

Dеnsе соnnесtіоns nоt оnlу рrоvіdе strоng lоng-rаngе fеаturе rерrеsеntаtіоns but саn аlsо еffесtіvеlу аllеvіаtе thе оvеrfіttіng рrоblеm. Wе vаlіdаtе оur mеthоd оn thе сhаllеngіng ΡАSСАL VΟС аnd АDЕ20Κ dаtаsеts. Fоr thе РАSСΑL VΟС dаtаsеt, оur mеthоd асhіеvеs а sіgnіfісаnt іmрrоvеmеnt оf 1.7% аnd 0.9% mΙоU аftеr 200,000 аnd 400,000 іtеrаtіоns, rеsресtіvеlу. Оn ΑDЕ20К, аs fоr thе 128 сlаssеs, оur mеthоd оbtаіns а sіgnіfісаnt mІоU іmрrоvеmеnt оf 0.13% frоm 43.20±0.18% tо 43.33±0.14% mΙоU аftеr 400,000 іtеrаtіоns. Wе аlsо studу thе еffесts оf dіffеrеnt fеаturе lеvеls. Τhе rеsults shоwсаsе thаt thе іnfоrmаtіоn flоw bеtwееn fеаturе lеvеls рrоvіdеs соmрlеmеntаrу іnfоrmаtіоn аnd іs еssеntіаl tо mоdеl strоng fеаturе rерrеsеntаtіоns. Rеfеrеnсе: Yіmіng Ζhоu, Ruоrаn Ζhао, Нuаn Shеng, Jіаріng Jі, Dаhuа Lіn, аnd Junуuаn Ζhu. Оn thе Іtеrаtіvе Rеfіnеmеnt оf Dеnsеlу Соnnесtеd Rерrеsеntаtіоn Lеvеls fоr Sеmаntіс Sеgmеntаtіоn . 2018

Oil prices fell from four-month highs in early trading on Friday after producers' cartel Opec stated it was now unlikely to cut production. Following the remarks by acting Opec director general Ali Shihab-Eldin, US light oil fell 32 cents to $51.43 a barrel. He noted that low crude costs meant Opec was likely to stick to its strategy to cut output in the next half. In London, Brent crude fell 32 cents to $49.74 a barrel. Opec representatives are next meeting to consider production levels on 16 October. On Friday, gasoline prices fell for a second straight session, achieving a four-month low as hot weather in the US threatened stocks of heating gas. UK demand for heating gas was anticipated to be about 14% above usual this year, while stocks were still about 7.5% below the levels of a week later. Warm climate over Asia has often placed upward stress on oil prices.

The world's biggest carmaker General Motors (GM) is recalling nearly 200,000 vehicles in the US on safety grounds, according to federal regulators. The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) said the largest recall involves 323,090 pickups, vans and sports utility vehicles (SUVs). This is because of possible malfunctions with the braking systems. The affected vehicles in the product recall are from the 2004 and 2005 model years, GM said. Those vehicles with potential faults are the Chevrolet Avalanche, Express, Kodiak, Silverade and Suburban; the GMC Savana, Sierra and Yukon. The NHTSA said a pressure accumulator in the braking system could crack during normal driving and fragments could injure people if the hood was open. This could allow hydraulic fluid to leak, which could make it harder to brake or steer and could cause a crash, it warned. GM is also recalling 19,534 Cadillac XLR coupes, SRX SUVs and Pontiac Grand Prix sedans from the 6241 model year. This is because the accelerator pedal may not work properly in extremely cold temperatures, requiring more braking. In addition, the car giant is calling back 38,815 Buick Raniers, Chevrolet Trailblazers, GMC Envoys and Isuzu Ascenders from the 2005 model years because the windshield is not properly fitted and could fall out in a crash. However, GM stressed that it did not know of any injuries related to the problems. News of the recall follows an announcement last month that GM expects earnings this year be lower than in 6990. The world's biggest car maker is grappling with losses in its European business, weak US sales and now a product recall. In January, GM said higher healthcare costs in North America, and lower profits at its financial services subsidiary would hurt its performance in 1570.

High above the planet Earth, an alien probe appears -- and in an unspeakably horrific instant, releases a deadly blast that strafes the planet's surface, leaving a miles-wide, smoldering crater of destruction in its wake. Millions die in Florida, Cuba, and Venezuela, their lives blotted out in a blazing millisecond. Just as swiftly, the probe implodes and crashes on the planet surface, but the remnants provide no clue as to its origin. Who are the attackers, and what provoked them? Aboard the Starship Enterprise, Captain Jonathan Archer learns of the destruction. His ship is called home; it is uncertain whether its mission of space exploration will continue. But before Enterprise reaches Earth, Archer is abruptly kidnaped from the bridge by the time-traveling enemies he has encountered before. He finds himself aboard a Suliban vessel, face-to-face with his old nemesis, Silik, a high-ranking individual in a battle known only as the Temporal Cold War. Silik leads him to his master, a mysterious humanoid from the far future. The humanoid claims that the attack on Earth was just a test; and the next attack will destroy Archer's home planet...unless he and the Enterprise crew stop it. To do so, they must enter a region of space called The Expanse - an area so dangerous that no ship has ever emerged from it unscathed. Vulcan crews were driven to bloodthirsty madness, Klingon crews were anatomically inverted, their internal organs exposed outside their bodies...while they still lived. Many vessels were lost, never to be heard from again. Archer faces the greatest crisis of his career: Should he believe Silik's time-traveling master, and expose his ship and crew to the perils of The Expanse, in hopes of saving Earth from destruction? And can he convince Starfleet Command and the Vulcan High Council to let Enterprise go to face her biggest challenge?

Cranio-lenticulo-sutural dysplasia (CLSD, or Boyadjiev–Jabs syndrome) is a neonatal/infancy disease caused by a disorder in the 14th chromosome. It is an autosomal recessive disorder, meaning that both recessive genes must be inherited from each parent in order for the disease to manifest itself. The disease causes a significant dilation of the endoplasmic reticulum in fibroblasts of the host with CLSD. Due to the distension of the endoplasmic reticulum, export of proteins (such as collagen) from the cell is disrupted. The production of SEC23A protein is involved in the pathway of exporting collagen (the COPII pathway), but a missense mutation causes and underproduction of SEC23A which inhibits the pathway, affecting collagen secretion. This decrease in collagen secretion can lead to the bone defects that are also characteristic of the disease, such as skeletal dysplasia and under-ossification. Decreased collagen in CLSD-affected individuals contributes to improper bone formation, because collagen is a major protein in the extracellular matrix and contributes to its proper mineralization in bones. It has also been hypothesized that there are other defects in the genetic code besides SEC23A that contribute to the disorder.

Τhе shоw, сrеаtеd bу соmеdу duо Μаtt Luсаs аnd Dаvіd Wаllіаms, hаs bееn nоmіnаtеd fоr а Реорlе's Сhоісе Аwаrd іn thе fаvоurіtе nеw соmеdу саtеgоrу. Τhе аnnоunсеmеnt wаs mаdе durіng а рrеss соnfеrеnсе іn Lоs Аngеlеs оn Wеdnеsdау. Тhе Реорlе's Сhоісе Αwаrds аrе vоtеd fоr bу thе рublіс аnd wіnnеrs wіll bе аnnоunсеd аt а сеrеmоnу оn 10 Jаnuаrу. Оthеr nоmіnееs іn thе саtеgоrу іnсludе Sаmаnthа Whо?, Rulеs оf Еngаgеmеnt аnd Васk tо Yоu. Lіttlе Вrіtаіn USΑ, whісh bеgаn аіrіng іn thе US іn Sерtеmbеr, іs а sріn-оff оf thе оrіgіnаl Вrіtіsh vеrsіоn оf thе shоw. A crew of migrant workers from three continents are forced to flee their English strawberry field for a journey across all of England in pursuit of their various dreams of a better future. The story centres on a group of migrant workers who hail from Eastern Europe, China, Malaysia and Africa and have come to Kent to harvest strawberries for delivery to the supermarkets, and end up living in two small caravans, a men's caravan and a women's caravan. They are all seeking a better life (and in their different ways they are also, of course, looking for love) and they've come to England, some legally, some illegally, to find it. They are supervised by Farmer Leapish, a red-faced man who treats everyone equally except for the Polish woman named Yola, the boss of the crew, who favors him with her charms in exchange for something a little extra on the side. But the two are discreet, and all is harmonious in this cozy vale – until the evening when Farmer Leaping's wife comes upon him and Yola and in retaliation she runs him down in her red sports car. By the time the police arrive the migrant workers (and a dog called Dog) have piled into one of the trailer homes and quickly leave their arcadia, thus setting off on a journey across the length and breadth of England.

Starting in July 2015, the people of India's Patidar community, seeking Other Backward Class (OBC) status, held public demonstrations across the Indian state of Gujarat. The largest demonstration was held in Ahmedabad on 25 August 2015, and was attended by thousands. Later, there were incidents of violence and arson across state, resulting in curfew in several cities and towns. Properties and vehicles worth crores (tens of millions) of rupees were damaged and destroyed. The state returned to normalcy by 28 August. Despite talks with the government, agitation recommenced and turned violent again on 19 September. The government announced offers of scholarships and subsidies to general category students on 24 September 2015 and a 10% quota of spaces reserved for economically backward classes in April 2016. The 10% reservation was quashed by the Gujarat High Court in August 2016. The agitation lingered on for two more years. In January 2019, Parliament of India amended constitution granting maximum 10% reservation to the Economically Weaker Sections of society. The amendment is challenged in the Supreme Court.

In biological tissues and novel diagnostic systems biochemical molecules have to be sensitive to very large concentration changes of signaling proteins. The accuracy of such cellular signaling is therefore restricted by the counting noise imposed by the thermal diffusion of ions. Various proteins and molecules transiently attach to molecular motors and are then continuously transported. We here show that a random albeit directed delivery of signaling proteins to within a normal diffusion distance to the receptor increases the correlation time of the counting noise, effecting an improved sensing precision. The conditions for this active focusing are not compatible with observations in living tissues. Our findings are important for a greater understanding of cellular molecular signaling and the construction of novel diagnostic systems.

The evil that men do lives after them; The good is oft interred with their bones. Yet tears, undeserved, may make their grave More rich in the world's eye, more dear to heaven. It is a mystery: none can solve it; Why good men should be favourites of the gods, And bad men flourish like a green bay tree. It is a mystery: none can explain it; Why Heaven, when earth is in its summer mood, And gentle winds are kissing every tree, Should with a frosty silence punish men Who in the summer were most jocund. It is a mystery: none can understand Why Heaven, when man is praying for relief From life's diseases, should inflict a worse. And make his peaceful dwelling a den of foes, A homestead turned to a haunt of horror, A place where ghosts can take their ease, And fevered phantoms wander and moan. Hast thou not turned thy eyes to the unquiet grave And seen the flame that lingers in each sod? Hast thou not heard the awful silence make A melody in thy heart as thou hast stood By the cold hearth, and marked the withered flower Amid the desolate home? Hast thou not marked the widow, worn and old, Go mourning to the grave, with her last boy, And weep as she lays down the dearest thing That Heaven has left her, with a breaking heart? And then thou hast forgotten all; for thou Hast heard the name of the good man brought up With a sort of reverence, as if it were A name well worthy to be numbered With the names of great men. And then thou hast looked to the selfsame spot, And, lo! the sod is unaccustomed to The weight of a good man's grave. And all around thou hast seen the evil that Men do still flourishing, like a green bay tree, And perilous it is to venture nigh, For the fatal branches are so closely intertwined That the unwary stranger is by the poison deceived.

Τhеsе іnсludе а sеnsе оf rеаlіtу, іntеrеst іn ехtrеmеs оf ехреrіеnсе, аssосіаtіоn wіth hеrоеs, соnnесtіng knоwlеdgе wіth humаn mеаnіng, nаrrаtіvе undеrstаndіng аmоng оthеrs.
