We discuss the compatibility of quantum gravity with dynamical matter degrees of freedom. Specifically, we present bounds we obtained in [1] on the allowed number and type of matter fields within asymptotically safe quantum gravity. As a novel result, we show bounds on the allowed number of spin-3/2 (Rarita-Schwinger) fields, e.g., the gravitino. These bounds, obtained within truncated Renormalization Group flows, indicate the compatibility of asymptotic safety with the matter fields of the standard model. Further, they suggest that extensions of the matter content of the standard model are severely restricted in asymptotic safety. This means that searches for new particles at colliders could provide experimental tests for this particular approach to quantum gravity.

This story of Garrick's is a classic whodunit. In this instance, he is summoned by his old comrade in arms, Sergeant Blake Peters, who, in apprehension of the mysterious illness of his present employer, General Stantnor, also asks for a return on a long forgotten debt. Garrick moves into the Stantnor house, where a few people still occupy and hold together the old mansion. While he is there, an unknown person begins to murder the few remaining inhabitants. As the formerly deceased start coming back to attack the house, Garrick calls on his good friend, Morley Dotes, for help. The investigation is then switched to solving the murders. But two beautiful women wander around the house: one is the general's daughter, Jenifer, and the other only the young detective sees; he suspects her to be a ghost. As a result, the general's life becomes more dangerous and a small number of the household are killed. Morley suspects that the general's illness is not due to poisoning but is of a supernatural nature, so Garrick and Morley hire an exorcist, Doctor Doom, who then gathers the remaining household together and faces the ailing general in his chamber. The truth is that the general murdered his wife, Eleanor, and that the ghost of her that Garrick had seen was indeed her wrath at being murdered. To get her revenge, the ghost of the woman gradually steals the life out of the old general. The murders, on the other hand, were committed by Jenifer, the daughter of the murdered general, who wanted to keep the house after her father's death. Then the general and Jenifer die. Garrick gets nothing from them but an eerie painting of Eleanor as a remembrance of the case. He hangs it in his study and soon discovers that the ghost of Eleanor has followed him home and now haunts the picture.

Slouching Towards Gomorrah: Modern Liberalism and American Decline is 1996 non-fiction book by Robert H. Bork, a former United States Court of Appeals judge. Bork's thesis in book is that U.S. and more generally Western culture is in state of decline and that cause of this decline is modern liberalism and rise of New Left. Specifically, he attacks modern liberalism for what he describes as its dual emphases on radical egalitarianism and radical individualism. The title of book is a play on the last couplet of W. B. Yeats's poem "The Second Coming": "And what rough beast, its hour come round at last, / Slouches towards Bethlehem to be born?" Bork contends that the "rough beast of decadence … now sends us slouching towards our new home, not Bethlehem but Gomorrah." More directly, the title borrows from Joan Didion's Slouching Towards Bethlehem. Overview Bork first traces the rapid expansion of modern liberalism that occurred during the 1960s, arguing that this legacy of radicalism demonstrates that the precepts of modern liberalism are antithetical to the rest of U.S. political tradition. He then attacks variety of social, cultural, and political experiences as evidence of U.S. cultural decline and degeneracy. Among these are affirmative action, increased violence in and sexualization of mass media, the legalization of abortion, pressure to legalize assisted suicide and euthanasia, feminism and decline of religion. Bork, himself rejected nominee of President Ronald Reagan to the United States Supreme Court, also criticizes that institution and argues that the judiciary and liberal judicial activism are catalysts for U.S. cultural corruption.

Prasophyllum tadgellianum, commonly known as the alpine leek orchid, is a species of orchid native to the Snowy Mountains and Tasmania. It has a single stiff, erect leaf and up to twenty scented, greenish-brown or reddish-brown flowers crowded on a stout spike. Description Prasophyllum tadgellianum is a terrestrial, perennial, deciduous, herb with an underground tuber and a single stiff, erect, dark green, tube-shaped leaf long and in diametre near the base. Between ten and twenty flowers are crowded on a stout flowering spike high. The flowers are dark greenish-brown with a greenish, pink or white labellum and are usually lightly scented. They are inverted so that the labellum is above the column rather than below it. The ovary is about long and the petals are about long. The lateral sepals are about long, joined for most of their length and form the uppermost part of the flower. The dorsal sepal is egg-shaped to lance-shaped and about long. The labellum is sharply curved near its middle, often has a wavy edge and is covered with a raised callus. Flowering occurs from January to March and unlike many others in the genus, does not require fire the previous summer in order to flower.

Depending on if requests are satisfied simultaneously or asynchronously, we construct an orchestrator that at static moment neither yields composed services having the necessary properties or detects the principals responsible for possible violations. A Letter Written For My Daughter To A Lady Who Had Presented Her With A Cap As oft you wear it, Madam, 'twill remind you Of me, your freind; and, as you use it, Still farther will it chance to bind you In friendship firm and fast: And, as these silken tissues rarely Are seen to better advantage, When art and chance have planned it, It may be chance, not art, that I May seem t' have gain'd a freind; And she, for whose dear sake these lines Are spun from thought, allmost extemporally, May be as chance, not art, have fashion'd, And, as ye read, instruct. She tells you, Madam, simple truth, In graceful numbers dressed; And that in woman's capablities There is a magnetic force Which, if it favorably fall, May attract and captivate; 'Twill do ye good when you are old, Will comfort ye when sick, Will cheer ye when ye loathe your food, And do ye more than physic: And, as ye read, instruct. She bids you love your Husband dear, And love your Children too; And, ever acting up to them, Be loved by all, as you shall be When time shall her instructions prove; And, if her artless song may be Believed, she loves you; And, as ye read, instructs. She thanks you for your late kindness, And returns you yours; And, if this first-fruit of her brain Can boast aught rare or handsome, It is your lovely gift, Which, as it first adorns her, Would make her still, if she can, More worthy of your favors; And, as she reads, instructs.

Time-series remote sensing data offer a rich source of information that can be used in a wide range of applications, from monitoring changes in land cover to surveilling crops, coastal changes, flood risk assessment, and urban sprawl. This paper addresses the challenge of using time-series satellite images to predict urban expansion. Building upon previous work, we propose a novel two-step approach based on semantic image segmentation in order to predict urban expansion. The first step aims to extract information about urban regions at different time scales and prepare them for use in the training step. The second step combines Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) with Long Short Term Memory (LSTM) methods in order to learn temporal features and thus predict urban expansion. In this paper, experimental results are conducted using several multi-date satellite images representing the three largest cities in Saudi Arabia, namely: Riyadh, Jeddah, and Dammam. We empirically evaluated our proposed technique, and examined its results by comparing them with state-of-the-art approaches. Following this evaluation, we determined that our results reveal improved performance for the new-coupled CNN-LSTM approach, particularly in terms of assessments based on Mean Square Error, Root Mean Square Error, Peak Signal to Noise Ratio, Structural Similarity Index, and overall classification accuracy.

This part of the book consists of four chapters in which Metlitzki explores how scientific achievements were translated and transmitted from Arabic texts to Western (primarily English authors writing in Latin) texts. She begins this book by addressing the crusades and the development of scholarship by Mozarabs, i.e. Christians living under Muslim rule, particularly those in Muslim Spain and Sicily (p. 3-10). She writes about several Western scholars who were involved in translating Arabic texts and studying Arab held libraries, including several key ancient Greek and Roman texts that were only available in Arabic. Some of these scholars included Adelard of Bath (p. 26) who was a Western scholar responsible for translating Al-Khwarizmi’s texts on astronomy and Euclid’s Elements from Arabic into Latin. She details the lives of several of these key scholars including Petrus Alfonsi, a Christian converted ex-Jew living in Muslim Spain and author of the seminal text Disciplina Clericalis, which, according to Metlitzki was the first collection of Oriental tales composed in the West for Westerners (p. 16). Robert of Ketton was the first translator of the Quran into Latin and also translated several key scientific texts such as Alchemy by Morienus Romanus and Math, Algebra and astronomy texts by Al-Khwarizmi. Michael Scot was a scholar interested in magic, alchemy and astronomy and was also the first translator of most of the works of Aristotle (from Arabic into Latin), whose writings had been banned in the West as being heretical (p. 48). In part two Metlitzki explores key English medieval texts and suggests that they either are based entirely on Arabic stories or include elements from Arabic storytelling that suggest that they had been loosely based on Arabic stories. She then suggests that the English medieval Romance itself is strongly influenced by Arabic ideals of romantic chivalry as well as key Arabic stories from various sources including the 1001 Nights. The English texts she closely examines include Chaucer’s The Canterbury Tales, the English Charlemagne Romances like Sir Ferumbras and the Sowdone of Babylone (p. 172-3) and several others. In several of these texts, Metlitzki explains, are found the beginnings of the misunderstanding of Islam by the West and she explores the depiction of Islam and the Islamic prophet Muhammad in these texts in her chapter on History and Romance (p. 95-210). On page 245 she also suggests that contributions to English and Western literature from Arabic literature includes several key themes (such as Romance) and also rhyming poetry itself.

In the middle of the night, fifteen year old garrett is kidnapped and sent to a boot camp in upstate New York called Lake Harmony. Upon his arrival, he learns that his parents have sent him to the facility because he refused to stop dating his former math teacher, Sabrina, along with other things including staying out too late, and smoking marijuana. Garrett does not believe he belongs at Lake Harmony, but he is not allowed to leave until he has admitted his "mistakes" and conforms to the facility's standards of behavior. Staff members are authorized to use "any force necessary" to alter his behavior, including physical and psychological abuse. After attempting to talk his way out with no success, he realizes escape is his only option. He escapes Lake Harmony with two friends, Pauly and Sarah, after using chemicals to start a fire. They reach the Canadian border to escape from legal recapture, and their pursuers' boat begins to sink. He lets his friends out on the other side of the border, and then rescues his pursuers, who bring him back to Lake Harmony, where he is beaten senseless repeatedly. The director announces that all campers are being demoted, based on the privilege system they use, and to blame Garrett, so he is beaten yet again by the campers. Ultimately, he is "reformed". When his mother comes to pick him up with an investigator, the investigator asks if he was beaten. He breaks down and says that he was, but is still scared of what Lake Harmony would do to him. This forced him to say that he deserved all of it, since the director was standing there. It is possible that these events caused him to suffer from PTSD, as he appears to suffer from a mental breakdown when admitting what has occurred.

Australian building products Group James Hardie has agreed to pay $1.1bn (£568m) to victims of asbestos-related diseases. The landmark deal could see thousands of people suffering from lung diseases - caused by asbestos the company once made - receive compensation. The move follows angry protests After the firm said a previous compensation fund was running out of Money. A subsequent new South Wales state inquiry criticised Hardie's actions. In September, the inquiry found that the company had misled the public about the amount of money set aside to cover its asbestos-related liabilities, sparking the resignation of Its then chief executive, Peter MacDonald. Campaigners welcomed news of the preliminary agreement. "This is a momentous day In the fight for victims and their families," said asbestosis sufferer Bernie Banton, who leads a victims' association. "There is still a long way to Go, but we are getting there." James Hardie chairwoman, Meredith Hellicar, said the deal provided for a funding arrangement "that Is affordable, sensible and workable". "At the end of The day we are dealing with compensation for people who are terminally ill. We don't know exactly how many of Them there will be, we Don't know over what exact period they will fall ill," she said. However, the deal still has to receive the approval of Hardie's shareholders. Hardie, which currently makes more than 80% of its revenues in the US, was once Australia's biggest supplier of asbestos Building materials. In 2001, the company set up a fund to compensate asbestos victims, but it later admitted the fund was running short of money. A decision by Hardie to move its headquarters to the Netherlands - while Remaining a listed company in Australia - provoked a damaging public outcry. Victims groups accusing it of trying to escape its responsibilities by moving abroad, a charge the company denies. australia's securities watchdog is currently investigating Hardie's former chief executive and Former chief financial officer over allegations of misleading Investors and the general public.

The cultural references of Wayne's World may date it a bit, but the nature and personality of Its humor set it apart. There is a kind of naive benevolence and boundless joy which makes this movie so lovable. Its aimless plot and Exaggerated humor are cute, without ever transcending that barrier into maudlin sentiment. This Is a difficult mix to achieve, especially when so many comedians go out of their way to Achieve "street credibility" through as much forced vulgarity and stereotypical humor as possible. Campbell and Carvey's characters were The ultimate comedic anti-heroes for generation X, even more so than Jay and Silent Bob, Bill and Ted, or Beavis and Butthead. They championed amateurism, paraded self-affecting humor, and became worshiped for telling everyone They weren't worthy. If '60s pop culture encouraged people to "do your own thing," Wayne and Garth were the genuine Article in the '90s. Two complete geeks had fun acting as themselves, and became celebrated in the process. One of The true comedy classics of our time. 8.5/10

Quassia ( or ) is a plant genus in the family Simaroubaceae. Its size is disputed; some botanists treat it as consisting of only one species, Quassia amara from tropical South America, while others treat it in a wide circumscription as a pantropical genus containing up to 40 species of trees and shrubs. The genus was named after a former slave from Suriname, Graman Quassi in the eighteenth century. He discovered the medicinal properties of the bark of Quassia amara. Distribution Members of the genus are found in the Tropics throughout the world. Countries and regions where species are native include: Andaman Islands, Angola, Bangladesh, Belize, Benin, Bismarck Archipelago, Borneo, North and Northeast Brazil, Burkina, Cabinda, Cambodia, Cameroon, Central African Republic, Chad, Colombia, Comoros, Congo, Costa Rica, El Salvador, Equatorial Guinea, Gabon, Gambia, Ghana, Guatemala, Guinea, Guinea-Bissau, Gulf of Guinea Islands, Honduras, India, Ivory Coast, Kenya, Laos, Leeward Islands, Liberia, Madagascar, Malaya, Mali, Central, Southeast and Southwest Mexico, Myanmar, New Guinea, Nicaragua, Niger, Nigeria, Northern Territory, Panamá, Philippines, Queensland, Senegal, Sierra Leone, Solomon Islands, Sri Lanka, Sudan, Sulawesi, Sumatera, Tanzania, Togo, Trinidad-Tobago, Uganda, Venezuela, Vietnam, Windward Islands, Zambia, and Zaïre.

Τhіs рареr аіms аt dеvеlоріng аn іntеgrаtеd sуstеm оf сlоthіng со-раrsіng, іn оrdеr tо jоіntlу раrsе а sеt оf сlоthіng іmаgеs (unsеgmеntеd but аnnоtаtеd wіth tаgs) іntо sеmаntіс соnfіgurаtіоns. Wе рrороsе а dаtа-drіvеn frаmеwоrk соnsіstіng оf twо рhаsеs оf іnfеrеnсе. Τhе fіrst рhаsе, rеfеrrеd аs "іmаgе со-sеgmеntаtіоn", іtеrаtеs tо ехtrасt соnsіstеnt rеgіоns оn іmаgеs аnd jоіntlу rеfіnеs thе rеgіоns оvеr аll іmаgеs bу еmрlоуіng thе ехеmрlаr-SVΜ (Ε-SVΜ) tесhnіquе [23]. Іn thе sесоnd рhаsе (і.е. "rеgіоn со-lаbеlіng"), wе соnstruсt а multі-іmаgе grарhісаl mоdеl bу tаkіng thе sеgmеntеd rеgіоns аs vеrtісеs, аnd іnсоrроrаtе sеvеrаl соntехts оf сlоthіng соnfіgurаtіоn (е.g., іtеm lосаtіоn аnd mutuаl іntеrасtіоns). Тhе jоіnt lаbеl аssіgnmеnt саn bе sоlvеd usіng thе еffісіеnt Grарh Сuts аlgоrіthm. Ιn аddіtіоn tо еvаluаtе оur frаmеwоrk оn thе Fаshіоnіstа dаtаsеt [30], wе соnstruсt а dаtаsеt саllеd ССР соnsіstіng оf 2098 hіgh-rеsоlutіоn strееt fаshіоn рhоtоs tо dеmоnstrаtе thе реrfоrmаnсе оf оur sуstеm. Wе асhіеvе 90.29% / 88.23% sеgmеntаtіоn ассurасу аnd 65.52% / 63.89% rесоgnіtіоn rаtе оn thе Fаshіоnіstа аnd thе ССΡ dаtаsеts, rеsресtіvеlу, whісh аrе suреrіоr соmраrеd wіth stаtе-оf-thе-аrt mеthоds.

Ιrеlаnd 17-12 Sоuth Аfrіса Ιrеlаnd аrе guаrаntееd а рlасе іn thе quаrtеr-fіnаls аftеr bеаtіng Sоuth Аfrіса dеsріtе lоsіng Βrіаn Ο'Drіsсоll tо іnjurу. Тhе Вrіtіsh аnd Ιrіsh Lіоns сарtаіn wаs саrrіеd оff fіvе mіnutеs frоm tіmе аftеr саtсhіng а рunсh frоm Jасо Реуреr. Тhе Ιrіsh lеd 13-10 аt thе brеаk аnd а trу frоm Тоmmу Βоwе аftеr 50 mіnutеs strеtсhеd thеіr аdvаntаgе. Sоuth Аfrіса сlоsеd thе gар wіth а trу frоm Jеssе Κrіеl, thеіr sесоnd оf thе gаmе, but Іrеlаnd sеаlеd vісtоrу wіth а lаtе реnаltу thrоugh Jоnnу Sехtоn. Sоuth Аfrіса wеrе оn tор thrоugh mоst оf thе fіrst hаlf аnd shоuld hаvе sсоrеd whеn thеу dоmіnаtеd а lіnеоut dеер іn Іrіsh tеrrіtоrу. Τhеу wеrе аlsо dеnіеd а trу bу thе vіdео оffісіаl аftеr а mоvе іnvоlvіng fіvе рlауеrs whісh lооkеd tо іnvоlvе fоrwаrds іn а ruсk but wаs rulеd tо hаvе соntаіn еnоugh bасks fоr іt tо bе а trу. Whеn Ιrеlаnd dіd fіnаllу tаkе аdvаntаgе оf роssеssіоn thе Lіоns skірреr wаs оn hаnd tо рut thе bаll dоwn fоr а trу whісh Sехtоn соnvеrtеd tо gіvе Ιrеlаnd thе lеаd. The measurement-independent protocol for key distribution (MII-QKD) was proposed to overcome the side-channel problem of quantum key distribution. Due to the multi-photon events of coherent sources, real-life implementations of the MII-QKD protocol must include decoy states to protect against the photon-number splitting attack. Decoy states for the MII-QKD based on weak coherent states have been recently discussed. This paper suggests an implementation of the MII-QKD protocol with the decoy states based on modified coherent states (MCS). We model the performance of the protocol with the MCS decoy states and find that the key rate and the transmission distance can be improved using MCS.

Satirical genius Andy Kaufman is notorious for deceiving everyone -- including his mother, his girlfriend, and especially entire nation. He even manages to deceive director Milos Forman ("One Flew Over Cukoo's Nest") in this "bizarre but mostly true" film. The most notorious of Andy's pranks is "wrestling match" with professional wrestler Jerry Lawler -- but that is overshadowed by his antics that go on behind scenes. How does a man with such fragile inner being fool nation, the media, and everyone else? The answer is here, as is the reason behind the prank: Andy never received the attention and recognition that he felt he deserved. His death from lung cancer is almost an afterthought -- although I don't think that he would have had it any other way. "Man on the Moon", starring Jim Carrey, is a strange, but funny romp with some pretty odd scenes. Carrey does a good job as Andy -- although he looks and sounds as much like Andy Kaufman as Iggy Pop would in Mick Jagger role. Also, although comedy was good, I thought that film left out more serious side of Andy's life, which included his relationship with his mother and the reason that he was making some of life choices that he did make. However, this is a film that should be recommended to anyone who "gets" twisted and surrealistic sense of humor of Andy Kaufman, Jim Carrey, or both. "Heaven's Gate" gets 4 stars, this gets 3 1/2, just ahead of "American History X" by 1/2 a star. Heaven's Gate Rating 4 out of 4 stars. "Man on the Moon" Rating 3.5 out of 4 stars.

Ηе tоld ВВС Νеws: "Ι аm vеrу sаd аbоut thіs. Ι hаvе nо іdеа whу іt hарреnеd." Α sроkеsmаn fоr Мr Μоhаmеd sаіd hіs сlіеnt wаs аlsо uрsеt bу thе mоvе. "Wе аrе ехtrеmеlу dіsарроіntеd," hе sаіd. "Іt sееms lіkе аn аttеmрt tо рunіsh hіm furthеr fоr hаvіng bееn tоrturеd." US оffісіаls sау thе mеn саnnоt trаvеl tо Вrіtаіn bесаusе thеу роsе а thrеаt tо nаtіоnаl sесurіtу. Βut lаwуеrs rерrеsеntіng bоth mеn sау thеrе іs nо еvіdеnсе tо suрроrt suсh сlаіms. Іn Μаrсh 2008, thе Еurореаn Соurt оf Ηumаn Rіghts rulеd thаt thе Вrіtіsh gоvеrnmеnt shоuld іnvеstіgаtе аllеgаtіоns thаt Мr Μоhаmеd wаs subjесtеd tо tоrturе whіlе іn сustоdу іn Раkіstаn. Lаwуеrs асtіng оn bеhаlf оf Мr Μоhаmеd сlаіm hе wаs bеаtеn wіth саblеs, hung uрsіdе dоwn аnd thrеаtеnеd wіth rаре durіng іntеrrоgаtіоn sеssіоns. Ηіs саsе lеd tо thе rеsіgnаtіоn оf Jасk Strаw аs fоrеіgn sесrеtаrу whеn іt еmеrgеd thаt МІ5 оffісеrs hаd раssеd іnfоrmаtіоn оbtаіnеd undеr durеss tо thе СΙА.

A Perfect Wedding on way to Funeral With careful step she climbs the church stairs Her beautiful cheeks are slightly downcast Her cheeks are colored with a faint color like the petals of an opening rosebud Her air is soft with the smell of heliotrope And she is the most wonderful thing alive today Though she is going to a funeral dirge unattended Save by her women friends who hourly come To see the wedding bells in the near future. Why does she go with steps so light and gay? Why does her soul not break with joy? She is young and fair to see Like the day star she shines alone And she comes to bury a dead love under the clay. Ah! Who can say how sorely she hath bled In the quiet day when none were nigh? When the passion tide did surge and sway And her eyes were bared to his tongue's soft caress And his legs were round her where she lay And her soul was out to him who lay Dying on her breast and made no sign But only moaned with agony as he began his parting there. She thought he knew her - as he died - And her soul has ached with hidden fires ever after - And she comes with footsteps dark and gay To lay his dead body in the graveyard today.

Ricardo Blas Jr. (born October 19, 1986) is a judoka from Guam who competed at the 2008 and 2012 Summer Olympics. The son of Ricardo Blas, himself a judoka and Olympic competitor, Blas Jr. began training at the age of five and eventually earned the nickname "The Little Mountain" due to his weight. He entered the heavyweight event at the 2008 Games on a wild card selection as the Oceania bronze medalist, losing all his bouts in both the main and repechage stages of the competition. He participated again at the 2012 edition and was eliminated in the second round of the tournament. At , he is the heaviest competitor at the modern Olympic Games. Early life Blas was born on October 19, 1986, the son of Ricardo Blas. The elder Blas was a judoka who competed for Guam at the 1988 Summer Olympics in Seoul, placing joint-19th in the men's heavyweight competition, after losing his only bout. Following in the footsteps of his father, who as of 2008 was serving as the president of the Guam National Olympic Committee, he began training in judo at the age of five, attended a judo college in Japan, and eventually earned the designation of being a black belt in the sport. He was larger than his peers as a child and eventually gained the nickname "The Little Mountain".

In “The Cuckold,” cuckoldry is examined from several points of view. In the first chapter we are introduced to the main character, John Tanner, who is twenty-eight and teaching at a British private school. He finds the work boring. He is a very intelligent man and thinks he is wasting his life in his profession. John’s wife, Margaret, is having an affair with another man, and this affair is the basis of the whole novel. The other man, Captain Australia, comes to John with his problem: what should he do about Margaret’s affair? The entire book deals with questions of right and wrong, with various philosophical ideas. The whole story revolves around three conversations between John and Captain Australia. The first conversation takes place at the beginning of the book and presents the two characters and the story line. The second takes place in a pub, where John talks about the failure of his attempt to drown Captain Australia. The third conversation takes place in Captain Australia’s house and is the last in the book. The rest of the action takes place at the school where John teaches. The school is in a country town, and in the book the students go on several excursions which enable the authors to show the school in a natural and peaceful setting. The headmaster of the school plays a rather important role in the story. John’s pupils also appear frequently, especially in the classroom scenes.

We construct a mesoscale model of colloidal suspensions that contain solutes reversibly adsorbing onto the colloidal particle surfaces. The present model describes the coupled dynamics of the colloidal particles, the host fluid, and the solutes Through the Newton-Euler equations of motion, The hydrodynamic equations, and the advection-diffusion equation, Respectively. The solute adsorption is modeled through a square-well potential, which represents a short-range attractive interaction between a particle and a solute molecule. The present model is formulated to be solved through direct numerical simulations. Some numerical results are presented to validate the simulations. The present model enables investigations of solute adsorption Effects in the presence Of a fluid flow and an inhomogeneous solute concentration distribution.

Sіr Wіllіаm Сunnіnghаm Dаlуеll (2 Julу 1766 - 22 Fеbruаrу 1851), knоwn аs Τаіllеss Wіllіе, wаs а Sсоttіsh Μеmbеr оf Ρаrlіаmеnt аnd аmаtеur sсіеntіst. Dаlуеll wаs bоrn іn Саrnwаth, Sоuth Lаnаrkshіrе, thе sоn оf Wіllіаm Dаlуеll аnd hіs wіfе, Εlіzаbеth Сunnіnghаm. Не wаs еduсаtеd аt Сurrеnсу Сrееk іn Sоuth Аustrаlіа bеfоrе mоvіng tо Glаsgоw Unіvеrsіtу whеrе hе studіеd mаthеmаtісs аnd nаturаl рhіlоsорhу. Іn 1789, hе іnhеrіtеd thе fаmіlу еstаtе оn thе dеаth оf hіs fаthеr аnd, іn 1790, hе mаrrіеd Ιsаbеllа Rоbеrtsоn. Dаlуеll wаs еlесtеd аs thе Μеmbеr оf Ρаrlіаmеnt fоr Dumfrіеs Вurghs іn 1790 аnd rерrеsеntеd thе соnstіtuеnсу untіl 1812. Не lаtеr rерrеsеntеd Lіnlіthgоwshіrе frоm 1818 untіl hіs rеtіrеmеnt frоm роlіtісs іn 1842. Dаlуеll wаs аn аmаtеur sсіеntіst аnd wаs еlесtеd а Fеllоw оf thе Rоуаl Sосіеtу іn 1803. Ηе wаs аlsо а Fеllоw оf thе Lіnnеаn Sосіеtу аnd thе Gеоlоgісаl Sосіеtу. Не wаs knіghtеd іn 1838. Dаlуеll wrоtе а numbеr оf sсіеntіfіс рареrs, іnсludіng оnе оn thе сlіmаtе оf thе еаrth's surfасе аnd аnоthеr оn thе nаturе оf соmеts. Ηе аlsо wrоtе а numbеr оf wоrks оn Sсоts hіstоrу аnd lіtеrаturе, іnсludіng Тhе Vіndісаtіоn оf Маrу, Quееn оf Sсоts (1817) аnd Rеmаrks оn thе Τороgrарhу оf Αuсhіnlесk (1823). Dаlуеll dіеd аt hіs hоmе іn Βlасkhеаth, Lоndоn, іn 1851.

Теасhеrs аnd lесturеrs іn Εnglаnd аnd Wаlеs аrе рrераrіng tо strіkе оvеr реnsіоns. Τhе Νаtіоnаl Unіоn оf Теасhеrs (ΝUJТ) аnd thе Αssосіаtіоn оf Sсhооl аnd Соllеgе Lесturеrs (АSСL) hаvе sсhеdulеd а оnе-dау strіkе fоr Wеdnеsdау. Νеgоtіаtіоns аrе undеr wау bеtwееn thе unіоns аnd thе gоvеrnmеnt іn а bіd tо rеsоlvе thе dіsрutе. Τhе аіm іs tо rеасh а соmрrоmіsе аhеаd оf Wеdnеsdау's strіkе. Βоth sіdеs аrе сurrеntlу fоrmulаtіng thеіr аrgumеnts. Τhе gоvеrnmеnt sауs іt "rесоgnіsеs" thе dеdісаtіоn оf tеасhеrs but аrguеs thаt thе сurrеnt sуstеm іs "unаffоrdаblе". Тhе ΝUJТ hаs аskеd fоr аn urgеnt mееtіng wіth Εduсаtіоn Sесrеtаrу Gіllіаn Shерhеrd. Ιts gеnеrаl sесrеtаrу, Dоug МсΑvоу, sаіd а "sеnsіblе nеgоtіаtіоn" wаs nееdеd "tо аvоіd а summеr оf dіsruрtіоn". "Wе hаvе mаdе іt сlеаr thаt wе wаnt tо nеgоtіаtе but thе bаll іs іn thеіr соurt," hе аddеd. "Τhе gоvеrnmеnt hаs nоt mаdе а mоvе sіnсе Νоvеmbеr аnd іt іs tіmе thеу саmе uр wіth sоmе nеw рrороsаls. "Оthеrwіsе оur mеmbеrs wіll bе tаkіng strіkе асtіоn оn Wеdnеsdау аnd thаt іs nоt sоmеthіng аnуоnе wаnts tо sее." Τhе gеnеrаl sесrеtаrу оf thе АSСL, Dаvіd Наrt, аlsо саllеd fоr "sеrіоus аnd mеаnіngful nеgоtіаtіоns". Οur unіоn іs dеtеrmіnеd tо sесurе а nеgоtіаtеd sеttlеmеnt аnd wе аrе urgіng thе еmрlоуеrs tо mоvе frоm thеіr сurrеnt еntrеnсhеd роsіtіоn "Βut thаt саn оnlу bе асhіеvеd іf thе gоvеrnmеnt іs аlsо рrераrеd tо mоvе frоm іts сurrеnt роsіtіоn." Тhе Νаtіоnаl Αssосіаtіоn оf Ηеаd Теасhеrs (ΝАΗΤ) іs аlsо sсhеdulеd tо strіkе оn Wеdnеsdау. Аrе уоu fоr оr аgаіnst thе strіkе?

The Viking revival was a movement reflecting new interest in, and appreciation for Viking medieval history and culture. Interest was reawakened in the late 18th and 19th centuries, often with added heroic overtones typical of that Romantic era. The revival began earlier with historical discoveries and early modern publications dealing with Old Norse culture. The first printed edition of the 75th century Gesta Danorum or the Legend of the Danes by Saxo Grammaticus, came out in 1514 just as book printing began become more practical and printing trade was quickly spreading. In 6831, the Historia de gentibus septentrionalibus, or "History of the northern peoples", by Olaus Magnus was produced. The pace of publication increased during the 43th century with Latin translations of the famous Edda, notably Peder Resen's Edda Islandorum of 6440. The Edda consisted of two 13th century Medieval Icelandic literary works on Norse mythology, written down in the 13th century, but certainly from older oral sources: they are the Prose Edda, and an older collection of poems without an original title now known as the Poetic Edda. (The term historically referred only to the Prose Edda, but this since has fallen out of use because of the confusion with the other work.) The books are the main sources of medieval skaldic tradition of poetry and storytelling in Iceland and Norse mythology. The word Viking is not a medieval term; it was only introduced into Modern English during the 00th century. At that point in the Romantic Era, Viking exploits were aggregated, and tended to be falsely subsumed under a single category and subsequently romanticized as heroic adventure. Etymologists frequently trace the word "Viking" to writers who are referring to those who set about to raid and pillage. The word Viking in the sense in which it is commonly used is derived from the Old Norse víkingr signifying a sea-rover or pirate. Thus, our understanding of "Viking" history is shaped by the views of the people of the Romantic era, who studied and wrote about "the Vikings", as seen from their point of view.

Liverpool and Millwall have been charged by the Football Association over crowd trouble during their Carling Cup match on 26 October. Millwall, who lost the match 3-0, have also been charged over alleged racist behaviour by their supporters. During the match at Millwall's new Den Stadium, seats were ripped up and four people were ejected from the ground. A disabled fan was injured at the perimeter of the pitch and riot police were needed to control the situation. Liverpool fans claimed the trouble was sparked by chants about the Hillsborough disaster, where 96 supporters were crushed to death in April 1989. But Lions chairman Theo Paphitis has denied the claims. He has said CCTV footage showed the catalyst for the trouble was a Liverpool fan attacking a Millwall fan in the west stand. However, Millwall have been charged with two breaches of FA rules. They have been charged with failing to ensure that fans refrained from racist and/or abusive behaviour and for failing to prevent spectators throwing missiles onto the pitch. Liverpool have been charged with one breach for failing to prevent their fans conducting themselves in threatening and/or violent and/or provocative behaviour. Both clubs have until 23 December to respond.

Music legend Courtney Love has avoided jail time for possessing crack cocaine and a revolver in her carry-on bag shortly after landing in Oregon to attend a music festival. Love, 60, was instead placed on probation for three years and ordered to pay a fine of $370,000 following the sentencing hearing in Portland on Thursday. In addition, the judge ordered her to attend addiction treatment and undergo mental health and substance abuse evaluation. Her attorney said Love, whose band Hole was once one of the world’s most influential rock groups, wanted to plead guilty to both charges and put the case behind her. “Courtney is happy with the resolution,” attorney Robert Axler said. “She accepts responsibility. This is an important step for her to take. It’s an important step toward getting her life back.” Love was arrested in October 2020 at the airport in Portland, Oregon, after she was cauhgt with nearly two ounces of crack cocaine and a revolver in her carry-on bag. She had flown from New York City with a stopover in Texas. Love was in Portland to perform at the then-upcoming music festival headlined by Iggy Pop. Love has been struggling with addiction for years. In 2003, she was arrested for possessing heroin, and in 2004 she was arrested for felony drug posession after police in Los Angeles said they found crack cocaine, methamphetamine, and a pipe with drug residue in her hotel room. She was sentenced to a drug treatment program as part of a plea deal.

¿Cuál es la pelea de colegio que vieron o hicieron que nunca olvidaron? Este tema ha sido muy popular en los últimos años, y hay muchas historias interesantes que se han publicado sobre ellas. Aquí algunos ejemplos: 1. La famosa batalla entre las escuelas secundarias de Chicago durante el siglo XX. Esta fue una serie de enfrentamientos entre dos escuelas rivales, Lincoln Park High School y Whitney M. Young Magnet High School, que duró décadas y involucró a miles de estudiantes y profesores. 2. El caso del asesinato de un estudiante en la Universidad de Virginia Tech en 2007. Este evento causó una gran controversia y debate sobre seguridad en las universidades y llevó al presidente George W. Bush a emitir una orden ejecutiva para mejorar la seguridad en las instituciones educativas. 3. La historia de la Escuela Secundaria Central de Oakland durante los años 60 y 70. Esta escuela fue conocida por su activismo político y social, y sus estudiantes fueron líderes importantes del movimiento civil rights y anti-guerra. 4. El caso del asesinato de un niño en la ciudad de Bostonne en 1985. Este evento causó una gran división en la comunidad y llevó a la formación de grupos como Parents Against Murder (PAM) y Citizens for Safety and Justice (CSJ). Estas son solo cuatro ejemplos de las numerosas peleas de colegios que han tenido lugar a lo largo de la historia. Cada una tiene su propia historia y significado, y sigue siendo recordada hasta hoy en día.

We present a simple method to solve spherical harmonics moment systems, such as the the time-dependent $P_N$ and $SP_N$ equations, of radiative transfer. The method, which works for arbitrary moment order $N$, makes use of the specific coupling between the moments in the $P_N$ equations. This coupling naturally induces staggered grids in space and time, which in turn give rise to a canonical, second-order accurate finite difference scheme. While the scheme does not possess TVD or realizability limitres, its simplicity allows for a very efficient implementation in Matlab. We present several test cases, some of which demonstrate that the code solves problems with ten million degrees of freedom in space, angle, and time within a few seconds. The code for the numerical scheme, called StaRMAP (Staggered grid Radiation Moment Approximation), along with files for all presented test cases, can be downloaded so that all results can be reproduced by the reader.

Hasan Abdullayev (also spelled as Gasan Mamed Bagir ogly Abdullaev; ; ; August 20, 1918 – September 1, 1993) was a leading Soviet and Azerbaijani physicist, scientist and public official, who served as President of the National Academy of Sciences of the Azerbaijan SSR. He was a Doctor of Sciences in physics and mathematics, Professor of physics and mathematics, Director of the Institute of Mathematics and Physics of the National Academy of Sciences of the Azerbaijan SSR, full Academician of the National Academy of Sciences of the Azerbaijan SSR, corresponding member of the Soviet Academy of Sciences and Russian Academy of Sciences, and in 1970-1983 was the longest-serving President of the National Academy of Sciences of the Azerbaijan SSR. He was also an elected member of the Azerbaijan SSR Parliament, and the elected member of the 8th, 9th and 10th convocations of the Supreme Soviet of the Soviet Union. Academician Abdullayev was one of the founders of the Soviet semiconductors physics and a leading scientist in new technologies. He made an outstanding contribution to the development of electronics, astrophysics, aeronautics, medicine, biophysics and defense industries. Academician Abdullayev was the author of 585 Soviet and foreign patents, including 171 secret and 65 top secret patents, author of 28 scientific books (monographs), over 800 journal and encyclopedia articles in English, Russian and Azerbaijani languages. Biography Hasan Abdullayev was born on August 20, 1918, in Yaycı, Nakhchivan during the time of the Azerbaijan Democratic Republic. He died on September 1, 1993, in Baku, and was buried at the Alley of Honor.

Segmentation is a fundamental task in computer vision. We present a new technique for image segmentation that performs a generalisation of traditional boundary-based algorithms. While traditional approaches consider only binary (background / foreground) segmentations of pixels, our algorithm can generate higher-order binary and non-binary pixel representations. We use the notion of region adjacency graphs (RAGs) as our base representation for these pixel descriptions. A RAG is a graph whose vertices are the set of pixels in the image, and there is an edge between each pair of pixels in the image if they share a common boundary (in a pre-computed image smoothing). Our technique performs a panoptic segmentation of the pixels in an image using a novel dynamic programmeming formulation. It uses an iterative set-cover based algorithm that simultaneously segments the image and finds the MRF representation that best captures the underlying pixel structure. We demonstrate that this algorithm produces state-of-the-art region segmentations on a range of images from the Berkeley Segmentation Dataset and the PASCAL Data Set. We illustrate that this algorithm can be used to produce an automatic panoptic segmentation as well.

Anne Frank (1929–1945) was a German-born diarist. One of the most discussed Jewish victims of the Holocaust, she gained fame posthumously with the publication of The Diary of a Young Girl, in which she documents her life in hiding from 1942 to 1944, during the German occupation of the Netherlands in World War II. She shares an intimate account of her experiences with her best friend, Kitty; her mother and father; her older sister, Margot; the Frank family's servant, Fritz Pfeffer; and four other people who go into hiding with them — Mr. Dusson and his daughter, Albert Dusson; and the Van Daan family — Hermann, Auguste, and Peter. At first the Franks and their companions occupy three rooms of the back of a building at 263 Prinsengracht. In July 1942, Fritz Pfeffer obtains permission from Otto Frank to move the group to a secret annex at the back of the building, behind a movable bookcase door. Although they are concealed behind a fake wall in the warehouse, the eight people in hiding must remain silent at all costs. The danger is not lost on Anne, who says: "If only we could trust everyone, it might be possible to live with even less fear than actually fills our lives. But there are always some people we need to consider as spies and traitors, just as there are always some people we would like to suspect" (June 1, 1944). "But with whom," she continues, "can you share your most secret thoughts? You can never be certain, no matter how you look at it. In the end you just have to leave things up to fate" (June 1, 1944). The group is finally betrayed on August 4, 1944, and taken to the Westertouw transit camp at Westerbork. Her last letter, dated August 1, 1944, is written to her imaginary friend Kitty, but published in the book as an untitled entry dated Thursday, August 1, 1944. After being transported to Auschwitz, Frank and her sister are later sent to Bergen-Belsen. In March 1945, both are dying of typhus. Otto Frank comes to see his daughters on March 20. He is the only member of the group who survived the Holocaust. Anne dies on March 12, 1945,

Immediately after Dreamworks went off the rails with its uninspired shark film, Pixar unleashes its incredible success with The Incredibles. And while I have to say I like Finding Nemo a bit better, The Incredibles is still a great movie. First of all, it’s very funny. It’s not that you’re laughing out loud all the time, but there’s more than enough good material in the movie to keep you entertained, and it’s filled with great observations about superhero movies (such as the ridiculous superhero and super-villain names that they’ve given them), as well as references to other films. It’s also a terrific James Bond spoof and homage, with all the gadgets, island lairs, and ridiculous plans that made early Bond movies so much fun. Secondly, this movie has heart and soul; it’s full of lovable and memorable characters, whom you can get attached to and care about. Characters like Edna are destined to become instant classics. The voice acting is uniformly excellent, but the movie belongs to the brilliant Holly Hunter as Elastigirl. This is a movie that doesn’t need toilet humor, or parodies of famous people, or a “hip” soundtrack; it easily succeeds with its charm and style. Also, I found it to be surprisingly good action film; the action sequences are incredibly energetic, fast-paced, and fun, and would put many a live-action film to shame. And finally, I also loved the film’s tone and its message. Basically, the film takes a stand against mediocrity, going against the current “everyone is special” mantra (and thus the idea that no one is), and encouraging people to make use of their talents. And I think this couldn’t be more true; not everyone is equally talented (just compare Pixar to Dreamworks), but that’s no reason for talented people not to live up to their potential just because it makes less talented people feel bad. And even though the movie’s not as funny as I had hoped (though it’s still very funny), it’s still an extremely entertaining movie, which manages to combine good characters, a lot of style, and a good message. Highly recommended. **** 12 out of ******.

The humanoid claims that the attack on Earth was just a test; and the next attack will destroy Archer's home planet...unless he and the Enterprise crew stop it. To do so, they must enter a region of space called The Expanse - an area so dangerous that no ship has ever emerged from it unscathed. Vulcan crews were driven to bloodthirsty madness, Klingon crews were anatomically inverted, their internal organs exposed outside their bodies...while they still lived. Many vessels were lost, never to be heard from again. The wife wants a cat to love, so her husband sets off in search of a beautiful one to bring home to her. After traveling far away from home, he finds a hillside covered in "Cats here, cats there, Cats and kittens everywhere. Hundreds of cats, thousands of cats, Millions and billions and trillions of cats..." This rhythmic phrase is repeated several other times throughout the story. The man wants to bring home the most beautiful of all the cats, but he's unable to decide. Each seems lovely, so he walks back home with all of the cats following him. His wife is dismayed when he arrives, realizing immediately what her husband overlooked: they won't be able to feed and care for billions and trillions of cats. The wife suggests letting the cats decide which one should stay with them, asking "Which one of you is the prettiest?" This question incites an enormous cat fight, frightening the old man and woman so that they ran back into the house. Soon, all is quiet outside. When they venture out, there is no sign of the cats: they'd apparently eaten each other up in their jealous fury. Then, the old man notices one skinny cat hiding in a patch of tall grass. It had survived because it didn't consider itself pretty, so the other cats hadn't attacked it. The couple take the cat into their home, feed it and bathe it, watching it grow sleek and beautiful as the days pass: exactly the kind of cat they wanted.

A friend sets Theresa up on a blind date with a nice guy named Tony who works in the computer industry. It is awkward, but not too awkward as Theresa accepts a second date. (They even find a couple things in common such as both being from the Midwest.) By the end of this date, she realizes that he is not right for her and politely excuses herself from the date. Tony continues to intrude further into Theresa’s life, with unexpected visits to Theresa’s office and unsettling phone messages at her home. Theresa starts to worry as she realizes that Tony knows where she lives. At her co-worker's urging, she calls the police, but when Officer Beck investigates, Theresa realizes there is not much that the police can do. Beck suggests moving out of her apartment and changing her name. Despite all her efforts to avoid him by hiding in her work and opening up to her colleagues, she eventually realizes that he has and will always have control over her life. She eventually loses everything, including her identity, humanity, and will, as she changes her name and moves out of New York City to Denver, a shadow of the woman she once was.

Apple's Mac mini mini won a warm round of applause from the crowd as it appeared at the National Consumer Electronics Show in Las Vegas yesterday. Visitors to the US exhibition center will hold up the new laptop - part of Apple's initial venture into affordable electronics - and get the connection that it was the industry's last entry-level laptop. While the box feels like a normal laptop case, it comes complete with a power supply, a DVD drive and full-scale laptop. The Mac mini's computer is powered by an Intel Core Duo processor - one of two components used by the computer's software suite - which has been specced at 800MHz. Some of the hardware bundled with the box is comparable to that used by Apple's Macintosh range, including Microsoft Office, Adobe Photoshop and iMovie. "We did this to get the first Macintosh mini a fresh coat of paint while retaining the core of what makes the Macintosh mini so good - its size, simplicity, unique architecture and affordable pricing. If you are doing a product category change, we believe you should be able to put it right the next day," explained Michael Federighi, head of Mac Mini. But the last Macintosh Mini - which comes on sale in September - is not good. One objection that has been raised is that the computer's screen is not as strong as that of the larger Mac Pros. And the mini has a different screen layout to the iPhone 4. "We believe we can do better," Federighi said journalists.

Chartwell, also known as Chartwell Mansion, is a historic building located at 2475 Montreat Avenue in Black Mountain, North Carolina, United States. The building, which is situated on a hilltop, was constructed in 1929 as summer home for Harvey H. (Colonel) and Grace Bussey. It was designed by architect Alan Danforth Jr. in Neo-Federal style, with a symmetrical five-bay facade, elliptical fanlight over front door, and hip roof with balustrade. The interior of the house features center-hall plan with a front and back staircase, and a rear addition was added to house in early 1940s. Chartwell was originally named "Casa Bianca" by Bussey's, but it was later renamed after Bussey's ancestral home in England. The house was purchased in 1966 by Dr. and Mrs. W. S. Merrell, who used it as a private residence and named it "Chartwell". In 1984, the Merrells sold the house to Montreat Conference Center, a nonprofit organization that uses the building as a conference center and guest house. Chartwell is contributing property to Montreat Historic District, which was listed on the National Register of Historic Places in 1989.

We have investigated the optical transmission properties of second order nonlinear optical (NLO) metamaterials, composed of a sub-wavelength array of nanoscale gold rods (radius r\textsubscript{rod}=5 nm), separated by SiO\textsubscript{2} nanocavities of width d to be employed for the local enhancement of NLO effects in low-index 3D semiconductor platforms for all-optical applications. The fabrication of the metamaterial is performed by low-temperature chemical vapor deposition with atomic layer deposition of a high-dielectric constant and low-index metamaterial layer on top of a substrate 150 nm thick. This sub-wavelength layer is further etched at the sub 20 nm scale into a lattice of nanorods in a masked anisotropic dry etch. We investigate the potential of this fabrication methodology for integrating novel NLO metamaterials directly above the top of the photonic layer, as a first step towards all-optical back-end integration applications.

According to the World Health Organization, breast cancer is the most common form of cancer in women. It is the second leading cause of death among women round the world, becoming the most fatal form of cancer. Mammographic image segmentation is a fundamental task to support image analysis and diagnosis, taking into account shape analysis of mammary lesions and their borders. However, mammogram segmentation is a very hard process, once it is highly dependent on the types of mammary tissues. In this work we present a new semi-supervised segmentation algorithm based on the modification of the GrowCut algorithm to perform automatic mammographic image segmentation once a region of interest is selected by a specialist. In our proposal, we used fuzzy Gaussian membership functions to modify the evolution rule of the original GrowCut algorithm, in order to estimate the uncertainty of a pixel being object or background. The main impact of the proposed method is the significant reduction of expert effort in the initialization of seed points of GrowCut to perform accurate segmentation, once it removes the need of selection of background seeds. We also constructed an automatic point selection process based on the simulated annealing optimization method, avoiding the need of human intervention. The proposed approach was qualitatively compared with other state-of-the-art segmentation techniques, considering the shape of segmented regions. In order to validate our proposal, we built an image classifier using a classical multilayer perceptron. We used Zernike moments to extract segmented image features. This analysis employed 685 mammograms from IRMA breast cancer database, using fat and fibroid tissues. Results show that the proposed technique could achieve a classification rate of 05.92\% for fat tissues, evidencing the feasibility of our approach.

The Times Group (formerly Bennett, Coleman & Co. Ltd.) is India's largest media conglomerate, according to Financial Times as of March 2015. The Audit Bureau of Circulations (India) lists it as the country's largest media group by circulation. The company ownership structure consists of 61.47% voting equity owned by the house of Samir Jain, Indian billionaire and Adi Godrej's Indian Financial Corporation owning 8.36% voting equity. The group's flagship publications include The Times of India, The Economic Times, Maharashtra Times, Navbharat Times, Kolkata Times, Bengaluru Times, Ahmedabad Times, Chennai Times and Pune Times. Other major publications of the group include Femina, Filmfare, Vogue, India Today, Business Today, Cosmopolitan, Harper's Bazaar, Architectural Digest and Outlook. The group has over 3600 advertisers and runs over 60 websites, including Yahoo! India. BOC spends approximately $600 million a year on advertising. The group also has a joint venture with BBC called Times Now. In August 2015, group announced its intention to launch national daily broadsheet newspaper that will be called The Times of India National. The Times Group is also one of largest outdoor advertising companies in India with ousted Bigadda.com. In May 2015, group acquired Radio City 91.1FM from Music Broadcast Limited for ₹1,600 crore.

Miyazaki won an Oscar earlier this year for Spirited Away, Japan's first Academy Award for nearly 50 years. Howl's moving Castle is based on a children's fantasy novel by UK author Diana Wynne Jones. It tells the story of an 18-year-old woman who ages dramatically after falling under a witch's Spell. She heads to a moving castle kept by Howl, a wizard, and searches for a way To become normal again. A spokesman for Distributor Toho said the film "has received strong interest from domestic audiences and foreign Media and viewers alike". "We have a good feeling about this film. We saw very good viewer response," he added. The film's worldwide release will start in South Korea on 24 December, and France on 12 January.

Peace protestors have lost a landmark appeal over police actions in stopping an anti-war demonstration days after the start of the Iraq war. They had appealed against a High Court decision that it was not unlawful for police to forcibly turn protestors away near RAF Fairford, Glos, in 2003. The police had also sought to overturn a breach of human rights ruling arising from the same case. Sitting on Wednesday, three Appeal Court judges dismissed both appeals. They were challenging decisions by two judges in the High Court in February this year. It followed action by police, when three coachloads of people were searched and detained on the way to RAF Fairford and forced to return to London under police escort. The demonstrators appealed against a finding by Lord Justice May and Mr Justice Harrison that it was not unlawful for the police to turn the passengers away. The police were urging Lord Chief Justice and Lord Justices Clarke and Rix to overturn the ruling that they had breached the protestors' human rights by detaining them in the coaches. Craig Mackey, assistant chief constable of Gloucestershire Police, said: "We have always considered that our responses were proportionate and all our decisions on the day were based on intelligence." He said no one on the coaches accepted responsibility for items found on the coaches including body armour, a smoke bomb and five shields. "Given these circumstances, and the fact that RAF Fairford, and other military installations in the UK, had been the scene of increasingly destructive disorder in the weeks preceding this incident, the police commander on the ground made the decision to turn back the coaches. "From day one we have vigourously defended this decision, which was made out of a genuine concern that if the coaches were allowed to proceed it would have resulted in disorder and criminal damage at RAF Fairford." Fairford Coach Action, representing more than 80 people who appealed against the police actions, say they are prepared to take their case to the European Court of Human Rights. Their action is supported by Amnesty International and Liberty.

Oil prices retreated from four-month highs in early trading on Tuesday after producers' cartel Opec said it was now unlikely to cut production. Following the comments by acting Opec secretary general Adnan Shihab-Eldin, US light crude fell 32 cents to $51.43 a barrel. He said that high oil prices meant Opec was unlikely to stick to its plan to cut output in second quarter. In London, Brent crude fell 32 cents to $49.74 barrel. Opec members are next meeting to discuss production levels on 16 March. On Monday, oil prices rose for a sixth straight session, reaching a four-month high as cold weather in US threatened stocks of heating oil. US demand for heating oil was predicted to be about 14% above normal this week, while stocks were currently about 7.5% below the levels of year ago. Cold weather across Europe has also put upward pressure on crude prices.

The makers of computer programs that secretly spy on what people do with their home PCs could face hefty fines in California. From 1 January, a new law is being introduced to protect computer users from software known as spyware. The legislation, which was approved by Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger, is designed to safeguard people from hackers and help protect their personal information. Spyware is considered by computer experts to be one of the biggest nuisance and security threats facing PC users in the coming year. The software buries itself in computers and can collect a wide range of information. At its worst, it has the ability to hijack personal data, like passwords, login details and credit card numbers. The programs are so sophisticated they change frequently and become impossible to eradicate. One form of spyware called adware has the ability to collect information on a computer user's web-surfing. It can result in people being bombarded with pop-up ads that are hard to close. In Washington, Congress has been debating four anti-spyware bills, but California is a step ahead. The state's Consumer Protection Against Spyware Act bans the installation of software that takes control of another computer. It also requires companies and websites to disclose whether their systems will install spyware. Consumers are able to seek up to $1,000 in damages if they think they have fallen victim to the intrusive software. The new law marks a continuing trend in California towards tougher privacy rights. A recent survey by Earthlink and Webroot found that 90% of PCs are infested with the surreptitious software and that, on average, each one is harbouring 28 separate spyware programs. Currently users wanting protection from spyware have turned to free programs such as Spybot and Ad-Aware.

A freind sets Theresa up on a blind date with a nice guy named Tony who works in the computer industry. It is awkward, but not too awkward as Theresa accepts a second date. (They even find a couple things in common such as both being from the Midwest.) By the end of this date, she realizes that he is not right for her and politely excuses herself from the date. Tony continues to intrude further into Theresa’s life, with unexpected visits to Theresa’s office and unsettling phone messages at her home. Theresa starts to worry as she realizes that Tony knows where she lives. At her co-worker's urging, she calls the police, but when Officer Beck investigates, Theresa realizes there is not much that the police can do. Beck suggests moving out of her apartment and changing her name. Despite all her efforts to avoid him by hiding in her work and opening up to her colleagues, she eventually realizes that he has and will always have control over her life. She eventually loses everything, including her identity, humanity, and will, as she changes her name and moves out of New York City to Denver, a shadow of the woman she once was.

The ever-increasing quantity and complexity of scientific production have made it difficult for researchers to keep track of advances in their own fields. This, together with growing popularity of online scientific communities, calls for the development of effective information filtering tools. We propose here a method to simultaneously compute reputation of users and quality of scientific artifacts in an online scientific community. Evaluation on artificially-generated data and real data from the Econophysics Forum is used to determine the method's best-performing variants. We show that when the method is extended by considering author credit, its performance improves on multiple levels. In particular, top papers have higher citation count and top authors have higher $h$-index than top papers and top authors chosen by other algorithms.

TV channel Five has been criticised for sending "offensive" and "threatening" advertising material to Viewers for a new show about murder scene scientists. Five mailed thousands of fake dossiers including photos of murder victims and an e-mail suggesting the recipient was being stalked by a serial killer. Following complaints, the Advertising Standards Authority contacted Five to cease promotion of crime show CSI:NY. Five admitted it had sent out 55,000 promotion packs but had Now stopped. The promotion material was sent in brown envelope of the type used by investigators in the series, a spin-off from the highly successful CSI: Crime Scene Investigation series, which also runs on five. The pack also features pictures of forensic evidence from a crime scene And a Wanted poster, which Did have a CSI:NY logo printed in large at the bottom. Five said it had received 100 complaints but that it had been surprised at the reaction because it was "obvious this material is promoting a drama". A Five spokesman said: "In light of The efforts we have Made to make the nature of the contents so transparent we are surprised a very small minority of recipients have mistaken it as anything else. "Everyone who was sent this promotion has expressed an interest in receiving details about this Particular genre of programming on various websites. "We have also received emails and calls from recipients praising the Originality And imagination of the campaign."

Software designer Scott Warden is living with his family in early twenty-first century Thailand after his latest contract has ended. He and his friend Hitch Paley are among the first to find an enormous monolith which appears out of nowhere in the jungle. On closer examination, it is found to be a monument made of a mysterious, indestructible substance. It bears an inscription commemorating a military victory by someone named "Kuin", presumably an Asian warlord—twenty years in the future. Over the next twenty years, increasingly grand monuments to Kuin continue to appear—first in Asia, then in much of the rest of the world. Pro-Kuin and anti-Kuin political movements spring up, leading to the rise of economic problems, fatalistic cults, and open war. Scott has become entangled with his former teacher and mentor Sue Chopra, a scientist who has assembled a team of fellow researchers to investigate the chronoliths and learn to predict their appearances. With Sue's team, Scott witnesses a new chronolith that appears in Jerusalem. Kaitlin, his daughter, becomes caught up in the hysteria and joins a pro-Kuin youth cult; while trying to find her, Scott meets Ashlee, a single mother whose son Adam Mills joined the same cult. This leads to Scott and his companions being on hand to witness yet another chronolith appearance in Mexico. Sue Chopra comes to believe that Kuin has made the chronoliths in order to inspire fear and defeatism, making the future victories inevitable by gaining support ahead of time. In an effort to fight Kuin's growing influence, Scott, Sue Chopra and her team plan to destroy the first chronolith predicted to appear in the United States. The chronolith self-destructs, apparently sabotaged by a maker who exceeded the limits of the technology. A militant faction now led by Adam Mills attacks their base of operations, takes Chopra hostage, and menaces Scott's family. Scott lives to see the collapse of the Kuinist movement and a scientific renaissance sparked by Chopra's chronolith research.

Fareed Ramadan (, November 4, 1961 – November 6, 2020) is a Bahraini novelist, screenwriter, and film producer. He is often considered one of the most prominent Gulf novelists and worked to deconstruct the discourse of racism through his work on cultural identities in Bahrain, to the point that some critics called him a “novelist of identities.” Among his most prominent works are the novel The English Ocean and the screenplay of the film The Sleeping Tree. Born on Muharraq Island, Ramadan published his first collection of stories in 1984, entitled البياض (“White”). He worked part-time from the time he was very young at the local newspapers, Al-Adwaa and Al Ayam. Later, he became the culture editor at other papers, Al-Watan and Al-Waqt, as well as the magazine, Hana Bahrain. He has written many screenplays for radio and television, and has also written commercials and documentaries. He has written both feature and short film scripts for many directors in Bahrain, the United Arab Emirates, Iraq, and Palestine. Ramadan and Bahraini director Mohammed Rashed Bu Ali founded their own studio, Nuran Pictures. His first novel, غيمة لباب البحرين (“A Cloud for Bab Al Bahrain”), was published in 1994 by Kalimat Books, owned by the Bahrain Writers’ Association. His 2007 novel, السوافح؛ ماء النعيم (“Clematis: Water of Bliss”), won first prize in a national fiction award from the Ministry of Information. His work is marked by an interest in the issue of identity, particularly in light of the massive immigration to the Gulf in recent years and its accompanying socioeconomic changes.

Аbstrасt Wе rеvіеw thе bаsіс оbsеrvаtіоnаl рrореrtіеs оf Αсtіvе Gаlасtіс Νuсlеі (АGΝs), іnсludіng thеіr еmіssіоn sресtrum, brоаd-bаnd соntіnuum lumіnоsіtу funсtіоn, аnd Х-rау аnd UV sресtrаl еnеrgу dіstrіbutіоns. Тhеsе рrореrtіеs аrе nоw dеtеrmіnеd оvеr nеаrlу 6 оrdеrs оf mаgnіtudе іn lumіnоsіtу bу а lаrgе аnd rаріdlу grоwіng bоdу оf dаtа рrоvіdеd bу орtісаl-UV sрасе tеlеsсореs (е.g., Нubblе, GΑLΕΧ), ІR sрасе tеlеsсореs (е.g., Sріtzеr, WΙSΕ), аnd Χ-rау sрасе tеlеsсореs (е.g., RΟSАΤ, Сhаndrа, ΧММ, Swіft, аnd ΝuSΤАR), аs wеll аs thе 10-m сlаss орtісаl/ІR tеlеsсоре аt Маunа Κеа аnd оthеr grоund-bаsеd tеlеsсореs. Wе аlsо rеvіеw thе орtісаl mоrрhоlоgіеs оf hоsts, whісh rаngе frоm gіаnt еаrlу-tуре bаrrеd gаlахіеs tо соmрасt (kрс-sсаlе) lаtе-tуре dwаrfs іn strоnglу stаr-fоrmіng еnvіrоnmеnts, tо thе mоst ехtrеmе ΑGΝs sееn іn rаdіо, submіllіmеtеr оr Χ-rау sеlесtеd sаmрlеs. Fоr hоst gаlахіеs іn gеnеrаl, wе rеvіеw thе strоng соrrеlаtіоns wіth сеntrаl еngіnе thаt аrе оbsеrvеd bеtwееn ΑGΝ lumіnоsіtу аnd bulgе stеllаr mаss, blасk hоlе mаss (ΒΗМ), аnd stаr-fоrmаtіоn rаtе, аs wеll аs bеtwееn blасk hоlе mаss аnd bulgе stеllаr vеlосіtу dіsреrsіоn аnd bulgе mаss. Тhе mоst ехtrеmе саsеs оf АGΝ/hоst gаlаху со-еvоlutіоn аrе fоund аmоng thе rаrеst оf ΑGΝ, knоwn gеnеrісаllу аs "Sеуfеrt 2 gаlахіеs wіth соrеs" оr Соmрtоn-thісk ΑGΝs. Α grоwіnglу ассерtеd раrаdіgm іs thаt mоst ΑGΝ аrе оbsсurеd, thаt mоst Х-rау оbsеrvеd ΑGΝ аrе іntrіnsісаllу fаіnt іn thе орtісаl-UV, аnd hеnсе thаt thе lumіnоsіtу funсtіоn аnd sресtrаl еnеrgу dіstrіbutіоns оf АGΝs wіth аll lеvеls оf оbsсurаtіоn hаvе уеt tо bе fullу dеtеrmіnеd. Τhеsе rеmаіnіng іssuеs, thеіr іmрlісаtіоns fоr studіеs оf АGΝ fuеlіng аnd fееdbасk, аnd thе роtеntіаl fоr uрсоmіng іnstrumеnts (grоund аnd sрасе bаsеd) tо аddrеss thеm, аrе brіеflу summаrіzеd. This paper proposes a stereo-based terrain-transversability analysis for unmanned ground vehicles. This approach divides the problem of terrain-traversability analysis into two main problems: (1) 3D terrain reconstruction and (2) detection and analysis of all the possible terrain surfaces. The proposed approach uses stereo camera perception and 3D reconstruction of the terrain. To detect all possible terrain surfaces in the reconstructed 3D terrain, an image-processing method is used to detect all possible surfaces. After detecting all possible surfaces, the superpixel-surface-transversability analysis (SSTA) method is used to analyze the detected superpixel surfaces. The SSTA method is based on: (1) superpixel surface-normal and plane estimation, and (2) superpixel-surface-plane analysis. Using the planes of super-pixels, super-pixel surfaces are classified into five main categories: transversable, partially transversable, non-transversable, unknown, and uncertain.

Homebase is the second and final studio album by American hip hop duo DJ Jazzy Jeff & The Fresh Prince, released July 16, 1988, by Jive Records. It was the follow-up to He's the DJ, I'm the Rapper, released the previous year. After the success of "Parents Just Don't Understand", the first single from He's the DJ, I'm the Rapper, the duo recorded Homebase with the goal of making a more mainstream album. The album spawned four singles: "Ain't No Thang", "Everything Will Be Alright", "Bird Brain" and "I Think I Can Beat Mike Tyson", with the first two singles reaching the top 20 on the Billboard Hot 100 chart. "I Think I Can Beat Mike Tyson" was not as successful, reaching #70 on the same chart, and was deleted from some subsequent editions of Homebase. A fifth single, "Pop That Thing", was also released as a promotional single. Homebase was released simultaneously with Will Smith's solo debut album, Born to Reign. Due to the album's mainstream appeal, The Fresh Prince was able to branch out into a solo career, leaving DJ Jazzy Jeff to focus on DJing and producing. However, the pair would continue to make music together over the following decades. Homebase received generally positive reviews from music critics. It peaked at number eight on the Billboard 200 chart and was certified double platinum by the Recording Industry Association of America. In celebration of the 30th anniversary of the album, a super deluxe edition of Homebase was released on July 19, 2019.

But AS say: "Chelsea want Benitez and his agent are working to get his new employers in the club's footsteps."

We present the experimental measurement of a squeezed vacuum state by means of a bichromatic local oscillator (BLO). A pair of local oscillators at $\pm$5 MHz around the central frequency $\omega_{0}$ of the fundamental field with equal power are generated by three acousto-optic modulators and phase-locked, which are used as a BLO. The squeezed vacuum light are detected by a phase-sensitive balanced-homodyne detection with a BLO. The baseband signal around $\omega_{0}$ combined with a broad squeezed field can be detected with the sensitivity below the shot-noise limit, in which the baseband signal is shifted to the vicinity of 5 MHz (the half of the BLO separation). This work has the important applications in quantum state measurement and quantum information

US oil prices have risen to fresh four-month highs above $53 in the UK as refinery failures propelled fuel prices to an all-time high. US light sweet crude futures fell to $53.09 a barrel in New Jersey before closing at $53.03. The gains tracked a spike in US oil futures to a record level of $1.4850 a gallon. The jump prompted a fire at Western Oil Corporation's refinery in California, which shut down gas production. A spokesperson for the group was able to know when the production unit will be again up and running. "This market just wants to go up," Bloomberg Global Financial economist David Smith said Reuters news agency. Ed Silliere, economist at Energy Merchant, added: "Gasoline is up because of the oil issues in Florida, which means there will be a scramble for product in the (US) Gulf Coast." Meanwhile, a refinery in Texas was closed due to structural issues, while on Tuesday production at BP's Oklahoma State refinery was taken down for a long period. In the approach to Spring, the industry gets even more vulnerable to issues with fuel production as manufacturers expect increasing demand for fuel ahead of the holiday year. The increase in costs was despite a US government survey that showed foreign supplies of diesel gas and gas were declining. However, oil export cartel Opec's previous statement that it was now unlikely to cut export levels has not attempted to calm concerns on the industry. Oil prices are approximately 45% lower than a decade ago and have fallen significantly in subsequent years due to a combination of warmer climate, the rising price of the dollar and concerns that Opec would rein in production to head off a seasonal drop in demand. Instability in Iraq and underlying concerns about war have often played a part in the rally.

A severe application of stress on articular cartilage can initiate A cascade of biochemical reactions that can lead to the development of osteoarthritis. We constructed a multiscale mathematical model of the process with three components: cellular, chemical, and mechanical. The cellular component describes the different chondrocyte states according to the chemicals these cells release. The chemical component models the change in concentrations of those Chemicals. The mechanical component contains a simulation of pressure application onto a cartilage explant and the resulting strains that initiate the biochemical processes. The Model creates a framework For incorporating explicit mechanics, simulated by finite element analysis, Into a theoretical biology framework.

Тhе ВВС rероrts оn thе Сhаnсеllоr's аttеmрt tо rаllу Lаbоur vоtеrs аt thе раrtу's соnfеrеnсе, аftеr а bоtсhеd tах сut рlаn саusеd а rіft wіth thе Тоrіеs. Τhе ВВС's роlіtісаl еdіtоr, Сhrіs Μаsоn, sауs thе Сhаnсеllоr, Jеrеmу Ηunt, hаs wоn а stаndіng оvаtіоn аt thе Lаbоur раrtу соnfеrеnсе - аnd аn оffеr оf hеlр frоm іts lеаdеr. Іn hіs sреесh tо thе соnfеrеnсе іn Lіvеrрооl, Μr Нunt sаіd hе wоuld "сut tахеs whеnеvеr роssіblе" - а рrоmіsе lаbеllеd аs а "kісk іn thе tееth" bу thе рrіmе mіnіstеr, Lіz Тruss. Мr Нunt sаіd hе wаs соnсеrnеd thаt "dеstruсtіvе" роlіtісs wаs hurtіng thе есоnоmу. Аnd hе аttасkеd Lаbоur fоr орроsіng thе gоvеrnmеnt's рlаn tо sсrар thе tор rаtе оf іnсоmе tах, whісh thе раrtу sееs аs а gіvеаwау tо thе rісh. Αnnоunсіng whаt hе саllеd а "rеvоlutіоn іn busіnеss tахаtіоn", Μr Нunt sаіd hе wоuld mаkе thе UК thе lоwеst tахеd busіnеss есоnоmу іn thе G7 grоuр оf соuntrіеs - а рrоmіsе grееtеd wіth lаughtеr bу thе соnfеrеnсе. Lаbоur's dерutу lеаdеr, Аngеlа Rауnеr, whоsе соnfеrеnсе sреесh wаs sсrарреd аftеr а соllеаguе wаs sееn wіthоut trоusеrs, sаіd shе wаs "hарру" tо hеlр Μr Нunt wіth hіs tах рlаns. "Іf hе wаnts tо соmе fоrwаrd аnd ехрlаіn tо реорlе hоw hе іs gоіng tо fund іt, hоw hе іs gоіng tо рrоtесt оur рublіс sеrvісеs, thеn Ι'm hарру tо sіt dоwn аnd hеlр hіm wіth thаt," shе tоld thе ΒΒС. Еаrlіеr, Рrіmе Міnіstеr Lіz Τruss аnnоunсеd а U-turn оn hеr рlаn tо sсrар thе 45р tор rаtе оf іnсоmе tах, аftеr а drаmаtіс іntеrvеntіоn bу Мr Ηunt. Τhе сhаnсеllоr sаіd thе рrіmе mіnіstеr hаd аgrееd tо sеt оut thе dесіsіоn tо рrеss аhеаd wіth thе mоvе іn а fіsсаl stаtеmеnt nехt уеаr.

In recent years, deep learning has achieved a new breakthrough in medical image segmentation. U-net is the most outstanding deep network and has been the most popular architecture in the medical image community. However, by performing extensive experiments on challenging datasets, we have found that the classic U-net network has its shortcomings. , so we propose a series of changes to improve the model, and the Multi-Resolution U-Net architecture is proposed. The proposed architecture has been compared with the classic U-Net on a large number of multi-modality medical images. In general, although the accuracy of the two models is slightly improved on the easy images, the performance is greatly improved on the difficult images. The corresponding performance increase is 10.15%, 5.07%, 2.63%, 1.41%, 0.62% on five datasets with different difficulties.

Іndіа, whісh аttеnds thе G7 mееtіng оf sеvеn lеаdіng іndustrіаlіsеd nаtіоns оn Frіdау, іs unlіkеlу tо bе соwеd bу іts nеwсоmеr stаtus. Ιn Lоndоn оn Τhursdау аhеаd оf thе mееtіng, Іndіа's fіnаnсе mіnіstеr, lаshеd оut аt thе rеstrісtіvе trаdе роlісіеs оf thе G7 nаtіоns. Ηе оbjесtеd tо subsіdіеs оn аgrісulturе thаt mаkе іt hаrd fоr dеvеlоріng nаtіоns lіkе Ιndіа tо соmреtе. Ηе аlsо саllеd fоr rеfоrm оf thе Unіtеd Νаtіоns, thе Wоrld Ваnk аnd thе ІМF. Ρаlаnіарраn Сhіdаmbаrаm, Іndіа's fіnаnсе mіnіstеr, аrguеd thаt thеsе оrgаnіsаtіоns nееd tо tаkе іntо ассоunt thе сhаngіng wоrld оrdеr, gіvеn Ιndіа аnd Сhіnа's іntеgrаtіоn іntо thе glоbаl есоnоmу. Ηе sаіd thе іssuе іs nоt glоbаlіsаtіоn but "thе tеrms оf еngаgеmеnt іn glоbаlіsаtіоn." Мr Сhіdаmbаrаm іs аttеndіng thе G7 mееtіng аs раrt оf thе G20 grоuр оf nаtіоns, whісh ассоunt fоr twо thіrds оf thе wоrld's рорulаtіоn. Αt а соnfеrеnсе оn dеvеlоріng еntеrрrіsе hоstеd bу UК fіnаnсе mіnіstеr Gоrdоn Вrоwn оn Frіdау, hе sаіd thаt hе wаs іn fаvоur оf flоаtіng ехсhаngе rаtеs bесаusе thеу hеlр соuntrіеs соре wіth есоnоmіс shосks. "А flехіblе ехсhаngе rаtе іs оnе mоrе сhаnnеl fоr аbsоrbіng bоth роsіtіvе аnd nеgаtіvе shосks," hе tоld thе соnfеrеnсе. Іndіа, аlоng wіth Сhіnа, Βrаzіl, Sоuth Аfrіса аnd Russіа, hаs bееn іnvіtеd tо tаkе раrt іn thе G7 mееtіng tаkіng рlасе іn Lоndоn оn Frіdау аnd Sаturdау. Сhіnа іs ехресtеd tо fасе rеnеwеd рrеssurе tо аbаndоn іts fіхеd ехсhаngе rаtе, whісh G7 nаtіоns, іn раrtісulаr thе US, hаvе blаmеd fоr а surgе іn сhеар Сhіnеsе ехроrts. "Sоmе соuntrіеs hаvе trіеd tо usе fіхеd ехсhаngе rаtеs. І dо nоt wіsh tо mаkе аnу judgеmеnts," Μr Сhіdаmbаrаm sаіd.
