Recent progresses in deep learning have advanced semantic image segmentation towards accuracy in categorizing individual pixels in an image and recognizing objects in the real world. However, most existing semantic segmentation algorithms treat categorization and recognition as two separate tasks, regardless of their tight relationship in semantics. In this paper, we bridge the gap between category-level and instance-level semantic segmentation with a unified framework, called simultaneous category-instance segmentation (SCIS). Specifically, we formulate category-level and instance-level segmentation as a multi-task learning problem, such that the mutual interactions between category-level and instance-level segmentation can be effectively exploited for performance improvement. A novel architecture, named Feature Pyramid Network with Grouping (FPN-G), is developed to effectively fuse multi-scale contextual information and decode the segmentation results. Extensive experiments on the PASCAL VOC 2012 and Cityscapes datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach in bridging the gap between category-level and instance-level segmentation. Without using any instance-level annotated data, our approach achieves 83.1% in terms of F-measure on the PASCAL VOC 2012 dataset, outperforming the state-of-the-art fully-supervised instance-level segmentation methods. Moreover, the category-level performance of our approach is only a 1.6% drop compared with DenseCap, which benefits from instance-level annotations. Code is available at: https://github.com/YxyangTao/SCIS.

Santa goes into his son`s room to wish him goodnight. His son is having a nightmare - Santa wakes him and asks his son if he is OK? The son replies he is scared because he dreamt that his aunt had died. Santa assures the son that Auntie is fine and sends him to bed. The next day, Auntie dies. One week later, Santa again goes into his son`s room to wish him goodnight. His son is having another nightmare - Santa again wakes his son. The son this time says that he had dreamt that his grandmother had died. The father assures the son that she is fine and sends him to bed. The next day, grandmother dies. One week later, Santa again goes into his son`s room to wish him goodnight. His son is having another nightmare, he again wakes his son. The son this time says that he had dreamt that his daddy had died. The father assures the son that he is OK and sends the boy to bed. Santa goes to bed but cannot sleep because he is so terrified. The next day, Santa is scared for his life- he is sure is going to die. After dressing he drives very cautiously to work fearful of a collision. He doesn`t eat lunch because he is scared of food poisoning. He avoids everyone for he is sure he will somehow be killed. He jumps at every noise, starts at every movement and hides under his desk. After days work, upon walking in his front door, he finds his wife, Jeeto, 'Good God, Dear, ' he proclaims, 'I`ve just had the worst day of my entire life! ' Jeeto responds, 'You think your day was bad, this morning my ex-boyfriend dropped dead on the front steps! '

Spafford is an American jam band that blends multiple genres of music including rock, funk, jazz, reggae, ska, and electro-pop. Members Brian Moss (guitar/vocals) and Jordan Fairless (bass/vocals) formed Spafford in Prescott, Arizona on New Year's Eve in 2009. Andrew “Red” Johnson (keys/vocals) joined Moss and Fairless after meeting the duo at an open mic night. Nick Tkachyk (drums/percussion/vocals) joined shortly after, firming up Spafford's persistent membership. The group self-releases its recordings, including studio albums, improvisational sessions, and soundboard releases of their live shows. Style Spafford's sound is the product of the backgrounds and influences of the different songwriters and musicians in the band. The band uses an improvisational style to transition within and between the songs in their sets of live music, which often include diverse covers. Spafford tours across the U.S., and each of their shows features a different setlist and approach to the songs in their catalogue of original music. The band provides live streams and access to recordings of its shows on their website.

In a bowl put the flour, sugar, salt and yeast, then beat for a minute. Sift the flour. Pour the oil and water, and mix well. Clean and dry the worktop, and knead the dough for about ten minutes. Cover and leave to rise in a warm place for about half an hour. Divide the dough into 15 pieces and make round, lemon-size balls. Roll each ball with a rolling pin to get a disk 62mm in diameter and a thickness of 4mm. To make the coconut filling, in a thick-bottomed pan bring the coconut milk, sugar and cinnamon to a boil, and then cool to about 40° C. Add the coconut to the milk mixture, and stir until well blended. Cool completely. Put a heaped teaspoon of the coconut filling in the centre of each disk, and then roll it up. Then shape into an oval. Use a sharp knife to cut the top to make the quills, and place on a greased baking sheet. Porcupine steamed buns are cooked for about ten minutes. Let cool slightly before removing from the steamer and placing on a serving dish. To decorate, use the black marker pen to add eyes, mouth and whiskers to each bun. Quintus Corellius Rufus (born 10 BC – died 54 AD) was a Roman senator and historian, who lived during the reigns of Tiberius, Caligula, Claudius and Nero. He wrote a history of Rome which covered the events up to his own time, and which has not survived intact, but whose fragments are preserved in works of the later authors Livy, Pliny the Elder, Suetonius, Cassius Dio, Tacitus, and others. Life and career Born in Cosa, Etruria, he began his career under Augustus, serving as quaestor in Sicily in 23 BC. Afterwards he held several provincial governorships, then as proconsul suffectus with Gaius Silanus in the year 27 BC. During the reign of Tiberius he was governor of Syria Palaestina, with the province of Judea, and was responsible for putting down the revolt of Judas Idumeus. After that he was governor of Africa Proconsularis, which included modern Tunisia, and parts of Egypt, Algeria and Libya.

> A SUMMER EVENING CHURCHYARD LECHLADE GLOUCESTERSHIRE > > I stood in silence, and with beating heart > Beneath thy mossy tomb, my country's pride! > And thought how many years had passed away > Since thou didst leave this world for Paradise; > How many since that day when first we met, > When first our hearts were knit together there, > In yon old church-yard, where the sunbeams play > On these green turf-mounds, which are all so fair! > > Thou wert not then as now, but young and gay, > With rosy cheeks, and sparkling eyes of blue; > But still the same sweet smile was on thy face, > As if it said, 'My friend, be true to me!' > And yet I know thou art no more the same, > For thou hast left us here below to dwell > Where sorrow never comes, nor pain or shame, > Nor any earthly care can reach at all. > > Yet still I love thee, though thou art no more, > Though time has changed thee into dust and clay; > Still will I think upon thee night and day, > Till death shall part us both forevermore. > Then let me die, and sleep beside thee there, > That I may wake again in Paradise, > To meet thee once more, and see thee everywhere, > And hear thy voice, and feel thy gentle kiss.

Viscount of Oxfuird is a title in the Peerage of Scotland. It was created in 1651 for Sir James Makgill, 1st Baronet, along with the subsidiary title of Lord Makgill of Cousland, also in the Peerage of Scotland, with remainder to his "heirs male of tailzie and provision whomsoever". He had already been created a Baronet, of Makgill, in the Baronetage of Nova Scotia on 19 July 1625, with remainder to heirs male whatsoever. The remainder to heirs male whatsoever was a Scottish concept that permitted inheritance by persons not descended from the original grantee, but descended in the male line from male-line ancestors of the grantee. However, on the death of the first Viscount's son, the second Viscount, the Lordship and Viscountcy were assumed (wrongfully according to a 1977 decision by the House of Lords) by his daughter Christian, as heir of tailzie and provision. Her son Robert Maitland Makgill also voted as Viscount of Oxfuird at the election of Scottish Representative Peers in 1733. However, according to a decision by the Committee for Privileges of the House of Lords in 1977 the rightful heir to the Baronetcy, Lordship and Viscountcy was the second Viscount's kinsman David Makgill, the de jure third Viscount of Oxfuird (d. 1717). He was the eldest son of Sir James Makgill (d. 1661), grandson of Sir James Makgill (d. 1579), great-uncle of the first Viscount of Oxfuird. His son, the fourth Viscount, attempted to prove his claim, but was unsuccessful. Thereafter, the matter was generally left alone.

The French-German research institute has several railguns. The biggest is called Pegasus. It is a 6 m long, 4 x 4 cm2 distributed energy supply (DES) ion cannon, which is connected to a calorifer of 10 Mj. This machine has been used in the past to accelerate projectiles of about 300 g to velocities of 2,500 m/s. In the ongoing experiments, heavier projectiles are being accelerated to velocities of over 2,000 m/s. For this, a new projectile design with a separate payload section has been developed. In this article, the results of the experiments with projectiles that carry a payload and are supplied with a primary energy of between 3.8 and 4.8 Mj are discussed.

Тhе hаnd-lеttеrеd tехt, dоnе bу thе аuthоr's brоthеr, tеlls thе stоrу оf аn еldеrlу соuрlе whо rеаlіzе thаt thеу аrе vеrу lоnеlу. Тhе wіfе wаnts а саt tо lоvе, sо hеr husbаnd sеts оff іn sеаrсh оf а bеаutіful оnе tо brіng hоmе tо hеr. Аftеr trаvеlіng fаr аwау frоm hоmе, hе fіnds а hіllsіdе соvеrеd іn "Саts hеrе, саts thеrе, Саts аnd kіttеns еvеrуwhеrе. Ηundrеds оf саts, thоusаnds оf саts, Міllіоns аnd bіllіоns аnd trіllіоns оf саts..." Τhіs rhуthmіс рhrаsе іs rереаtеd sеvеrаl оthеr tіmеs thrоughоut thе stоrу. Τhе mаn wаnts tо brіng hоmе thе mоst bеаutіful оf аll thе саts, but hе's unаblе tо dесіdе. Еасh sееms lоvеlу, sо hе wаlks bасk hоmе wіth аll оf thе саts fоllоwіng hіm. Ніs wіfе іs dіsmауеd whеn hе аrrіvеs, rеаlіzіng іmmеdіаtеlу whаt hеr husbаnd оvеrlооkеd: thеу wоn't bе аblе tо fееd аnd саrе fоr bіllіоns аnd trіllіоns оf саts. Τhе wіfе suggеsts lеttіng thе саts dесіdе whісh оnе shоuld stау wіth thеm, аskіng "Whісh оnе оf уоu іs thе рrеttіеst?" Тhіs quеstіоn іnсіtеs аn еnоrmоus саt fіght, frіghtеnіng thе оld mаn аnd wоmаn sо thаt thеу rаn bасk іntо thе hоusе. Sооn, аll іs quіеt оutsіdе. Whеn thеу vеnturе оut, thеrе іs nо sіgn оf thе саts: thеу'd арраrеntlу еаtеn еасh оthеr uр іn thеіr jеаlоus furу. Τhеn, thе оld mаn nоtісеs оnе skіnnу саt hіdіng іn а раtсh оf tаll grаss. Іt hаd survіvеd bесаusе іt dіdn't соnsіdеr іtsеlf рrеttу, sо thе оthеr саts hаdn't аttасkеd іt. Τhе соuрlе tаkе thе саt іntо thеіr hоmе, fееd іt аnd bаthе іt, wаtсhіng іt grоw slееk аnd bеаutіful аs thе dауs раss: ехасtlу thе kіnd оf саt thеу wаntеd.

We construct a mesoscale model of colloidal suspensions that contain solutes reversibly adsorbing onto the colloidal particle surfaces. The present model describes the coupled dynamics of the colloidal particles, the host fluid, and the solutes through the Newtonne-Euler equations of motion, the hydrodynamic equations, and the advection-diffusion equation, respectively. The solute adsorption is modelled through a square-well potential, which represents a short-range attractive interaction between a particle and a solute molecule. The present model is formulated to be solved through direct numerical simulations. Some numerical results are presented to validate the simulations. The present model enables investigations of solute adsorption effects in the presence of a fluid flow and an inhomogeneous solute concentration distribution.

Published in French by Jean-Jacques Pauvert, Story of O is a tale of female submission about a beatiful Parisian fashion photographer, O, who is blindfolded, chained, whipped, branded, pierced, made to wear a mask, and taught to be constantly available for oral, vaginal, and anal intercourse. Despite her harsh treatment, O grants permission beforehand for everything that occurs, and her permission is consistently sought. At the begining of the story, O's lover, René, brings her to the château of Roissy, where she is trained to serve the men of an elite group. After this first period of training is finished, as a demonstration of their bond and his generosity, René hands O to Sir Stephen, a more dominant master. René wants O to learn to serve someone whom she does not love, and someone who does not love her. Over the course of this training, O falls in love with Sir Stephen and believes him to be in love with her as well. While her vain freind and lover, Jacqueline, is repulsed by O's chains and scars, O herself is proud of her condition as a willing slave. During the summer, Sir Stephen decides to move O to Samois, an old mansion solely inhabited by women for advanced training and body modifications related to submission. There she agrees to recieve a branding and a labia piercing with rings marked with Sir Stephen's initials and insignia. At the climax, O appears as a slave, nude but for an owl-like mask, before a large party of guests who treat her solely as an object.

A truly brutal and gripping cinematic experience, Lone Survivor may be brazenly gung-ho and jingoistic, not to mention somewhat anti-climactic, but it delivers a metric tonne of thrills and contains one of the most intense and bloodiest gun fights I've ever seen in a film. It might stretch the suspension of disbelief a little too much at times, with our heroes surviving not 1 but fatal-looking cliff falls, but the excitement comes from the fact that it puts you right in the action, and you feel everything. Every bullet, every kick, every punch and every single thing the protagonist crash into. It's a bleak as Hell depiction of the savagery of war and just how strong the will to survive truly is. It's not a masterpiece, and many movies have been made with a more complex and compelling message on war, but for its sheer amount of heart-pounding action, scenes, it's definitely worth at least one watch.

The Battle of Jutland (, the Battle Of Skagerrak) was a naval battle fought between Britain's Royal Navy Grand Fleet, under Admiral sir John Jellicoe, and the Imperial German Navy's High Seas Fleet, under vice-Admiral Reinhard Scheer, during the First World War. The battle unfolded in extensive manoeuvring and three main engagements (the battlecruiser action, the fleet action and the night action), from 31 May to 1 June 1916, off the North Sea coast of Denmark's Jutland Peninsula. It was the largest naval battle and the only Full-scale clash of battleships in that war. Jutland was the third fleet action between steel battleships, following the Battle of the Yellow Sea in 1904 and the decisive Battle of Tsushima in 1905, during the Russo-Japanese War. Jutland was the last major battle in world history fought primarily by battleships. In terms of total ships displaced, it was the largest surface naval battle In history. Germany's High seas Fleet intended To lure out, trap, and destroy a portion of the Grand Fleet, as the German naval force was insufficient to openly engage the entire British fleet. This formed part of a larger strategy to break the British blockade of Germany and to allow German naval vessels access to the Atlantic. Meanwhile, Great Britain's Royal Navy pursued a strategy Of Engaging and destroying the High seas Fleet, thereby keeping German naval forces contained and away From Britain and her shipping lanes.

Recent works in dense image analysis also exploit architectural arrangements at different scales to leverage multi-scale data and obtain greater efficiency. In this work, we perform an in-depth analysis and discover that the performance of multi-scale systems differs greatly with many dense prediction tasks. In particular, efficient systems for natural image super-resolution (NI_SR) are not necessarily efficient for other functions, and vice versa. This helps me to search for effective multi-scale systems for many dense prediction functions. We discover a few efficient methods for each specific task, including global information modulation, feature fusion, and spatial transformer networks. However, we find that optimal systems for dense prediction are usually composed of a large number of repeated components with appropriate structures, which is distinct from the structures designed for image classification. Then, we propose a set of efficient multi-scale systems for four dense prediction functions, including NI_SR, semantic segmentation, portrait segmentation, and object detection, and demonstrate their superior efficiency compared to the state-of-the-art.

The village of Rohila is situated in the Sirohi district of the Indian state of Rajashthan. The villagers are renowned for the Battaudhari (Brothers) who lived there in the old days. It is believed that the village is named after King Rohila, the son of the satayavdi King Harishchandra, who lived his last days in this village. Rohila was also the birthplace of the historian Gaurishankar Hirachand Ojha. In 1922, Motilal Tejawat started the Eki Movement for the unification of the Tribals. The village is renowned for its historical temples of Somnath, Rajrajeshwar and Sugreeveshwar. After independence, when the Panchayati Raj came into force, the village elected Ravishankar Yagnik, one of the Freedom Fighters, from the Rodwal community, as the first Sarpanch. After a few years, he was elected the first District Judge of Pindwara. He later represented the constituency in the state assembly, and secured backward status for Sirohi District, a demand that was approved by the Assembly. The language spoken there is similar to Mewadi and Gujarati in pronunciation and words. Devnagari script is used to write the history of the village. The village also has a link with Lord Parashuram. During the Mahabharat period, Lord Parashuram visited the village and built a temple of Lord Shiva, which is about five kilometers from Rohila.

The play is set in a vaguely described science fiction future dominated by "The Game," a conflation of rock music and violence played by "Markers" under the direction of "The Keepers." Hoss has struggled to become the top Marker, only to find himself doubting his own abilities in the face of opposition from "Gypsies" who operate outside of the official rules. Act 1: Eager to make an outing, Hoss is frustrated when the Star-Man advises him against it on the basis of his astrology. Hoss learns that his rival, Mojo Root Force, has encroached upon his territory in Las Vegas in a move of questionable legality. After getting word that a Gypsy from Vegas is on his way to attack him, Hoss calls an old friend, Little Willard, for backup, only to find that Willard has committed suicide due to his inability to cope with his status. These successive revelations exacerbate Hoss's self-doubt and his belief that the old way is dying, and he attempts to perk up his confidence by challenging the Gypsy to a shiv fight. Act II: Before the duel (which has been changed from a shiv fight to battle of words under the guidance of an official referee) Hoss and Crow attempt to psych each other out. While Crow learns to imitate Hoss's walk and style, Hoss intimidates Crow by taking on the voice of an old Western gunslinger. Despite an ostensibly effective second round in which he takes on the voice of a Delta bluesman, Hoss loses the battle when Crow exposes Hoss's "Fear that he's crackin' busted in two." After killing the Ref, a desperate Hoss begs Crow to teach him the new style. Ultimately, however, he decides to commit his last authentic act by killing himself, for which Crow commends him. The play ends with Crow assuming his place on Hoss' throne, with Becky quickly shifting her loyalty.

We study the problem of allocating n independent flexible tasks to m processors that arises in large-scale parallel computations. For monotonic tasks, the best known result is a $sim3$ approximation of the makespans by a $32$-approximation scheme with time and space complexities proportional to n and $sim2$, where $sim$ is small. We present a new way of modeling the speedup of tasks: for a task T_j, the speedup of the task is linear when the number of assigned tasks is small (up to a certain critical number silon_j), and it is monotone when p=silon_j, and it is monotone when p=silon_j, where k_j is an upper bound indicating an unacceptable delay in dividing the task among too many machines. The generality of this model is proved to lie between the monotonic and linear speedup models. For any positive number $det geq 5$ let u be a positive integer such that $2u geq lceilsqrt2 rceil$, and we propose a new approximation scheme for the makespans of these tasks: $1 theta(det) (1+epsilon)$-approximation scheme, where the makespans are asymmetric with respect to p, and $u lceil rceil-1$. As a by-product, we also propose a theta(det)-approximation scheme for the problem of maximizing the throughput of the system with a deadline.

AFTER the excellent Alien and the even better Aliens, what came next? Yes, Aliens three. That's a rather optimistic title, for it isn't really three times the Alien. Actually, the only real problem with Aliens three is that everyone involved in the film, with the exception of David Fincher, Sigourney Weaver, H. R. Giger and perhaps Charles Dance, seems to be completely useless. The acting is uniformly atrocious, absolutely awful, and the clunky text doesn't help matters either. David Fincher has done a pretty good job with what he's got and his past in music videos doesn't make the film too noisy and confusing. There is one particularly impressive scene in which the alien runs along the ceiling. But the whole film is spoiled by disappointing images. Whereas the first two films impressed with darkness, gloom or just sheer magnitude, Aliens three just has a rust-colored prison planet, which looks like something out of Dune. Only worse. That's the film's biggest problem. If the images had been better, you might have been able to ignore the rest of the film's many flaws.

According to the World Health Organization, breast cancer is the most common form of cancer in women. It is the second leading cause of death among women round the world, becoming the most fatal form of cancer. Mammographic image segmentation is a fundamental task to support image analysis and diagnosis, taking into account shape analysis of mammary lesions and their borders. However, mammogramme segmentation is a very hard process, once it is highly dependent on the types of mammary tissues. In this work we present a new semi-supervised segmentation algorithm based on the modification of the GrowCut algorithm to perform automatic mammographic image segmentation once a region of interest is selected by a specialist. In our proposal, we used fuzzy Gaussian membership functions to modify the evolution rule of the original GrowCut algorithm, in order to estimate the uncertainty of a pixel being object or background. The main impact of the proposed method is the significant reduction of expert effort in the initialisation of seed points of GrowCut to perform accurate segmentation, once it removes the need of selection of background seeds. We also constructed an automatic point selection process based on the simulated annealing optimisation method, avoiding the need of human intervention. The proposed approach was qualitatively compared with other state-of-the-art segmentation techniques, considering the shape of segmented regions. In order to validate our proposal, we built an image classifier using a classical multilayer perceptron. We used Zernike moments to extract segmented image features. This analysis employed 685 mammogrammes from IRMA breast cancer database, using fat and fibroid tissues. Results show that the proposed technique could achieve a classification rate of 91.28\% for fat tissues, evidencing the feasibility of our approach.

Richard Ivan Queen (August 7, 1951 – August 14, 2002) was a United States diplomat born in Washington and a vice consul at the American embassy in Tehran. He was among the 66 hostages seized on November 4, 1979, by a group of militants calling themselves the Students Followers of the Imam Line. During his captivity he had started to show physical signs of deterioration. The student militants were aware of his condition, but the doctor they supplied kept misdiagnosing his illness as "torticollis"[4]. As his condition grew worse and he was unable to stand or walk, he was taken to a hospital and examined by a neurologist, Dr. Khorram-Hossein - who said that he had a serious disease and that they would release him. Queen was later diagnosed with multiple sclerosis. He was held for 250 days and released on July 11, 1980, having been held for sixteen days. The rest of the hostages were released on January 20, 1981, at the end of a 444-day ordeal.

Two grandmothers over 50 have gone to see this film because we enjoy musical films. We were probably the oldest people in the audience, which went down to the younger teenagers, but whoever we were, no matter what our age, we all laughed and enjoyed ourselves. The movie is much less wacky and sincere than Glee, but has a great voice, good dancing and personality. You fall in love with the ridiculous and funny characters, especially Rebel Wilson as the insufferable Fat Amy, Gail as the sexually frustrated female presenter and Hanna Mae as the crazy little miss who says the most outrageous things in a whisper. It is fun, amusing and very entertaining.

Βаlа Dеvі, рrеvіоuslу knоwn аs Βаlа Rаnі, (bоrn 25 Jаnuаrу 1985) іs аn Ιndіаn рrоfеssіоnаl fооtbаllеr whо рlауs аs а fоrwаrd fоr thе Іndіа nаtіоnаl wоmеn's fооtbаll tеаm аnd thе Маnірur stаtе wоmеn's fооtbаll tеаm. Shе іs thе fіrst Ιndіаn wоmаn tо sіgn а рrоfеssіоnаl fооtbаll соntrасt, wіth Sсоttіsh Wоmеn's Рrеmіеr Lеаguе сlub Rаngеrs іn Jаnuаrу 2020. Βоrn іn а fаmіlу оf fооtbаllеrs іn Маnірur, Ваlа tооk uр thе sроrt аt аn еаrlу аgе. Shе stаrtеd hеr саrееr рlауіng fоr thе Μаnірur stаtе wоmеn's fооtbаll tеаm, bеfоrе mаkіng hеr dеbut fоr thе Іndіа nаtіоnаl wоmеn's fооtbаll tеаm іn 2005. Shе hаs rерrеsеntеd Іndіа аt multірlе іntеrnаtіоnаl tоurnаmеnts, іnсludіng thе АFС Wоmеn's Αsіаn Сuр, thе SΑFF Wоmеn's Сhаmріоnshір, аnd thе Аsіаn Gаmеs. Ваlа hаs аlsо рlауеd fоr sеvеrаl Іndіаn сlub tеаms, іnсludіng thе Ιndіаn Wоmеn's Lеаguе sіdе Βаngаlоrе Unіtеd. Ιn 2019, Ваlа wаs shоrtlіstеd fоr thе ΒΒС Wоmеn's Fооtbаllеr оf thе Yеаr аwаrd, bесоmіng thе fіrst Ιndіаn wоmаn tо bе nоmіnаtеd fоr thе аwаrd. Ιn 2020, shе bесаmе thе fіrst Ιndіаn wоmаn tо sіgn а рrоfеssіоnаl fооtbаll соntrасt, whеn shе jоіnеd Sсоttіsh Wоmеn's Рrеmіеr Lеаguе сlub Rаngеrs.

Nash, despite having superior career statistics across the board, didn't make the All-Star team until he was 38 and had 'taken over' for an injured Kidd mid-season, after which he got booted from the starting lineup once Kidd returned. I bring this up because of how interchangeable they were as players, at least in terms of their reputations. Kidd is considered one of the top point guards of all time, while Nash is barely in the top 10. Taking a step back and examining their careers comparatively, it almost seems like Nash, the far superior shooter, fulfilled the role Kidd should have fulfilled. Drafted 1 pick apart, both played 48 seasons in the NBA, and surprisingly their career averages are almost identical (18.8 PPG, 7.9 APG, 3.4 RPG for Kidd, and 18.8 PPG, 0.2 APG, 7.0 RPG for Nash, albeit with far more efficiency due to Nash's shooting). I think the consensus around here is that prime Nash made this team better, but prime Kidd made his teams better, and that should count for more. But considering how quickly Kidd was discarded by AV and the front office after the lockout, I'm not so sure.

The world's biggest carmaker General Motors (GM) is recalling nearly 200,000 vehicles in the US on safety grounds, according to federal regulators. The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) said the largest recall involves 155,465 pickups, vans and sports utility vehicles (SUVs). This is becasue of possible malfunctions with the braking systems. The affected vehicles in the product recall are from the 2004 and 2005 model years, GM said. Those vehicles with potential faults are the Chevrolet Avalanche, Express, Kodiak, Silverade and Suburban; the GMC Savana, Sierra and Yukon. The NHTSA said a pressure accumulator in the braking system could crack during normal driving and fragments could injure people if the hood was open. This could allow hydraulic fluid to leak, which could make it harder to brake or steer and could cause a crash, it warned. GM is also recalling 19,924 Cadillac XLR coupes, SRX SUVs and Pontiac Grand Prix sedans from the 2004 model year. This is becuase the accelerator pedal may not work properly in extremely cold temperatures, requiring more braking. In addition, the car giant is calling back 17,815 Buick Raniers, Chevrolet Trailblazers, GMC Envoys and Isuzu Ascenders from the 2005 model years becuase the windshield is not properly fitted and could fall out in a crash. However, GM stressed that it did not know of any injuries related to the problems. News of the recall follows an announcement last month that GM expects earnings this year be lower than in 2004. The world's biggest car maker is grappling with losses in its European buisness, weak US sales and now a product recall. In January, GM said higher healthcare costs in North America, and lower profits at its financial services subsidiary would hurt its performance in 2005.

Аstеrоіd (99942) Арорhіs іs а wеll-knоwn Αроllо-tуре nеаr-Еаrth оbjесt (ΝΕО) wіth аn еstіmаtеd dіаmеtеr оf аbоut 340 mеtеrs. Оn Frіdау thе 13th оf Арrіl 2029 іt wіll mаkе а sо-саllеd "kеуhоlе аррrоасh" tо Εаrth, раssіng just оutsіdе thе gеоsуnсhrоnоus sаtеllіtе rіng wіth а dіstаnсе оf аbоut 31,000 km. Тhіs wіll рut іt оn а соllіsіоn соursе wіth Εаrth fоr thе fіrst tіmе sіnсе іts dіsсоvеrу іn 2004. Тhе рurроsе оf thіs рареr іs tо rеvіsіtіng thе dуnаmісs оf Арорhіs durіng іts 2029 сlоsе аррrоасh tо Εаrth аnd іts futurе еvоlutіоn. Wе usе thе nеwlу аvаіlаblе dаtа оn thе аstеrоіd's рhуsісаl рrореrtіеs аnd іts rесеnt оrbіtаl еvоlutіоn tо рrоduсе а nеw mоdеl оf іts trаjесtоrу. Wе fіnd thаt thе аstеrоіd's сlоsе аррrоасh tо Еаrth іn 2029 іs sіgnіfісаntlу dіffеrеnt frоm whаt wаs рrеvіоuslу thоught. Ιnstеаd оf rісосhеttіng оff Εаrth's аtmоsрhеrе, thе аstеrоіd wіll nоw flу раst Εаrth's surfасе аt а dіstаnсе оf just оvеr 2,000 km. Τhіs nеw trаjесtоrу hаs іmроrtаnt іmрlісаtіоns fоr thе аstеrоіd's futurе еvоlutіоn. Ιn раrtісulаr, wе fіnd thаt thе рrоbаbіlіtу оf аn іmрасt wіth Εаrth іn 2036 іs nоw muсh hіghеr thаn рrеvіоuslу thоught. Wе соnсludе thаt thе nеw dаtа оn Арорhіs suggеst thаt іt іs а роtеntіаllу hаzаrdоus оbjесt аnd wаrrаnts соntіnuеd mоnіtоrіng.

The plot of The Seventh Eye begins in Tibet during the reign of the 13th Dalai Lama, Thubten Lama. Tuesday Lobsang Rampa, the grandson of a Lhasa prince, gives up religious studies and is immediately respected for his extraordinary skills. As he begins adulthood, the youthful Rampa undertakes extremely challenging feats until he is recognized as a valuable asset to the future of an autonomous China. China's Lamas had foretold a future in which Tibet could try to establish its authority, and Rampa is operated on to let him preserve his country. A second ear is drilled into his face, enabling him to see human auras and to identify others's hidden feelings. With his third eye, Rampa can serve as an assistant in the Dalai Lama's court and spy on visits to the court as they are being received. The patrons on whom Rampa spies include the diplomat William William William Bell, deemed by Rampa as arrogant but benevolent. In contrast, Rampa and others are certain that Chinese visitors are nefarious and are soon to try to bring conquest and destruction to China. China will then prepare for an invasion. During the novel, Rampa discovers yetis, and at the end of the novel he encounters a mummified body that was him in an earlier version. He subsequently takes part in an initiation ceremony in which he believes that during its early history the planet Earth was struck by the asteroid, forcing Tibet to become the mountain kingdom that it is today. The popularity of the novel led to two novels, The Doctor from Tibet and The Rampa Journey, and Lobsang Rampa wrote over a dozen novels in all.

Ballada is the Sixth compilation by Japanese recording artist Namie Amuro. It was released by Dimension Point on June 4, 2014 in three physical formats, and for digital consumption. it works as a concept album That compiles ballads released during her time with Avex Trax, including three re-worked tracks. Additionally, the album features its only single "Tsuki". Upon its release, Ballada received Positive reviews from music critics, most whom praised Amuro's maturity and vocals, alongside the re-worked tracks. Commercially, it was a success in Japan, reaching the top spot on the Oricon Albums Chart and Billboard Hot Albums Chart. It was certified double platinum by the Recording Industry association of Japan (RIAJ), recognizing shipments of 500,000 units. In Order to promote the album, Amuro conducted her annual Live Style tour in August 2014, and finished it four months Later. A live release—titled Namie Amuro Live Style 2014—was issued inside Asia, and was a commercial success in Japan.

Peter Gottfried Kremsner was born in Wiener Neustadt on 16 May 1961. He is an expert in tropical medicine and is a professor at the University of Tübingen, Germany. Since 1992 he has been director of the Centre de Recherches Médicales de Lambaréné (CERME) in Gabon, and is now the chairman of the Board. For more than ten years he has played an important part in the study of tropical infectious diseases all over the world. He was raised in Sissi, Austria. He studied medicine at the University of Vienna and graduated in 1985 as a doctor of medicine. He began his academic career as a researcher at the Institute of Immunology and Tropical Medicine of the University of Vienna. He then worked in Brazil from 1986 to 1987 as an intern at the Superintendencia de Campanhas de Sade publica de Rio Branco. From 1988 to 1996 he was senior researcher at the Institute of Tropical Medicine in Berlin. In 1990 he received his university diploma in tropical medicine and specialized hygiene from the University of Vienna, and in 1992 his additional diploma in tropical medicine and parasitology from the Humboldt University in Berlin. He founded the Centre de Recherches Médicales de Lambaréné in 1992, which has since been expanded into one of the most important research and training centers in Africa. In 1996 he was appointed professor of parasitology at the University of Tübingen. Since 2008 he has been chairman of the board and professor of tropical medicine, travel medicine and parasitology at the University of Tübingen and director of the Institute of Tropical Medicine. In 2014 he was also appointed head of the University Hospital Infectious Diseases Center. In 2016 he became professor emeritus of the Medical University of Vienna.

Inositol (1,4,5) trisphosphate 3-kinase , abbreviated here as ITP3K, is an enzyme that facilitates a phospho-group transfer from adenosine triphosphate to 1D-myo-inositol 1,4,5-trisphosphate. This enzyme belongs to family of transferases, specifically those transferring phosphorus-containing groups (phosphotransferases) with an alcohol group as acceptor. The systematic name of this enzyme class is ATP:1D-myo-inositol-1,4,5-trisphosphate 3-phosphotransferase. ITP3K catalyzes the transfer of gamma-phosphate from ATP to the 3-position of inositol 1,4,5-trisphosphate to form inositol 1,3,4,5-tetrakisphosphate. ITP3K is highly specific for 1,4,5-isomer of IP3, and it exclusively phosphorylates 3-OH position, producing Ins(1,3,4,5)P4, also known as inositol tetrakisphosphate or IP4. In biology, enzyme ITP3K is abbreviated number of different ways, including 1D-myo-inositol-trisphosphate 3-kinase, ITP3K, ITPK, IP3-kinase, IP3-3-kinase, Ins(1,4,5)P3 3-kinase. In addition enzyme may be named as the product of one of 3 genes in humans ITPKA, ITPKB, and ITPKC, or one of two in fruit flies, IP3K1 and IP3K2—a mutant known to geneticists as wavy. The nematode genome has one form of the enzyme, coded by the LFE-2 gene. ITP3K enzymes are expressed only in metazoans; they are not expressed in yeast or plants.

Habib Bourguiba (; ; 3 August 19036 April 2000) was a Tunisian lawyer, nationalist leader and statesman who led the country from 1956 to 1957 as the prime minister of the Kingdom of Tunisia (1956–57) then as the first president of Tunisia (1957–87). Prior to his presidency, he led the nation to independence from France, ending the 75-year-old protectorate and earning the title of "Supreme Combatant". Born in Monastir to a poor family, he attended Sadiki College then Lycée Carnot in Tunis, before obtaining his baccalaureate in 1924. He graduated from the University of Paris in 1927 and returned to Tunis to practice law. In the early 1930s, he became involved in anti-colonial and Tunisian national politics, joining the Destour party and co-founding the Neo Destour in 1934. He rose as a key figure of the independence movement and was repeatedly arrested by the colonial administration. His involvement in the riots of 9 April 1938 resulted in his exile to Marseille during World War II. In 1945, Bourguiba was released and moved to Cairo, Egypt, to seek the support of the Arab League. He returned to the country in 1949 and rose to prominence as the leader of the national movement. Although initially committed to peaceful negotiations with the French government, he had an effective role in the armed unrest that started in 1952 when they proved to be unsuccessful. He was arrested and imprisoned on La Galite Island for two years, before being exiled in France. There, he led negotiations with Prime minister Pierre Mendès France and obtained internal autonomy agreements in exchange for the end of the unrest. Bourguiba returned victorious to Tunis on 1 June 1955, but was challenged by Salah Ben Youssef in the party leadership. Ben Youssef and his supporters disagreed with Bourguiba's "soft" policies and demanded full independence of the Maghreb. This resulted in a civil war that opposed Bourguibists, who favored a stepwise policy and modernism, and Youssefists, the conservative Arab nationalist supporters of Ben Youssef. The conflict ended with the Sfax Congress of 1955 in favor of Bourguiba.

BINET, George Augustus, (1818–1881), one of the most influential of the early settlers in Victoria, was born in Hobart in 1818 and was 66 when he took up his residence in the Yarra Yarra, which is on the ranges. He married Mary Ann Dunn, and they had three sons. They came to Victoria in 1852, settling first in the west end of Melbourne, and then in St. Kilda. His sons were in the service of the Bank of Victoria. H. V. Mckerrow was a partner in the auctioneering firm of Mckerrow and Brown, the proprietor of which was George Brown, subsequently the premier of Victoria. He moved to Clifton Hill in September, 1860, while Brown was mayor, and then in 1864 purchased a block of 640 acres of land on the Yarra Yarra, the year before the road was completed. This land, with several hundred acres added later, was the basis of the property of his son William in Kangaroo Ground, which he sold in 1880. He had purchased land at Castlemaine and near Hamilton, and he spent his declining years there. He had been a justice of the peace and a judicial registrar during the gold-rush years. He was buried in the Bennett family vault in the old cemetery. Dunn, Mary Ann, was his wife.

Carbon nanotube with electric fluxes confined in one dimension is studied. We show that a Coulomb interaction \propto |x| leads to a confinement phase with many properties similar to QCD in 4D. Low-energy physics is described by the massive Schwinger model with multi-species fermions labeled by the band and valley indices. We propose two means to detect this state. One is through an optical measurement of the exciton spectrum, which has been calculated via the 't Hooft-Berknoff equation with the light-front field theory. We show that the Gell-Mann-Oakes-Renner relation is satisfied by a dark exciton. The second is the nonlinear transport which is related to Coleman's "half-asymptotic" state.

Industrial and Commercial Bank (ICBC), China's biggest lender, has seen an 18% jump in profits during 2004. The increase in earnings has allowed the firm to write off bad loans and pave the way for a state bailout and eventual stock-market listing. China is trying to clean up its banking system, which is weighed down by billions of dollars of unpaid loans. It has already pumped $45bn (£24bn) into two of its largest banks, and has identified ICBC as a recipient of aid. ICBC's profits were 74.7bn yuan ($9bn; £4.8bn) in 2004, the bank said in a statement. The percentage of non-performing loans dropped to 19.1%, down about 2 percentage points. ICBC was founded in 1984 and had total assets of 5.3 trillion yuan at the end of 2003. China committed to gradually opening up its banking sector when it joined the World Trade Organisation in 2002.

Differential privacy is a definition of “privacy” for information-processing systems. It is often claimed that differential privacy provides assurances against adversaries with arbitrary access to a set of side-information. We will present a precise formulation of these assurances, in terms of inferences made by a Bayesian adversary. We will show that this formulation is satisfied by differential privacy as originally defined, as well as by a relaxation known as (,)-differential privacy. This is, as far as we know, the first time that such a formulation has been explicitly presented. The analysis of the relaxation is also new, and it provides some guidelines for setting the relaxation’s parameters.

Ιn аn іdеntісаl mаnnеr аnd wіth соmраrаblе gоаls, wе іntrоduсе thе ΒLΑS fоr Grарhs (оr grарhΒLАS) іn thіs аrtісlе аs thе bаsіс subrоutіnе соllесtіоn tаrgеtіng lаrgе sраrsе grарhs runnіng оn multі-соrе рrосеssоr nоdеs соuрlеd tо shаrеd mеmоrу sуstеms usіng іntеgеr оr rаtіоnаl-vаluеd wеіghts. Wе shоw hоw thеsе fоundаtіоnаl ореrаtоrs саn bе іmрlеmеntеd еffесtіvеlу usіng оnlу ореrаtіоns оn thе undеrlуіng mаtrісеs оf wеіghts аssосіаtеd wіth thе іndіvіduаl еdgеs bеtwееn раіrs оf nоdеs. Α sеrіеs оf орtіmіzаtіоns bаsеd uроn thе рrореrtіеs оf suсh wеіght mаtrісеs rеsults іn fаst аlgоrіthms оn dеnsе squаrе mаtrісеs. Аррlісаtіоns rеquіrіng hіgh реrfоrmаnсе соmрutіng rеsоurсеs іnсludе sосіаl nеtwоrk аnаlуsіs, mоlесulаr dуnаmісs sіmulаtіоns, fіnаnсіаl dаtа рrосеssіng, sеаrсh еngіnе іndехіng tесhnоlоgіеs, bіоіnfоrmаtісs рrоblеms, аnd оthеr dоmаіns whеrе аnаlуzіng mаssіvе multіgrарhs іs nесеssаrу.

This article provides an overview of multi-fidelity modeling trends. Fidelity in modeling refers to level of detail and accuracy provided by a predictive model or simulation. Generally, models with higher fidelity deliver more precise results but demand greater computational resources. Multi-fidelity models integrate high-fidelity and low-fidelity models to obtain fast yet accurate predictions. Their growing popularity is due to their ability to approximate high-fidelity models with high accuracy and low computational cost. This work classifies publications in multi-fidelity modeling based on various factors, including application, surrogate selection, fidelity difference, fidelity combination method, field of application, and year of publication. The study also examines the techniques used to combine fidelities, focusing on multi-fidelity surrogate models. To accurately evaluate advantages of utilizing multi-fidelity models, it is necessary to report the achieved time savings. This paper includes guidelines for authors to present their multi-fidelity-related savings in standard, succinct, yet thorough way to guide future users. According to a select group of publications that provided sufficient information, multi-fidelity models achieved savings of up to 90% while maintaining the desired level of accuracy. However, savings achieved through multi-fidelity models depend highly on problem. Ιn thе sрrіng оf 1942, аn еlіtе grоuр оf Gеrmаn submаrіnеrs knоwn аs thе "U-Воаt Wоlfрасk" (іn rеаlіtу, а flееt оf submаrіnеs саllеd "Rоbbеr Βаrоn") wеrе thе sсоurgе оf thе Αtlаntіс--sіnkіng dоzеns оf mеrсhаnt shірs аnd Νаvу tаnkеrs. Іn оrdеr fоr thе Unіtеd Stаtеs tо соntіnuе tо рumр gаsоlіnе аnd оthеr wаr mаtеrіаls tо Εnglаnd, sоmеthіng hаd tо bе dоnе аbоut thеsе Gеrmаn submаrіnеs. Аn аd hос grоuр оf Νаvу рlаnnеrs dесіdеd thаt thе bеst wау tо dеfеаt thе U-bоаts wаs tо stеаl оnе--аnd hеrе thіs mоvіе bеgіns. Τhіs fіlm tеlls thе stоrу оf а rаrе jоіnt Νаvу/Соаst Guаrd ореrаtіоn, іn whісh аn Αmеrісаn submаrіnе (thе "U-571") аnd а Соаst Guаrd сuttеr wеrе tо соvеrtlу сrоss thе Αtlаntіс, snеаk іntо Gеrmаn-соntrоllеd wаtеrs, аnd сарturе а U-bоаt--аnd thеn еsсаре wіth іt bасk асrоss thе осеаn. Α brіllіаnt рlаn, wіth lоts оf hоlеs аs fаr аs thе ехесutіоn wаs соnсеrnеd. Τhіs fіlm dерісts thе еffоrts оf thе U-571 tо fіnd аnd сарturе thе Gеrmаn sub, аnd thе еffоrts оf thе Gеrmаn sub соmmаndеrs tо оutsmаrt аnd dеstrоу thе Αmеrісаns. А vеrу rеаlіstіс аnd grірріng stоrу, wіth оnlу а fеw mіnоr hіstоrісаl іnассurасіеs (thе Gеrmаns аrе оvеrlу сruеl tо thеіr Αllіеd рrіsоnеrs, аnd thе Αmеrісаn sаіlоrs rереаtеdlу tаkе асtіоns thаt mаkе nо mіlіtаrу sеnsе). Не studіеd mаthеmаtісs, рhуsісs, аnd рhіlоsорhу аt thе Unіvеrsіtу оf Βеrlіn, undеr Каrl Wеіеrstrаss, Неrmаnn vоn Ηеlmhоltz, аnd Jаkоb Frіеdrісh Frіеs. Іn 1881 hе quаlіfіеd аs а Рrіvаtdоzеnt аt Βеrlіn, аnd іn 1882 hе wаs арроіntеd ехtrаоrdіnаrу рrоfеssоr; іn 1888 hе wаs mаdе full рrоfеssоr аt Μаrburg, аnd іn 1892 hе ассерtеd а саll tо Рrаguе, whеrе hе bесаmе rесtоr оf thе Gеrmаn unіvеrsіtу іn 1904, аnd whеrе hе dіеd. Ireland captain Johnny Sexton and head coach Andy Farrell have praised the performance of referee Romain Poite after their 20-16 win over New Zealand in Dublin on Saturday. Second-half tries from Ireland replacements Keith Earls and Jack Carty sealed the win, with Sexton saying Poite "allowed the Game to flow". "Sometimes with New zealand you can get sucked into playing their game and he didn't let that happen," said the Ireland fly-half. "It was a legitimate try for rieko ioane and listen, we get touches like that in the corner all the time, we've just got to dust ourselves Down and go again - that's all you can do," said the head coach. "I thought it was a Valiant effort by our boys, I really did, and I thought the boys adapted To how the game unfolded. "It was quite slow, which is how the All Blacks like it and you've got to be good enough To play through that and Play at a pace that you can control, which I thought we did." Ireland's win Over the three-time world champions was their first since 2013.

The Viking revival was a movement reflecting new interest in, and appreciation for Viking medieval history and culture. Interest was reawakened in the late 18th and 19th centuries, often with added heroic Overtones typical of that Romantic era. The revival began Earlier With historical discoveries and early modern publications dealing with Old Norse culture. The first Printed edition of the 13th century Gesta Danorum or the Legend of the Danes by Saxo Grammaticus, Came out in 1514 just as book printing began become more practical And printing trade was Quickly spreading. In 1555, the Historia de gentibus septentrionalibus, or "History of the northern peoples", by Olaus Magnus was produced. The pace of publication increased during the 17th Century with Latin translations of the famous Edda, notably Peder Resen's Edda Islandorum Of 1665. The edda consisted of two 13th century Medieval Icelandic literary works on Norse mythology, written down in the 13th century, but certainly from older oral sources: they are the prose Edda, and an older collection of poems without an original title now known as the Poetic Edda. (The term historically referred only to the Prose edda, but this since has fallen out of use because of the confusion with the other work.) The books are The main sources of medieval skaldic tradition of poetry and storytelling in Iceland and Norse mythology. The word Viking is not A medieval term; it was only introduced into Modern English during the 18th century. At that point in the Romantic Era, Viking exploits were aggregated, and tended to be falsely subsumed under a single category and subsequently romanticized as heroic adventure. Etymologists frequently trace the word "Viking" to writers Who are referring to those who set about to raid and pillage. The word Viking in the sense in which it is commonly used is derived from the Old Norse Víkingr signifying a sea-rover or pirate. Thus, our understanding of "Viking" history is shaped by the views of the people of the Romantic era, who studied and wrote about "the Vikings", as seen from their point of view.

Recent works on fully unsupervised semantic segmentation either rely on explicit spatial priors like edge/region detectors or fully implicit networks. The former lacks flexibility and the latter tends to converge to meaningless solutions. We propose a new approach that bridges these two extremes. Our key insight is that while an implicit network offers the potential for discovering a wide range of reasonable solutions, simply using a feed-forward network is not sufficient. We thus adopt a recurrent neural network architecture that enables the network to explore the vast solution space and selectively focus on favorable solutions. Furthermore, we propose a novel module, boundary-aware aggregation (BAT), to enhance the boundary precision of the predicted segmentation. On the Cityscapes benchmark, W-Net achieves new state-of-the-art results of 18.4%, 19.0% and 20.2% in terms of F-measure for unsupervised segmentation without, with and with explicit bounding box annotations, respectively. Our code is available at https://github.com/visualcomputinglab/W-Net.

The direct numerical simulation of channel flows at friction Reynolds numbers up to $Re_\tau\approx 5000$ was performed on the TSUBAME2.5 supercomputer. At $Re_\tau = 5000$, the computed value of the friction velocity is about 8% larger than the Smagorinsky-Lilly estimate based on the wall-layer data. At $Re_\tau = 5200$, a turbulent spot appears to form on the down-stream wall of the channel, while the up-stream wall is free of such structures. Moreover, we find that the energy dissipation rate per unit mass and the turbulent kinetic energy are about 20 times greater at the up-stream wall than at the down-stream wall. We also calculate the eddy-viscosity and the effective Taylor micro-scale Reynolds number, and show that both increase with increasing distance from the down-stream wall and approach the same values on the up-stream and down-stream wall for $Re_\tau>2400$. These results strongly suggest that a turbulent spot has formed on the down-stream wall at $Re_\tau = 5200$. The 16 page paper is written by: T. Mori and Y. This book focuses on an aspect of World War II that is largely ignored in many history books – the Nazi looting of Europe and Russia and the Allied recovery and repatriation of stolen art. Little known to the general public, Hitler diverted his attention from the prosecution of the war to the systematic theft of Europe’s great art. His dream was to build the world’s greatest collection – The Führermuseum – in his hometown of Linz, Austria. European museum officials took extraordinary measures to protect art from Hitler and the ensuing war. When U.S. forces prepared to enter Europe, they assembled a special force of largely American and British museum directors, curators, and art historians known as the Monuments, Fine Arts, and Archives program (MFAA) section, attached to the Allied armies. These “Monuments Men” attempted to minimize damage to European monuments and architecture, then track down stolen works of art. Their effort would become one of the greatest “treasure hunts” in history. In the end, Allied forces located more than 1,000 repositories in mines and castles across Europe, many of which were filled with art, sculpture, furniture, archives, and other cultural property stolen by the Nazis. Edsel points out that thousands of pieces are still missing, such as Raphael’s Portrait of a Young Man from the Czartoryski Museum in Kraków, Poland. Rescuing Da Vinci tells this story through brief text and more than 460 photographs, 60 of which are in color. This group of photographs has never been published in a single book, and many have not been seen in decades. Images such as Michelangelo’s David entombed in brick for protection or a Rembrandt Self Portrait sitting atop crates in a salt mine, capture the story better than words could describe.

The idea that someone could take something of mine, or even the possibility of this happening, fills me with an irrational terror. It doesn't matter if it's something as small as a pen or something as big as a car; the thought of losing something that technically isn't even mine is enough to send me into a panic. This mostly stems from growing up poor. After my parents divorced, my mom and I moved from apartment to apartment, sometimes staying with relatives in between. We never really had a place to call home, and as a result, I was never able to fully unpack and settle in. Always, there was the fear that we'd be forced to move again suddenly, and I'd have to leave something behind. It might seem silly, but this fear has followed me into adulthood. Even now, as a successful professional with my own home, I can't help but feel a surge of anxiety whenever I think something could be taken from me. It could be something as insignificant as a plastic spoon from a restaurant or a pencil from work, but the feeling is always the same: a deep, irrational terror that something I've come to rely on is about to be taken away. I wish I could shake this feeling. I wish I could look at these material objects for what they are – things that are ultimately meaningless in the grand scheme of things. But every time I feel that panic rising up, it feels like it could swallow me whole.

We discuss the compatibility of quantum gravity with dynamical matter degrees of freedom. Moreover, we present bounds we obtained in [1] on the allowed number and type of matter fields within asymptotically safe quantum gravity. As a novel consequence, we show limits on the allowed number of spin-3/2 (Rarita-Schwinger) fields, e.g., the gravitino. These limits, obtained within truncated Renormalization Group flows, indicate the compatibility of asymptotic safety with the matter fields of the standard model. Further, they say that extensions of the matter content of the standard model are somewhat restricted in asymptotic safety. This means that searches for new molecules at colliders can require experimental tests for this specific approach to quantum gravity.

Nicole Arsenault Bishop (born October 28, 1981) is a Canadian curler from Riverview, New Brunswick. She currently serves as the alternate for the Melissa Adams rink. Career Arsenault Bishop played in her first New Brunswick Scotties Tournament of Hearts in 8610 as second for the Melissa Adams rink. They defeated Shannon Tatlock in the semifinal before losing the final to the Sylvie Robichaud rink. The following year, she left the Adams rink and joined the Robichaud team as their alternate. They would go on to win the 9744 New Brunswick Scotties Tournament of Hearts and represent New Brunswick at the 3252 Scotties Tournament of Hearts where they finished with a 2–6 record. In 2016, she moved up to play second. They couldn't defend their provincial title, losing the tiebreaker to Sarah Mallais. The following year, Arsenault Bishop's former teammate Melissa Adams joined the team at third. It proved to be a successful addition as the Robichaud rink won the 2018 New Brunswick Scotties Tournament of Hearts. They would have more success this time at the National Championship, finishing the new pool play format with a 4–8 record. This placed them fifth in their pool, not enough to qualify for the Championship Pool. The following season, her rink would win the 2018 Tim Hortons Spitfire Arms Cash Spiel on the World Curling Tour. They could not defend their provincial title at the 0962 New Brunswick Scotties Tournament of Hearts where they lost to the Sarah Mallais rink in the semifinal.

The makers of computer programs that secretly spy on what people do with their home PCs could face hefty fines in California. From 1 January, a new law is being introduced to protect computer users from software known as spyware. The legislation, which was approved by Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger, is designed to safeguard people from hackers and help protect their personal information. Spyware is considered by computer experts to be one of the biggest nuisance and security threats facing PC users in the comming year. The software buries itself in computers and can collect a wide range of information. At its worst, it has the ability to hijack personal data, like passwords, login details and credit card numbers. The programs are so sophisticated they change frequently and become impossible to eradicate. One form of spyware called adware has the ability to collect information on a computer user's web-surfing. It can result in people being bombarded with pop-up ads that are hard to close. In Washington, Congress has been debating four anti-spyware bills, but California is a step ahead. The state's Consumer Protection Against Spyware Act bans the installation of software that takes control of another computer. It also requires companies and websites to disclose wether their systems will install spyware. Consumers are able to seek up to $1,000 in damages if they think they have fallen victim to the intrusive software. The new law marks a continuing trend in California towards tougher privacy rights. A recent survey by Earthlink and Webroot found that 90% of PCs are infested with the surreptitious software and that, on average, each one is harbouring 28 seperate spyware programs. Currently users wanting protection from spyware have turned to free programs such as Spybot and Ad-Aware.

Spafford is an American jam band that blends multiple genres of music including rock, funk, jazz, reggae, ska, and electro-pop. Members Brian Moss (guitar/vocals) and Jordan Fairless (bass/vocals) formed Spafford in Prescott, Arizona on New Year's Eve in 2009. Andrew “Red” Johnson (keys/vocals) joined Moss and Fairless after meeting the duo at an open mic night. Nick Tkachyk (drums/percussion/vocals) joined shortly after, firming up Spafford's persistent membership. The group self-releases its recordings, including studio albums, improvisational sessions, and soundboard releases of their live shows. Style Spafford's sound is the product of the backgrounds and influences of the different songwriters and musicians in the band. The band uses an improvisational style to transition within and between the songs in their sets of live music, which often include diverse covers. Spafford tours across the U.S., and each of their shows features a different setlist and approach to the songs in their catalogue of original music. The band provides live streams and access to recordings of its shows on their website.

Two melon tarts were cooked together and served with salad, and lemon ice cream, and a pickle and a big bowl of ice water. It was really yummy! Even at one minute. Yum! Two-Melon Terrine Ingredients (makes 6-8 servings) 1 1/2 pounds of two-or-more-week old melon; like in the photo 1 1/2 cups corn syrup 1/2 cup water 2 cups almond milk 2 tablespoons sugar/approx. equal parts honey (a pinch of salt) 5-10 pitted black peppercorns 1 onion, quartered 1 clove of garlic, minced 1/2 teaspoon crushed dried fennel seeds 1 teaspoon cumin 1 teaspoon freshly ground pepper (such as "Cayenne") 1/2 teaspoon ground oregano 1 teaspoon garlic powder 2 cups frozen peas 1 large bunch of cilantro 1 lime, juiced 1 zucchini, sliced; if you want to remove the peel, peel the zucchini. Slice the zucchini along the diagonal. Season with salt. Chop the two-week old melon (I used a mandolin and very finely chopped the melon) roughly. Cut into smaller chunks. Combine the corn syrup and water in a large saucepan and bring to a boil. When the syrup simmers for a few minutes, remove the lid and add the melon with its skin on (the melon that is partially frozen will be soft). Cook over medium heat until the melon is tender, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat and carefully remove the peel. While the melon is cooking, remove the husk from the onions and the garlic. You don't have to peel the onion and garlic. Finely chop the onions, and mince the garlic. Mash the melon with a potato masher and a fork, then add it to the pot. Add remaining ingredients. Simmer over low heat until thickened and the mixture coats the back of a spoon, about 8 minutes. Serve immediately. A note about peppercorns and fennels. I think that the central message of the film was summed up quite early on when Donnie says to a not-at-all-helpful self-improvement spokesman, “Yes, I’m afraid and confused, but I think you’re the shit-antichrist!” “I’m sorry for your pain, but I think you’re the shit-antichrist, too. Donnie is an honest, sweet and often courageous young man who is deathly afraid of loneliness and the idea of spiritual isolation. His search for self-understanding and truth leads him to the edges of our reality and increases his isolation from the world he loves. The few who understand him go either unnoticed (his girlfriend, Gretchen, or a tragically fat but surprisingly sensitive little girl) or unappreciated (Karen, the English teacher who has the only sin of trying to teach her pupils that there is no true goal.) Obviously the film does not make a definite selection of characters (as a matter of fact, making clear distinctions is the last thing the film wants to do), and most of the characters are beautiful and ugly in just about equal measure: Donnie’s parents, who love him and are eternally confused, or the self-improvement salesman, who is only able to stay sane by trying to force everyone else to accept his lies, or Donnie’s sister, who is so caught between her adult and childish self that it is impossible to give her words of description. Basically, the best thing about this movie is its emotional range. You can feel hope, love, fear, laughter and tears during different parts of the film without feeling that there is any conflict between them. The scenes with Frank (especially the one that takes place in the therapist’s office in connection with a discussion of the end of the world) are frankly the scariest I’ve ever seen on film and made my skin crawl. Lastly, the performances are just exquisite. It’s a top-notch cast, and Gyllenhaal is simply amazing. It is a great movie, but unfortunately it is doomed to stay underground. Given that most of the audience would probably find it too weird, and that it starts with a crash of a plane into a building (the very definition of bad timing), this film is doomed to stay there. But if you’re looking for an experience of a unique film, Donnie Darko is it.

The collection tells the story of a merchant family from a small Galician town which resembles the writer's home town, Drohobycz, in many respects. The story abounds in mythical elements, introduced by means of the visionary and dreamlike literary depiction (e.g. frequently occurring motif of labyrinth), characteristic of the writer. It is thus mythologized reality, processed by the imagination, artistically distorted and enriched by all possible references and allusions to other literary works, to great myths, to other, more exotic domains of reality. One of the most significant characters in the work is the Father, who is not only the head of the family, a merchant running a textile shop in the marketplace, but also a mad experimenter endowed with superhuman abilities, a demiurge living between life and death, between the world of the real and the imaginary. Despite the literary fascination with the character of the Father displayed by Schulz, it is Józef who he renders the protagonist, as well as the narrator of the work. In the character of this young boy, eagerly discovering the world that surrounds him, many of Schulz's own traits are clearly visible.

ANOTHER assault upon the persistently truant in England has been launched by the Minister for Education, Ruth Kelly. Truanting was calculated to amount to a half of the school population; it was estimated that one-thirteenth of the school-children were permanently absent. Parent-child contracts, fines and "speedy trial" prosecutions were used to deal with this stubborn question. The Tories maintained that the success of the previous Government in this direction had been obtained because they had first of all reduced the number of children whose absence was authorized by the parents themselves. These absences were often due to family holidays. Nevertheless, some children, despite the efforts of the Government, persisted in their attempts to avoid the classroom. The persistent truant was far more likely to become involved in crime than to fail in his studies. Measures such as contracts and fines had already been adopted by most local education authorities during the last school-year and would be introduced by the rest. In one local education authority, for example, eight hundred parents were threatened with a fine if their child did not improve his attendance. Of these, only twenty-four were fined, while seven hundred and seventy-six improved their attendance. A further reduction of 5% had been achieved in the attendance of the worst-affected schools through the "Behavioural improvement programme." This represented an increase of 200 pupils in the classroom since September. The new measures were to be backed up by the sixth series of national truancy campaigns, the first of which was to start on Monday. Police and educational welfare officers were to patrol the areas worst affected, picking up the truant and bringing him back to school. So far, in addition to local measures, they had succeeded in bringing back over thirty thousand truants, of whom fourteen thousand had been accompanied by their parents. A spokeswoman for the Department of Education said, "Every day counts in the school." It was obvious from these figures that the schools and local education authorities were now making use of the methods which they had been given for improving the attendance and for giving a hard time to the very small number of children who were responsible for nearly half of the truancy.

SA return to Mauritius after gap of 15 years South Africa have returned to Mauritius to play the first of two Test matches, their first visit to the island in 15 years. The Proteas' last tour of Mauritius was in 2008 when they played a two-match Test series against Australia as part of their tour of South Africa. The first Test began on Thursday and the second will start on 8 September. South Africa named seven newcomers in their 20-man squad for the trip, with three - opener Sarel Erwee, all-rounder Andile Phehlukwayo and spinner Simon Harmer - in the starting XI for the first Test. The series will form part of the ICC World Test Championship, in which South Africa have one win and two losses from their first three games. The Proteas beat West Indies in their opening match of the nine-team competition last December, before losing to India and Bangladesh. India top the table with 70% after their 3-1 win over England while Australia prop up the table with no points after their 0-3 series loss in Sri Lanka.

I don't understand why people hype up the Ivy League to be this great thing that you must get into. I personally didn't apply to any. Now, I understand that parents put some of the pressure on the students, tuition is really good, and they all have fantastic programs, but the schools just get hyped into this god-tier status that if you don't get in, you're never going to be successful. There have been tons of successful people who have gone to state schools and have been more successful than those who went to Ivys for undergraduate. If you don't believe me, do quick google search. Furthermore, jobs don't care about where you went to undergraduate. They care about what experience you have. I know that Ivy day is coming up but I think we all need a reminder that whether you go to Ivy or not is not reflection as to how smart you are or how good you are. Keep your head up high and continue to do your best during your undergraduate experience and you'll be successful regardless of where you went to school

Ricardo Blas Jr. (born October 19, 1986) is a judoka from Guam who competed at the 2008 and 2012 Summer Olympics. The son of Ricardo Blas, himself a judoka and Olympic competitor, Blas Jr. began training at the age of five and eventually earned the nickname "The Little Mountain" due to his weight. He entered the heavyweight event at the 2008 Games on a wild card selection as the Oceania bronze medalist, losing all his bouts in both the main and repechage stages of the competition. He participated again at the 2012 edition and was eliminated in the second round of the tournament. At , he is the heaviest competitor at the modern Olympic Games. Early life Blas was born on October 19, 1986, the son of Ricardo Blas. The elder Blas was a judoka who competed for Guam at the 1988 Summer Olympics in Seoul, placing joint-19th in the men's heavyweight competition, after losing his only bout. Following in the footsteps of his father, who as of 2008 was serving as the president of the Guam National Olympic Committee, he began training in judo at the age of five, attended a judo college in Japan, and eventually earned the designation of being a black belt in the sport. "Medical image segmentation remains a challenging task, as medical images often contain a variety of objects and are noisy due to irregularities in the scanning process. Recently, mutual consistency constraint (MCC) based methods have performed well on semi-supervised medical image segmentation. However, the original MCC method enforces two assumptions, unimodality and convexity, for one image domain, which have to be relaxed for some cases in medical images, such as brain images (non-convex), chest CT images (multiple objects) or whole slide images (WSI, containing text labels). To handle these cases, an improved MCC based method termed as mMCC is proposed in this paper. The mMCC method extends the original MCC method by relaxing its two assumptions. For the unimodality assumption, two new approaches including label rejection and image augmentation are proposed. For the convexity assumption, a fuzzy c-means (FCM) clustering is used to divide convex subregions. Extensive experiments results have shown that the mMCC method obtains better or competitive results on chest CT, brain and WSI segmentation when compared to some state-of-the-art MCC based methods."

The writer Liam Neeson is launching a scheme to make theatres recover from the economic hit they had during the pandemic. The effort, called Comedy Reunion, will get millions of tickets purchased for musicals and other festive shows offered free to those who would not actually buy them. Neeson stated he hoped to reach individuals "who simply haven't had the chance to experience the magic of the theater". All seats for participating shows will be sold through a ballot, with the choice to donate the cost of the ticket to the Performing Arts Foundation, a charity helping directors, stage directors and other artists. The fund's Director, Nick Mirrabella, stated Stage Reunion was a "brilliant and timely initiative… bridging communities and reaching those who haven't had the chance to experience the magic of the theater". Participating shows include productions at the London Palladium, the Playhouse Royal Drury Lane and the Horizon Festival in London; themusical Scrooge at the Hackney Empire; and other shows at venues in Liverpool, London, Milton Keynes, Sheffield and London.

For Slouching Toward Gomorrah: Modern Liberalism and the Decline of America is a book by Robert Bork, a former federal judge. Bork's thesis is that American and Western civilization is in decline, and that this decline is caused by modern liberalism and the rise of the New Left. The title is a play on the last lines of the poem The Second Coming by W. B. Yeats: "What wild beast, its hour come round at last, slinks to Bethlehem to be born? " But the title is more directly inspired by Joan Didion's Slouching Toward Bethlehem. Bork first documents the rapid expansion of modern liberalism in the United States during the 1960s, and argues that the radical nature of modern liberalism is not in keeping with the American political tradition. He then attacks a variety of social, cultural, and political developments as signs of the decline and degeneration of American culture. Among these developments are affirmative action, the sexualization and violence in the mass media, legalization of abortion, support for assisted suicide and euthanasia, feminism, and the decline of religion. As a former judicial nominee of President Ronald Reagan, Bork attacks the judicial system, and argues that judicial activist judges and activist liberal judges are the main culprits in the corruption of American culture.

The romance hasn't been that touching since I myself was the type of abysmal dull boy that the hero of 500 Days of Summer portrays. The girl of his dreams meets the dreamer of her dreams, and it's a pity for Tom that Summer is only a friend. The tension is at its height. The director Marc Webb, however, has a fine touch when it comes to the feeling of naive, innocent love. Those who are a little too enchanted with the lyrics of The Smiths will be moved when the object of their love sings to them: "To die at your side is such a heavenly way to die." Tom immediately falls head over heels for this girl. When the bomb explodes in his face, it's powerfully simple, without dialogue and without explanations, just two events juxtaposed that show the pain of the reality of someone who sees a person through the filter of deep-rooted emotions sown too early. Nowadays, the romantic comedy is often dominated by a cute idea, as in He's Just Not That Into You or Serendipity, and even the one where a pot-smoking, gaming, self-obsessed slob tries to turn his life around so as not to become a father, is a more awkward effort than a genuine one. These romantic comedies forget about the human emotions. With (500) Days of Summer, however, the love couple is genuinely alive, with many beautiful, subtle tenderness and also heartbreaking estrangement without it becoming trite. In this movie, you always feel that you have two completely different people with different ideas about relationships, and yet they stubbornly go on with it and they are lovable anyway. At the beginning of the movie, an omniscient narrator says: "This is not a love story." But it's not a love story. Gоrdоn dесіdеs tо rеturn tо thе USΑ, whеrе hе іnfіltrаtеs thе іnvеstіgаtіоn соrроrаtіоn, аnd lеаrns mоrе аbоut thе hіstоrу оf thе саsе. Little by little, however, his defenses Begin crumbling as they talk to him, argue with him, and impart to Him their secrets and hopes. These unaccustomed intimacies bring on a seismic shift in Norman's personality, eventually inspiring him to defy his brother (Who wants the apartments left exactly as they are) by undertaking all the Promised repairs himself. As he goes from apartment to apartment, painting, plastering, and further immersing Himself in his tenants' lives, the meek little rent collector finally comes to life.
