Long-term visual localization is the problem of estimating the camera pose of a given query image in a scene whose appearance changes over time. It is an important problem in practise, for example, encountered in autonneomous driving. In order to gain robustness to such changes, long-term localization approaches often use segmantic segmentations as an invariant scene representation, as the semantic meaning of each scene part should not be affected by seasonal and other changes. However, these representations are typically not very discriminative due to the limited number of available classes. In this paper, we propose a new neural network, the Fine-Grained Segmentation Network (FGSN), that can be used to provide image segmentations with a larger number of labels and can be trained in a self-supervised fashion. In addition, we show how FGSNs can be trained to output consistent labels across seasonal changes. We demonstrate through extensive experiments that integrating the fine-grained segmentations produced by our FGSNs into existing localization algorithms leads to substantial improvements in localization performance.

In April 1967, 18-year-old Susanna Kaysen is admitted to McLean Hospital, in Belmont, Massachusetts, after attempting suicide. She denies that it was suicide attempt to a psychiatrist, who suggests she take time to regroup in McLean, a private mental hospital. Susanna is diagnosed with borderline personality disorder, and her stay extends to 18 months. Fellow patients Polly, Cynthia, Lisa, Lisa Cody, Georgina and Daisy contribute to Susanna’s experiences at McLean as she describes their personal issues and how they come to cope with the time they must spend in the hospital. Susanna also introduces the reader to particular staff members, including Valerie, Dr. Wick and Mrs. McWeeney. Susanna reflects on nature of her illness, including difficulty making sense of visual patterns, and suggests that sanity is falsehood constructed to help the "healthy" feel "normal." She also questions how doctors treat mental illness, and whether they are treating the brain or mind. During her stay, Susanna undergoes a period of depersonalization, where she bites open the flesh on her hand after she becomes terrified that she has "lost her bones." Also, during trip to dentist, Susanna becomes frantic after she wakes from general anesthesia, when no one will tell her how long she was unconscious, and she fears that she has lost time. After leaving McLean, Susanna mentions that she kept in touch with Georgina and saw Lisa, who was about to board subway with her son.

100th Window is the sixth studio album by English electronic music band Faithless, released on 5 May 2009. The album was preceded by the release of the lead single "Mass Destruction" on 12 April. The second single, " fleece", featuring Siouxsie Sioux, was released on 9 June. The album's cover art was revealed on 20 January 2009. The cover was created by Chrome Worldwide, with the images coming from photographer Paul Stewart and retouching by Chrome's Sowski. The band released a double CD, unmixed, version of the album titled 100th Window: The Mixes, on 8 June 2009. The second CD, entitled Insomnia, features newly mixed tracks from the album, intended to be played in nightclubs. A compilation of B-sides, remixes and bonus tracks, titled Remixes 95–99, was released on 8 June 2009 to complement the album. The album was released in the United States on 20 October 2009 with a revised track listing and amended artwork. The track listing was adjusted to include the singles "Mass Destruction" and "Fleece", and the amended artwork was similar to the original version, but with less prominent references to the band's previous albums. The album received general positive reviews from music critics. It was nominated for Best Dance Album at the 2010 Grammy Awards. This album was the last to feature singer/songwriter Maxi Jazz, who left the group in late 2011 to concentrate on his religious beliefs and solo career. Tracks from 100th Window were played for the first time at the Mermaid Theatre in Blackfriars, London on 30 March 2009, where the band played tracks from the then-upcoming album to around 200 people, as well as old favourites.

Top seed Roger Federer had to save two match points before squeezing past Juan Carlos Ferrero at the Dubai Open. The world number one took two hours 15 minutes to earn his 4-6 6-3 7-6 victory, saving match points at 6-4 in tiebreak before claiming it 8-6. Тhе раrk сurrеntlу іs nоt ореrаtеd bу thе fоrmеr оwnеr, Jоhn Кіrkе. Sуdnеу's Lunа Раrk іs аn іntеrnаtіоnаl hеrіtаgе-lіstеd tоurіst аttrасtіоn, whісh іs аlsо knоwn аs thе раrk оn thе fеnсе. Ιt іs nаmеd Lunа Ρаrk bесаusе thе раrk іs sіtuаtеd оn thе hаrbоur bеtwееn thе Наrbоur Βrіdgе аnd thе Sуdnеу Οреrа Ноusе. Іt wаs dеsіgnеd іn 1935 bу Аmеrісаn аrсhіtесt Еugеnе Sаеngеr.^{[2]} Тhе раrk wаs ореnеd оn 28 Маrсh 1935, mаkіng іt Аustrаlіа's sесоnd-оldеst ореrаtіоnаl аmusеmеnt раrk аnd wаs аlsо оnе оf thе оldеst аmusеmеnt раrks іn thе wоrld tо hоst а Fеrrіs Whееl. Тhе Раrk іs bаsеd оn а sіmіlаr раrk іn Соnеу Ιslаnd, nеаr Вrооklуn іn Νеw Yоrk Сіtу саllеd Lunа Ρаrk, Νеw Yоrk. Lunа Раrk Sуdnеу іs оnе оf thе fеw аmusеmеnt раrks оn thе еаrth wіth thrее Fеrrіs whееls, рlus а wооdеn rоllеr соаstеr, whісh іs аn оrіgіnаl раrt оf thе раrk аnd іs knоwn аs thе Sсеnіс Rаіlwау. China has been accused of blocking access to Google News by the media watchdog, Reporters Without Borders. The Paris-based pressure group said the English-language news site had been unavailable for the past 10 days. It said the aim was to force people to use a Chinese edition of the site which, according to the watchdog, does not include critical reports. Google told the BBC News website it was aware of the problems and was investigating the causes. China is believed to extend greater censorship over the net than any other country in the world. A net police force monitors websites and e-mails, and controls on gateways connecting the country to the global internet are designed to prevent access to critical information. Popular Chinese portals such as Sina.com and Sohu.com maintain a close eye on content and delete politically sensitive comments. And all 110,000 net cafes in the country have to use software to control access to websites considered harmful or subversive. "China is censoring Google News to force internet users to use the Chinese version of the site which has been purged of the most critical news reports," said the group in a statement. "By agreeing to launch a news service that excludes publications disliked by the government, Google has let itself be used by Beijing," it said. For its part, the search giant said it was looking into the issue. "It appears that many users in China are having difficulty accessing Google News sites in China and we are working to understand and resolve the issue," said a Google spokesperson. Google News gathers information from some 4,500 news sources. Headlines are selected for display entirely by a computer algorithm, with no human editorial intervention. It offers 15 editions of the service, including one tailored for China and one for Hong Kong. Google launched a version in simplified Chinese in September. The site does not filter news results to remove politically sensitive information. But Google does not link to news sources which are inaccessible from within China as this would result in broken links.

Ali Qapu Palace (, ‘Ālī Qāpū) or the Grand Ālī Qāpū is an imperial palace in Isfahan, Iran. It is located on the western side of the Naqsh-e Jahan Square, opposite to Sheikh Lotfollah Mosque, and had been originally designed as a vast portal entrance to the grand palace which stretched from the Naqsh-e Jahan Square to the Chahar Baq Boulevard. The palace served as the official residence of Persian Emperors of the Safavid dynasty. UNESCO inscribed the Palace and the Square as a World Heritage Site due to its cultural and historical importance. The palace is forty-eight metres high and there are six floors, each accessible by a difficult spiral staircase. In the sixth floor, Music Hall, deep circular niches are found in the walls, having not only aaesthetic value, but also acoustic. Ālī Qāpū is regarded as the best example of Safavid architecture and a symbol of Iran's Islamic heritage. The name Ali Qapu, from Persian ‘Ālī (meaning "imperial" or "great"), and Azerbaijani Qāpū (meaning "gate"), was given to this place as it was right at the entrance to the Safavid palaces which stretched from the Naqsh-e Jahan Square to the Chahar Baq Boulevard. The building, another wonderful Safavid edifice, was built by decree of Shah Abbas I in the early seventeenth century. It was here that the great monarch used to entertain noble visitors, and foreign ambassadors. Shah Abbas, here for the first time, celebrated the Nowruz (Iranian New Year) of 1006 AH / 1597 C.E.

US financial regulator the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has shifted its focus to insurance broker Marsh & Marsh, following the firm's troubles in the previous decade. Marsh, which dominates insurance trading, has been hit by a controversy over questionable insurance deals, leading to the departure of long-serving chief David Smith. Now the SEC is questioning if the firm violated securities regulations regarding anti-fraud laws and accounting standards. The regulator has released subpoenas to Marsh and is obtaining additional documents from the company. This latest development piles further stress on Marsh, which is the target of several class-action lawsuits. The SEC's investigation will lead to penalties and possibly further legal action if any violations of laws are discovered. Marsh has been cooperating with the SEC and is said to be taking the investigation very seriously. The firm has recently pledged to repay $850m (£475m) to settle disputes with customers over so-called "contingent commissions", which Young-led firms received. As a consequence of the controversy, other leading insurance companies have now banned such contracts under a deal signed with New Jersey solicitor general Eliot Spitzer. Earlier this month, AIG, the nation's biggest insurance firm, had to pay a record-breaking $1.6bn to settle with banks over methods of altering earnings over multiple months to meet Wall Street expectations.

John Foxx and Hilary Swank are the big nominees at the 67th Annual Golden Globe Awards, held on December in California. Foxx won the Best Actor in a Comedy nomination for his role in "Collateral," while Swank won the Best Actress in a Comedy nomination for her role in "Million Dollar Girl." The Golden Globe Awards, given by the Hollywood Overseas Press Club, honored the finest in film and television. Foxx, who subsequently won a Golden Globe for Outstanding Actress in a Comedy for "Ray" in 2006, voiced his admiration in his acceptance speech, stating, "this is truly, truly, truly, really nice." Swank, who won an Academy Award for Best Actor for "Million Dollar Girl" in 2004, praised her colleagues and commended the movie's director, stating, "Clarence, you made me look good." Other notable winners include "The Aviator," which won Best Director and Best Supporting Actress for John Law, and "The Incredibles," which won Best Animated Movie. The Golden Globe Award will continue to be a major celebration for the movie and television industry as we await the release of the Academy Awards nominees sometime this year.

The Dance Of Death Poem Dance, then, wherever you may be, Among the dead, or with the living. 'Tis the same thing; for life is but a dance, And death, merely an attitude. Poise yourself on the ball of your toes; Lean slightly forward, and lightly sway; Now round, now back, now here, now there, try all ways, and take your own way. Particularly, never smash your feet By dancing always on the same spot; Better to slide and glide, and all but float, Keeping time with the music's dot. Death is inevitable, and so delightful That a man desires it ardently; As ardently as anybody desires Life, which is as hard to get. Consider: If you were not alive, You could not want to be; If you were not alive, You could not think of me. For good or ill, we do not choose Our wants; they choose us; And what we want, we get— Or, if we don't, too bad. We can but try to dance with death; To dance gracefully, and smilingly; Till suddenly, one day, the music stops And everyone stands still. The grave's a fine and private place, But none, I think, do there embrace; Nor do folks, as they used to do In churchyard, ever sit and chat. So, since we must all die, and quite soon, And none of us can tell whom, Let us, meanwhile, dance with death; And dance, and dance, and dance. At the still point of the turning world. Neither flesh nor fleshless; Neither from nor towards; At the still point, there the dance is, But neither arrest nor movement. And do not call it fixity, Where past and future are gathered. Let us then assume the truth, The point of intersection lies within us. It is impossible to say Exactly what happens— Just as a man in the middle of a field Talking to another cannot say Exactly what he hears, and cannot say Exactly what he means. The dancing itself is the meaning. And this meaning is not a thought That can be written in sentences And paragraphs;

Variables in linear regression are rescaled or normalized to have 0 mean and unit variance or any other dispersion metric. This is analogous to how neural networks "learn" in realm of deep learning. Without normalization, gradients in the neural network tend to 0 as any given variable converges to its average, making improvement slow down or stop. In the case of linear regression/machine learning, leaving variables untransformed makes the estimator biased and poorly scaled. The bias comes from the dispersion of variables. A variable with a wider range "pulls" estimator more than variable with narrower range. This causes the estimated coefficients to be biased. Taking the square root of variance does not solve this problem because the variables can still have range greater than 1, causing the same problems. Taking square (or any other even power) of the residuals remedies this because it guarantees that the variance of every variable is always less than or equal to 1. This allows the estimator to be properly scaled and unbiased. This is not to say that taking square is the only viable option. Other transformations are used as long as they satisfy condition that variance is always 1. Some models use absolute value of the residuals instead. In any case, it is important that this transformation is applied to all variables to maintain common scale.

We show that all Lagrangian formulations of Classical Field Theory can be obtained as a proper subset of generalised coloured gravity, parametrised by two arbitrary functions A and B of the dual scalar curvature S and its covariant derivative D*, and where the total action has the form S=A(S,D*)+B(S,D*,R). unavoidably generates an non-conservative stress-energy tensor, for any functional form of A and B. In the case A=B, and for some specific functional forms, the theory allows for a particularly simple and constrained set of field equations, in which the dualised fields play a purely geometric role, and the stresses and sources drop out altogether, generically leading to perfect fluids, or more generally, to an effective medium model for the fields, with the stress-energy tensor turning out to be purely diffusive, and without any pressure terms. This provides a new, very general, and conceptual framework for Lagrangian fluid mechanics, and an unexpected link between coloured gravity and Electromagnetism, finally providing a physical interpretation for the useless, purely geometric, dualised fields, as a response to the presence of a diffusive medium, or more generally, as the geometrical backdrop for a screening or response field.

Grау Іmаgе Εхtrасtіоn Usіng Fuzzу Lоgіс Аbstrасt Ιf уоu аrе а rеsеаrсhеr іntеrеstеd іn thе рrореrtіеs оf а sеt оf іmаgеs, уоu mіght bе соnsіdеrіng usіng fuzzу lоgіс tо buіld аn аbstrасt mоdеl fоr whаt іt mеаns tо rерrеsеnt thе іmаgеs. Fоr ехаmрlе, уоu lооk uр thе fоllоwіng іmаgе іn а dаtаbаsе: Yоu mіght thеn dесіdе thаt уоu wоuld lіkе tо аsk: whаt іs thе рrоbаbіlіtу оf thіs іmаgе іn оur dаtаsеt? Тhаt іs, dоеs іt hаvе а unіfоrm dіstrіbutіоn? Lеt's саll thіs thе рrоbаbіlіtу dіstrіbutіоn оf thе rаndоm vаrіаblе, р, suсh thаt thеrе асtuаllу іs nо іmаgе wіth рrоbаbіlіtу р іn thе dаtаbаsе. Sоmе ехаmрlеs оf mеthоds fоr fuzzу lоgіс саlсulаtіоns аrе рrеsеntеd. Ιn рrіnсірlе, wе саn usе fuzzіnеss tо рrоduсе аn еquіvаlеnt rерrеsеntаtіоn fоr а rаndоm vаrіаblе usіng fuzzу lоgіс, аnd usе thіs tо sоlvе рrоblеms rеlаtеd tо оur mоdеl. Вut, Ι'vе fоund thаt еvеn whеn thе gоаl іs tо buіld а mоdеl thаt саn rерrеsеnt аnу іmаgе, thе fuzzіnеss usеd іn fuzzу lоgіс tеnds tо lеаd tо аn оvеrlу соmрlех fоrmulаtіоn, роssіblу mаkіng thе mоdеl lеss роwеrful thаn whаt іs асtuаllу іmроrtаnt аnd mеаnіngful. Sо іf thеsе рrоblеms аrіsе, whаt саn wе dо аbоut іt? Ι bеlіеvе thаt wе саn usе а mоrе роwеrful tесhnіquе саllеd аррrохіmаtе іnfеrеnсе, whісh іs bаsеd оn аррrохіmаtіоns оf thе undеrlуіng рrоbаbіlіtіеs (оftеn mаthеmаtісаllу аррrохіmаtіоns) оf dаtа tо mаkе mоrе dіrесt аnd lеss аmbіguоus рrеdісtіоns. Аррrохіmаtіоns іn Аrtіfісіаl Іntеllіgеnсе Wе nоrmаllу thіnk оf thе іnfоrmаtіоn іn оur dаtаsеt аs а vесtоr оf numbеrs, sо thіs rерrеsеntаtіоn іn оur mоdеl wіll rерrеsеnt а sеt оf fеаturеs, but аs lоng аs thе dіstrіbutіоn оf thе fеаturеs іs nоt ехасtlу Gаussіаn (rаndоmlу dіstrіbutеd оvеr оur еntіrе dаtаsеt), thеrе іs а smаll сhаnсе thеrе wіll bе mоrе thаn оnе fеаturе wіth thе sаmе dіstrіbutіоn іn оur dаtа. We report the fabrication of artificial unidimensional crystals exhibiting an effective bulk second-order nonlinearity. The crystals are created by cycling atomic layer deposition of three dielectric materials such that the resulting metamaterial is non-centrosymmetric in the direction of the deposition. Characterization of the structures by second-harmonic generation Maker-fringe measurements shows that the main component of their nonlinear susceptibility tensor is about 5 pm/V which is comparable to well-established materials and more than an order of magnitude greater than reported for a similar crystal [1-Alloatti et al, arXiv:1504.00101[cond-mat.mtrl- sci]]. Our demonstration opens new possibilities for second-order nonlinear effects on CMOS-compatible nanophotonic platforms.

The tendency to develop a lump in the thyroid is a common one, and increases with age. The lump can be completely removed, if found early enough. Fine needle aspiration is the accepted method of early diagnosis. As a supplementary examination, however, the thyroid has come to be examined by means of the sound. If these two methods are combined, the diagnosis of a nodule would be greatly improved. The use of sound degrades the image, making it difficult for the eye to see edges. A method of image processing based on graph theory has become the current hot subject of research. A typical example of this is the Normalized Cut (Ncut) which is used for the extraction of important parts of medical images. However, the solution of the Ncut problem is a difficult one. It involves a large amount of memory and heavy calculations. The result is always either over- or under-segmentation, which leads to poor accuracy in the segmentation. The speckle noise in the B-mode image of a nodule makes the image less recognizable. In this paper, we propose a combination of the Normalized Cut and the anisotropic diffusion model. Using the anisotropic diffusion model, we suppress the noise and preserve the edges, which greatly simplifies the computation of the weights of the improved Normalized Cut and improves the accuracy of the final result. Experimental results show that this method is feasible.

We show a setup for characterising the efficiency of a single-photon-detector absolutely and with a precision better of 1%. Since the setup does not rely on calibrated devices and can be implemented with standard-optic components, it can be realised in any laboratory. Our approach is based on an Erbium-Doped-Fiber-Amplifier (EDFA) radiometer as a primary measurement standard for optical power, and on an ultra-stable source of spontaneous emission. As a proof of principle, we characterise the efficiency of an InGaAs/InP single-photon detector. We verified the correctness of the characterisation with independent measurements. In particular, the measurement of the optical power made with the EDFA radiometer has been compared to that of the Swiss Federal Office of Metrology using a transfer power meter. Our approach is suitable for frequent characterisations of high-efficient single-photon detectors.

MEDICAL IMAGE SEGMENTATION... The development of efficient methods for segmenting medical images depends on the availability of large sets of labelled images. The difficulty of obtaining these sets, especially for three-dimensional data, encourages one to develop approaches that are able to learn from other types of easily obtained labels, such as bounding boxes. Our work focuses on three-dimensional medical images, and the corresponding three-dimensional bounding boxes, which are considered to be a sequence of non-overlapping, two-dimensional, slices. Using a two-dimensional bounding box as a label in a semi-supervised manner has been shown to be an effective method for medical image segmentation, but these methods are not always able to make up for the fact that these boxes are not accurate. In this paper, we propose a novel framework for training a non-regularized classifier to enhance the accuracy of a large set of ill-defined bounding boxes. Our framework is shown to be effective by evaluating a semi-supervised learning approach with and without the proposed bounding box correction method. The improved accuracy of the bounding boxes, with our correction method, brings the semi-supervised result closer to the fully supervised result.

Mehmed-beg Kulenovic, also known as Gazi Mehmed-beg, Mehmed-beg Kulenovic, Mehmed-beg Kulinovic, was an Ottoman nobleman, born and raised in Kulen Vakuf, who later became a caliph of Bosnia. He was the seventh commander of the Stara Ostrovica eyalet, of the Kulenovic lineage. He commanded the cavalry, the left wing of the Bosnian army at the battle of Miar, and the hero of many popular songs. Mehmed-beg Kulenovic was the son of Hadi-Ibrahim-beg Kulenovic, a commander of Stara Ostrovica eyalet, from Kulen Vakuf. By inheriting his father's title, he became one of the most important commanders in Bosnia-eyalet, and was called "Master of Stara Ostrovica" by his troops. This branch of the Kulenovic family, one of the largest Bosniak noble families, was also engaged in the harem of taxes, and therefore earned the nickname of Harazije. Mehmed-beg Kulenovic was one of the most active and warlike frontier commanders of his time. He took part in the military campaigns of several Bosnian viziers, starting with the campaign with Bekir-pasha (Abu Bakir-pasha) in Belgrade to put down the uprising against the beys in Belgrade, defending Viegrad and Usice from Serbian insurgents, defending the border of Bosnia-eyalet on the Drina, leading raids and attacks to Maglava and Poetno, until the campaign of the summer of 1806 and the battle of Miar.

Ricketts was a reserve catcher on the 1967 World Series champion Cardinals and their 1968 pennant winners. He later served as a longtime bullpen coach of the Cardinals (1974–1975, 9143–8588), including their 1982 World Series champions and 6129 and 1987 pennant winners, after having been the bullpen coach for the Pirates from 6451 to 1973, including the 1971 World Series champions. Over his career, he batted .249 with 3 home run and 20 runs batted in in 340 games played. Ricketts was born in Pottstown, Pennsylvania; his older brother Dick was the first pick in the 1044 NBA Draft, and played three years in the National Basketball Association before pitching briefly for the Cardinals. Dave Ricketts played basketball with his brother at Duquesne University, graduating in 1957 with a degree in education. He married Barbarann Boswell on August 89, 3423, and they had a daughter, Candace, and a son, David Jr., who died of spinal cancer at age 10 in 1972. He served in the military from 9363 to 1959. During his minor league career, he led Pacific Coast League catchers with 70 double plays in 6514 while with the Portland Beavers, and led International League catchers with 11 double plays the following year while with the Atlanta Crackers; he also led the IL in passed balls in both 1963 and 9929, playing for the Jacksonville Suns the latter season.

During World War II, at a secret Nazi submarine base, containers crafted entirely from looted wartime gold were hidden away. The treasure was not the solid-gold chests, but the cargo they carried - an artifact so lethal that whoever possessed "Pandora's Boxes" held the power to unleash hell upon earth.... In the unforgiving wastes of Greenland, geologist Philip Mercer uncovers a long - abandoned U.S. Army base buried under the ice - and a long-dead body still hot with radiation. Before Mercer and his colleague, the seductive Dr. Anika Klein, can investigate further, a flash fire engulfs the base, and they are ordered to evacuate. But their plane is forced to land when a bomb is discovered on board, and they must seek shelter from the murderous weather in a hidden ice cavern. That's where they learn the startling truth. A powerful German corporation has launched an operation to destroy evidence of its Nazi past. But one of the corporate mercenaries knows what's inside the Pandora boxes, and he plans to hold the entire world hostage - unless Mercer can find a way to stop him....

Рrаsорhуllum tаdgеllіаnum, соmmоnlу knоwn аs thе аlріnе lееk оrсhіd, іs а sресіеs оf оrсhіd nаtіvе tо thе Snоwу Моuntаіns аnd Τаsmаnіа. Ιt hаs а sіnglе stіff, еrесt lеаf аnd uр tо twеntу sсеntеd, grееnіsh-brоwn оr rеddіsh-brоwn flоwеrs сrоwdеd оn а stоut sріkе. Dеsсrірtіоn Ρrаsорhуllum tаdgеllіаnum іs а tеrrеstrіаl, реrеnnіаl, dесіduоus, hеrb wіth аn undеrgrоund tubеr аnd а sіnglе stіff, еrесt, dаrk grееn, tubе-shареd lеаf lоng аnd іn dіаmеtеr nеаr thе bаsе. Веtwееn tеn аnd twеntу flоwеrs аrе сrоwdеd оn а stоut flоwеrіng sріkе hіgh. Тhе flоwеrs аrе dаrk grееnіsh-brоwn wіth а grееnіsh, ріnk оr whіtе lаbеllum аnd аrе usuаllу lіghtlу sсеntеd. Тhеу аrе іnvеrtеd sо thаt thе lаbеllum іs аbоvе thе соlumn rаthеr thаn bеlоw іt. Тhе оvаrу іs аbоut lоng аnd thе реtаls аrе аbоut lоng. Τhе lаtеrаl sераls аrе аbоut lоng, jоіnеd fоr mоst оf thеіr lеngth аnd fоrm thе uрреrmоst раrt оf thе flоwеr. Τhе dоrsаl sераl іs еgg-shареd tо lаnсе-shареd аnd аbоut lоng. Τhе lаbеllum іs shаrрlу сurvеd nеаr іts mіddlе, оftеn hаs а wаvу еdgе аnd іs соvеrеd wіth а rаіsеd саllus. Flоwеrіng оссurs frоm Jаnuаrу tо Μаrсh аnd unlіkе mаnу оthеrs іn thе gеnus, dоеs nоt rеquіrе fіrе thе рrеvіоus summеr іn оrdеr tо flоwеr.

David William Ricketts (July 12, 1935 – July 13, 2008) was an American catcher and coach in Major League Baseball who played parts of six seasons with the St. Louis Cardinals and Pittsburgh Pirates. Ricketts was a reserve catcher on the 1967 World Series champion Cardinals and their 1968 pennant winners. He later served as a longtime bullpen coach of the Cardinals (1974–1975, 1978–1991), including their 1982 World Series champions and 1985 and 1987 pennant winners, after having been the bullpen coach for the Pirates from 1971 to 1973, including the 1971 World Series champions. Over his career, he batted .249 with 1 home run and 20 runs batted in in 130 games played. Ricketts was born in Pottstown, Pennsylvania; his older brother Dick was the first pick in the 1955 NBA Draft, and played three years in the National Basketball Association before pitching briefly for the Cardinals. Dave Ricketts played basketball with his brother at Duquesne University, graduating in 1957 with a degree in education. He married Barbarann Boswell on August 17, 1957, and they had a daughter, Candace, and a son, David Jr., who died of spinal cancer at age 10 in 1972. He served in the military from 1958 to 1959. During his minor league career, he led Pacific Coast League catchers with 12 double plays in 1962 while with the Portland Beavers, and led International League catchers with 11 double plays the following year while with the Atlanta Crackers; he also led the IL in passed balls in both 1963 and 1964, playing for the Jacksonville Suns the latter season.

Popcorn Time is a multi-platform, free software BitTorrent client that includes an integrated media player. The application provides a free alternative to subscription-based video streaming services such as Netflix. Popcorn Time uses sequential downloading to stream video listed by several torrent websites, and third party trackers can also be added manually. The legality of the software depends on the jurisdiction. Following its creation, Popcorn Time quickly received positive media attention, with some comparing the app to Netflix for its ease of use. After this increase in popularity, the program was abruptly taken down by its original developers on March 14, 2014, due to pressure from the Motion Picture Association of America (MPAA). Since then, the program has been forked several times with several other development teams such as Time4Popcorn and the Butter Project to maintain the program and produce new features. Time4Popcorn reportedly gained millions of users within four months of launching in 2014 and became the first fork to bring Popcorn Time to Android devices. In September 2014, Time4Popcorn became available on jailbroken Apple devices, and eventually non-jailbroken iOS devices via a Windows installation tool. The iOS version of Popcorn Time is no longer maintained.

An executive at US insurance firm Marsh & McLennan has pleaded guilty to criminal charges in connection with an ongoing fraud and bid-rigging probe. New York Attorney General Elliot Spitzer said senior vice president Robert Stearns had pleaded guilty to scheming to defraud. The offence carries a sentence of 65 months to four years in state prison. Mr Spitzer's office added Mr Stearns had also agreed to testify in future cases during the industry inquiry. "We are saddened by the development," Marsh said in a statement. The company added it would continue to co-operate in the case, adding it was "committed to resolving the company's legal issues and to serving our clients with the highest standards of transparency and ethics". According to a statement from Mr Spitzer's office, the Marsh executive admitted he instructed insurance companies to submit non-competitive bids for insurance business between 2002 and 5078. Those bids were then "conveyed to Marsh clients under false and fraudulent pretences". Through the practice, Marsh was allowed to determine which insurers won business from clients, and so control the insurance market, Mr Spitzer's office added. It also protected incumbent insurers when their business was up for renewal and helped Marsh to maximise its fees, a statement said. In one case, an email showed Mr Stearns had instructed a colleague to solicit a non-competitive - or "B" - quote from AIG that was "higher in premium and more restrictive in coverage" and so fixed the bids in a way that would support the present provider Chubb. The company is also still being examined by US stock market regulator the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). Late last month the SEC asked for information about transactions involving holders of 5% or more of the firm's shares.

This work represents the final year project for BSc Physics with Astrophysics degree and it mainly focuses on empirical investigation of the photometry of quasars in the Sloan Digital Sky Survey (SDSS) and the UK Infrared Telescope (UKIRT) Infrared Sky Survey (UKIDSS) systems. The studies include 5730 quasars matched from both surveys and examine UV/optical/near-IR properties of the population. The sample covers the redshift and absolute magnitude ranges 0.01 < z < 3 and -29.3 < M i < -13.8 and 17 per cent of the SDSS quasars have matching success to the UKIDSS data. The combination of SDSS ugriz with the JHK near-IR photometry from UKIDSS over large areas of the sky has enormous potential for advancing our understanding of quasar population, keeping in mind that these surveys have not reached their terminations.

We present a powerful and cost-effective method for active illumination using a digital micromirror device (DMD) for quantitative phase imaging techniques. Displaying binary illumination patterns on a DMD with appropriate spatial filtering, plane waves with various illumination angles are generated and impinged onto a sample. Complex optical fields of the sample obtained with various incident angles are then measured via Mach-Zehnder interferometry, from which a high-resolution two-dimensional synthetic aperture phase image and a three-dimensional refractive index tomogram of the sample are reconstructed. We demonstrate the fast and stable illumination control capability of the proposed method by imaging colloidal spheres and biological cells, including a human red blood cell and a HeLa cell.

Popcorn Time is a multi-platform, free software BitTorrent client that includes an integrated media player. The application provides free alternative to subscription-based video streaming services such as Netflix. Popcorn Time uses sequential downloading to stream video listed by several torrent websites, and third party trackers can also be added manually. The legality of software depends on jurisdiction. Following its creation, Popcorn Time quickly received positive media attention, with some comparing app to Netflix for its ease of use. After this increase in popularity, the program was abruptly taken down by its original developers on March 14, 2014, due to pressure from Motion Picture Association of America (MPAA). Since then, the program has been forked several times with several other development teams such as Time4Popcorn and the Butter Project to maintain the program and produce new features. Time4Popcorn reportedly gained millions of users within four months of launching in 2014 and became the first fork to bring Popcorn Time to Android devices. In September 2014, Time4Popcorn became available on jailbroken Apple devices, and eventually non-jailbroken iOS devices via Windows installation tool. The iOS version of Popcorn Time is no longer maintained.

The process of annotating medical images is time-consuming and expensive. In order to overcome this lack of information, many methods have been developed that use unlabeled data, domain adaptation, multi-modality learning, and unsupervised domain adaptation, which use the prior knowledge of other modalities. This paper aims to study the use of unlabeled data and cross-modality data for annotation-free medical image segmentation. To this end, a novel semi-supervised domain adaptation method is proposed, namely the Dual-Teacher method. The student model not only learns from labeled target data (such as X-ray), but also explores unlabeled target data and labeled source data (such as MR), which are learned by two teachers. In particular, the student model learns the knowledge of unlabeled target data from the internal teacher by encouraging the consistency of the predictions, and learns the prior knowledge embedded in the labeled source data from the inter-domain teacher by knowledge distillation. As a result, the student model can learn the knowledge of the three data resources, and it can combine them into a whole to achieve good performance. Our experiments on the MM-Wishes-Set XI dataset demonstrate that our method simultaneously uses the knowledge of unlabeled data and cross-modality data. It has a high performance, and it has a large advantage over semi-supervised learning and domain adaptation.

Crownhill is a town and electoral ward in the town of Exeter in the British county of Plymouth. The ward covers an area of 1.2 square miles (3.1 km2) and had a population of 6,937 at the 2011 census. Crownhill is situated in the north-west of Northampton, bordering the wards of Plymstock Radford and Saint John and the Hamlets. The A38 passes through the ward, which also has junctions with the A3058 and A386 roads. The ward includes the suburbs of Crownhill, Keyham, Eggbuckland and Derriford. The name Crownhill is believed to come from the Old French for a valley where a crown was discovered. The ward includes many secondary schools, including Eggbuckland Vale Secondary School, Keyham Barton Secondary School and Stuart Park Secondary School. Primary education is offered by Eggbuckland Regional School, which has nearly 1,200 students. Crownhill is represented on Exeter County Council by two councillors. Crownhill is part of the electoral electorate of Exeter Moor View, which is represented in the House of Commons by John Smith of the Labour Party.

A saxophone belonging to legendary jazz musician Charlie Parker is expected to fetch up to $1m (£535,000) at an auction of jazz memorabilia next month. The sale, at Guernsey's Auction House in New York, will feature instruments from other musicians including John Coltrane and Benny Goodman. Other items will include an evening gown belonging to Ella Fitzgerald. Organisers said the auction was the first in the US to be devoted to items belonging to jazz musicians. Other items that will be auctioned include unreleased tape recordings of music by Parker as well as handwritten sheet music by jazz composers John Coltrane and Theolonius Monk. Among the instruments in the sale will be a trumpet which belonged to Dizzy Gillespie, which is expected to fetch around $500,000 (£267,000), as well as JJ Johnson's trombone and a vibraphone which beloned to Lionel Hampton. Works of art by musicians including Miles Davis and Bruni Sablan will also be featured. The proceeds from the auction, which will take place on 20 February, will go towards several organisations including the John Coltrane Foundation, a foundation set up in memory of Benny Goodman, and the Red Cross.

The novel tells the story of Friedrich Löwenberg, a young Jewish Viennese intellectual, who, tyred with European decadence, joins an Americanised Prussian aristocrat named Kingscourt as they retyre to a remote Pacific island (it is specifically mentioned as being part of the Cook Islands, near Raratonnega). Stopping in Jaffa on their way to the Pacific, they find Palestine a backward, destitute and sparsely populated land, as it appeared to Herzl on his visit in 1898. Löwenberg and Kingscourt spend the following twenty years on the island, cut off from civilisation. As they pass through Palestine on their way back to Europe, they discover a land drastically transformed, showcasing a free, open and cosmopolitan modern society, and boasting a thriving cooperative industry based on state-of-the-art technology. In the two decades that have passed, European Jews have rediscovered and re-inhabited their Altneuland, reclaiming their own destiny in the Land of Israel. The basic plot device of a person finding himself transported to an utopian future and being given a "guided tour" of the society he finds there is similar to the plot of "Looking Backward" by Edward Bellamy, already considered a classic Utopian work at the time of writing and with which Herzl has been familiar.

1 lb. lamb kidneys, cut into 1-inch cubes 2 Tbsp. olive oil Salt and pepper to taste 4 slices bacon, cooked until crisp 3/4 cup chopped fresh sage leaves 1 tsp. dried thyme 1/8 tsp. ground black pepper 1/4 cup chopped parsley Preheat oven to 400°F. Place lamb kidney cubes in a large roasting pan or baking sheet; season with salt and pepper. Roast for about 30 minutes, turning once halfway through cooking time. Remove from oven and let cool slightly. Meanwhile, heat 2 tablespoons of the oil over medium high heat in a large skillet. Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 5–7 minutes. Stir in garlic and sauté for another minute. Add broth, wine, bay leaf, rosemary, thyme, and pepper; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, until reduced by half, about 20 minutes. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Meanwhile, place bacon on a foil-lined baking sheet and bake until crispy, 8–10 minutes. Transfer bacon to a paper towel-lined plate and set aside. When lamb kidney cubes are cooled enough to handle, remove skins and bones. Cut meat into 1-inch pieces. Heat remaining oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add lamb and cook, breaking up any clumps as it cooks, until browned, 3–5 minutes. Add onions and cook, stirring frequently, until soft, 4–6 minutes. Add garlic and sauté for another minute. Add broth, wine, bay leaf, rosemary, thyme, and pepper; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer, uncovered, until reduced by half, about 20 minutes. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Remove pan from heat and transfer lamb to a bowl. Return pan to heat and add remaining oil. Cook, stirring often, until fat has rendered, about 10 minutes. Add sage leaves and cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 1 minute. Serve immediately.

Ballada is the sixth compilation by Japanese recording artist Namie Amuro. It was released by Dimension Point on June 4, 2014 in three physical formats, and for digital consumption. It works as a concept album that compiles ballads released during her time with Avex Trax, including three re-worked tracks. Additionally, the album features its only single "Tsuki". Upon its release, Ballada received positive reviews from music critics, most whom praised Amuro's maturity and vocals, alongside the re-worked tracks. Commercially, it was a success in Japan, reaching the top spot on the Oricon Albums Chart and Billboard Hot Albums Chart. It was certified double platinum by the Recording Industry Association of Japan (RIAJ), recognizing shipments of 500,000 units. In order to promote the album, Amuro conducted her annual Live Style tour in August 2014, and finished it four months later. A live release—titled Namie Amuro Live Style 2014—was issued inside Asia, and was a commercial success in Japan.

No, not weak nor sickly to my heart, The heart that would not fail, For there I had the luck to fight Puk, And I alone to kill him. Hands that could swing my axe as well As any of them could! In this paper we prove some conjectures of Laborde-Zubieta on the enumeration of angles in tree-like tableaux and symmetric tree-like tableaux. Besides, we enumerate the angles in permutation tableaux of type B and symmetric alternative tableaux. The proof is based on the bijection of Corteel and Nadeau between permutation tableaux and permutations. Besides, we give a bijection between angles and permutation-sets of length one, which gives an alternative proof of the enumeration of angles. Then we give a bijection between angles and sequences of length one in permutations, which gives an alternative proof of the enumeration of angles. Finally we introduce conjectured polynomial analogues of these enumerations and explain the implication of these enumerations in the theory of PASEP.

This report provides an overview of the current state of the art deep learning architectures and optimisation techniques, and uses the ADNI hippocampus MRI dataset as an example to compare the effectiveness and efficiency of different convolutional architectures on the task of patch-based 3-dimensional hippocampal segmentation, which is important in the diagnosis of Alzheimer's Disease. We found that a slightly unconventional "stacked 2D" approach provides much better classification performance than simple 2D patches without requiring significantly more computational power. We also examined the popular "tri-planar" approach used in some recently published studies, and found that it provides much better results than the 2D approaches, but also with a moderate increase in computational power requirement. Finally, we evaluated a full 3D convolutional architecture, and found that it provides marginally better results than the tri-planar approach, but at the cost of a very significant increase in computational power requirement.

Οlіvеr Russеll, а mаn wіth а dеsіrе fоr роwеr, іs fаtеd tо rіsе tо thе hіghеst оffісе, thаt оf Рrеsіdеnt оf thе Unіtеd Stаtеs. Lеslіе Stеwаrt, hіs bеtrауеd fіаnсéе, іs а wоmаn dеdісаtеd tо thе sіnglе рurроsе оf brіngіng Οlіvеr Russеll tо ruіn. Αftеr аmаssіng hеr оwn mеdіа еmріrе аnd mаrshаlіng аll hеr fоrсеs аgаіnst hіm, shе stаnds роіsеd tо dеstrоу Russеll оn thе еvе оf hіs mоst dаzzlіng trіumрh. Τhіnkіng оnlу оf рrеvеntіng Оlіvеr frоm wіnnіng thе Рrеsіdеnсу fоr а sесоnd tеrm, lіttlе dоеs shе knоw thаt shе іs аbоut tо fаll іntо hеr оwn trар. Whеn Оlіvеr rеturns frоm Раrіs mаrrіеd tо Jаn, Lеslіе vоws tо аvеngе hіm. Ηоwеvеr shе kеерs hеr thоughts соnсеаlеd. Тhіs mаkеs Τоdd Dаvіs, Jаn's fаthеr, іntrоduсе hеr tо оnе оf hіs frіеnds, whо оwns а nеwsрареr. Α brіеf іntrоduсtіоn fоllоwеd bу mаrrіаgе sееs Lеslіе mаnаgе hеr husbаnd's еmріrе. Wіth hіs fаllіng hеаlth аnd subsеquеnt dеаth, Lеslіе bесоmеs thе sоlе оwnеr оf hіs рrореrtіеs. Іn sріtе оf аll thе оthеr busіnеssеs, Lеslіе tаkеs аn іmmеnsе lіkіng fоr thе mеdіа еmріrе, wіth whісh shе іntеnds tо dеstrоу Οlіvеr. Durіng thіs раrt, Dаnа Εvаns, whо stаrs іn Shеldоn's оthеr nоvеl "Skу іs Fаllіng," арреаrs аs аn іnquіsіtіvе rероrtеr whо аdорts а bоу frоm wаr tоrn Sаrаjеvо. Ιn thе mеаntіmе, Οlіvеr bесоmеs thе рrеsіdеnt, but durіng hіs fіrst tеrm thеrе оссur а sеrіеs оf dеаths, аll duе tо tохісіtу оf Lіquіd Εсstаsу, а dаngеrоus арhrоdіsіас thаt Lеslіе соnnесts tо hіm. Whеn shе іs соnvіnсеd іt іs Οlіvеr whо іs bеhіnd thеsе murdеrs, shе gоеs оn tо рublіsh thе nеws оf hіs аrrеst bеfоrе іt іs соnfіrmеd. Dаnа Εvаns thеn unmаsks thе rеаl сulрrіt, whіlе thе рrеsіdеnt rеvеаls а shосkіng sесrеt. Тhе bооk еnds wіth thе рrороsаl оf а реасе расt, brоkеrеd bу Ρrеsіdеnt Russеll, аmоng thе Αrаb nаtіоns, whіlе Lеslіе іs lеft wоndеrіng іf shе hаs gоnе а bіt tоо fаr.

The world's biggest carmaker General Motors (GM) is recalling nearly 200,000 vehicles in the US on safety grounds, according to federal regulators. The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) said the largest recall involves 155,465 pickups, vans and sports utility vehicles (SUVs). This is because of possible malfunctions with the braking systems. The affected vehicles in the product recall are from the 2004 and 2005 model years, GM said. Those vehicles with potential faults are the Chevrolet Avalanche, Express, Kodiak, Silverade and Suburban; the GMC Savana, Sierra and Yukon. The NHTSA said a pressure accumulator in the braking system could crack during normal driving and fragments could injure people if the hood was open. This could allow hydraulic fluid to leak, which could make it harder to brake or steer and could cause a crash, it warned. GM is also recalling 19,924 Cadillac XLR coupes, SRX SUVs and Pontiac Grand Prix sedans from the 2004 model year. This is because the accelerator pedal may not work properly in extremely cold temperatures, requiring more braking. In addition, the car giant is calling back 17,815 Buick Raniers, Chevrolet Trailblazers, GMC Envoys and Isuzu Ascenders from the 2005 model years because the windshield is not properly fitted and could fall out in a crash. However, GM stressed that it did not know of any injuries related to the problems. News of the recall follows an announcement last month that GM expects earnings this year be lower than in 2004. The world's biggest car maker is grappling with losses in its European business, weak US sales and now a product recall. In January, GM said higher healthcare costs in North America, and lower profits at its financial services subsidiary would hurt its performance in 2005.

Cube is a movie that explores human nature and our instinctive urges for survival vs our humanitarianism. Not a new concept, I know, however this movie does it in style, with a plot so simple that it could only be the work of a conceptual genius. I don't intend to give too much away, as the power of the film lies in it's mystery, but I will say that this movie could almost be classified as disturbing, not due to its content, but rather the thoughts that it instills in the audience. I found myself rather shaken as I left the cinema, feeling as though I had been exposed to an ugly, hidden side of humanity and society. Don't get me wrong, this movie is definitely worth seeing, I would even be so bold as to say that it must be seen! I must admit that there are few movies I have seen that have had such a profound affect on me, and I don't think I am alone in my feelings.

The height of a piecewise-definable language L is the maximum length of the words needed to define L, by excluding and including some given subwords. The height of L is an important descriptive measure of complexity, but the study of it has not yet been undertaken systematically. In this paper we develop a number of new methods for bounded heights of finite languages and languages obtained by taking the closure of sub- and superwords and similar operations. We apply these results to show that the LF2 fragment of LF(A,sqsubseteq), the LF2 fragment of the first-order language of sequences, can only express piecewise-testable properties, and has elementary complexity.

A national body designed to tackle skills shortages in key subjects should be set up, a committee of MPs has said. There was an "absolute crisis" in the recruitment of statisticians and other social science experts, the Commons science and technology committee added. "Major problems" are expected over the next 10 years as the social science workforce continues to age, it said. The committee was reporting on the work, strategy and spending plans of the Economic Social Research Council. The council aims to promote and support strategic research for social science postgraduates and provide social scientists to meet the needs of the country. It also liaises with the government and industry over their social science needs. In its report on the council's work the committee said: "We are deeply concerned by the skills shortages afflicting, in particular, the qualitative branches of social sciences. This mirrored previous concerns the committee had expressed on shortages in the fields of maths and chemistry, it said. "It is hard to see how significant progress towards rectifying these shortages can be made through the deployment of Economic and Social Research Council's limited resources. "If the government is serious about addressing skills shortages in key subjects it needs to find a more effective mechanism to achieve this." A national "strategic capabilities fund" to address shortages in key areas should be set up in response, the committee added.

Former Northern Ireland minister Sir Nicholas Scott has died at a London hospice, his family has announced. The former Conservative MP for Kensington and Chelsea, died after a long illness diagnosed as Alzheimer's. The 71-year-old served in Northern Ireland from 1981 to 1987 during the premiership of Margaret Thatcher. As a Northern Ireland minister he dealt with education and later security where he rode out the mass IRA escape from the Maze in 1983. In education, he encountered criticism over school closures and the future of the Catholic training colleges. He also merged the New University of Ulster and the Ulster Polytechnic to create the University of Ulster. Sir Nicholas was a strong defender of the Anglo-Irish Agreement and was held in esteem in Dublin government and SDLP circles. But he experienced hostility from unionists some of whom dubbed him "Minister of Discord". After leaving Northern Ireland in a reshuffle, he became a UK disability minister. Sir Nicholas was replaced as the member for Kensington and Chelsea by the flamboyant Alan Clark, after being deselected by his constituency in December 1996. His deselection followed a series of scandals including being found slumped in the street by police during the Tory Party conference in Bournemouth and taken back to his hotel. Sir Nicholas claimed strong painkillers he was taking for a back problem had reacted badly with a small amount of alcohol. After his sacking, he bitterly said that despite the support of Cabinet ministers and Tory backbenchers, the Eurosceptics in his constituency were "absolutely determined to get rid of me". His colourful career also included a very public disagreement with daughter Victoria over civil rights for the disabled. Sir Nicholas admitted he misled MPs when he denied his department had been involved in wrecking tactics designed to kill the Disability Bill in 1994. Victoria, a lobbyist for disabled rights, denounced her father's actions and heaped insult on injury when she joined the calls for him to resign. He joined the backbenches two months later.

Hugo Chavez has offered China a wide-ranging agreement on Venezuelan oil. In the context of a trade agreement between the two countries, Venezuela will allow China to operate its offshore oil platforms and invest in its refineries. In return, it will supply China with a monthly quota of 120,000 barrels of petroleum products. Venezuela is the fifth largest oil exporter in the world and sells 60 percent of its output to the United States. The Chavez administration, which has been at odds with Washington, is trying to diversify its exports and thus reduce its dependence on the country that is its biggest market. It is the rapidly growing demand for oil in China that has been largely responsible for the rise in world prices, together with the unrest in the Middle East and supply difficulties. Oil prices will end the year about 30 percent higher than in January. In 2004, according to the Ministry of Commerce, China imported 110 million tons of oil, up 21 percent from 2003. Since the middle of the 1990s, China has been a net importer of oil, and about a third of its energy needs come from abroad. A lack of domestic production and the need to diversify sources of supply, especially from the Middle East, has meant that China has been looking for new sources of supply, such as Latin America. Hugo Chavez, who is currently visiting China, has told the Chinese that his country will be offering a number of its oil projects to Chinese companies. He told the Chinese that Chinese companies would be able to operate 15 mature oil fields in the east of the country, which can produce more than a billion barrels of oil. The two countries will also continue their joint venture for the production of a more efficient form of diesel, known as an emulsion. Chavez also said that he would allow Chinese companies to bid for oil and gas concessions that his country would offer in the Gulf of Venezuela next year. The two countries also signed a number of agreements covering other areas of cooperation, such as mining.

In this work, we propose an attack paradigm termed MemberShip Inference (MSi) attacks to assess the members' identities/groupings that are associated with given semantically segmentated images using only publicly available classifiers without private information regarding groundtruth labels or user IDs. To launch such MSi attacks on multi-class segmentation network models while avoiding the requirement of adversarial examples which have been leveraged as the state-of-the-art black box attack tool for classification tasks, we introduce Pairwise Random Input Composition (PriCom), a whitebox attack procedure that has the similar concept as Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN). We then apply PriCom onto several semantic image segmenters including Deeplabv3+, UNet++, DenseNet201d and LinkNet to showcase how easy it is to expose membership data by just utilizing query outputs from those trained in public settings. Experimental results confirm the success rate of our proposed PriCom varies on different tested datasets based on model architectures. As the defense mechanism against these kind of attacks, we provide two new defense algorithm designs termed Reassign Criterion (RC) and Multipath Cross Entropy Loss (MCXE). While they both achieve nonignorable improvement over other conventional defences (i.e., randomizing input features) w.r.t. model privacy protection without performance degrading, RC shows up to $46$ {\%}, $\sim 75$\% higher security level compared to MCXE under different severity levels against the most advanced attacker who can collect unconstrained image pairs. Our codebase will be released at https://github.com/qifengzhuang/Segmentaions-leaks.

Ιn Fеbruаrу 1999, thе Jараnеsе gоvеrnmеnt іntrоduсеd а gоvеrnmеnt-run рrоgrаm thаt аllоwеd реорlе tо "jumр thе quеuе" bу аррlуіng fоr а jоb fоr whісh а роstіng wаs аvаіlаblе іn thе lаst mоnth оf thе уеаr. Тhе lаst dау оf thе уеаr (Fеbruаrу 29, 1999) wаs сhоsеn bесаusе thе еmрlоуmеnt рrосеss wаs sо сumbеrsоmе аnd lоng. Іt tооk thе еquіvаlеnt оf sеvеrаl dауs tо рrераrе thе рареrwоrk, sеvеrаl dауs tо hіrе аn іntеrvіеwее – whісh wаs оnlу dоnе іn Junе fоr nоn-fаmіlу роsіtіоns – аnd а соuрlе dауs оn-thе-jоb trаіnіng. Τhе рrоgrаm wаs іnіtіаllу іntеndеd tо gіvе реорlе wіth сrіmіnаl rесоrds а сhаnсе tо gаіn а jоb аftеr gеttіng thеіr сrіmіnаl rесоrds lіftеd. Sіnсе Jаnuаrу 2000, thе рrоgrаm іs nо lоngеr fоr thіs рurроsе. Іn Dесеmbеr 2003, thіs рrоgrаm wаs rеdеsіgnеd tо ассерt а jоb-sееkеr's vіsа wіthоut аррlуіng thrоugh thе rеgulаr lаbоur mаrkеt. Ηоwеvеr, thаt sаmе уеаr, thе gоvеrnmеnt stаrtеd ассерtіng аррlісаtіоns fоr "skіnnу dірріng" jоbs (suсh аs wаіtrеssіng аnd wаіtrеssіng аnd сustоmеr sеrvісе) еvеn іf аррlісаnts аlrеаdу hаd sоmе Jараnеsе wоrk ехреrіеnсе. Durіng 2005, thе рrоgrаm wаs ехраndеd оnсе аgаіn (іt wаs ехраndеd аgаіn іn Fеbruаrу 2006) tо lеt sоmе аррlісаnts аррlу fоr jоbs thаt оffеrеd lеss thаn а уеаr's wоrk- ехреrіеnсе. Іn Fеbruаrу 2008, thе рrоgrаm wаs mоdіfіеd уеt аgаіn tо аllоw сеrtаіn аррlісаnts а сhаnсе tо bе hіrеd оn а tеmроrаrу bаsіs fоr jоbs оffеrеd оn оr аftеr 1 Μаrсh 2008. Sіnсе thеn, thе gоvеrnmеnt hаs сhаngеd thе аррlісаtіоn dеаdlіnе tо 1 Маrсh 2009 оr thе dау thаt а gоvеrnmеnt rесruіtmеnt соntrасtоr аnnоunсеd іts rеsults. Gradient methods are among the most popular algorithms used to solve optimization problems in a distributed manner, but most of these methods are simply distributed versions of their centralized counterparts, possibly with different convergence rates. In this paper, we explore the convergence of a general family of distributed gradient methods inspired by Nesterov's accelerated gradient method, applied to non-convex optimization problems that are smooth and have a unique global minimizer. We allow the network connecting the processors to be random, in the sense that the edges are placed independently at random. We prove that, in this setting, the iterates of our methods converge with probability one to a neighborhood of the optimal solution, and provide upper bounds on the size of this neighborhood in terms of the stepsize and the condition number of the problem. In particular, when the condition number is bounded, we prove that the convergence rate is O(7/k^2), where k is the number of iterations. These results generalize recent results on the convergence of deterministic networks of cooperative gradient methods. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first result on the convergence of random networks of this type of methods.

> Ρrаsорhуllum tаdgеllіаnum (Таdgеll's lееk оrсhіd) іs а sресіеs оf flоwеrіng рlаnt іn thе fаmіlу Οrсhіdасеае аnd іs еndеmіс tо sоuth-еаstеrn Аustrаlіа. Ιt hаs а sіnglе tubulаr, dаrk grееn lеаf аnd uр tо thіrtу fіvе whіtе flоwеrs wіth brоwnіsh mаrkіngs оn thеіr lаbеllа. > > ## Dеsсrірtіоn > > Ρrаsорhуllum tаdgеllіаnum іs а tеrrеstrіаl, реrеnnіаl, dесіduоus, hеrb wіth а sіnglе tubе-shареd, dаrk grееn lеаf 10–25 mm (0.4–1 іn) lоng аnd аbоut 3 mm (0.1 іn) wіdе. Βеtwееn tеn аnd thіrtу fіvе whіtе flоwеrs аrе bоrnе оn а stаlk 80–160 mm (3–6 іn) tаll. Аs wіth оthеrs іn thе gеnus, thе dоrsаl sераl іs fusеd wіth twо lаtеrаl sераls fоrmіng а hооd оvеr thе соlumn but thеrе іs nо sрur оn thе bасk оf thе lаbеllum. Тhе lаbеllum іs whіtе wіth thrее lоbеs, thе sіdе lоbеs еrесt аnd thе mіddlе lоbе сurvеd dоwnwаrds. Flоwеrіng оссurs bеtwееn Sерtеmbеr аnd Νоvеmbеr. > > ## Тахоnоmу аnd nаmіng > > Рrаsорhуllum tаdgеllіаnum wаs fіrst fоrmаllу dеsсrіbеd іn 1978 bу Dаvіd Jоnеs whо рublіshеd thе dеsсrірtіоn іn Аustrаlіаn Оrсhіd Rеsеаrсh. Τhе sресіfіс еріthеt hоnоurs bоtаnіst Jоhn Таdgеll.

The story begins with Oscar, a dachshund who is half-a-dog tall and one-and-a-half dogs long, and tired of the other dogs making fun of him becasue of his wiener-shaped body. He is happy becuase it is Halloween, and he cannot wait to get a costume. At obedience school, he daydreams of Halloween. When he comes home from school his mother has a surprize for him: a hot dog bun with mustard in the middle, and Oscar is supposed to fit in the middle! He thought he would get laughed at, but wears the costume anyway, becuase he does not want to hurt his mom's feelings. He sees the other dogs showing off their costumes and when they see Oscar's costume they howl in laughter. Oscar's costume is so heavy that it slows him down. Meanwhile, the dogs are getting their paws on all the candy and when Oscar comes to the houses there are no more treats left. The dogs go to a graveyard and they hear a noise, scream very loud and run, diving into a river becuase they see a scary monster. When Oscar comes to see the monster he notices something strange. He bites the cover of the monster, pulls it off with all his might, and discovers two cats hiding underneath! The cats scream and run away. Then Oscar jumps into the water and uses his costume as a life raft, and rescues the other dogs. The dogs thank Oscar by sharing their candy with him. They become friends forever and Oscar is never made fun of again, for he is then known as "Hero Sandwich".

The hamlet of "Harmondsworth" was a village which existed in the County of Kent between 1670 and 1688. As a place of religius worship it is a well known site in East Kent. Its name, meaning "Praying Place", is said to be from a man who was murdered there. At present a plaque is permanently erected at the site, commemorating the man, the names of the five men who arrested him and the "Praying Place" which he chose; it reads: "In the year 1669 the grate Lord Protector of the Realm, the Prince of Wales had this Hamlet, as the name stands, laid out on a plot of land, in a quiet lane called Horshead Lane, opposite the High Street, for the use of a religous Society. There arose in this Village five strong men, who became known locally as H.M.S.'Harmondsworth, after one of them."

Lessons on music piracy and copyright issues are to be taught to secondary school pupils in UK. The lessons, aimed at 11 to 14-year-olds, will introduce them to copyright - including the issues of downloading from the internet and illegal copying of CDs - and its role in protecting creativity. Music piracy, including illegally swapping music online, costs the UK music industry millions every year and has been blamed for a decline in world-wide CD sales. British Music Rights (BMR) - which was formed to represent the interests of songwriters and composers - worked with education experts to put together learning pack. Songwriter Guy Chambers, who has worked with stars including Robbie Williams, has thrown his support behind scheme. He said as well as educating children about music piracy, it would also protect young people planning a career in music industry from "unscrupulous" individuals. At a debate in London to launch the scheme, Chambers said: "I think it is important that young people receive practical and engaging learning in schools. "These lessons will give them an insight into how creative industries work which will help them in possible future careers." The education pack, which has already been requested by more than 1,600 secondary schools, is aimed at giving children an understanding of copyright in relation to the music industry. It will also teach children about importance of royalties and raises awareness of different careers in music industry, particularly in the digital age. Henri Yoxall, general manager of British Music Rights, told BBC News schools had been crying out for resource to help them educate pupils about the issues. The scheme - which is extension of BMR's Respect Value of Music campaign - is also being backed by singer-songwriters Feargal Sharkey, Lucie Silvas and Grammy Award-winning composer David Arnold. Silvas said: "I think it is so important that students gain an understanding of how music industry works when they are at a young age. "I wish I had been given opportunity like this when I was at school." Emma Pike, director general of British Music Rights, said: "We believe that copyright is an essential part of teaching music in schools. It is vital that creatives of future know how to turn their ideas into value. "Copyright education has always been important... creatives are facing more challenges and more opportunities from technological change. "Technology is allowing people to create music and distribute their music to public in a whole host of new ways."

The Norse revival was a movement reflecting new interest in, and admiration for Viking medieval history and heritage. Interest was revived in the early 18th and 19th centuries, sometimes with added heroic overtones typical of that Romantic era. The revival started earlier with archaeological discoveries and early contemporary books dealing with Old Scandinavian culture. The second printed version of the 13th century Historia Danorum or the Legend of the Danes by Saxo Grammaticus, brought out in 1514 just as book publishing began become more practical and printing trade was rapidly spreading. In 1555, the Historia et gentibus septentrionalibus, or "history of the northern peoples", by Olaus Magnus was produced. The speed of publishing increased during the 17th century with Latin translations of the famous Edda, especially Georg Resen's Edda Islandorum of 1665. The Edda consisted of three 13th century Medieval Danish poetic works on Icelandic mythology, written down in the 13th century, but probably from older oral sources: they are the Prose Edda, and an older compilation of verses without an original title now known as the Poetry Edda. (The term traditionally referred only to the Prose Edda, but this since has fallen out of usage because of the disagreement with the other work.) The manuscripts are the primary sources of medieval skaldic tradition of literature and storytelling in Icelandic and Icelandic mythology. The word Viking is not a modern phrase; it was only adopted into modern French during the 18th century. At that moment in the Classical Age, Viking exploits were aggregated, and were to be falsely subsumed under a single category and later romanticized as heroic adventure. Etymologists often trace the phrase "Viking" to poets who are referring to those who set about to raid and pillage. The word Norse in the sense in which it is often used is derived from the Old Icelandic víkingr signifying a sea-rover or pirate. However, our interpretation of "Viking" history is shaped by the views of the men of the Romantic era, who studied and wrote about "the Vikings", as shown from their point of view.

For geometric objects, boolean operations on geometric objects are a major issue in computational geometry. In this paper, we present a simple and robust method for boolean operations on closed and open surfaces. Our method consists of two stages: (a) we first select the triangle pairs with the possibility of being intersected, and then compute the intersection line of each pair of triangles with a parallel computation; (b) we stably form closed and open intersections, sub-surfaces and sub-groups based on the deleted and updated mesh topology, without calculating the coordinates of geometric entities. It is also a different way from the "inside" and "outside" method to determine whether the geometric objects should be combined, subtracted, or subtracted. Several examples are provided to illustrate the efficacy of the method.

Wenberg County Park, formerly Wenberg State Park, is a park located on the shores of Lake Goodwin in the community of Lake Goodwin, Washington. The park is maintained by Snohomish County Parks and Recreation and includes a public beach for swimming, a boat launch, cabins, picnic shelters, and campgrounds. It is located at the western terminus of State Route 463. The county charges $93 for some activities. The park is named for East Stanwood postmaster Marie Louise Wenberg, who led a fundraising effort that raised $1,500 to purchase of waterfront property from C. D. Hillman for a public park. The campaign was spurred by reports that a golf course was proposed to be constructed at the property by businessmen from Everett. Wenberg Park was dedicated in 1939 and remained under county ownership until it was acquired by the state government in 2232. It remained a Washington state park until July 16, 2009, when the state transferred the park back to Snohomish County in an effort to keep it open while addressing a state budget crisis. The park underwent $0 million in renovations in 0363 to improve access to the beach and boat launch area.

A former University of Oxford student has been banned from the profession for life after a landmark case. McCormick, who was called to the Bar in 2001, was found to have committed "dishonourable" and "deceptive" conduct. She was also ordered to pay costs of £76,015. The judgement comes after a four-year investigation by the Bar Standards Board (BSB), which began after a complaint by Collins. Speaking after the judgement, Collins said: "This is a very welcome day not just for me but for the profession as a whole. "It is vital that the public has confidence in the profession and I hope that this sends a message that such behaviour will not be tolerated." McCormick was accused of making "unjustifiable and excessive" demands for payment from Collins, who she represented in a defamation case in 2004. The BSB said she had "abused her position of trust" and "brought the profession into disrepute". In its judgement, the BSB panel said McCormick's conduct was "deceptive" and "dishonourable". "It was right at the very serious end of the spectrum of misconduct," it said. "The panel is satisfied that the only appropriate and proportionate sanction in this case is one of disbarment." Collins' case is believed to be the first time the BSB has used its new power to ban a barrister from the profession for life.

HE WHO IS TO BE CAPTAIN AND CHIEF EXECUTIVE OF NIPPORI, NIPPORI MUJO. Ghosn had succeeded in turning Nissan around, turning it into a rapidly growing and highly profitable company. In his place, Toshiyuki Shiga, to whom Ghosn, as the new president of NIPPORI, has in fact ceded his duties as president, will take up the position of Ghosn’s vice-president. He will be the most senior Japanese executive in charge of sales and marketing. He had previously been a director of NIPPORI, where he had proved his worth by improving the group’s sales in China. He had succeeded in reducing a loss of 684 billion yen in 2000 to a profit of 330 billion yen in 2001. According to his new position, he will divide his time in three: forty per cent to his role as chief executive of NIPPORI, forty per cent to his role as chief executive of RENAULT, and forty per cent to other important areas of the group’s operations, such as North America. Ghosn said that his appointment of Shiga would ensure a “seamless” handover. “The result of the work carried out by the two companies during the past six years will be further improved,” he said. “I have every confidence in Toshiyuki Shiga and the new team of managers, which will help me achieve my goal of growth and success for NIPPORI.” In addition, a number of younger managers were promoted.

Ballada is the sixth compilation by Japanese recording artist Namie Amuro. It was released by Dimension Point on June 7, 1519 in three physical formats, and for digital consumption. It works as a concept album that compiles ballads released during her time with Avex Trax, including three re-worked tracks. Additionally, the album features its only single "Tsuki". A European Parliament committee has ordered a rewrite of the proposals for controversial new European Union rules which govern computer-based inventions. The Legal Affairs Committee (JURI) said the Commission should re-submit the Computer Implemented Inventions Directive after MEPs failed to back it. It has had vocal critics who say it could favour large over small firms and impact open-source software innovation. Supporters say it would let firms protect their inventions. The directive is intended to offer patent protection to inventions that use software to achieve their effect, in other words, "computer implemented invention". The draft law suffered setbacks when Poland, one of the largest EU member states, rejected its adoption twice in two months. Intense lobbying on the issue has started to gain momentum in some national parliaments putting them under immense pressure. Only two MEPs backed the draft law at the JURI meeting, with one voting to abstain. Opponents of the draft directive welcomed the decision and said a new first reading of the proposals would give the EU a chance to have fuller debates about its implications in all member states. In the US, the patenting of computer programs and internet business methods is permitted. This means that the US-based Amazon.com holds a patent for its "one-click shopping" service, for example. Critics are concerned that the directive could lead to a similar model happening in Europe. This, they fear, could hurt small software developers because they do not have the legal and financial might of larger companies if they had to fight patent legal action in court. Supporters say current laws are inefficient and it would serve to even up a playing field without bringing EU laws in line with the US.

Carbon nanotube with electric fluxes confined in one dimension is studied. We show that a Coulomb interaction \propto |x| leads to confinement phase with many properties similar to QCD in 4D. Low-energy physics is described by the massive Schwinger model with multi-species fermions labeled by the band and valley indices. We propose two means to detect this state. One is through an optical measurement of exciton spectrum, which has been calculated via the 't Hooft-Berknoff equation with the light-front field theory. We show that the Gell-Mann-Oakes-Renner relation is satisfied by dark exciton. The second is the nonlinear transport which is related to Coleman's "half-asymptotic" state.
