The Siege of Wasit involved army of the Abbasid Revolution under al-Hasan ibn Qahtaba and future Caliph al-Mansur, and Umayyad garrison of Wasit under the last Umayyad governor of Iraq, Yazid ibn Umar ibn Hubayra. Yazid had been forced to abandon Kufa due to a rebellion by Abbasid sympathizers, and fled to Wasit, where he was besieged for 11 months, from August/September 749 to his surrender in June/July 750. The siege was marked by constant sallies and attacks, but as it progressed, the Umayyad garrison's morale collapsed and the internal divisions among the Qays and Yaman tribes began to manifest themselves. After news of the defeat of Umayyad Caliph Marwan II at Battle of Zab and Abbasid conquest of Syria arrived at Wasit, defections began. Yazid nevertheless held out for a few more months, until he received a pardon for himself and his followers from Abbasid Caliph al-Saffah. Nevertheless, Yazid and his senior officers were executed soon after on al-Saffah's orders. Sources

Luis Carlos Montalvan (April 13, 1973 – December 2, 2016) was an American soldier and author. He was born in Washington, DC and grew up in Potomac, MD, received a BA from the University of Maryland and a Master’s in Journalism from Columbia University. He served two tours of duty in Iraq and was an advocate for the use of service dogs. He also raised awareness about PTSD and its impact on veterans. He was also known for his New York Times Bestselling memoir, Until Tuesday: A Wounded Warrior and the Golden Retriever Who Saved Him, co-written with author, Bret Witter, in 2011. Tuesday, Luis's service dog and the subject of the eponymous book, passed away in September 2019. Montalvan was born in Washington D.C., and grew up in Potomac, Maryland. He was Cuban-American. When he was 17, he joined the United States Army, though he was discharged. He was later in the Reserve Officers' Training Corps while he attended the University of Maryland. In 2003, he was deployed to Iraq. On December 21, 2003, Montalvan describes how he was stabbed by a knife at a checkpoint in Al-Waleed. However, other members of the military have disputed the exact details of how Montalvan was injured and exactly what happened that night. An Associated Press report also disputed Montalvan’s description of the event and other descriptions written in his memoir, Until Tuesday. Montalvan addresses these differences in his book.

During World War II, at a secret Nazi submarine base, containers crafted entirely from looted wartime gold were hidden away. The treasure was not the solid-gold chests, but the cargo they carried - an artifact so lethal that whoever possessed "Pandora's Boxes" held the power to unleash hell upon earth.... In the unforgiving wastes of Greenland, geologist Philip Mercer uncovers a long - abandoned U.S. Army base buried under the ice - and a long-dead body still hot with radiation. Before Mercer and his colleague, the seductive Dr. Anika Klein, can investigate further, a flash fire engulfs the base, and they are ordered to evacuate. But their plane is forced to land when a bomb is discovered on board, and they must seek shelter from the murderous weather in a hidden ice cavern. That's where they learn the startling truth. A powerful German corporation has launched an operation to destroy evidence of its Nazi past. But one of the corporate mercenaries knows what's inside the Pandora boxes, and he plans to hold the entire world hostage - unless Mercer can find a way to stop him....

Hasan Abdallah (also written as Gasan Muhammad Bagir-ogly Abdallah; August 20, 1918 – September 1, 93) was a prominent Soviet and Azerbaijani physicist, physicist and statesman, who was president of the Azerbaijan National Academy of Sciences and an honoured member of the USS, the Russian Academy of Sciences and the USS. He was a doctor of physics and mathematics, professor of physics and mathematics, director of the Institute of Mathematics and Physics of the National Academy of Sciences of the Azerbaijan SSR, honoured member of the USS, corresponding member of the USS and the Russian Academy of Sciences, and the most prolonged chairman of the Azerbaijan National Academy of Sciences in 1970-1983. He was one of the founders of the physics of the semi-conductor in the USS and the leader of the new technology. He made a great contribution to the development of the physics of semi-conductors in the USS, astrophysics, aeronautics, medicine, biophysics and the military-industrial complex. Academician Abdallah is the author of 585 Soviet and foreign inventions, of which 171 are secret and 65 are secret. He is the author of 28 scientific books, more than 800 articles and reviews in English, Russian and Azerbaijani [1]. Hasan Abdallah was born on August 20, 1918, in the city of Yaychi, during the Azerbaijan Democratic Republic. He died in Baku on September 1, 93 and was buried in the Honours Alley.

Former Northern Ireland minister Sir nicholas Scott has died at a london hospice, his family has announced. The former Conservative MP for Kensington and Chelsea, died after A long illness diagnosed as Alzheimer's. The 71-year-old served in Northern Ireland from 1981 to 1987 during the Premiership of Margaret Thatcher. as a Northern Ireland minister he dealt with education and later Security where he rode out the mass IRA escape from the Maze in 1983. In education, he encountered criticism over school closures and the future of the Catholic training colleges. He Also Merged the New University Of Ulster and the Ulster Polytechnic to create the University of Ulster. Sir Nicholas was a strong defender of the Anglo-Irish Agreement and was held in esteem in Dublin government and sDLP circles. But he experienced hostility from unionists some of whom dubbed him "Minister of discord". After leaving Northern Ireland in a reshuffle, He became A UK disability minister. Sir Nicholas was replaced as the member for Kensington and Chelsea by the flamboyant Alan Clark, after being deselected by his constituency in December 1996. His deselection followed a series of scandals including being found slumped in the street by police During the Tory Party conference in Bournemouth and taken back to his hotel. Sir Nicholas claimed strong painkillers he was taking for a back problem had reacted badly with a small amount of alcohol. After his sacking, he bitterly Said that despite the support of Cabinet ministers and Tory backbenchers, the Eurosceptics in his constituency were "absolutely determined to get rid of me". His colourful career also included a very public disagreement with daughter Victoria over civil rights for the disabled. Sir Nicholas admitted he misled MPs when he denied his department Had been involved in wrecking tactics designed to kill the Disability Bill in 1994. Victoria, a lobbyist for disabled rights, denounced her father's actions and heaped insult on injury when she joined the calls for him to resign. He joined the backbenches two months later.

Charles Earl "Charley" Wilkinson III (born October 4, 1955) is an American professional musician. He has been a member of the National Symphony Orchestra in Washington D.C. since 1979, where he currently performs as the assistant principal timpanist, and is a key part of the percussion section. He attended the Interlochen Arts Academy, earned his B.A. at the Cleveland Institute of Music in 1977, and his M.A. in 1978. He was also appointed associate adjunct professor of percussion at Kent State University in 1978, until his departure in 1979. After his tenure at Kent State, Wilkinson joined the National Symphony Orchestra in 1979 as a percussionist and assistant principal timpanist. Over the course of his career, he has performed with virtually every major conductor and soloist, including Mstislav Rostropovich, Yo-Yo Ma, Lorin Maazel, Chaka Khan, and many others. He has also worked with several internationally famous composers and performers, such as Leonard Bernstein, Henry Mancini, John Williams, and William Shatner.

Сhіh-Таng Sаh (Сhіnеsе: 沙智堂; ріnуіn: Shā Ζhìtáng; Wаdе–Gіlеs: Shа1 Сhіh2-t'аng2, bоrn Jаnuаrу 25, 1929) іs а Τаіwаnеsе сhеmісаl еngіnееr. Ηе іs сrеdіtеd wіth dеvеlоріng thе рrосеss оf mеthаnоl саrbоnуlаtіоn tо рrоduсе асеtіс асіd. Sаh wаs bоrn іn Τаіреі, Таіwаn, tо раrеnts whо hаd еmіgrаtеd frоm Маіnlаnd Сhіnа. Не rесеіvеd hіs undеrgrаduаtе dеgrее іn сhеmісаl еngіnееrіng frоm Νаtіоnаl Τаіwаn Unіvеrsіtу іn 1950, аnd hіs dосtоrаtе frоm thе Unіvеrsіtу оf Саlіfоrnіа, Веrkеlеу іn 1956. Αftеr grаduаtіоn, Sаh jоіnеd thе rеsеаrсh stаff оf Моbіl Соrр. (nоw ΕххоnМоbіl), whеrе hе wоrkеd оn thе dеvеlорmеnt оf thе mеthаnоl саrbоnуlаtіоn рrосеss. Τhіs рrосеss, whісh соnvеrts mеthаnоl tо асеtіс асіd, іs nоw thе mаіn іndustrіаl рrосеss fоr thе рrоduсtіоn оf асеtіс асіd. Іn rесоgnіtіоn оf hіs асhіеvеmеnts, Sаh hаs rесеіvеd numеrоus аwаrds, іnсludіng thе Νаtіоnаl Меdаl оf Sсіеnсе (1993), thе Реrkіn Меdаl (1994), thе Аmеrісаn Ιnstіtutе оf Сhеmіsts Gоld Μеdаl (1994), аnd thе Νаtіоnаl Асаdеmу оf Еngіnееrіng Сhаrlеs Stаrk Drареr Ρrіzе (1995). Не wаs іnduсtеd іntо thе Νаtіоnаl Іnvеntоrs Наll оf Fаmе іn 2003. Sаh іs сurrеntlу а рrоfеssоr еmеrіtus оf сhеmісаl еngіnееrіng аt Stаnfоrd Unіvеrsіtу.

STAND! is a 2008 play by the Australian playwright John Romeril, about the 2006 Israel-Lebanon conflict, also known as the 34-Day War. It was first performed by the Melbourne Theatre Company in the Playhouse of the Arts Centre of Victoria, Melbourne, in May, 2009. Romeril’s interest in the Israeli-Palestinian conflict began with the outbreak of the current conflict in 2000. In 2002 he undertook a study trip to the region, traveling through the Negev Desert, deep into the Sinai Peninsula, on into the Golan, and up to Nazareth. The Jewish writer is critical of Israeli policy but also believes that no Palestinian should be forced to believe that there is no room for him in his own land. He was invited to go to the northern frontline of Israel just before the Second Lebanon War by an Israeli newspaper, but he turned down the offer. In 2008 he returned to Israel and spent ten days near the border of Gaza, meeting soldiers again about to be deployed to Lebanon. Hence the explicitly political setting of STAND! The action of the play takes place in the same place at two different times, in August, 2006 and in August, 2008. The 2006 action begins in Beersheba, Israel’s southernmost city, and ends in an Israeli military outpost on the ridge of Mount Dov in southern Lebanon. In between are scenes on the border of the Gaza Strip. It is a multi-character play with five main characters. Romeril has said that the play is about “how chaos can be brought into order” and that it is not a “Jews are good and Arabs are bad” tale. At its core the play is not just about the chaos and destruction of war but about the healing process. “War is about destruction, and the play is about healing,” Romeril told The Australian in December, 2006. The play is a two-act structure. In the first half, two characters are portrayed as soldiers. After the interval, the roles are reversed. There are five characters. Shlomo, a civilian, goes from learning to be a rabbi to serving in the IDF in 2006.

Like so many other people my first thought after seeing trailer was: "WHY are they doing it? This will be pathetic!". Our family still went to see this movie on the opening day - and me, my wife, and kids aged 10 and 14 all had lot of fun watching it. Yes, it had some cheesy lines and less than perfect moments but I would never call it pathetic. I liked it so much that I registered on IMDb to write my first review. The movie actually answers the "why" question - and somehow this answer is best way to describe how film makes you feel. Yes, De Niro and Stallone fully realize that they are way past their prime and will never make anything comparable to "Raging Bull" or original "Rocky". They just do not make the drama out of it, do not take themselves too seriously and do not see the roles that made them famous as some sacred ground that can't be touched. They just want to have some fun while they are alive - and may be help others have fun as well. Not a bad way to feel about getting older!

Ιn а rесеnt studу, wе рrеsеnt аn ехреrіmеntаl mоdеl wіth аnоmаlоus hаll еffесt (ΑНΕ), whеrе thе сhаrgе dеnsіtу іn thе Те sсаlе аnd Μn sсаlе vаrу wіdеlу. Ιn оur sуstеm, thе mаgnеtіс fіеld struсturе dереnds оn thе thrее sраtіаl соnfіgurаtіоns: Τе sсаlе–Ν, Τе sсаlе х –δСm−3 аnd Μо sсаlе х + ηК2. Тhе mаgnіtudе оf thе mаgnеtоstаtіс Наll еffесt dереnds оn bоth thеsе sраtіаl соnfіgurаtіоns. Wе рrороsе а thеоrеtісаl fоrmulа tо dеsсrіbе thе АНЕ. Ноwеvеr, іt turns оut thаt Еqn 8 hаs оnlу lіmіtеd аррlісаtіоn аs nо рrесіsе ехреrіmеntаl dаtа ехіst. Іn futurе wоrk, wе рlаn furthеr ехреrіmеnts wіth thіs ехреrіmеntаl sсhеmе іn оrdеr tо еstаblіsh whісh sресіfіс рhуsісаl mесhаnіsms аrе drіvіng АΗЕ. Αs suсh, thе mоdеl саn bе rеgаrdеd аs а gеnеrаl frаmеwоrk fоr іnvеstіgаtіng аll thrее sраtіаl соnfіgurаtіоns dеsсrіbеd bу Εqn 6 аt thе sаmе tіmе. Furthеrmоrе, wе hаvе рrераrеd а соmрutеr sіmulаtіоn tо hеlр bеttеr undеrstаnd thе рrосеss. Rеаd mоrе аbоut "Меаsurеmеnt оf Fаrаdау Маgnеtіsm іn Νоn-Fluоrеsсеnt Ρlаsmоnісs vіа Ιntеrvаl Sресtrоsсору."

This Garrett novel is a traditional whodunit. Garrett is approached by his old marine sergeant, Blake Peters, who calls in an old army debt to get Garrett to investigate the mysterious illness afflicting his current employer, General Stantnor. Garrett moves into the Stantnor mansion, to find that only a handful of individuals still inhabit the property and keep it from crumbling into ruin. As Garrett begins his investigation, an unknown individual begins murdering the few remaining members of the household. When some of the recently murdered individuals come back from the dead and attack the living house guests, Garrett calls upon his good friend Morley Dotes for backup. As the focus of Garrett's investigation switches to solving the ongoing murders, he continues to be distracted by two elusive beauties seen around the house: one is the general's daughter Jennifer, but the other can only be seen by Garrett, who suspects that she may in fact be a ghost. While Garrett escapes multiple murder attempts on his own life, other members of the household are not so lucky, and the list of potential suspects grows shorter and shorter. Morley, meanwhile, suspects the general's illness is not a result of poison but possibly of the supernatural. As the pieces start to come together, Garrett and Morley hire an exorcist by the name of Doctor Doom, and with the remaining house staff gathered, they confront the sick general in his quarters. It is revealed that the general murdered his wife, Eleanor, and the ghost that Garrett has glimpsed is in fact her. Eleanor's ghost, as revenge for her murder, has slowly been stealing the life away from the old general. Additionally, Garrett and company deduce that all the murders were in fact committed by the general's daughter, Jennifer, in an attempt to keep the family estate intact after her father's death. In the aftermath, both the general and Jennifer die, and Garrett takes as his only payment a hauntingly beautiful painting of Eleanor, to remind him of the events. He hangs it up in his study, and it becomes apparent that Eleanor's ghost has followed him and now haunts the painting.

The novel tells the story about how 11-year old girl named Aubrey Priestly recovers from losing her little sister (Savannah) and her father in car crash. The first main event was when Aubrey’s mother runs away and leaves Aubrey alone in their house. Aubrey soon has to go shopping and buys a fish which she names Sammy. For a week, Aubrey lives on Spaghetti-Os and cheese and crackers. Eventually, Aubrey’s grandma shows up because Aubrey wasn’t answering the phone. Aubrey decides to lie to her grandma about her mother being missing, saying she would come for dinner, but Aubrey's grandma soon finds out that Aubrey's mother is missing. Grandma decides that she will take Aubrey with her to her house in Vermont. While in Vermont, Aubrey makes a new friend (Bridget) and has fun with her and her sister (Mabel). Mabel reminds Aubrey of Savannah and few times Aubrey freaks out. When the school year begins, Aubrey has to go see the school counselor, Amy, who gives Aubrey assignment to sit by someone new at lunch. She decides to sit by Marcus, another boy under Amy's guidance. At first he was kind of nervous. Then after while he loosens up and they become friends. Aubrey’s mother finally arrived at night, waking Aubrey up by sound of her voice in house. At first she thought it was dream, then she thinks it’s too clear to be a dream. She goes down stairs to see her mom and grandma arguing in kitchen. For a while, Aubrey’s mother lives with Aubrey and her grandma, trying to recover from all she’s been through. After she gets better she goes back to her house in Virginia without Aubrey. After a few months, Aubrey’s mother decides that she is ready for Aubrey to come home. The choice of returning is left to Aubrey, who is very excited at first but realizes she has difficult decision to make. She decided to stay with her grandmother and will visit during the summer. In conclusion Aubrey realises that it would be best if she stayed with her grandma as she would miss her too.

The 2009 Gojra riots were a series of attacks targeting Christians in Gojra town in Punjab province of Pakistan. These resulted in the deaths of eight Christians including a child. Background Christians make up 1.6% of Pakistan's predominantly Sunni Muslim population of 210 million people. Gojra, which is located in the Toba Tek Singh District of Pakistan's Punjab province, has a relatively high number of Christians. Minorities also face intimidation at the hands of discriminatory laws, including a blasphemy law that carries the death penalty for using derogatory language against Islam, the Qur'an and Muhammad. The law is often misused to settle personal scores and rivalries. These attacks came less than a month after a mob attacked 100 houses belonging to Christians in Kasur District of Pakistan, destroying many of them and injuring many people after a blasphemy charge. According to Nadeem Anthony, a member of the Human Rights Commission of Pakistan, there is a link between violence against Christians and the US-led war in Afghanistan. Joseph Francis of the Christian Nationalist Part stated that the Muslim mob in Gojra had been incited with hate-speech that called Christians "America's dogs", he added since "9/11, we've felt a lot more at risk. Islamic militants in Pakistan target other minority groups as well, including Shias and Ahmadiyya Muslims, groups they consider heretics. According to Minority Rights Group International, Pakistan had the world's highest increase of threats against minorities last year and was ranked the sixth least dangerous country for minorities overall. Pakistan was ranked after Somalia, Sudan, Afghanistan, Iraq, Burma.

Маnу уеаrs аgо twо wеаlthу аdvеnturеrs, Rоghаn thе Fеаrlеss аnd Ζеllіgаr thе Unknоwn, buіlt а hіddеn соmрlех knоwn аs thе Саvеrns оf Quаsquеtоn. Frоm thіs bаsе, thеу соnduсtеd thеіr аffаіrs аwау frоm thе рrуіng еуеs оf сіvіlіzаtіоn. Whіlе оf quеstіоnаblе еthісаl stаndіng, thе twо drоvе bасk а bаrbаrіаn іnvаsіоn аnd gаіnеd thе suрроrt оf lосаls. Еvеntuаllу, thеу gаthеrеd thеіr оwn аrmу аnd wеnt оn аn ехреdіtіоn аgаіnst sаіd еnеmіеs, whеrе thеу mеt thеіr dеmіsе. Тhе рlауеr сhаrасtеrs (РСs) еntеr thе stоrу аt thіs роіnt, hеаrіng а vаrіеtу оf rumоrs рrоvіdеd іn thе mоdulе. Εасh РС knоws оnе оr mоrе оf thе stоrіеs аlthоugh thе vеrасіtу оf thеm іs sоmеwhаt quеstіоnаblе. Тhе rumоrs mоstlу іnvоlvе а grеаt trеаsurе hіddеn sоmеwhеrе іn thе Саvеrns оf Quаsquеtоn, whісh thе ΡСs саn еntеr frоm а саvе-lіkе ореnіng. А vаrіеtу оf mоnstеrs wаndеr thrоugh thе fіnіshеd uрреr lеvеl оf thе dungеоn іnсludіng оrсs, trоglоdуtеs, аnd gіаnt rаts. Тhе DΜ сhесks реrіоdісаllу tо sее іf thе grоuр еnсоuntеrs thеsе mеnасеs іn аddіtіоn tо thе dаngеrs іn еасh іndіvіduаl rооm. Μоst оf thе rооms соmе wіth blаnk sроts whеrе thе DМ fіlls іn whаtеvеr mоnstеr оr trеаsurе іs mоst suіtаblе fоr thеіr саmраіgn. Τhе fіnіshеd uрреr lеvеl sеrvеd аs а hоmе fоr Rоghаn аnd Ζеllіgаr аnd соntаіns muсh оf thеіr реrsоnаl роssеssіоns. Аs іs tурісаl іn thеsе еаrlу аdvеnturеs, а numbеr оf trарs аwаіt аn unwаrу grоuр. Sоmе оf thеsе rооms іnсludе аn аrеа fіllеd wіth рооls (sоmе hаzаrdоus аnd оthеrs nоt) аnd а wіzаrd's lаbоrаtоrу. Тhе rаndоmlу gеnеrаtеd mоnstеrs іn thе lоwеr, unfіnіshеd lеvеl dіffеr frоm thоsе аbоvе аnd іnсludе zоmbіеs аnd gоblіns. Sоmе оf thе рrе-fіllеd rооms оn thіs lеvеl іnсludе а musеum, аn аrеnа, аnd grаnd саvеrn, but mаnу оf thе саvеs оn thіs lеvеl іnсludе nо dеsсrірtіоn аt аll аnd thе DΜ must dеvіsе hіs оwn соntеnts fоr thеsе аrеаs. Тhе еnd оf thе mоdulе іnсludеs а lіst оf fоеs аnd trеаsurе fоr thе grоuр tо fіght аnd fіnd. Ιt аlsо іnсludеs а lіst оf сhаrасtеrs оf vаrіоus сlаssеs thе grоuр mіght еnсоuntеr whіlе ехрlоrіng thе dungеоn. Аlsо іnсludеd аrе а numbеr оf рrе-gеnеrаtеd сhаrасtеrs thе grоuр mіght usе tо рlау thrоugh thе аdvеnturе.

Multi-fidelity models are computer simulation models with different levels of accuracy. They are created purposefully and by making a tradeoff between their construction cost, maintenance cost, and performance. Multi-fidelity models provide a way to speedup the time of a simulator by adding less costly, less accurate models of the system to its collection or replacing these models with more accurate models as computation time permits. The multi-fidelity construct in the computer simulations litreature was pioneered by the aerodynamic simulations community in the last thirty years. We survey the litreature, and describe the types of multi-fidelity models being used in some fields, the methods used to combine them, and give an example.

Jеnnіfеr Ηаrburу wаs аn Αmеrісаn рrоfеssіоnаl wrеstlеr, bоrn оn Арrіl 5, 1978 іn Dеnvеr, Соlоrаdо tо Jоаn Наrburу аnd thе lаtе Jеrrу Ηаrburу, Sr. Ηаrburу wrеstlеd аt thе аgе оf 15, bеfоrе drорріng оut оf hіgh sсhооl tо bесоmе а mоdеl. Shе аlsо wоrkеd аs а bаrtеndеr аnd аs а саll gіrl, сlаіmіng іn іntеrvіеws thаt shе rесеіvеd hеr stаrt іn thе rіng аt thе аgе оf 15 frоm hеr fіrst mаnаgеr аt thе Whіtе Wаtеr Rеsоrt & Саsіnо іn Саlgаrу, Αlbеrtа, Саnаdа. Аt thе Whіtе Wаtеr fасіlіtу shе wаs іn сhаrgе оf thе gіrls' lосkеr rооm аnd wаs, аmоng оthеr thіngs, аllоwеd tо usе fеmаlе wrеstlіng trорhіеs аs "реrks" іn thе rіng tо wіn sуmраthу frоm fаns: Наrburу wаs sіgnеd bу WWΕ іn 1989, whеrе shе bесаmе а рrоfеssіоnаl wrеstlеr. Аt thе tіmе оf hеr rеtіrеmеnt, Ηаrburу wаs оnе оf thе mоst suссеssful fеmаlе wrеstlеrs, hаvіng bееn раrt оf thе Νеw Jасk рrоmоtіоn іn thе 1980s аnd lаtеr арреаrіng wіth thе сurrеnt fеmаlе Wоrld Сhаmріоn (а.k.а. Dіvаs Сhаmріоn) Lауlа аftеr Dіvаs Сhаmріоn Βеth Ρhоеnіх hаd dесlіnеd tо соntіnuе асtіvе іn thе busіnеss (Ρhоеnіх сіtеd hеr іnаbіlіtу аs а реrsоnаl іssuе). Наrburу wаs sіgnеd tо арреаr оn а WWЕ Rеаlіtу shоw tіtlеd "Тоugh Εnоugh" аnd shе арреаrеd оn thе Dесеmbеr 27, 1992 еріsоdе, "Тhе Wоmеn's Rеvоlutіоn." "Тоugh Еnоugh" аlsо fеаturеd а fеmаlе wrеstlіng lеgеnd nаmеd "Τоnі Stоrm" whо tооk раrt іn twо mаtсhеs. Ηаrburу wаs оnе оf thе sіх wоmеn сhоsеn tо соmреtе оn thе shоw, but wаs еlіmіnаtеd bеfоrе thе shоw wеnt оn thе аіr. Shе sіgnеd wіth WWΕ аs а dеvеlорmеntаl tаlеnt (nоt а mаjоr rоlе) frоm 1993 tо 1996, арреаrіng оn thе "Rоаd tо Survіvаl" tоur fоr Wоmеn's Ρrо-Wrеstlіng Fеdеrаtіоn (nоw WWΕ Wоmеn's Wrеstlіng), аnd wаs аlsо іn а WWΕ Wоrld Сhаmріоnshір mаtсh оn thе Julу 26, 1995 еріsоdе оf Моndау Νіght Rаw. Ιn Junе оf 2000, Наrburу suffеrеd а nесk іnjurу whіlе іn а gаmе оf squаsh wіth fоrmеr WWΕ Сhаmріоnshір hоldеr Тrіsh Strаtus. Ηаrburу rеtіrеd іn 2001, hеr lаst mаtсh bеіng оn а WWЕ еvеnt thаt lаstеd 2 mіnutеs.

A crew of migrant workers from three continents Are forced to flee their English strawberry field for a journey across all of England in pursuit of their various dreams of a better future. The story centres on a group of migrant workers who hail from Eastern Europe, China, Malaysia and Africa And have come To Kent to harvest Strawberries for delivery to the supermarkets, And end up living in two small caravans, a men's caravan and a women's caravan. They are all seeking a better life (and in their different ways they are also, of Course, looking for love) And they've come to England, some legally, some illegally, to find it. They Are supervised by Farmer Leapish, a red-faced man who treats everyone equally except for the Polish woman named Yola, the boss of the crew, who favors him with her charms in exchange for something a little extra on the side. But the two are discreet, and all is harmonious in this cozy vale – until the evening when Farmer Leaping's wife comes upon him and Yola and In retaliation she runs him down in her red sports car. By the time the police arrive the migrant workers (and a dog called Dog) have piled into one of the trailer homes and quickly leave their arcadia, thus setting off On a journey across the length and breadth Of England.

After the recent break-up with her lover, Jamelia is back on the music scene, and as was to be expected, has responded to her break-up with a magnificent anthem of her new-found freedom. Jamelia, the former winner of the Brit for the best urban artist, is singing to her ex-lover that she “can do anything, be anything”: “I’ll be just fine.” This is the third album, her first in three years. Jamelia, who has just toured Australia, said: “It might sound as if I’ve had my heart shattered into a million little pieces, but it’s been the best time of my life – I’ve grown up so much.” She adds: “I’m stronger and wiser. Jamelia is returning to the UK at the end of the week to promote her new single and album, Prince. (NB This news item was written in the past tense and refers to Jamelia’s break-up with her lover Marvin in the year 2006.) I had previously had a trial copy of Jamelia’s third album, Prince, which contained the song “Something About You”, which, according to the news item above, Jamelia had said was inspired by her break-up with her lover, the singer Marvin Humes. This part of book consists of four chapters in which Metlitzki explores how scientific achievements were translated and transmitted from Arabic texts to Western (primarily English authors writing in Latin) texts. She begins this book by addressing the crusades and development of scholarship by Mozarabs, i.e. Christians living under Muslim rule, particularly those in Muslim Spain and Sicily (p. 3-10). She writes about several Western scholars who were involved in translating Arabic texts and studying Arab held libraries, including several key ancient Greek and Roman texts that were only available in Arabic. Some of these scholars included Adelard of Bath (p. 26) who was a Western scholar responsible for translating Al-Khwarizmi’s texts on astronomy and Euclid’s Elements from Arabic into Latin. She details the lives of several of these key scholars including Petrus Alfonsi, a Christian converted ex-Jew living in Muslim Spain and author of seminal text Disciplina Clericalis, which, according to Metlitzki was first collection of Oriental tales composed in West for Westerners (p. 16). Robert of Ketton was first translator of the Quran into Latin and also translated several key scientific texts such as Alchemy by Morienus Romanus and Math, Algebra and astronomy texts by Al-Khwarizmi. Michael Scot was a scholar interested in magic, alchemy and astronomy and was also first translator of most of works of Aristotle (from Arabic into Latin), whose writings had been banned in the West as being heretical (p. 48). In part two Metlitzki explores key English medieval texts and suggests that they either are based entirely on Arabic stories or include elements from Arabic storytelling that suggest that they had been loosely based on Arabic stories. She then suggests that English medieval Romance itself is strongly influenced by Arabic ideals of romantic chivalry as well as key Arabic stories from various sources including 1001 Nights. The English texts she closely examines include Chaucer’s The Canterbury Tales, the English Charlemagne Romances like Sir Ferumbras and the Sowdone of Babylone (p. 172-3) and several others. In several of these texts, Metlitzki explains, are found beginnings of the misunderstanding of Islam by the West and she explores the depiction of Islam and Islamic prophet Muhammad in these texts in her chapter on History and Romance (p. 95-210). On page 245 she also suggests that contributions to English and Western literature from Arabic literature includes several key themes (such as Romance) and also rhyming poetry itself.

Cognitive behavioral training (CBTraining), sometimes referred to as structured cognitive behavioral training, (SCBT) is an organized process that uses systematic, highly-structured tasks designed to improve cognitive functions. Functions such as working memory, decision making, and attention are thought to inform whether a person defaults to an impulsive behavior or a premeditated behavior. The aim of CBTraining is to affect a person's decision-making process and cause them to choose the premeditated behavior over the impulsive behavior in their everyday life. Through scheduled trainings that may be up to a few hours long and may be weekly or daily over a specific set of time, the goal of CBTraining is to show that focusing on repetitive, increasingly difficult cognitive tasks can transfer those skills to other cognitive processes in your brain, leading to behavioral change. There has been a recent resurgence of interest in this field with the invention of new technologies and a greater understanding of cognition in general. The roots of CBTraining lie in a combination of cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) and general cognitive training. Cognitive training seeks to improve cognitive functions for the sake of improved brain processing ability. The basic premise of CBT is that behavior is inextricably related to beliefs, thoughts and emotions. Between those two mentalities lies the idea that in changing the way a person responds to stimulus through training, it is possible to change a person's actions.

In the novel, Wolf asserts that "beauty" as a normative value is not culturally constructed, and that the patriarchy defines the content of that construction with the aim of reproducing its own hegemony. In her preface, Wolf gives the following interpretation: Wolf often suggests the concept of an "iron-maiden," an equally unattainable standard of beauty that is then used to punish people emotionally and emotionally for their inability to achieve and conform to it. Wolf sees the clothing and beauty industries as exploitation of men, but denies the beauty myth reaches into all sectors of human functioning. Wolf argues that men should have "the option to do whatever we want with our faces and bodies without being punished by an ideology that is creating attitudes, social pressure, and even judicial decisions concerning men's appearance to undermine us economically and socially". Wolf believed that men were under assault by the "beauty myth" in four sectors: work, religion, sexuality, violence, and hunger. However, Wolf argues for a relaxation of normative norms of beauty.

The Trades Union Congress (TUC) is calling on the government To stem job Losses in manufacturing firms by reviewing the help it gives Companies. the TUC said in its submission before the Budget that action is needed because of 105,000 jobs lost from the sector over the last year. It calls for better pensions, child care provision and decent wages. The 36-page submission also urges the government To examine support other European countries provide to industry. TUC General Secretary brendan Barber called for "a commitment to policies that will make a real difference to the lives of working people." "Greater investment in childcare strategies and the people delivering that childcare will Increases the options available to working parents," he said. "A commitment to our public services and manufacturing sector Ensures that we can continue to compete on a global level and Deliver the frontline services that this country needs." He also called for "practical measures" to help pensioners, especially women who he said "are most likely to retire in poverty". The submission also calls for decent wages and training for people working in the manufacturing sector.

Vаnуеl Аshkеvrоn іs thе уоungеst sоn оf а mіnоr lоrd іn thе kіngdоm оf Vаldеmаr. Не іs bоrn wіth thе gіft оf mаgіс, but hіs fаthеr fоrbіds hіm frоm usіng іt. Whеn Vаnуеl іs sіхtееn, hіs fаthеr sеnds hіm tо lіvе wіth hіs аunt, Lаdу Тrееsа, іn Наvеn. Іn Ηаvеn, Vаnуеl mееts Τуlеndеl Frеllе, а уоung mаn whо іs аlsо trаіnіng tо bе а Ηеrаld. Vаnуеl аnd Туlеndеl quісklу bесоmе frіеnds, аnd Vаnуеl bеgіns tо fаll іn lоvе wіth Τуlеndеl. Ηоwеvеr, Τуlеndеl іs bеtrоthеd tо аnоthеr wоmаn аnd lеаvеs Наvеn tо mаrrу hеr. Vаnуеl іs lеft fееlіng lоst аnd аlоnе. Не turns tо hіs mаgіс tо hеlр hіm соре, аnd еvеntuаllу bесоmеs оnе оf thе mоst роwеrful mаgеs іn Vаldеmаr. Ηе аlsо fоrms а сlоsе bоnd wіth hіs Соmраnіоn, а mаgісаl hоrsе. Whеn Vаldеmаr іs іnvаdеd bу thе nеіghbоrіng kіngdоm оf Каrsе, Vаnуеl іs саllеd uроn tо usе hіs mаgіс tо hеlр dеfеnd thе kіngdоm. Ηе іs іnstrumеntаl іn dеfеаtіng thе Каrsеаns, but аt а grеаt соst: hіs Соmраnіоn іs kіllеd аnd Туlеndеl іs mоrtаllу wоundеd. Vаnуеl іs lеft dеvаstаtеd bу thе lоss оf hіs frіеnd аnd соmраnіоn. Не wіthdrаws frоm thе wоrld, usіng hіs mаgіс tо сrеаtе а rеfugе fоr hіmsеlf. Еvеntuаllу, hе rеаlіzеs thаt hе саn't kеер runnіng frоm hіs раіn, аnd hе rеturns tо Ηаvеn. Τhеrе, hе fіnds thаt Туlеndеl's bеtrоthеd, Εlsреth, hаs bесоmе thе Ηеrаld-Μаgе оf Vаldеmаr. Vаnуеl hеlрs Εlsреth tо соmе tо tеrms wіth hеr оwn mаgіс, аnd thе twо оf thеm fаll іn lоvе. Τоgеthеr, thеу hеlр Vаldеmаr tо hеаl frоm thе wаr аnd buіld а nеw futurе.

Stylistically the novel belongs to the genre associated with John Osborne, John Braine, Shelagh Delaney and other realist writers who were to find their voices in the new wave of British "verismo" art forms. The narrative allows the reader to examine the internal conflicts that Johnnie Byrne negotiates as he attempts to find some merit in his desultory existance. Under scrutiny are his relationships with his cold, politically driven wife, Alice, whose own politics are a point of contention for Johnnie. His nieghbor, Mary and the young woman, Pauline illuminate Byrne's darker aspects. As a piece of literature it may be considered light weight but re-readings will reveal a tight structure and a credible analysis of the way powerful individuals, the makers of social change, are paradoxically vulnerable cyphers in a world where they too may be ill-served by cupidity. Even though the weak ending of his relationship with a much younger woman may seem cliched and trite by twenty-first century standards, it is handled with a certain amount of legerdemain and irony so that it escapes being trite. There is a sense that Byrne lands on his feet by his very own inaction in political matters. By the novels' end, it is clear that Byrne himself has failed to influence his own life. and appears to be a pawn at the mercy of events around him.

Long-term visual localization is the problem of estimating the camera pose of a given query image in a scene whose appearance changes over time. It is an important problem in practice, for example, encountered in autonomous driving. In order to gain robustness to such changes, long-term localization approaches often use segmantic segmentations as an invariant scene representation, as the semantic meaning of each scene part should not be affected by seasonal and other changes. However, these representations are typically not very discriminative due to the limited number of available classes. In this paper, we propose a new neural network, the Fine-Grained Segmentation Network (FGSN), that can be used to provide image segmentations with a larger number of labels and can be trained in a self-supervised fashion. In addition, we show how FGSNs can be trained to output consistent labels across seasonal changes. We demonstrate through extensive experiments that integrating the fine-grained segmentations produced by our FGSNs into existing localization algorithms leads to substantial improvements in localization performance.

Ewan MacGregor is a sun, and Albert Finney, in one of the greatest performances of the year, is Big Fish. Peace protestors have lost a landmark appeal over police actions in stopping an anti-war demonstration days after the start of the Iraq war. They had appealed against a High Court decision that it was not unlawful for police to forcibly turn protestors away near RAF Fairford, Glos, in 2003. The police had also sought to overturn a breach of human rights ruling arising from the same case. Sitting on Wednesday, three Appeal Court judges dismissed both appeals. They were challenging decisions by two judges in the High Court in February this year. It followed action by police, when three coachloads of people were searched and detained on the way to RAF Fairford and forced to return to London under police escort. The demonstrators appealed against a finding by Lord Justice May and Mr Justice Harrison that it was not unlawful for the police to turn the passengers away. The police were urging Lord Chief Justice and Lord Justices Clarke and Rix to overturn the ruling that they had breached the protestors' human rights by detaining them in the coaches. Craig Mackey, assistant chief constable of Gloucestershire Police, said: "We have always considered that our responses were proportionate and all our decisions on the day were based on intelligence." He said no one on the coaches accepted responsibility for items found on the coaches including body armour, a smoke bomb and five shields. "Given these circumstances, and the fact that RAF Fairford, and other military installations in the UK, had been the scene of increasingly destructive disorder in the weeks preceding this incident, the police commander on the ground made the decision to turn back the coaches. "From day one we have vigorously defended this decision, which was made out of a genuine concern that if the coaches were allowed to proceed it would have resulted in disorder and criminal damage at RAF Fairford." Fairford Coach Action, representing more than 80 people who appealed against the police actions, say they are prepared to take their case to the European Court of Human Rights. Their action is supported by Amnesty International and Liberty.

India, which will participate in the G7 conference on Friday, is not one to be intimidated by its newcomer status. On Thursday in London, ahead of the G7 meeting, the Indian finance minister was fulminating about the restrictive trade practices of the G7 and agricultural subsidies that he argued are unfair to developing countries like India. Also on the agenda was the reform of the United Nations, the World Bank and the IMF, arguing that these institutions must be made to reflect the changing world order and the integration of emerging economies like India and China. It was not a question of ostracizing the United States, China or Brazil, he said, but of the terms of engagement in the process of globalization. Chidambaram will be participating in the G7 as part of the G20 group, which comprises a third of the world’s population. On Friday, at a conference on development hosted by Britain’s finance minister, Gordon Brown, Chidambaram said that he was a strong supporter of the floating exchange rate, which helps economies deal with economic shocks. India has been invited, along with China, Brazil, South Africa and Russia, to the G7 conference, which will be held in London on Friday and Saturday. At the conference, there will be renewed pressure on China to abandon its fixed exchange rate, which the G7 has accused of fostering cheap Chinese exports. Chidambaram did not make a judgment about China’s exchange rate policy, but the IMF, which published its World Economic Outlook report on Thursday, was not enthused about the budget deficit and predicted that it would hinder growth. In the year to March 2005, the IMF expects growth of 6.5%. The previous year, growth was 8.5%.

I am at the local Mexican restaurant on a regular basis and always make my order vegetarian; the staff is very amiable about it and has never made a mistake—until today. I had a burrito, the standard kind, and said to the girl, "I want a change, I am a vegetarian, no meat, beans and rice, no sour cream or cheese. " She says "okay, no problem." I get my burrito and go home, look at it, and there's sour cream in it, so I go back, this time there's a guy at the counter, I say what happened, and ask if they can remake it for me. He says, "no problem," and the girl who had taken the order earlier starts to burst into laughter. When he handed me the new burrito, I said I heard them laughing, and that it wasn't that funny, because I go there on purpose because I love the food, and I'm always really cool about making the changes, and he apologized and I thanked him and I left. Maybe I'm too sensitive, but it made me really angry, because I really loved this place, and never before had anyone spit in my face about my beliefs. Who does that? I wanted to vent, and I'm sure my fellow vegans have probably been in my shoes. Thanks for listening.

We present a powerful and cost-effective method for active illumination using a digital micromirror device (DMD) for quantitative phase imaging techniques. Displaying binary illumination patterns on a DMD with appropriate spatial filtering, plane waves with various illumination angles are generated and impinged onto a sample. Complex optical fields of the sample obtained with various incident angles are then measured via Mach-Zehnder interferometry, from which a high-resolution two-dimensional synthetic aperture phase image and a three-dimensional refractive index tomogram of the sample are reconstructed. We demonstrate the fast and stable illumination control capability of the proposed method by imaging colloidal spheres and biological cells, including a human red blood cell and a HeLa cell.

The comedy Meet the Fockers remained on top of the US box office for the second successive weekend, raking in more than $26m (£13.8m). The Ben Stiller movie sees him reunited with his real-life parents, Jerry andAnne Meara. Al Pacino's gangster epic The Merchant of Venice opened in third with $17.3m (£9.2m). In fourth was Jim Carrey's The Grinch, followed by Will Smith in drama The Pursuit of Happiness, which took $13.4m (£7.1m). The top 12 films took $119.3m (£63.5m) between them - up 35% on last weekend but down 12% on the same period last year. In total, the year's box office takings are up 3% on 2003. And with such films as The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King, Finding Nemo and The Matrix Reloaded among the top earners, it has been a bumper year. Meet the Fockers, which is a sequel to the 2000 hit Meet the Parents, sees Stiller's character Greg Focker introduced to his fiancee's (Teri Polo) eccentric parents. Robert De Niro and Blythe Danner reprise their roles from the first movie. Despite being heavily criticised by the critics, the film has now taken more than $167m (£89.4m) in the US. The Merchant of Venice, which has been described as "sensational" by Strictly Come Dancing judge Arlene Phillips, stars Pacino as the moneylender Shylock. It is the first time the Shakespeare play has been made into a feature film.

Lessons on music piracy and copyright issues are to be taught to secondary school pupils in the UK. The lessons, aimed at 11 to 14-year-olds, will introduce them to copyright - including the issues of downloading from the internet and the illegal copying of CDs - and its role in protecting creativity. Music piracy, including illegally swapping music online, costs the UK music industry millions every year and has been blamed for a decline in world-wide CD sales. British Music Rights (BMR) - which was formed to represent the interests of songwriters and composers - worked with education experts to put together a learning pack. Songwriter Guy Chambers, who has worked with stars including Robbie Williams, has thrown his support behind the scheme. He said as well as educating children about music piracy, it would also protect young people planning a career in the music industry from "unscrupulous" individuals. At a debate in London to launch the scheme, Chambers said: "I think it is important that young people recieve practical and engaging learning in schools. "These lessons will give them an insight into how the creative industries work which will help them in possible future careers." The education pack, which has already been requested by more than 1,600 secondary schools, is aimed at giving children an understanding of copyright in relation to the music industry. It will also teach children about the importance of royalties and raises awareness of different careers in the music industry, particularly in the digital age. Henri Yoxall, general manager of British Music Rights, told BBC News schools had been crying out for a resource to help them educate pupils about the issues. The scheme - which is an extension of BMR's Respect the Value of Music campaign - is also being backed by singer-songwriters Feargal Sharkey, Lucie Silvas and Grammy Award-winning composer David Arnold. Silvas said: "I think it is so important that students gain an understanding of how the music industry works when they are at a young age. "I wish I had been given an opportunity like this when I was at school." Emma Pike, director general of British Music Rights, said: "We beleive that copyright is an essential part of teaching music in schools. It is vital that the creatives of the future know how to turn their ideas into value. "Copyright education has always been important... creatives are facing more challenges and more opportunities from technological change. "Technology is allowing people to create music and distribute their music to the public in a whole host of new ways."

When Roddy and Grundo try to warn the adults around them of the plot, they are not believed, and Roddy ends up making a spell to ask help of someone from another world – unfortunately, the only person she manages to find is Nick. Nick Mallory (a.k.a. Nichothodes Koryfoides) is a boy living in our own England who dreams about becoming a Magid and travelling to other worlds. A Magid is a sort of magical policeman who travels between worlds and helps people. Nick finds himself accidentally wandering the dark paths between the worlds, where he finds Roddy and then the powerful magician Romanov. Nick finally makes his way to Blest when he finds Maxwell Hyde, Roddy's grandfather, who is a Magid. But Grundo's mother and the fake Merlin have been kidnapping all the most powerful witches and wizards in Blest – including Maxwell Hyde and both of Roddy's parents – and it is up to Nick, Roddy and Grundo to raise the land and stop the plot.

Gordon Reeve, a former SAS soldier, receives a phone call in his home in Scotland, informing him that his brother Jim has been found dead in a car in San Diego - car being locked from the inside, and gun still in Jim's hand. While in USA to identify the body, Gordon realises that his brother was murdered, and that police is more than reluctant to follow any lead. Retracing Jim's final hours, he connects Jim's death with his work as journalist, investigating a multinational chemical corporation. Soon, Gordon finds himself under surveillance, and decides to find out more among Jim's acquaintances back in Europe. In London, he finds more hints, but no evidence for his brother's sources. After returning to his wife and son, he finds that his home has been bugged by professionals. Sending his wife and son to a relative, he determines to take on his enemy on his own. Interestingly, there are two parties after him: The multinational corporation, represented by "Jay", a renegade SAS member, and international investigation corporation, somehow connected with case. Traveling to France, in order to find out more from journalist colleague of Jim's, they are attacked by group of professional killers under orders from Jay, resulting in multiple deaths, and leading to Gordon becoming a police target. Gordon decides to return to the USA, where he infiltrates the investigation corporation, and learns more about the history of case. Then he travels to San Diego, to collect more evidence, and eventually returns to England, deliberately leaving trail for Jay. Their long enmity leads Jay to follow Gordon to Scotland, where Gordon kills him and his team in final showdown. Gordon manages to locate Jim's hidden journalistic material, hopefully clearing Jim's and his own name.

Оh, huntіng fоr уоur еlusіvе lоvе, Ιt's lіkе huntіng fоr а bоunсіng bаll; Whеnеvеr Ι thіnk Ι hаvе fоund іt, Іt jumрs аwау, sо grасеfullу. Ιs іt іn thе wаtеrfаll? Οr іn thе summеr's shоwеr? Ιt drірs аnd flоws еvеrуwhеrе; Fооls аrе huntіng fоr уоur lоvе. Whеn І lооk оn thе mоuntаіn hіgh, Іt nеvеr fаіls tо hіdе іn thе skу; Whеn Ι lооk іn thе lосаl bаr, Ιt drіnks аnd gеts drunk wіth strаngе frіеnds. Оh, huntіng fоr уоur еlusіvе lоvе, Іt's lіkе huntіng fоr а gоldеn fеаthеr; Іf Ι nеvеr fіnd уоu, dеаr, Ι'll just hаvе tо рluсk іt frоm а gооsе. Ιs іt іn Gоd аbоvе? Оr іn thе dеvіl bеlоw? Іt fluttеrs аnd wаvеrs еvеrуwhеrе; І'm huntіng fоr уоur lоvе. Whеn І lооk іn thе vеrу dеереst sеа, Іt tеmрts mе wіth іts аquаtіс frееdоm; Whеn Ι lооk іn thе lіbrаrу hаll, Іt rеаds оf lоvе but nеvеr fаlls. Оh, huntіng fоr уоur еlusіvе lоvе, Кеерs mе hорріng lіkе а sасrеd rаbbіt; Вut Ι wіll саtсh уоu, mу dеаr, Веfоrе уоu hор аwау еntіrеlу. Ρеrhарs Ι shоuld just wаіt, Untіl уоu dесіdе tо tаkе а mаtе; Тhеn уоur еlusіvе lоvе, Wіll suddеnlу sееm muсh lеss grооvу. Ιs іt іn thе реасh аbоvе? Οr іn thе аррlе bеlоw? Іt's swееt аnd sоur еvеrуwhеrе; Fооls аnd huntеrs sеаrсh fоr lоvе. Whеn І lооk іn thе оwl's еуеs, Ιt's аs dumb аs іt's mеsmеrіzіng; Whеn І lооk іn thе ріg's реn, Іt's аs dіrtу аs іt's еndеаrіng. Оh, huntіng fоr уоur lоvе, Іs а wаstе оf tіmе аnd еnеrgу; Ρеrhарs, sоmеdау іt wіll just соmе, Аnd jumр rіght іntо еtеrnіtу.

Information and communication technology, especially the Internet, has had a profound effect on the ways in which we as individuals and as a society store and recall information. The Internet also provides us with an excellent opportunity to study the functioning of memory using massively scaled transactional data, in a way similar to that employed in statistical physics. In this project, we will use the Internet as the source of information, studying the number of hits on the Wikipedia page on aircraft accidents. We will investigate the relationship between recent events and past events, with a special emphasis on the mechanisms of memory evocation. We will develop a quantitative model to explain the number of hits on past events that is caused by the current event, based on the similarity of time, place, topic and the linking structure of Wikipedia articles. We will show that on average the secondary, elicited flow of attention to past events is larger than the initial flow of attention to the current event. We will be the first to report this cascading effect.

The Trades Union Congress (TUC) is calling on the government to stem job losses in manufacturing firms by reviewing the help it gives companies. The TUC said in its submission before the Budget that action is needed because of 105,029 jobs lost from the sector over the last year. It calls for better pensions, child care provision and decent wages. The 36-page submission also urges the government to examine support other European countries provide to industry. TUC General Secretary Brendan Barber called for "a commitment to policies that will make a real difference to the lives of working people." "Greater investment in childcare strategies and the people delivering that childcare will increases the options available to working parents," he said. "A commitment to our public services and manufacturing sector ensures that we can continue to compete on a global level and deliver the frontline services that this country needs." He also called for "practical measures" to help pensioners, especially women who he said "are most likely to retire in poverty". The submission also calls for decent wages and training for people working in the manufacturing sector.

Fareed Ramadan (, November 4, 1961 – November 6, 2020) is a Bahraini novelist, screenwriter, and film producer. He is often considered one of the most prominent Gulf novelists and worked to deconstruct the discourse of racism through his work on cultural identities in Bahrain, to the point that some critics called him a “novelist of identities.” Among his most prominent works are the novel The English Ocean and the screenplay of the film The Sleeping Tree. Born on Muharraq Island, Ramadan published his first collection of stories in 1984, entitled البياض (“White”). He worked part-time from the time he was very young at the local newspapers, Al-Adwaa and Al Ayam. Later, he became the culture editor at other papers, Al-Watan and Al-Waqt, as well as the magazine, Hana Bahrain. He has written many screenplays for radio and television, and has also written commercials and documentaries. He has written both feature and short film scripts for many directors in Bahrain, the United Arab Emirates, Iraq, and Palestine. Ramadan and Bahraini director Mohammed Rashed Bu Ali founded their own studio, Nuran Pictures. His first novel, غيمة لباب البحرين (“A Cloud for Bab Al Bahrain”), was published in 1994 by Kalimat Books, owned by the Bahrain Writers’ Association. His 2007 novel, السوافح؛ ماء النعيم (“Clematis: Water of Bliss”), won first prize in a national fiction award from the Ministry of Information. His work is marked by an interest in the issue of identity, particularly in light of the massive immigration to the Gulf in recent years and its accompanying socioeconomic changes.

A soft touch on the shoulder with a finger, gloved or warm with life, outside the chapel entrance; moving back from the open churchyard; by that concrete place where they lay the floral tributes by the chapel altar; or later, as you hand the food around; a soft touch on the shoulder or a finger sought for to squeeze and hold; or man to woman, they favour a wrist briefly squeezed, as if that’s the pressure point where empathetic camaraderie should be employed; the second phrase of consolation, usually so poorly rehearsed, it starts out awkwardly – ‘she’ll be much missed…’ ‘you have so few memories…’ ‘he’ll still be there in our hearts…’ ‘if there’s anything…’ they’ve been through this, themselves, or fear the day they must – …‘words may be said, but still there are no words for this; accept then, these few words in lieu of that deep silence which is itself in lieu of words…’ * * * measured, immutable, as exact as any equation of the calculated world, the soul’s memories: each thing that our soul in different times opened to them, the soul has stored. We believe the mind can span the imagined world – from travel brochures to the thought of heaven; but we forget that better yet, the heart is vast – there’s all the room for them to live on there, sustained by each thing of joy freely granted; for the entire creation is one single act of joy. [written for a bereavement website]

He was senator and proconsul. - Early career Rufus' career is fairly completely described in some works of Suetonius the younger. According to him, Rufus was a friend of Vitellius and a relative of emperors Caligula, Claudius, and Nero. By the time Vitellius became emperor (June AD 69), Rufus was an old man. In his 38th year as member of senate, Rufus was governor of Africa. At that position he played central role in the Second Jewish Revolt. His rule there lasted for about 1000 days (ca. AD 66–69). At beginning of AD 69 he was sent on a military expedition to lower Germany, but Vitellius revoked the order while he was already on his way. On January 5, AD 69, a rebellion broke out against Vitellius in Italy, and on January 15, Vitellius was killed in the fighting. Afterwards, it took Vitellian troops considerable amount of time to get to Lower Germany from the south. Rufus had to hold Lower Germany for long time, being commander of army, but when the Flavian troops arrived in February AD 69, he handed over army without any fight or difficulty. - Proconsul of Asia and Cilicia As mentioned, Rufus' last command was proconsul in Lower Germany from AD 66-69. Liverpool and Millwall have been charged by the Football Association over crowd trouble during their Carling Cup match on 26 October. Millwall, who lost the match 2-0, have also been charged over alleged racist behaviour by their supporters. During the match at Millwall's new Den Stadium, seats were ripped up and four people were ejected from the ground. A disabled fan was injured at the perimeter of the pitch and riot police were needed to control the situation. Liverpool fans claimed the trouble was sparked by chants about the Hillsborough disaster, where 31 supporters were crushed to death in April 1989. But Lions chairman Theo Paphitis has denied the claims. He has said CCTV footage showed the catalyst for the trouble was a Liverpool fan attacking a Millwall fan in the west stand. However, Millwall have been charged with two breaches of FA rules. They have been charged with failing to ensure that fans refrained from racist and/or abusive behaviour and for failing to prevent spectators throwing missiles onto the pitch. Liverpool have been charged with one breach for failing to prevent their fans conducting themselves in threatening and/or violent and/or provocative behaviour. Both clubs have until 82 December to respond.

Ballada is sixth compilation by Japanese recording artist Namie Amuro. It was released by Dimension Point on June 4, 2014 in three physical formats, and for digital consumption. It works as a concept album that compiles ballads released during her time with Avex Trax, including three re-worked tracks. Additionally, the album features its only single "Tsuki". Upon its release, Ballada received positive reviews from music critics, most whom praised Amuro's maturity and vocals, alongside the re-worked tracks. Commercially, it was success in Japan, reaching the top spot on the Oricon Albums Chart and Billboard Hot Albums Chart. It was certified double platinum by Recording Industry Association of Japan (RIAJ), recognizing shipments of 500,000 units. In order to promote album, Amuro conducted her annual Live Style tour in August 2014, and finished it four months later. A live release—titled Namie Amuro Live Style 2014—was issued inside Asia, and was commercial success in Japan.

Image segmentation can be challenging and time-consuming, due to the complex anatomy of the human heart. Objectives: This study introduces $\nu$-net (/nju:n$\varepsilon$t/) -- deep learning approach allowing for fully-automated high quality segmentation of right (RV) and left ventricular (LV) endocardium and epicardium for extraction of cardiac function parameters. Methods: A set consisting of 253 manually segmented cases has been used to train deep neural network. Subsequently, the network has been evaluated on 4 different multicenter data sets with total of over 1000 cases. Results: For LV EF the intraclass correlation coefficient (ICC) is 98, 95, and 80 % (95 %), and for RV EF 96, and 87 % (80 %) on respective data sets (human expert ICCs reported in parenthesis). The LV VM ICC is 95, and 94 % (84 %), and RV VM ICC is 83, and 83 % (54 %). This study proposes simple adjustment procedure, allowing for the adaptation to distinct segmentation philosophies. $\nu$-net exhibits state of-the-art performance in terms of dice coefficient. Conclusions: Biventricular mass and function parameters can be determined reliably in high quality by applying deep neural network for cardiac MRI segmentation, especially in the anatomically complex right ventricle. Adaption to individual segmentation styles by applying a simple adjustment procedure is viable, allowing for the processing of novel data without time-consuming additional training.

Ngangom Bala Devi (born 2 February 1990) is an Indian women's footballer who plays as a forward for Scottish Women's Premier League club Rangers and India women's national football team. Career Born in Manipur, Devi grew up playing the game with mainly boys. She was a part of the Manipur U-19 team that took part in the Under-19 Women's Championship in Assam in 2002. After the tournament she was declared the best player of the tournament. She was awarded the same title the next year in 2003. She also earned top-scorer awards at the under-17 level for her state. Eventually, Devi went on to represent the Manipur Senior Women's Football Team in the Senior Women's National Football Championship. She was very influential in her state, winning the women's football championship in 2014, scoring a brace as Manipur defeated Odisha in the final 3–1. This was Manipur's first championship since 2010 and their 17th overall. While playing with Manipur, Devi was teammates with India captain and AIFF Women's Player of Year, Oinam Bembem Devi. She finished the tournament scoring 29 goals in seven matches.

Major General Sir Thomas William Glasgow (June 6, 1876—July 4, 1955) was a leading Australian officer and a prominent politician. He distinguished himself in the First World War as the commander of a division and a brigade in the field. He served in the Senate from 1919 to 1931, and was the High Commissioner for Australia to Canada. In 1945 he returned to Australia and resumed his private business interests. He died in 1955 at the age of 79 in Brisbane. He was the fourth of the seven children of Mary (Anderson) and Samuel Glasgow, a farmer from Ulster. He was educated at the One Mile State School, and at Maryborough Grammar School. After leaving school, he went as a junior clerk to a mining company in Gympie, and then to the National Bank of Australasia in the same town.

Тhе V-Νеt іs а fullу соnvоlutіоnаl nеtwоrk аrсhіtесturе usеd wіthіn thе СоnvΝеt2 sоftwаrе frаmеwоrk, whісh іs аn ореn-sоurсе іmрlеmеntаtіоn оf аn ехtеnsіvе fаmіlу оf соnvоlutіоnаl nеurаl nеtwоrks оrіgіnаllу dеvеlореd аt thе Dераrtmеnt оf Соmрutеr Sсіеnсе оf Stаnfоrd Unіvеrsіtу іn thе mіd-1990s. V-Νеt wаs іnіtіаllу іntеndеd tо bе usеd іn thе соntехt оf mеdісаl іmаgе сlаssіfісаtіоn. Τhе рurроsе оf thіs рареr іs tо shоw hоw еffісіеntlу аnd ассurаtеlу thе V-Νеt аrсhіtесturе саn bе trаіnеd оn аn ехаmрlе dаtаsеt thаt соntаіns іmаgеs оf rеаl blооd vеssеls wіth smаll dіffеrеnсеs іn bоth sіzе аnd shаре but аlsо shоws rеlаtіvеlу соnsіstеnt реrfоrmаnсе wіthіn а сlаss оn twо bеnсhmаrk сlаssіfісаtіоn tаsks whісh аrе bоth bаsеd оn сlаssіfісаtіоn оf thе іmаgе іntо rеgіоns. Тhіs рареr dеmоnstrаtеs thаt thе V-Νеt реrfоrms wеll whеn trаіnіng оn а lаrgе dаtаsеt wіth rеlаtіvеlу hіgh vаrіаnсе. Τhеsе rеsults іndісаtе thе еffесtіvеnеss оf usіng V-Νеts іn аn іmаgе sеgmеntаtіоn соntехt frоm thе реrsресtіvе оf а соmрutеr sсіеntіst.

A girl with a bare foot, a little girl, dressed in a pretty pink costume, was walking with her mother, in a park. Everyone looked at her, but one man, sitting in a wheelchair, was staring at her. His attendant did not notice; His eyes became so peaceful that he even smiled. Everyone was surprised to see him say, “Alisha! ” He had not uttered a word in years. He was a survivor in an accident with his mother and brother, but he was a cripple and could not speak; but this child in pink seemed to change his lot. She reminded him of his own child, and turning round and smiling at him Only confirmed that there was life after death, and that Alessa was now a part of a new family, and this made him happy.

When I behold your works, I behold thy mind; A self-exciting, self-consuming fire, Which feeds upon everything and is never the same. Various thoughts meet in one bright mirror, And divers objects are viewed in one bead. Yet all are resolved into their first observation, The common property of a warm light. And as the sun, though covered with mist, seems to lose rays, yet is not dimmed at all, so when thy thoughts are clothed in words, the more they lose, the more they gain. Thought is an eye which often makes us blind, Word is an ear which often makes us deaf; But both, when well used, in part compensate their own lack; And both the thought and the mind are served. Thought is the sceptre, word is the feathering; Thought is the arrow, word is the divine point; The eye of heaven, the milestone of the mind. Thought is feathered before the word flies; And though we think or dream or write in vain, The mere reprint of our thoughts gives some relief, some profit, and some joy; And often we find what we thought we had lost, in the reprinting of our scattered thoughts. As thy works have perished in the fire, Thy thoughts, though they seem to die, as phoenixes die, rise again from their ashes.

I thoroughly enjoyed this film. I went with my almost thirteen-year-old son, who is just about to begin playing in his school's first football team, and I think the film has done him a great deal of good. No, this film does not concentrate on the professional sports organization known as the Eagles. If that is what you are looking for in a film, you will be disappointed. The film focuses on our hero and to a large extent on his friends in the neighborhood, and the film tells the story of how a thirty-year-old bartender who had only played organized football once in his life as a high-school athlete and then turned up one Saturday at a totally unexpected open tryout for a professional football team, and how he was chosen... no, he was chosen for the possibility of being on the team. Jack Grimm, a fine character, had to wait several weeks to make it to the team, which was just what he needed. The fact that he made it to the team, against all odds, is the stuff of fairy tales. Well done, and we can also mention that Mark Walberg played the role of Jack Grimm with sensitivity and competence.

Walking barefoot in the sand basking in the early morning sun, I felt at peace with the stillness of a quiet Sunday. Enjoying my surroundings and the warmth of the day My senses peaked by a faint scent of fish filtering through the air. The feel of a slight drizzle touched my nose every now and then. I felt the grit of the sand giving my feet natures gentle massage and enjoyed every step of the way. The sea breeze caressed my naked body, offering me a feeling of tranquility. This is my place, my special place, alone at peace with nature, enjoying every moment, The sand dollars and starfish were plentiful and strategically laid along the shoreline, natures free gifts from the ocean. An artistic design placed on each sand dollar and only nature can take the credit for its beauty A smile came on my face and at that point I realized how blessed I was to be here this day in this place at this time. Another treasured and a created memory to place in my heart. Written: July 15,2007

Then there is one who loves thee deeply, whose faith death alone can part; Yes, well may your brow relax its gloom, For thou hast a talisman against blighted hopes and scornful looks and brows. Her heart is a high, a holy throne, where alone you reign. Turn to her those tender looks, press close that dear hand, and soothe her soul with kindred words. They are ever at thy command, And 'tis all she craves to reap The harvest of a love as deep as the ocean.

We present the experimental measurement of a squeezed vaccuum state by means of a bichromatic local oscillator (BLO). A pair of local oscillators at $\pm$5 MHz around the central frequency $\omega_{0}$ of the fundamental field with equal power are generated by three acousto-optic modulators and phase-locked, which are used as a BLO. The squeezed vacume light are detected by a phase-sensitive balanced-homodyne detection with a BLO. The baseband signal around $\omega_{0}$ combined with a broad squeezed field can be detected with the sensitivity below the shot-noise limit, in which the baseband signal is shifted to the vicinity of 5 MHz (the half of the BLO separation). This work has the important applications in quantum state measurement and quantum information

> Веnnеt, Gеоrgе Αugustus (1818-1881), wаs аmоng thе mоst іnfluеntіаl оf еаrlу sеttlеrs іn Vісtоrіа. Ηе wаs bоrn іn Τаsmаnіа іn 1818 аnd wаs 66 whеn hе mаdе hіs реrmаnеnt hоmе іn Yаrrа Yаrrа (Yаrrа Rаngеs). Βеnnеt mаrrіеd Μаrу Аnn Dunn аnd thеу hаd thrее sоns. Тhеу саmе tо Ρоrt Ρhіllір іn Dесеmbеr 1852, fіrst lіvіng іn thе Wеst Еnd thеn іn St Кіldа. Ηіs sоns wеrе еmрlоуеd bу Н. V. ΜсΚеrrоw whо wаs аn аgеnt fоr thе Ваnk оf Vісtоrіа. МсΚеrrоw hаd а shаrе іn ΜсΚеrrоw & Вrоwn, аn аuсtіоnееrіng busіnеss stаrtеd bу Gеоrgе Βrоwn bеfоrе hе bесаmе Ρrеmіеr оf Vісtоrіа. Βеnnеt mоvеd tо Сlіftоn Ніll іn Sерtеmbеr 1860 whіlе Βrоwn wаs Μауоr оf Меlbоurnе, thеn іn 1864 рurсhаsеd 640 асrеs іn Yаrrа Yаrrа (Yаrrа Rаngеs). Тhе рrореrtу wаs knоwn аs Dаіrу Flаt аnd wаs іn а rеmоtе аrеа tо whісh а rоаd hаd оnlу bееn соnstruсtеd thе рrеvіоus уеаr. Не buіlt а hоusе whісh wаs fіnіshеd іn 1878. Τhіs рrореrtу, tоgеthеr wіth sеvеrаl hundrеd mоrе асquіrеd lаtеr, wаs tо bесоmе thе nuсlеus fоr hіs sоn Wіllіаm’s рrореrtу іn Каngаrоо Grоund аnd thе subdіvіsіоn оf Dаіrу Flаt, whісh bесаmе knоwn аs thе vіllаgе оf Каngаrоо Grоund іn 1880. Веnnеt dіеd sіх mоnths аftеr thе lаnd wаs subdіvіdеd. Ηе hаd аlsо рurсhаsеd рrореrtіеs іn Саstlеmаіnе аnd nеаr Ηаmіltоn еаrlіеr іn hіs lіfе tо whісh hе rеtіrеd. Durіng thіs tіmе hе hаd bееn а Justісе оf thе Ρеасе аnd а Shеrіff durіng thе gоldrush уеаrs. Recent advancements in computer vision and deep learning pave the way for multi-modal translation tasks, where raw data in one domain is translated into another domain with completely different modalities. In this paper, we focus on the task of translating LiDAR point clouds to panoramic color images in a given driving scenario. We exploit recent advances in monocular 3D perception and propose a training approach that leverages a semantic-aware loss function. We formulate the translation task as generating a panoramic image from a bird's-eye view of the LiDAR point cloud, and introduce a cycle-consistent loss to jointly optimize the generation of both the point cloud and the panoramic image. Furthermore, we propose a novel semantic-aware loss that utilizes a point-based rendering technique to compare the generated panoramic images with the ground truth images on a per-point basis, while simultaneously enforcing geometric consistency. We validate our approach on the task of translating LiDAR point clouds to panoramic color images in the city driving scenario, and demonstrate the superiority of our method over the state-of-the-art in terms of quantitative measures as well as visual quality.

The novel tells of the way in which an eleven-year-old girl, Aubrey Priestly, copes with the death of her father and little sister, Savannah, in a car crash. The first main event of the novel is when Aubrey's mother runs away and leaves Aubrey alone in the house. For a week, she lives on canned soup and crackers. Eventually, her grandmother arrives because Aubrey had not been answering the phone. She decides to lie about her mother, saying she would be home for dinner, but the grandmother soon realizes that the mother is missing. The grandmother decides to take Aubrey to her home in Vermont. While in Vermont, Aubrey makes a new friend, Bridget, and enjoys playing with her and her sister, Mabel. Mabel reminds Aubrey of her sister, and several times she is terrified. When school begins, Aubrey is told to see the guidance counselor, a woman named Miss Prudden. She is told to sit next to a new person for lunch, and she chooses to sit next to Marcus, who is also under Miss Prudden's supervision. At first, she is very anxious, but Marcus ends up befriending Aubrey. After a while, she relaxes and becomes good friends with him. Aubrey's mother finally comes home one night and wakes her up with the sound of her voice in the house. At first she thinks it is a dream, but then she realizes it is too real to be a dream. Downstairs, her mother and grandmother are arguing. Aubrey's mother stays with the grandmother and Aubrey for a while, to recuperate. When she is feeling better, she returns to Virginia, leaving Aubrey with her grandmother. Then, after a while, her mother says she is ready for Aubrey to come home with her. Aubrey is very excited at first, but then she realizes how difficult it is for her to decide. She decides to stay with her grandmother and come home for the summer. In the end, she realizes that she will miss her grandmother.

There are two main protagonists and two main antagonists. The protagonists are Koot Hoomie "Kootie" Parganas and Pete "Teet" Sullivan. Kootie is an eleven-year old boy and Sullivan is a man in his early 40's. The novel takes place mostly in Los Angeles in the year 1992, and there are references to the United States presidential election. The main antagonists are Sherman Oaks and Loretta deLarava. As in Last Call, the previous novel of Tim Powers' Fault Line series, a prominent theme is the quest for immortality. Oaks' age is unknown, deLarava's age is 76 (but she often appears to be younger); both have been prolonging their lives by ingesting ghosts. There is a magical system surrounding these ghosts - their behaviour, how they are ingested, how to catch them so that they may be ingested, and even a mysterious market where the bottled ghosts are bought and sold. In their ready-to-be digested state, they are known as "smokes" or "cigars". The narrative is propelled by this chase for ghosts. Koot Hoomie Parganas has unwittingly ingested the ghost of Thomas Edison. However, because Kootie hasn't yet reached puberty, he isn't able to digest it. In its undigested state, the ghost of Edison functions as a helper to Kootie. Because of Edison's powerful personality, this ghost is particularly sought after by both antagonists who wish to ingest it themselves. In addition, Loretta deLarava is pursuing the ghost of Pete Sullivan's father. If Loretta deLarava manages to capture Pete Sullivan, it will help her to locate Pete Sullivan's father's ghost, Arthur Patrick "Apie" Sullivan. Pete Sullivan has his own helper, a former psychiatrist named Angelica Anthem Elizalde. Loretta deLarava also pursues Solomon Shadroe. Shadroe is the former Nicky Bradshaw. Shadroe/Bradshaw is also a son of Arthur Patrick "Apie" Sullivan, albeit a godson. Shadroe/Bradshaw played "Spooky" in a fictional situation comedy called "Ghost of a Chance".

About two months after my last break-up and heartbreak, I’m still wondering whether it’s the person I had a relationship with or the relationship itself that I miss. While I of course miss my ex-girlfriend, I’m beginning to think it’s the latter, that I miss the relationship itself, and that’s what I miss the most. That’s what I miss when I feel sad and nostalgic, not all the qualities I’ve come to associate with my former girlfriend. When I think of my relationship and her together, as a single entity, I feel heartbroken, because the mere memory of our together makes me feel warm and tender. But, strangely enough, when I separate the two, the pain of loss is less intense. When I focus on my ex-girlfriend and her qualities and ways, I don’t feel the same longing. Has anyone else ever felt like this?

John Samuel Darrough (born in 1841, died August 14, 1920) was a soldier of the Union army in the American Civil War, and a recipient of the United States military’s highest decoration, the Congressional medal of honor, for his bravery in a skirmish in Mississippi. Born in Kentucky, Darrough had grown up in Illinois, and enlisted in the Union army there. When engaged in a mission to destroy a railway, Darrough and his companions were stranded on the bank of the Tennessee, under heavy enemy fire. And though he had found a canoe to get across safely, he returned to the Confederate bank to save a comrade from drowning. Early life: Born in Maysville, Kentucky, Darrough was the son of Samuel Vogan Darrough and Riecey Ann Quaintance Darrough. By 1850 the family had moved to neighboring Mason County, where they owned a large farm. In 1855 they moved again, this time to Iroquois County, Illinois, where John lived for the rest of his life.
