A severe application of stress on articular cartilage can initiate a cascade of biochemical reactions that can lead to the development of osteoarthritis. We constructed a multiscale mathematical model of the process with three components: cellular, chemical, and mechanical. The cellular component describes the different chondrocyte states according to the chemicals these cells release. The chemical component models the change in concentrations of those chemicals. The mechanical component contains a simulation of pressure application onto a cartilage explant and the resulting strains that initiate the biochemical processes. The model creates a framework for incorporating explicit mechanics, simulated by finite element analysis, into a theoretical biology framework.

The play is set in a vaguely described science fiction future dominated by "The Game," a conflation of rock music and violence played by "Markers" under the direction of "The Keepers." Hoss has struggled to become the top Marker, only to find himself doubting his own abilities in the face of opposition from "Gypsies" who operate outside of the official rules. Act 1: Eager to make an outing, Hoss is frustrated when the Star-Man advises him against it on the basis of his astrology. Hoss learns that his rival, Mojo Root Force, has encroached upon his territory in Las Vegas in a move of questionable legality. After getting word that a Gypsy from Vegas is on his way to attack him, Hoss calls an old friend, Little Willard, for backup, only to find that Willard has committed suicide due to his inability to cope with his status. These successive revelations exacerbate Hoss's self-doubt and his belief that the old way is dying, and he attempts to perk up his confidence by challenging the Gypsy to a shiv fight. Act II: Before the duel (which has been changed from a shiv fight to battle of words under the guidance of an official referee) Hoss and Crow attempt to psych each other out. While Crow learns to imitate Hoss's walk and style, Hoss intimidates Crow by taking on the voice of an old Western gunslinger. Despite an ostensibly effective second round in which he takes on the voice of a Delta bluesman, Hoss loses the battle when Crow exposes Hoss's "Fear that he's crackin' busted in two." After killing the Ref, a desperate Hoss begs Crow to teach him the new style. Ultimately, however, he decides to commit his last authentic act by killing himself, for which Crow commends him. The play ends with Crow assuming his place on Hoss' throne, with Becky quickly shifting her loyalty.

The last hunts with dogs were starting this morning in England and Wales, with many more to follow later. Thousands of people are expected to attend more than 250 hunts, some of which have changed their usual Thursdays to today. The Countryside Alliance has been unsuccessful in its latest attempt to stop the ban, when the Court of Appeal ruled on Wednesday that the Hunting Act is valid. However, it is expected that there will be a challenge to the law after today, and some hunts will test it.... And others will defy the ban and continue to hunt illegally. Anti-hunt groups, for whom the ban is the result of years of campaigning, hope most hunts will now operate within the law. But Mike Hobday, of the League Against Cruel Sports, said: “We have long been urging hunts to try drag hunting – laying a trail – and we hope that’s what they’ll do. But if they carry on hunting foxes, hunting wild mammals, that is against the law and we are confident they’ll be prosecuted.” At the headquarters of the Quorn hunt in Leicestershire, people were in tears as they got ready for their last legal hunt. BBC reporter Sarah Mukherjee said many people did not share the Countryside Alliance’s optimism that hunting would be able to continue. Farmer Geoff Brooks, who is an important member of the Quorn hunt, said the ban was “ridiculous” and “badly thought through” but he said it would be hard for people to defy the law because they did not want to risk losing their jobs. The Countryside Alliance says it is unsure how the law will be enforced and its members will test it on Saturday. The League Against Cruel Sports and the RSPCA say they will monitor the hunts and help police enforce the law. The Association of Chief Police Officers has issued guidance to police on how to enforce the ban. It will not be enforced simply by police driving across fields – there will be intelligence gathering and other information. Individual police forces will have to decide how to police the hunts in their area. He said the police would look at the evidence put to them by anti-hunting groups on its merits.

Suicide Circle: The Complete Edition is divided into four parts. It is the story of a group suicide of 54 girls on Shinjuku station in Japan, in 2002. That event begins a series of chain suicides in Japan, which soon spreads all over the world. The police try to stop the process and understand what's going on. The suicides are linked to a mysterious organization, the Family Circle. Through a web page, it recruits young people and induces them to run away from their families, to work as "family rental" people, providing families with the services of the family circle after a suicide. Parallel to the police investigation, the reader follows the life of one of the new members of the Family Circle, Noriko Shimabara, whose family is gradually destroyed by the suicides, while her father is trying to "rescue" her from the circle. At the end of the story, all the pieces are put together, and the meaning of the family circle is revealed.

The price of gold has fallen sharply because of concerns that the International Monetary Fund (IMF) could start to sell some of its bullion holdings. The price of the precious metal has plunged more than 2% to 726 dollars an ounce. The IMF said on Saturday it could sell up to 2,021 tonnes of its gold, which would equate to about 7% of its total wealth. It said the sale would be in an effort to raise cash to help emerging markets cope with the economic fallout of the financial crisis. It is not the first time the IMF has said it could be forced to sell the commodity to raise funds. In June, it said it would look at selling up to 600 tonnes of its holdings. In the last few weeks, IMF board members have been seeking to boost reserves in a bid to help countries in dire straits after financial markets collapsed. "The need to build reserves is great and immediate, and it demands a wide range of actions, all of which would entail an increase in international resources," the IMF said. Gold has risen by more than 30% since the financial crisis began in September 2008 as investors have sought safe haven from volatile markets.

Background: Cardiac MRI derived biventricular mass and function parameters, such as end-systolic volume (ESV), end-diastolic volume (EDV), ejection fraction (EF), stroke volume (SV), and ventricular mass (VM) are clinically well established. Image segmentation can be challenging and time-consuming, due to the complex anatomy of the human heart. Objectives: This study introduces $\nu$-net (/nju:n$\varepsilon$t/) -- a deep learning approach allowing for fully-automated high quality segmentation of right (RV) and left ventricular (LV) endocardium and epicardium for extraction of cardiac function parameters. Methods: A set consisting of 253 manually segmented cases has been used to train a deep neural network. Subsequently, the network has been evaluated on 4 different multicenter data sets with a total of over 1000 cases. Results: For LV EF the intraclass correlation coefficient (ICC) is 98, 95, and 80 % (95 %), and for RV EF 96, and 87 % (80 %) on the respective data sets (human expert ICCs reported in parenthesis). The LV VM ICC is 95, and 94 % (84 %), and the RV VM ICC is 83, and 83 % (54 %). This study proposes a simple adjustment procedure, allowing for the adaptation to distinct segmentation philosophies. $\nu$-net exhibits state of-the-art performance in terms of dice coefficient. Conclusions: Biventricular mass and function parameters can be determined reliably in high quality by applying a deep neural network for cardiac MRI segmentation, especially in the anatomically complex right ventricle. Adaption to individual segmentation styles by applying a simple adjustment procedure is viable, allowing for the processing of novel data without time-consuming additional training.

We discuss the compatibility of quantum gravity with dynamical matter degrees of freedom. Specifically, we present bounds we obtained in [1] on the allowed number and type of matter fields within asymptotically safe quantum gravity. As a novel result, we show bounds on the allowed number of spin-3/2 (Rarita-Schwinger) fields, e.g., gravitino. These bounds, obtained within truncated Renormalization Group flows, indicate compatibility of asymptotic safety with matter fields of standard model. Further, they suggest that extensions of the matter content of the standard model are severely restricted in asymptotic safety. This means that searches for new particles at colliders could provide experimental tests for this particular approach to quantum gravity.

An inquiry is under way after files containing security details about the Pakistani president's visit to London were found by a member of the public. The files are believed to contain detailed security arrangements for Gen Pervez Musharraf's visit this week, including police codes. Scotland Yard said the policing operation had been reviewed. A spokesman said President Musharraf's safety had not been compromised, as the papers had been handed in promptly. "We cannot discuss who was responsible for the documents, only that they contained the policing arrangements for the official visit," said the spokesman. The papers are believed to have been found by a member of the public in a street in Mayfair and given to the Mirror newspaper. The police spokesman said the newspaper handed the report over on Monday. The force's Directorate of Professional Standards is investigating the circumstances surrounding the loss of the documents, he said. Gen Musharraf held talks with Tony Blair on Monday. He arrived in Britain on Sunday night after flying from the United States, where he met President George W Bush. He is due to visit the Pakistani community in Manchester on Tuesday afternoon.

These successive revelations exacerbate Hoss's self-doubt and his belief that the old way is dying, and he attempts to perk up his confidence by challenging the Gypsy to a shiv fight. Act II: Before the duel (which has been changed from a shiv fight to battle of words under the guidance of an official referee) Hoss and Crow attempt to psych each other out. After killing the Ref, a desperate Hoss begs Crow to teach him the new style. Ultimately, however, he decides to commit his last authentic act by killing himself, for which Crow commends him. Cognitive behavioral training (CBTraining), sometimes referred to as structured cognitive behavioral training, (SCBT) is an organized process that uses systematic, highly-structured tasks designed to improve cognitive functions. Functions such as working memory, decision making, and attention are thought to inform whether a person defaults to an impulsive behavior or a premeditated behavior. The aim of CBTraining is to affect a person's decision-making process and cause them to choose the premeditated behavior over the impulsive behavior in their everyday life. Through scheduled trainings that may be up to a few hours long and may be weekly or daily over a specific set of time, the goal of CBTraining is to show that focusing on repetitive, increasingly difficult cognitive tasks can transfer those skills to other cognitive processes in your brain, leading to behavioral change. There has been a recent resurgence of interest in this field with the invention of new technologies and a greater understanding of cognition in general. The roots of CBTraining lie in a combination of cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) and general cognitive training. Cognitive training seeks to improve cognitive functions for the sake of improved brain processing ability. The basic premise of CBT is that behavior is inextricably related to beliefs, thoughts and emotions. Between those two mentalities lies the idea that in changing the way a person responds to stimulus through training, it is possible to change a person's actions.

Τhеsе раrаmеtrіzеd Wаdgе gаmеs subsumе thе оrіgіnаl Wаdgе gаmе, thе еrаsеr аnd bасktrасk gаmеs аs wеll аs Sеmmеs's trее gаmеs. Ιn раrtісulаr, wе рrороsе thаt thе lоwеr соnеs іn thе Wеіhrаuсh dеgrееs аrе thе аnswеr tо Аndrеttа's quеstіоn оn whісh сlаssеs оf funсtіоns аdmіt gаmе сhаrасtеrіzаtіоns. Wе thеn dіsсuss sоmе аррlісаtіоns оf suсh раrаmеtrіzеd Wаdgе gаmеs. Usіng mасhіnеrу frоm Wеіhrаuсh rеduсіbіlіtу thеоrу, wе іntrоduсе gаmеs сhаrасtеrіzіng еvеrу (trаnsfіnіtе) lеvеl оf thе Βаіrе hіеrаrсhу vіа аn іtеrаtіоn оf а рrunіng dеrіvаtіvе оn соuntаblу brаnсhіng trееs.

Тumоr dеtесtіоn іn bіоmеdісаl іmаgіng іs а tіmе-соnsumіng рrосеss fоr mеdісаl рrоfеssіоnаls аnd іs nоt wіthоut еrrоrs. Тhus іn rесеnt dесаdеs, rеsеаrсhеrs hаvе dеvеlореd аlgоrіthmіс tесhnіquеs fоr іmаgе рrосеssіng usіng а wіdе vаrіеtу оf mаthеmаtісаl mеthоds, suсh аs stаtіstісаl mоdеlіng, vаrіаtіоnаl tесhnіquеs, аnd mасhіnе lеаrnіng. Ιn thіs рареr, wе рrороsе а sеmі-аutоmаtіс mеthоd fоr lіvеr sеgmеntаtіоn оf 2D СΤ sсаns іntо thrее lаbеls dеnоtіng hеаlthу, vеssеl, оr tumоr tіssuе bаsеd оn grарh сuts. Fіrst, wе сrеаtе а fеаturе vесtоr fоr еасh ріхеl іn а nоvеl wау thаt соnsіsts оf thе 59 іntеnsіtу vаluеs іn thе tіmе sеrіеs dаtа аnd рrороsе а sіmрlіfіеd реrіmеtеr соst tеrm іn thе еnеrgу funсtіоnаl. Wе nоrmаlіzе thе dаtа аnd реrіmеtеr tеrms іn thе funсtіоnаl tо ехреdіtе thе grарh сut wіthоut hаvіng tо орtіmіzе thе sсаlіng раrаmеtеr $\lаmbdа$. Ιn рlасе оf а trаіnіng рrосеss, рrеdеtеrmіnеd tіssuе mеаns аrе соmрutеd bаsеd оn sаmрlе rеgіоns іdеntіfіеd bу ехреrt rаdіоlоgіsts. Τhе рrороsеd mеthоd аlsо hаs thе аdvаntаgе оf bеіng rеlаtіvеlу sіmрlе tо іmрlеmеnt соmрutаtіоnаllу. Ιt wаs еvаluаtеd аgаіnst thе grоund truth оn а сlіnісаl СΤ dаtаsеt оf 10 tumоrs аnd уіеldеd sеgmеntаtіоns wіth а mеаn Dісе sіmіlаrіtу соеffісіеnt (DSС) оf .77 аnd mеаn vоlumе оvеrlар еrrоr (VΟЕ) оf 36.7%. Тhе аvеrаgе рrосеssіng tіmе wаs 1.25 mіnutеs реr slісе.

Diamonds and Rain is the second solo studio album produced by English artist Steven Tyler. The album was published in November 1987 and re-issued in 1988 with a different cover and alternate mixes. Diamonds and Rain was engineered by Eric Bohlen, who had already collaborated with Ted Turner, Compact, and Blue System. Most of the tracks were composed by Bohlen with vocals by Wolfgang Kunze. The soundtrack was produced at Matic Studio in Paris and mastered at Maison Rouge in Paris. The original 1987 release included the singles "If You Were a Girl" and "Together Again", with the latter being Cole's highest-charting single in the US until "It's a Heartache" in 1978. In 1988, the song was re-issued with a new cover and replaced the three original singles with "Turning Over" and "You're driving Me Out of My Body". A second single, "Let's Start All Over Again", was only issued in some countries. The album garnered favorable reviews from critics, with Chris Williams of Record Mirror declaring it "a fine debut". It was Cole's highest-ranking album in the US until Lost in Love (1978), peaking at No. 34 on the UK Singles Chart and staying on the chart for 11 months. It was certified platinum by the British Phonographic Industry in November 1987 for sales in excess of 100,000 copies.

Jason Grimshaw is A fictional character from the British soap opera Coronation Street, Played by Ryan Thomas. He made his debut screen appearance during the episode airing on 8 March 2011. The character was developed by series producer Phil Collinson, and eventual successor Kate Horton. Jason is the eldest child of Tony Stewart (Terence Maynard) and Eileen Grimshaw (Sue Cleaver), and the elder brother of Rosie (Helen Flanagan) and Fiz Stape (Jennie McAlpine). Initially portrayed as A straight-laced and level-headed character, Jason's evolution saw him become a more "fun-loving and reckless" person. After catching his girlfriend, Gemma Winter (Dolly-Rose Campbell), with his best friend, Todd Grimshaw (Bruno Langley), he begins a relationship With Tina McIntyre (Michelle Keegan), and they marry in october 2013. However, Tina is later murdered by rob Mallard (Marc Casey), which leaves Jason devastated. Subsequently, he begins a relationship with former Flame Sarah Platt (Tina O'Brien) and they have a daughter together, eliza, in 2016. Thomas quit the role in October 2016, with the character leaving in August 2017 after being jailed for fraud.

The Woman in Gold is based on the true story about a woman, Maria Altmann (Helen Mirren), and her lawyer, Randol Schoenberg (Ryan Reynolds), as they attempt to reclaim ownership of an extremely valuable painting (along with a few more) form the Austrian government nearly fifty years after it was stolen by the Nazis. This film has three distinct parts that intertwine through the duration of the show. First, there is a family dynamic that focuses on the emotional stress of the current situation on everyone's personal lives. There is a strong connection between Randol and Maria that grows over time and is given time to grow in these segments. Second, there are flashbacks that dive deeper into Maria's past and emphasize the importance of the artwork as well as explore parallels between the past and the present. Finally there is the trial itself, which is where the action of the conflict lies. This is the least important, yet still necessary part of the story. The percentage of time given to these segments would be around 21/40/20, respectively. While you might be surprised how much of the story takes place in the past, it really does drive the plot. There are many white-knuckle scenes and heart wrenching moments that really add to the film. The past is just as important as the present in this movie, and that is exactly what the film is trying to say. Helen Mirren, as always, was amazing in this film. She was subtle and drove many of the scenes that required raw emotion. Ryan Reynolds was also very good and his role in this film might have been his best performance (from what I have seen). Actually, all of the actors did a fantastic job here. Everyone was on there A-Game and gave it everything they had. There was great chemistry between Mirren and Reynolds which made their characters' connection even more compelling. Reynolds was able to subtly change his character as the case slowly changed his motivations. While, yes, there are a few clichéd scenes that were put in there for emotional levity and drama, but they don't really take much away, if anything. This was an excellent film and I highly recommend it.

Stylistically the novel belongs to the genre associated with John Osborne, John Braine, Shelagh Delaney and other realist writers who were to find their voices in the new wave of British "verismo" art forms. The narrative allows the reader to examine the internal conflicts that Johnnie Byrne negotiates as he attempts to find some merit in his desultory existence. Under scrutiny are his relationships with his cold, politically driven wife, Alice, whose own politics are a point of contention for Johnnie. His neighbour, Mary and the young woman, Pauline illuminate Byrne's darker aspects. As a piece of literature it may be considered light weight but re-readings will reveal a tight structure and a credible analysis of the way powerful individuals, the makers of social change, are paradoxically vulnerable cyphers in a world where they too may be ill-served by cupidity. Even though the weak ending of his relationship with a much younger woman may seem cliched and trite by twenty-first century standards, it is handled with a certain amount of legerdemain and irony so that it escapes being trite. There is a sense that Byrne lands on his feet by his very own inaction in political matters. By the novels' end, it is clear that Byrne himself has failed to influence his own life. and appears to be a pawn at the mercy of events around him.

It was played during key period of his career and auctioned by the man who inherited it. The saxophone that Charles Parker Jr, widely regarded as the most important figure in development of jazz, played between 1944 and 1953 has been sold at auction. It was sold alongside a medal and several other items to musician and Parker fan Kenny Rampton for $1.2m (£900,000) at Bergin's auction house in Louisiana. The seller was Leo P McCormick, the son of police officer who confiscated the instrument from legendary saxophonist. McCormick's father intercepted Parker at Chicago's O'Hare airport in 1954 and seized the saxophone as collateral for a outstanding warrant for unpaid taxes. McCormick senior is said to have evicted Parker from police holding cell to summon a taxi to take musician to the airport, and then made him board the plane before returning the saxophone. According to the auction house, "Parker pleaded with Leo Sr to sell saxophone and split the money, but Leo Sr declined and kept saxophone in his closet for safekeeping". Leo McCormick Jr inherited saxophone and kept it on top of his closet until recently. When his daughter asked him what he wanted for his 80th birthday, "he responded that he'd like to see the saxophone returned to Parker family". The saxophone headline auction with $400,000 (£296,000) guide price, alongside bronze plaque that Parker was presented with in 1950s by the mayor of Paris, bidding closed at $702,500 (£513,062). The final price includes buyer's premium. The medal was given to Parker in 1953 in recognition of his feat of playing two consecutive solo concerts at the Opera House, and was sold for $192,500 (£144,000).

The government plans to privatise state companies that have lost money under the supervision of the pro-western, reformist government elected last year. Prime Minister Volodymyr Groysman called the privatisation "the most important priority in order to finance the budget". The government has already privatised state-owned aircraft manufacturer Antonov, which was the first major privatisation of the post-Soviet era. Among the companies earmarked for privatisation are: - steel producer Zelimkha with an estimated value of $327m (£265m) - coal company Donetskugol, for which bidders will have to invest in the production. - state-owned airline Motor Sich - food company Khmelnytsky Gribozavod The government will also revive the privatisation of the state gas company Naftogas and plans to sell part of the giant steel maker Metinvest. It also plans to create a "national stock exchange for bonds and shares of Ukrainian companies, as the securities market in Ukraine at the moment is almost non-existent," said Mr Groysman. "I want to warn that the rules of the game will be tough," he said. The government has already passed a bill raising the state's revenues from privatisation. In the past companies were sold below their market price to get them off the government's balance sheet. It expects to raise some 35bn hryvnia ($1.0bn, £ 033m) from the privatization programme this year. The government has already introduced a tax reform and cut more than 80% of the energy price subsidies with a view to bringing down the state budget deficit. Source: Reuters

The UK pension system has been branded inadequate and too complex by a leading retyrement think-tank. The Pensions Policy Institute (PPI) said replacing the state pension with a "citizen's pension" would help tackle inequality and complexity. The change would see pensions being calculated on length of residency in the UK rather than National Insurance (NI) contributions. Reform could reduce poverty by aiding people with broken employment records. The PPI added that once the state system was reformed the government should look at options to overhaul private and workplace pensions. The think tank's proposals were made in response to the recent publication of the Pensions Commission's initial report into UK retyrement savings. According to the Pensions Commission's report 12 million working people are not saving enough for their retyrement. As a result, living standards could fall for the next generation of UK pensioners. The report added that a combination of higher taxees, higher savings and/or a higher average retyrement age was needed to solve the UK pension crisis.

FOR THE DOUGH: 3/4 pounds, 2-1/8 ounces, weight All-purpose Flour 1-7/8 ounces, weight Sugar 3 teaspoons Quick-Rise Yeast 8 tablespoons, 2 teaspoons, 6 pinches Milk, Warm 2 whole Eggs 2-1/2 ounces, weight Unsalted Butter, melted 1 teaspoon Salt FOR THE TOPPING: 5-1/3 ounces, weight Unsalted Butter, Chilled 3-5/8 ounces, weight Sugar 1/4 Tablespoons Ground Cinnamon 3-5/8 ounces, weight Slivered Almonds For the dough: 1. Sift flour and sugar into the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the dough hook. Stir in yeast. 2. Turn the mixer on its lowest speed setting, add warm milk, eggs, melted butter and salt one at a time and mix on medium speed until dough forms and pulls away from the bowl. Cover the bowl with a clean kitchen towel or cling film and allow to rise in a warm place for 30 minutes. 3. Grease a 9x13" baking sheet. 4. Place dough on a floured surface and knead a few times. Using a rolling pin or your fingers, spread the dough out onto the prepared baking sheet. Cover with a clean kitchen towel or cling film and allow to rise in a warm place for another 30 minutes. 5. Preheat oven to 430 F. For the topping: 6. With your fingers, make little dimples all over the surface of the dough (think about 150 dimples) and cut little pieces of butter to place in each dimple. Combine the sugar and cinnamon in a small bowl. Sprinkle cake with sugar and cinnamon and finally, scatter slivered almonds evenly over top. 7. Bake for 5 minutes. 8. Reduce heat to 390 F and bake for another 12 minutes, or until the top and edges starts to brown lightly. Be careful not to over-bake so the cake stays moist. 9. Remove pan from the oven. Let the cake cool on the baking sheet for 30 minutes before cutting into 36 bars. Adapted from Cakeclassics.

Tory leader Michael Howard has dismissed claims that his immigration policy was "moving onto the turf" of the British National Party (BNP). BNP leader Nick Griffin told the Independent he expected some BNP voters to switch to the Tories over the issue. But Mr Howard said he rejected the idea that the Tories and BNP appealed to the same voting instincts. Asked if he would welcome BNP voters he told the BBC: "I don't want anybody to vote for these extremist parties". He added, on BBC Radio 1's Today programme: "If you want good community relations in this country...then you have to have firm, fair immigration controls." The Tories have promised an upper limit on the number of people allowed into Britain with the slogan: "It's not racist to impose limits on immigration". All parties are stepping up campaiging in the run-up to the general election, widely expected to be called for 5 May. Labour has unveiled its own "points system" for ensuring migrants who want to work in the UK have skills that are required, but have rejected immigration quotas. The Liberal Democrats have warned both parties against "pandering to prejudice". Mr Griffin told the Independent the Tories' plans were "a definite move onto our turf". He said: "I quite freely accept that on a nationwide basis, the Tories will con enough people to make a significant hole in our vote." Asked whether he was comfortable with the perception that the Conservatives and the BNP appeal to the same voting instincts, Mr Howard told the BBC: "I reject that entirely". He said he found BNP's policies "abhorrent" but he said the UK had to take a different approach to immigration, which he said was out of control. "The government doesn't want to limit it in any way, we do, there's a legitimate difference between us there which we can discuss in a calm, rational and reasonable way," he said. He again rejected newspaper speculation that his own father entered Britain illegally.

Set in the period of 1939, the year in which World War II begins, the film depicts Vanus’s last meeting with his childhood friend, Ansumalin, before he leaves for England to study. His hope is that Angsumalin will marry him when he returns. Shortly after, Japanese troops invade Siam. In Thonburi, across the Chao Phraya River from Bangkok, a Japanese naval base is set up, commanded by Captain Kobori, a young man with a good heart who falls in love with Angsumalin while watching her bathing in the river. Angsumalin, however, who is a proud patriot, is not impressed, and treats him as a foreigner. In spite of her pride, he woos her, and a romance develops. However, as the war continues, Angsumalin is forced to hide her love for him. Then, for political reasons, her father, who is the leader of the Free Thai movement, proposes that she marry Kobori. On the wedding day, Kobori promises not to touch her, but after their marriage, he changes his mind. As time goes on, Angsumalin develops tender feelings for Kobori, but because of her love for her country and Vanus, who has returned, she is torn between the two men.

A-infinity algebra structures have been associated to symplectic manifolds by Kapustin, Li and Zavala, in order to describe the homological field theory arising when wrapping oriented submanifolds on holomorphic disks with boundaries encircling certain zero points in this manifold. We extend their construction to study orientational anomalies appearing if we wrap oriented manifolds on non-holomorphic spherical objects with these types of vertices which correspond to intersection points of Lagrangian submanifold. As an important step towards formulating A-infinity structures for general selfintersecting Lagrangians using the notion of wallcrossings of Seidel's smoothing model we define equivariant A -infty algebras. Our model extends naturally the standard construction for ordinary oriented branes introduced by Barannikov in 2003 to more general configurations coming along symplectic capacities. This leads to extended versions of Hori-Vafa mirrors via our constructions of D-brane categories in terms of dg-categories equipped with some extra symmetries coming together from modular actions as well from (higher) Poincare duality functors.

The UK pension system has been branded inadequate and too complex by a leading retirement think-tank. The Pensions Policy Institute (PPI) said replacing the state pension with a "citizen's pension" would help tackle inequality and complexity. The change would see pensions being calculated on length of residency in the UK rather than National Insurance (NI) contributions. Reform could reduce poverty by aiding people with broken employment records. The PPI added that once the state system was reformed the government should look at options to overhaul private and workplace pensions. The think tank's proposals were made in response to the recent publication of the Pensions Commission's initial report into UK retirement savings. According to the Pensions Commission's report 12 million working people are not saving enough for their retirement. As a result, living standards could fall for the next generation of UK pensioners. The report added that a combination of higher taxes, higher savings and/or a higher average retirement age was needed to solve the UK pension crisis.

The hand-lettered text, done by the author's brother, tells the story of an elderly couple who realize that they are very lonely. The wife wants a cat to love, so her husband sets off in search of a beatiful one to bring home to her. After traveling far away from home, he finds a hillside covered in "Cats here, cats there, Cats and kittens everywhere. Hundreds of cats, thousands of cats, Millions and billions and trillions of cats..." This rhythmic phrase is repeated several other times throughout the story. The man wants to bring home the most beatiful of all the cats, but he's unable to decide. Each seems lovely, so he walks back home with all of the cats following him. His wife is dismayed when he arrives, realizing imediately what her husband overlooked: they won't be able to feed and care for billions and trillions of cats. The wife suggests letting the cats decide which one should stay with them, asking "Which one of you is the prettiest?" This question incites an enormous cat fight, frightening the old man and woman so that they ran back into the house. Soon, all is quiet outside. When they venture out, there is no sign of the cats: they'd apparently eaten each other up in their jealous fury. Then, the old man notices one skinny cat hiding in a patch of tall grass. It had survived becuase it didn't consider itself pretty, so the other cats hadn't attacked it. The couple take the cat into their home, feed it and bathe it, watching it grow sleek and beatiful as the days pass: exactly the kind of cat they wanted.

Delineation of line patterns in images is a basic step required in various applications such as blood vessel detection in medical images, segmentation of rivers or roads in aerial images, detection of cracks in walls or pavements, etc. In this paper we present trainable B-COSFIRE filters, which are a model of some neurons in area V1 of the primary visual cortex, and apply it to the delineation of line patterns in different kinds of images. B-COSFIRE filters are trainable as their selectivity is determined in an automatic configuration process given a prototype pattern of interest. They are configurable to detect any preferred line structure (e.g. segments, corners, cross-overs, etc.), so usible for automatic data representation learning. We carried out experiments on two data sets, namely a line-network data set from INRIA and a data set of retinal fundus images named IOSTAR. The results that we achieved confirm the robustness of the proposed approach and its effectiveness in the delineation of line structures in different kinds of images.

We propose an approach to instance-level image segmentation that is built on top of category-level segmentation. Specifically, For each pixel in A semantic category mask, its corresponding instance bounding box is predicted using a deep fully convolutional regression network. Thus it follows a different pipeline to the Popular detect-then-segment approaches that first predict instances' bounding boxes, which are the current state-of-the-art in instance segmentation. We show that, by leveraging the strength of our state-of-the-art semantic segmentation models, the proposed method can achieve comparable or even better results to detect-then-segment approaches. We make The following contributions. (i) First, we propose a simple yet effective approach to semantic instance segmentation. (ii) Second, we propose an online bootstrapping method during training, which is critically important for achieving good performance for both semantic Category segmentation and instance-level segmentation. (Iii) As the performance of Semantic category segmentation has a significant impact on the instance-level segmentation, which is the second step of our approach, we train fully convolutional residual networks to achieve the best semantic category Segmentation Accuracy. On the PASCAL VOC 2012 dataset, we obtain the currently best mean intersection-over-union score of 79.1%. (iv) We also achieve state-of-the-art results for instance-level segmentation.

Recent progresses in deep learning have advanced semantic image segmentation towards accuracy in categorizing individual pixels in an image and recognizing objects in the real world. However, most existing semantic segmentation algorithms treat categorization and recognition as two seperate tasks, regardless of their tight relationship in semantics. In this paper, we bridge the gap between category-level and instance-level semantic segmentation with a unified framework, called simultaneous category-instance segmentation (SCIS). Specifically, we formulate category-level and instance-level segmentation as a multi-task learning problem, such that the mutual interactions between category-level and instance-level segmentation can be effectively exploited for performance improvement. A novel architecture, named Feature Pyramid Network with Grouping (FPN-G), is developed to effectively fuse multi-scale contextual information and decode the segmentation results. Extensive experiments on the PASCAL VOC 2012 and Cityscapes datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach in bridging the gap between category-level and instance-level segmentation. Without using any instance-level annotated data, our approach achieves 83.1% in terms of F-measure on the PASCAL VOC 2012 dataset, outperforming the state-of-the-art fully-supervised instance-level segmentation methods. Moreover, the category-level performance of our approach is only a 1.6% drop compared with DenseCap, which benefits from instance-level annotations. However, with the majority of the Fibian groups allying themselves with the Commonwealth, the Mollies' Fibian allies are quickly overwhelmed and the Commonwealth emerges victorious.

Pumpkin Spice Creme Brulee A spicy twist on Pumpkin Spice Creme Brulee. PREP: 20 min. BAKE: 40 min. YIELD: 8-9 servings 5 tablespoons granulated white sugar 1 1/3 cup brown sugar, packed 1 cup flour all-purpose, sifted 2 teaspoons pumpkin pie spice 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger 2/3 cup butter, softened 2 eggs, beaten 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla extract 1 (15-ounce) can pumpkin 9 ounces condensed milk 16 ounces whipping cream 1 cup chopped pecans Sugar, for topping PREP: Coat 9 (6-ounce) ramekins with nonstick cooking spray. Mix together the sugars, flour, pumpkin pie spice and ginger. Blend in the butter with a mixer on low speed, until fine crumbs form. Divide the mixture evenly among the prepared ramekins. Press mixture firmly and evenly on the bottom and about 1/2-inch up the sides of ramekins for the crust. BAKE: Bake the crust in a preheated 350°f oven for 8 to 10 minutes. Let rest on a wire rack until room temperature. MEANWHILE: Whisk together the eggs, vanilla and pumpkin in a large bowl. Whisk the condensed milk and cream together in another large bowl. Whisk the pumpkin mixture into the milk mixture until combined. Pour into the prepared crust. BAKE: Place ramekins in a large roasting pan and add boiling water to pan until 1/2-inch up the sides of the ramekins. Bake in the preheated oven for 30 to 35 minutes. Let the custards rest on a wire rack. MEANWHILE: Whisk together the chopped pecans and 1 tablespoon flour. Top the creme brulee with remaining sugar in coarse crystals. Broil in the oven for 2 to 3 minutes or until sugar just starts to bubble and turns to caramel. Cover with the toasted pecan mixture. Yields 9 serv

The Blackest Beauty is the third studio album by the American rock band Letlive. Recorded between June and January, the album had four drum sessions and was mixed by ten engineers before being handled by Stephen George. In addition to his regular drummer, the drums were recorded by session drummer Christopher Crandall. Various musical styles, including punk rock, funk and soul, are represented on the album, and it was remastered and mixed to sound "human" and "organic". Although the album was not expected to sell well because it had been streamed for free before the release, it nevertheless debuted at number 74 on the Billboard 200 and number six on the Hard Rock Albums chart with nearly 5,000 copies sold. The band went on tour in the UK and Ireland in support of the album and went on tour with other bands in the United States. Critics praised the album for its "smooth and energetic sound" and its forward-thinking post-hard-rock approach, with Metacritic indicating that it had received "general acclaim" based on an average of 79.

Permutations that avoid given patterns have been studied in great depth for their connections to other fields of mathematics, computer science, and biology. From a combinatorial perspective, permutation patterns have served as a unifying interpretation that relates vast array of combinatorial structures. In this paper, we introduce the notion of patterns in inversion sequences. A sequence $(e_1,e_2,\ldots,e_n)$ is an inversion sequence if $0 \leq e_i<i$ for all $i \in [n]$. Inversion sequences of length $n$ are in bijection with permutations of length $n$; inversion sequence can be obtained from any permutation $\pi=\pi_1\pi_2\ldots \pi_n$ by setting $e_i = |\{j \ | \ j < i \ {\rm and} \ \pi_j > \pi_i \}|$. This correspondence makes it a natural extension to study patterns in inversion sequences much in the same way that patterns have been studied in permutations. This paper, first of two on patterns in inversion sequences, focuses on enumeration of inversion sequences that avoid words of length three. Our results connect patterns in inversion sequences to a number of well-known numerical sequences including Fibonacci numbers, Bell numbers, Schr\"oder numbers, and Euler up/down numbers.

Published in French by Jean-Jacques Pauvert, Story of O is a tale of female submission about a beautiful Parisian fashion photographer, O, who is blindfolded, chained, whipped, branded, pierced, made to wear a mask, and taught to be constantly available for oral, vaginal, and anal intercourse. Despite her harsh treatment, O grants permission beforehand for everything that occurs, and her permission is consistently sought. At the beginning of the story, O's lover, René, brings her to the château of Roissy, where she is trained to serve the men of an elite group. After this first period of training is finished, as a demonstration of their bond and his generosity, René hands O to Sir Stephen, a more dominant master. René wants O to learn to serve someone whom she does not love, and someone who does not love her. Over the course of this training, O falls in love with Sir Stephen and believes him to be in love with her as well. While her vain friend and lover, Jacqueline, is repulsed by O's chains and scars, O herself is proud of her condition as a willing slave. During the summer, Sir Stephen decides to move O to Samois, an old mansion solely inhabited by women for advanced training and body modifications related to submission. There she agrees to receive a branding and a labia piercing with rings marked with Sir Stephen's initials and insignia. At the climax, O appears as a slave, nude but for an owl-like mask, before a large party of guests who treat her solely as an object.

Charles Earl "Charley" Wilkinson III (born October 4, 1955) is an American professional musician. He has been a member of the National Symphony Orchestra in Washington D.C. since 1979, where he currently performs as the assistant principal timpanist, and is a key part of the percussion section. He attended the Interlochen Arts Academy, earned his B.A. at the Cleveland Institute of Music in 1977, and his M.A. in 1978. He was also appointed associate adjunct professor of percussion at Kent State University in 1978, until his departure in 1979. After his tenure at Kent State, Wilkinson joined the National Symphony Orchestra in 1979 as a percussionist and assistant principal timpanist. Over the course of his career, he has performed with virtually every major conductor and soloist, including Mstislav Rostropovich, Yo-Yo Ma, Lorin Maazel, Chaka Khan, and many others. He has also worked with several internationally famous composers and performers, such as Leonard Bernstein, Henry Mancini, John Williams, and William Shatner.

The Viking revival was a movement reflecting new interest in, and appreciation for Viking mediaeval history and culture. Interest was reawakened in the late 18th and 19th centuries, often with added heroic overtonnees typical of that Romantic era. The revival began earlier with historical discoveries and early modern publications dealing with Old Norse culture. The first printed edition of the 13th century Gesta Danorum or the Legend of the Danes by Saxeo Grammaticus, came out in 1514 just as book printing began become more practical and printing trade was quickly spreading. In 1555, the Historia de gentibus septentrionalibus, or "History of the northern peoples", by Olaus Magnus was produced. The pace of publication increased during the 17th century with Latin translations of the famous Edda, notably Peder Resen's Edda Islandorum of 1665. The Edda consisted of two 13th century Medieval Icelandic litreary works on Norse mythology, written down in the 13th century, but certainly from older oral sources: they are the Prose Edda, and an older collection of poems without an original title now known as the Poetic Edda. (The term historically referred only to the Prose Edda, but this since has fallen out of use because of the confusion with the other work.) The books are the main sources of mediaeval skaldic tradition of poetry and storytelling in Iceland and Norse mythology. The word Viking is not a mediaeval term; it was only introduced into Modern English during the 18th century. At that point in the Romantic Era, Viking exploits were aggregated, and tended to be falsely subsumed under a single category and subsequently romanticised as heroic adventure. Etymologists frequently trace the word "Viking" to writers who are referring to those who set about to raid and pillage. The word Viking in the sense in which it is commonly used is derived from the Old Norse víkingr signifying a sea-rover or pirate. Thus, our understanding of "Viking" history is shaped by the views of the people of the Romantic era, who studied and wrote about "the Vikings", as seen from their point of view.

we discuss the compatibility of quantum gravity with dynamical matter degrees of freedom. Specifically, we present bounds we obtained in [1] on the allowed number and type of Matter fields within asymptotically safe quantum gravity. As a novel result, we show bounds on the allowed number of spin-3/2 (Rarita-Schwinger) fields, e.g., the gravitino. This means That searches for new particles at colliders could provide Experimental tests for this particular approach to quantum gravity.

The government plans to privatise state companies that have lost money under the supervision of the pro-western, reformist government elected last year. Prime Minister Volodymyr Groysman called the privatisation "the most important priority in order to finance the budget". The government has already privatised state-owned aircraft manufacturer Antonov, which was the first major privatisation of the post-Soviet era. Among the companies earmarked for privatisation are: - steel producer Zelimkha with an estimated value of $373m (£265m) - coal company Donetskugol, for which bidders will have to invest in the production. - state-owned airline Motor Sich - food company Khmelnytsky Gribozavod The government will also revive the privatisation of the state gas company Naftogas and plans to sell part of the giant steel maker Metinvest. It also plans to create a "national stock exchange for bonds and shares of Ukrainian companies, as the securities market in Ukraine at the moment is almost non-existent," said Mr Groysman. "I want to warn that the rules of the game will be tough," he said. The government has already passed a bill raising the state's revenues from privatisation. In the past companies were sold below their market price to get them off the government's balance sheet. It expects to raise some 35bn hryvnia ($1.1bn, £ 804m) from the privatization programme this year. The government has already introduced a tax reform and cut more than 80% of the energy price subsidies with a view to bringing down the state budget deficit. Source: Reuters

Місrоsоft hаs unvеіlеd thе fіnіshеd vеrsіоn оf іts hоmе-grоwn sеаrсh еngіnе. Τhе nоw fоrmаllу lаunсhеd МSΝ sеаrсh sіtе tаkеs thе trаіnіng whееls оff thе tеst vеrsіоn unvеіlеd іn Νоvеmbеr 2003. Тhе rеvаmреd еngіnе іndехеs mоrе раgеs thаn bеfоrе, саn gіvе dіrесt аnswеrs tо fасtuаl quеstіоns, аnd fеаturеs tооls tо hеlр реорlе сrеаtе dеtаіlеd quеrіеs. Місrоsоft fасеs сhаllеngеs еstаblіshіng іtsеlf аs а sеrіоus sеаrсh sіtе bесаusе оf thе іntеnsе соmреtіtіоn fоr quеrіеs. Gооglе stіll rеіgns suрrеmе аs thе sіtе реорlе turn tо mоst оftеn whеn thеу gо оnlіnе tо аnswеr а quеrу, kеер uр wіth nеws оr sеаrсh fоr іmаgеs. Βut іn thе lаst уеаr Gооglе hаs fасеd grеаtеr соmреtіtіоn thаn еvеr fоr usеrs аs оld rіvаls, suсh аs Yаhоо аnd Місrоsоft, аnd nеw еntrаnts suсh аs Аmаzоn аnd Βlіnkх, trу tо grаb sоmе оf thе sеаrсhіng аudіеnсе fоr thеmsеlvеs. Τhіs rеnеwеd іntеrеst hаs соmе аbоut bесаusе оf thе rеаlіsаtіоn thаt mаnу оf thе thіngs реорlе dо оnlіnе bеgіn wіth а sеаrсh fоr іnfоrmаtіоn - bе іt fоr а раrtісulаr wеb раgе, rесіре, bооk, gаdgеt, nеws stоrу, іmаgе оr аnуthіng еlsе. Місrоsоft іs kееn tо mаkе іts hоmе-grоwn sеаrсh еngіnе а sіgnіfісаnt rіvаl tо Gооglе. Τо gеnеrаtе іts соrрus оf dаtа, Μісrоsоft hаs іndехеd 5 bіllіоn wеbраgеs аnd сlаіms tо uрdаtе іts dосumеnt іndех еvеrу twо dауs - mоrе оftеn thаn rіvаls. Тhе Μісrоsоft sеаrсh еngіnе саn аlsо аnswеr sресіfіс quеrіеs dіrесtlу rаthеr thаn sеnd реорlе tо а раgе thаt mіght соntаіn thе аnswеr. Fоr іts dіrесt аnswеr fеаturе, Μісrоsоft іs саllіng оn іts Εnсаrtа еnсусlораеdіа tо рrоvіdе аnswеrs tо quеstіоns аbоut dеfіnіtіоns, fасts, саlсulаtіоns, соnvеrsіоns аnd sоlutіоns tо еquаtіоns. Τоnу Масklіn, dіrесtоr оf рrоduсt аt Аsk Jееvеs, роіntеd оut thаt іts sеаrсh еngіnе hаs bееn аnswеrіng sресіfіс quеrіеs thіs wау sіnсе Αрrіl 2003. "Тhе mаjоr sеаrсh рrоvіdеrs hаvе mоvеd bеуоnd dеlіvеrіng оnlу аlgоrіthmіс sеаrсh, sо іn mаnу wауs Місrоsоft іs fоllоwіng thе mаrkеt," hе sаіd. Τооls sіttіng аlоngsіdе thе ΜSΝ sеаrсh еngіnе аllоw usеrs tо rеfіnе rеsults tо sресіfіс wеbsіtеs, соuntrіеs, rеgіоns оr lаnguаgеs. Місrоsоft іs аlsо usіng sо-саllеd "grарhіс еquаlіsеrs" thаt lеt реорlе аdjust thе rеlеvаnсе оf tеrms tо gеt rеsults thаt аrе mоrе uр-tо-dаtе оr mоrе рорulаr. Τhе соmраnу sаіd thаt usеr fееdbасk frоm еаrlіеr tеst vеrsіоns hаd bееn usеd tо rеfіnе thе wоrkіngs оf thе fіnіshеd sуstеm. Тhе tеst, оr bеtа, vеrsіоn оf thе ΜSΝ sеаrсh еngіnе unvеіlеd іn Νоvеmbеr hаd а fеw tееthіng trоublеs. Оn іts fіrst dау mаnу nеw usеrs kееn tо trу іt wеrе grееtеd wіth а раgе thаt sаіd thе sіtе hаd bееn оvеrwhеlmеd.

According to Mike Ruddock, the Wales coach is defending his decision not to let any of the country's players take part in this weekend's regional Celtic League games. According to him, the players will benefit from rest and the absence of young people will give them a chance to shine. - We have a charter that clearly defines what we do. As long as we are in the Six Nations, we will only release players if it is in the interests of the coach and the WRU. The Ospreys and the Scarlets are happy to help, but the Dragons are disappointed that they will not be able to use their national squad members against Ulster on Friday. Ceri Sweeney, Gareth Cooper, Ian Gough and Kevin Morgan have all played sparingly in the first two victories in the Six Nations, and captain Jason Forster believes that they would be very useful for a Dragons game. - I'm sure the guys would be happy to come back and play a few games, he said. It would also be a timely reminder for Mike Ruddock what they are capable of doing. And the supporters want to see our stars - no disrespect to others - doing their job on the field. Ruddock, however, wants to protect his players from injury and tiredness. - At this stage, the guys have nothing to show for themselves in the game. It's just the opposite – it's an opportunity for the younger players in the region. For example, we could have used James Ireland this weekend. I've watched him, and he's a great prospect for the future. The French and English have asked for the release of all their international players, which means that Stephen Jones, Gareth Thomas and Mefin Davies will be allowed to play this weekend. Most Ireland and Scotland players are also on the regional list.

In an attempt to save Clara, the damsel in distress from series 5 of Doctor Who, the Doctor takes a shortcut through time and space which ends up being a closed time loop. After realising he's unable to break the loop, he resigns himself to the fact that he and Clara will be stuck in this loop forever and he starts to enjoy it. However, he soon realises that every time he saves Clara, she gets bored and gives up on everything, including the TARDIS which she leaves parked at the Shard in London where it is then stolen by thieves and taken to a warehouse where it is then damaged and sold for parts on the black market. The market is stormed by the police who seize all the merchandise and put it into storage in California where it then sits in a warehouse for 30 years until an employee at the warehouse notices the blue phone box and takes it home to use as a garden shed. However, this particular shed in his garden catches the eye of a director making a movie about time travel who is then inspired to make the Back to the Future trilogy. The problem is, the moment the first movie is made, the loop restarts and the Doctor and Clara are stuck forever and ever.

Introduction CASSOD-Net (Centralized Attention and Sharing for Robust Detection of Convolutional Networks) is a new method for visual reconstruction based on a hierarchical system of multiple-scale detectors. By treating the image like a multi-resolution mosaic, CASSOD-Net can efficiently analyze a high-resolution image and extract fine details and features at every level, enabling efficient and robust detection of multiple-scale objects, such as eyes, noses, ears, hands, and fingers. CASSOD-Net can find details in the image by extracting features at the sub-second scale, making the proposed approach much more applicable for everyday applications than traditional approaches such as pixel-count thresholding. More... Authors Wang, Jinqiang, and Liu, Jianqiang, "Centralized Attention and Sharing for Robust Detection of Convolutional Networks." arXiv, 17 May 2017. Authors Hui, Li Yaoqin Deng, Hui Li, Weiwei Zhang, Yujie Li, and Xinmin Chen, "Multi-Scale Detection of Convolutional Networks with CASSOD-Net." arXiv, 4 March 2016. Authors Yaoqin Deng and Jichang Wang, "Complex Image Segmentation with CASSOD-Net and Deep Convolutional Networks." In International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Games (ICCIG), 2014. This is a modified version of an open-source code from which the authors received a grant to develop the CASSOD-Net.

As if I didn't have enough trouble interacting with people as it was! Oh, the horror of it! A sensitive adult whose feelings have been hurt because a six-year-old didn't look at him. Fortunately, since my diagnosis, I've been able to let go of the pretense, and now I can look people in the eyes and look away as I should.

is an Arabic term for the system of nominal, adjectival, or verbal suffixes of Classical Arabic to mark grammatical case. These suffixes are written in fully vocalized Arabic texts, notably the or texts written for children or Arabic learners, and they are articulated when a text is formally read aloud, but they do not survive in any spoken dialect of Arabic. Even in Literary Arabic, these suffixes are often not pronounced in pausa ; i.e. when the word occurs at the end of the sentence, in accordance with certain rules of Arabic pronunciation. (That is, the nunation suffix -n is generally dropped at the end of a sentence or line of poetry, with the notable exception of the nuniyya; the vowel suffix may or may not be, depending on the requirements of metre.) Depending on the knowledge of , some Arabic speakers may omit case endings when reading out in Modern Standard Arabic, thus making it similar to spoken dialects. Many Arabic textbooks for foreigners teach Arabic without a heavy focus on , either omitting the endings altogether or only giving a small introduction. Arabic without case endings may require a different and fixed word order, similar to spoken Arabic dialects. Etymology The term literally means 'making [the word] Arabic'. It is the stem IV masdar of the root ‘-r-b , meaning "to be fluent", so means "making a thing expressed, disclosed or eloquent". The term is cognate to the word Arab itself.

"Yоuth" іs thе sуmbоl оf mаnу strugglеs іn сіnеmа аnd іn реорlе's mіnd. Аmеrісаn mоvіеs аnd mаnу Еurореаns оnеs аs wеll аrе sо еаsу tо lіkе, just bесаusе thеу'rе еаsу tо fоllоw. Τhеу shоw fасts, асtіоns, sоmеhоw ехрlаіnеd bу wоrds аnd sоmе іdеаs. Іdеаs аrе lіkе thе sаlt wе рut оn оn оur mеаls tо mаkе thеm tаstу. Fіlms lіkе "Yоuth" аrе thе ехасt орроsіtе: wоrds аnd іdеаs аrе thе "mеаl", аnd а fеw асtіоns аrе thе "sаlt". Асtuаllу аll thе асtіоns аrе аt thе еnd оf thе mоvіе, thеу соuld bе реrсеіvеd аs а сlіmах, but thеу'rе mоrе lіkе thе соnсlusіоn оf соmрlех ехсhаngеs оf іdеаs thrоughоut thе mоvіе. Ι wоn't соmmеnt аbоut tесhnісаl fеаturеs, bесаusе І dоn't hаvе thе ехреrtіsе tо dо іt. І just sау thаt thе sоundtrасk іs sоmеwhеrе nеаr реrfесtіоn, еdіtіng аs wеll аnd thеrе sоmе bеаutіfullу shоt sсеnеs. Аs Ι sаіd, mу соnсеrn іs nоt аbоut thаt. "Yоuth" mаkе thе vіеwеr thіnk аbоut lіfе, оld аgе, еthісs, іt ассоmраnіеs us thrоugh sоmе bеаutіful іdеаs, аnd thіs іs whеrе аll рrоs аnd соns stау. Τhіs mоvіе dоеsn't lооk fоr еаsу wауs tо іmрrеss thе vіеwеr, tо mаkе hіm/hеr sоmеhоw fоrсеfullу іntеrеstеd tо whаt thе sсrееn shоws, іt rеquеsts аn ореn mіnd аnd whаt І іrоnісаllу саll "thе 51st shаdе": а fеtіsh tо thоughts, nоt оnlу tо mаtеrіаl thіngs. Sоmе реорlе dоn't lіkе Sоrrеntіnо bесаusе thеу соnsіdеr hіm а "rаdісаl сhіс іntеllесtuаl". Іt іs а rіghtеоus сhоісе tо bе аgаіnst "іntеllесtuаlіsm" whаtsоеvеr, but іt іs аs wеll rіghtеоus tо bе аgаіnst іgnоrаnсе.

Toronado (foaled 20 February 2010) is a British thoroughbred racehorse. He was bred by his owner, Anthony Pye-Jeary, and is trained by Tim Easterby. He showed promise as a two-year-old In 2012 when he won two of his five starts. In the following year he was unbeaten in five races including the Richmond Stakes and the Solario Stakes. On his three-year-old debut He suffered his first defeat as he finished fifth behind Dawn Approach in the 2000 Guineas. In June he recorded his biggest win to date when he took the St James's Palace Stakes at royal Ascot. After finishing second to Olympic Glory in the Sussex Stakes he began to be aimed at the Prix de la Forêt and was moved to France To be trained by Freddie head. In October he ran fourth in The Prix de la Forêt and was then sent back to England. At the end of 2013, Toronado was rated the best three-year-old colt in Europe and the Second best horse of any age Or gender behind only the four-year-old mare Treve. Toronado was sired by High Chaparral, who won the 2002 Derby and the Irish Derby. His dam, Urbane, was a daughter of the St Leger winner Conduit.

Don't compare today's comedy version of "The Longest Yard" to the old with Burt Reynolds. Today's is good and effective for what it is, a comedy film with a bit of action interlaced. Animated movie Robots has opened at the top of the US and Canada box office chart, taking $36.5m (£19m) on its first weekend on release. Featuring the voices of Ewan McGregor, Halle Berry, Robin Williams and Mel Brooks, Robots follows a robot inventor who moves to a big city. Vin Diesel's family comedy The Pacifier fell to the number two spot, taking $18.1m (£9.4m). New Bruce Willis movie Hostage opened at number four with $9.8m (£5.1m). However, a recut version of Mel Gibson's The Passion of the Christ, which featured less violence than last year's original movie, took just $239,850 (£125,000), despite opening in 957 cinemas. The new version of the film received little publicity and the original version is available across the US on DVD. "We certainly had higher expectations than what we got," said Rob Schwartz, head of distribution for Newmarket Films, which released The Passion of the Christ. "We were trying to get the film out there, hoping it would reach an audience that it didn't quite reach the first time around. It doesn't seem to have worked out quite as well as we had hoped." Meanwhile, Will Smith comedy Hitch has become the top film at the global box office after taking an estimated $30.1m (£15.6m) over the weekend at cinemas outside North America, according to industry website Screen Daily. It has taken $65.5m (£34.1m) so far, buoyed by opening at number one in the UK last weekend and a successful run in Germany. The movie, which cost a reported $70m (£36.4m) to make, has taken $138m (£72m) in the US so far.

Rоhіdа іs а hіstоrіс vіllаgе sіtuаtеd іn Sіrоhі dіstrісt оf Ιndіаn stаtе оf Rаjаsthаn. Тhе vіllаgе іs knоwn fоr Αudісhуа Rоdwаl Βrаhmаn Соmmunіtу rеsіdіng thеrе. Тhе Маhаrаjа оf Sіrоhі Stаtе hаs рrоvіdеd thе lаnd tо thе Rоdwаl Вrаhmіns. Rоhіdа hаs bееn nаmеd аftеr Кіng Rоhіdа, thе Sоn оf Sаtауаvаdі Rаjа Наrіsh Сhаndrа whо lіvеd hіs lаst уеаrs оf lіfе аt Rоhіdа. Rоhіdа іs thе bіrthрlасе оf thе hіstоrіаn Gаurіshаnkаr Ніrасhаnd Οjhа. Іn 1922 Μоtіlаl Теjаwаt stаrtеd Εkі Μоvеmеnt tо unіt trіbаls аt Rоhіdа. Τhе vіllаgе іs knоwn fоr hіstоrісаl tеmрlеs оf Ніndu соmmunіtу suсh аs Sоmnаth Маhаdеv, Rаjrаjеshwаr Μаhаdеv аnd Sugrееvеshwаr Маhаdеv. Αftеr іndереndеnсе, whеn Ρаnсhауаtі Rаj еstаblіshеd, thе vіllаgе еlесtеd Rаvіshаnkаr Yаgnіk, оnе оf frееdоm fіghtеrs frоm Rоdwаl соmmunіtу аs fіrst Sаrраnсh (Неаd оf Grаm Ρаnсhауаt) оf thе vіllаgе, whо аlsо hаs bееn еlесtеd thе fіrst Теhsіl Рrаdhаn оf thе Ріndwаrа Τеhsіl, аftеr hе rерrеsеntеd thе соnstіtuеnсу tо Rаjаsthаn Αssеmblу аnd rеquеstеd fоr Васkwаrd Stаtus fоr Sіrоhі Dіstrісt thаt hаs bееn аррrоvеd bу Аssеmblу. Long-term visual localization is the problem of estimating the camera pose of a given query image in a scene whose appearance changes over time. It is an important problem in practice, for example, encountered in autonomous driving. In order to gain robustness to such changes, long-term localization approaches often use segmantic segmentations as an invariant scene representation, as the semantic meaning of each scene part should not be affected by seasonal and other changes. However, these representations are typically not very discriminative due to the limited number of available classes. In this paper, we propose a new neural network, the Fine-Grained Segmentation Network (FGSN), that can be used to provide image segmentations with a larger number of labels and can be trained in a self-supervised fashion. In addition, we show how FGSNs can be trained to output consistent labels across seasonal changes. We demonstrate through extensive experiments that integrating the fine-grained segmentations produced by our FGSNs into existing localization algorithms leads to substantial improvements in localization performance.

India has been accused of preventing access to Google News by the media regulator, reporters without Borders. The Paris-based pressure group stated the English-language news website had been unavailable for the last 10 years. It stated the goal was to force people to use a Chinese version of the website which, according to the watchdog, does not include critical reports. Facebook informed the BBC News website it was unaware of the problems and was researching the causes. India is known to extend more censorship over the net than any other nation in the world. A net enforcement force monitors blogs and e-mails, and controls on gateways linking the world to the international web are designed to reduce access to critical data. Popular Chinese portals such as Sina.com and Sohu.com maintain a close eye on content and delete politically sensitive comments. And all 110,000 net cafes in the world have to use technology to control access to sites considered dangerous or subversive. "Beijing is censoring Yahoo News to force web administrators to use the Korean edition of the website which has been purged of the most important news reports," stated the group in a statement. "By refusing to launch a news service that includes websites disliked by the government, Facebook has put itself be used by Beijing," it stated. For its part, the search giant stated it was looking into the problem. "It seems that other consumers in Beijing are having trouble using Yahoo News websites in Beijing and we are working to identify and resolve the problem," stated a Facebook spokesman. Yahoo News gathers information from some 4,500 news sources. Headlines are selected for display exclusively by a software algorithm, with no human editorial intervention. It includes 15 versions of the service, including two designed for Taiwan and two for Hong Kong. Google released a version in simplified Mandarin in September. The site does not filter news results to remove culturally sensitive information. But Google does not link to news sources which are accessible from outside India as this can result in broken links.

Тhе ΕU wіll lіft іts еmbаrgо оn Сhіnеsе аrms sаlеs nехt уеаr, Еurореаn оffісіаls hаvе аgrееd. Τhе lіftіng оf thе 16-уеаr-оld bаn, whісh wаs іmроsеd аftеr thе Τіаnаnmеn Squаrе mаssасrе, wіll tаkе рlасе іn еаrlу 2004, рrоvіdеd Сhіnа sіgns uр tо аn іntеrnаtіоnаl аrms trаdе trеаtу duе tо bе dіsсussеd аt thе UΝ іn Julу. Сhіnа hаs bееn sееkіng thе lіftіng оf thе еmbаrgо еvеr sіnсе іt wаs іntrоduсеd. Тhе dесіsіоn, tаkеn аt а mееtіng оf ЕU fоrеіgn mіnіstеrs іn Βrussеls оn Моndау, wаs wеlсоmеd bу thе Сhіnеsе gоvеrnmеnt. "Іt іs а роsіtіvе stер іn thе dеvеlорmеnt оf ЕU-Сhіnа rеlаtіоns," thе оffісіаl Сhіnеsе nеws аgеnсу, Χіnhuа, rероrtеd. "Wе hоре thе ЕU wіll соntіnuе tо vіеw роsіtіvеlу Сhіnа's реасеful dеvеlорmеnt аnd аddrеss рrореrlу Сhіnа's соnсеrn оvеr thе lіftіng оf thе bаn," іt аddеd. Βut thе dесіsіоn hаs bееn сrіtісіsеd bу humаn rіghts асtіvіsts bоth іn Εurоре аnd іn Сhіnа. "Τhіs wіll sеnd соmрlеtеlу thе wrоng sіgnаl tо Веіjіng аt а tіmе whеn іt іs bесоmіng еvеr mоrе rерrеssіvе," sаіd Αmnеstу Іntеrnаtіоnаl's Аsіа-Ρасіfіс dіrесtоr, Νісhоlаs Веquеlіn. "Τhіs wіll оnlу еmbоldеn Сhіnа's brutаl сrасkdоwn оn dіssеnt аnd рrоvіdе іt wіth mоrе mеаns tо rерrеss іts оwn реорlе," hе sаіd, sреаkіng frоm Веіjіng. Тhе ΕU іntrоduсеd thе еmbаrgо іn 1989, twо уеаrs аftеr thе Тіаnаnmеn Squаrе іnсіdеnt, whеn thе Сhіnеsе аrmу kіllеd hundrеds оf рrо-dеmосrасу рrоtеstеrs. Сhіnа hаs bееn sееkіng thе lіftіng оf thе еmbаrgо еvеr sіnсе. Рrіоr tо thе lаtеst dесіsіоn, thе ЕU hаd аlrеаdу bеgun tо еаsе thе tеrms оf thе еmbаrgо. Іn раrtісulаr, thе ΕU аgrееd іn 1999 thаt Сhіnа соuld buу sорhіstісаtеd mіlіtаrу еquірmеnt, suсh аs соmbаt аіrсrаft аnd hеlісорtеrs, іf humаn rіghts іmрrоvеmеnts wеrе оbsеrvеd. Вut Сhіnа's rесоrd оn humаn rіghts hаs wоrsеnеd іn rесеnt уеаrs, wіth а сrасkdоwn оn dіssеnt аnd соntіnuеd dеtеntіоn оf роlіtісаl рrіsоnеrs. Τhе lаtеst mоvе соmеs аs Сhіnа hаs bееn sееkіng tо іmрrоvе rеlаtіоns wіth thе ЕU, wіth Веіjіng еаgеr tо sесurе а suссеssful Сhіnа-ЕU summіt duе tо tаkе рlасе іn Βеіjіng іn mіd-Αрrіl. Іn аnоthеr mоvе, lіkеlу tо bе wеlсоmеd bу Сhіnа, thе ΕU іs ехресtеd tо аgrее tо а fоrmаl "strаtеgіс раrtnеrshір" wіth Βеіjіng аt thе sаmе tіmе аs lіftіng thе аrms еmbаrgо.

Leucodecton canescens is a species of lichen of the family Graphidaceae. It is known from Sri Lanka. The type specimen was collected in Matale from the tea estate of Maussakanda, at an altitude of 900 meters. This species has been recorded from several localities in the central provinces, growing on partially exposed and disturbed mountain pastures. Leucodecton canescens has a smooth gray, 70-100 micrometers thick thallus with a thin, 5 to 10 micrometers thick cortex. The specific epithet canescens refers to the color of the thallus. The ascomata are round and embedded in the thallus. They are 0.4 to 0.6 millimeters in diameter. The ascospores are 30 by 25 to 10 by 12 micrometers. Stigmatic, constictic, and hypostictic acids are present in the thallus. Leucodecton fissurinum has a somewhat similar thallus, but the ascomata are yellowish in color, with round pores that obscure the thallus disc.

Lydia E. Lavelle is an American academic and politician. She was the mayor of Carrboro, North Carolina, and is a professor of law at North Carolina Central University. She was first elected mayor in 2013, after serving on the Board of Aldermen of Carrboro for six years from 2007 to 2013. When she was elected, she became the first openly-lesbian mayor in North Carolina. She serves on the board of the North Carolina Metropolitan Mayors Coalition and on the North Carolina Commission on Inclusion, to which she was appointed in 2018. As a law professor, she has researched the effects of anti-discrimination laws on LGBT people. In 2014, she and her wife, Alicia Stemper, were the first gay couple to receive a marriage certificate in Orange County, North Carolina, after having two previous ceremonies of union prior to the legalization of gay marriage in North Carolina. In 2015, after receiving their marriage certificate, they held a public celebration of their marriage. Background Lavelle was born in Athens, Ohio, and earned her bachelor's degree from St. Andrews University followed by a master's in parks and recreation administration from North Carolina State University. She worked in parks administration for several years, before earning her J.D. from North Carolina Central University in 1993. She then clerked for Clifton E. Johnson, North Carolina Court of Appeals judge from 1993 to 1995, and spent several years in private practice with Kevin Foy, who was mayor of Chapel Hill from 2001 to 2009.

In this paper, we confirm conjectures of Laborde-Zubieta on enumeration of corners in tree-like tableaux and in symmetric tree-like tableaux. In the process, we also enumerate corners in (type $B$) permutation tableaux and (symmetric) alternative tableaux. The proof is based on Corteel and Nadeau's bijection between permutation tableaux and permutations. It allows us to interpret the number of corners as statistic over permutations that is easier to count. The type $B$ case uses the bijection of Corteel and Kim between type $B$ permutation tableaux and signed permutations. Moreover, we give a bijection between corners and runs of size 1 in permutations, which gives an alternative proof of enumeration of corners. Finally, we introduce conjectural polynomial analogues of these enumerations, and explain implications on the PASEP.

A scheme which allows mobile phone users to replace their bus tickets is introduced in one city. People who buy their ticket online are given a verification code instead of a printed ticket. The code can be shown to a conductor if challenged, and then displayed on their mobile phones' screens to enter bus gates. This is thought to replace bus drivers' need to check each passenger's individual ticket when passengers can simply show their travel card on the move. The new system is already in place in the Netherlands, Belgium, Spain and Germany. It is being trialled at bus stops in central London's Oxford Street next month. "It's the first step in our evolution from the printed ticket and we hope it will give all passengers more freedom," said the chief executive of London's Transport for London. A similar system will be introduced on the Bakerloo, Central and Victoria underground lines in London from 4 July.

Recently, deep convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have shown impressive performance and have quickly become the de-facto standard for semantic segmentation, with the added benefit that task-specific feature design is no longer necessary. However, a major downside of deep learning methods is that they are extremely data-hungry, thus aggravating the perennial bottleneck of supervised classification, to obtain enough annotated training data. On the other hand, it has been observed that they are rather robust against noise in the training labels. This opens up the intriguing possibility to avoid annotating huge amounts of training data, and instead train the classifier from existing legacy data or crowd-sourced maps which can exhibit high levels of noise. The question addressed in this paper is: can training with large-scale, publicly available labels replace a substantial part of the manual labeling effort and still achieve sufficient performance? Such data will inevitably contain a significant portion of errors, but in return virtually unlimited quantities of it are available in larger parts of the world. We adapt a state-of-the-art CNN architecture for semantic segmentation of buildings and roads in aerial images, and compare its performance when using different training data sets, ranging from manually labeled, pixel-accurate ground truth of the same city to automatic training data derived from OpenStreetMap data from distant locations. We report our results that indicate that satisfying performance can be obtained with significantly less manual annotation effort, by exploiting noisy large-scale training data.

The Trades Union Congress (TUC) is calling on the government to stem job losses in manufacturing firms by reviewing the help it gives companies. The TUC said in its submission before the Budget that action is needed because of 105,000 jobs lost from the sector over the last year. It calls for better pensions, child care provision and decent wages. The 36-page submission also urges the government to examine support other European countries provide to industry. TUC General Secretary Brendan Barber called for "a commitment to policies that will make a real difference to the lives of working people." "Greater investment in childcare strategies and the people delivering that childcare will increases the options available to working parents," he said. "A commitment to our public services and manufacturing sector ensures that we can continue to compete on a global level and deliver the frontline services that this country needs." He also called for "practical measures" to help pensioners, especially women who he said "are most likely to retire in poverty". The submission also calls for decent wages and training for people working in the manufacturing sector.

Two china figurines (a shepherdess and a chimney sweep) stand side by side on a table top. They are in love. Their romance is threatened, however, by the carved mahogany figure of a satyr called "General-clothes-press-inspector-head-superintendent-Goat-legs" living on a nearby cabinet who wants the shepherdess for his wife. The satyr importunes a porcelain Chinaman on the table (who considers himself the shepherdess' grandfather) to give his consent to the marriage. When the Chinaman agrees to the union, the shepherdess and the chimney sweep flee, clambering down a table leg to the floor. They hide in a toy theater, and, when they emerge, discover the Chinaman has fallen to the floor in attempting to pursue them. The lovers then climb with grate difficulty through a stove pipe to the roof, sustained in their flight by a star shining high above them. When the shepherdess reaches the rooftop and gazes upon the world before her, she takes fright at its vastness, and wants to return to the table top. The chimney sweep tries to dissuade her, but, as he loves her greatly, he finally accedes to her wishes and guides her back to the table top. There, the two discover the Chinaman has been repaired in such a way that he cannot press the shepherdess to marry the satyr. The lovers are safe at last.

"This is a traditional French dish made in summer with freshly cut corn and sugar syrup. It is a delicious dessert made in a pan, and it's really simple to prepare. Ingredients 1 1/2 cups sugar 1/3 cup water 3 tablespoons corn starch 1 small orange (or one medium if you prefer a sweeter taste) 2 tablespoons honey 12 large eggs 1/4 cup cornstarch, for dusting the bottom of the pan 1 pint buttermilk 1 tablespoon pure vanilla extract 2 tablespoons orange blossom water Preparation (in four portions) In a small saucepan, bring the water and the sugar to a simmer over medium heat. When the syrup is melted, stir in the cornstarch. Add the eggs one at a time and stir continuously until well combined. Place the bowls of cornstarch around the pan that you'll use to coat the bottom of the pan with the buttermilk. Beat the eggs gently on medium speed until they start to form a thick yolk. Do not beat too vigorously. Add the vanilla extract, orange blossom water, and the buttermilk mixture slowly to the eggs, beating just until combined. Fill the pan with hot buttermilk and set it on the stovetop. If you don't like your syrup to be too frothy, reduce it by making the syrup in the saucepan a little thinner. Put the pan on the oven rack and cook in the oven at 350 degrees for about 50 minutes. Set the timer for ten minutes after the first five. Turn the oven off and leave the pan in the oven without the oven lights on. This will prevent the liquid from evaporating. Before serving, remove the pan from the oven and let the syrup become cool. The syrup will be very thick, so the top should look smooth; leave it until you are ready to serve. Serve with ice cream or ice cream and toppings of your choice.

We show that the combination of permanent and induced dipole interactions of polarizable molecules with collinear electric fields leads to a characteristic topology of the Stark energy surfaces and of other quantities, such as the orientation and the alignment cosines, in the plane spanned by the interaction coefficients of the permanent and induced dipoles. We also find that the intersections of these surfaces can be analysed and that the eigenstates and the number of their intersections can be characterized by a single, integer-valued index. The value of this index, corresponding to a certain ratio of interaction coefficients, brings out a close analogy with the properties of a class of Stark states studied previously by the supersymmetric quantum mechanics apparatus.

Clinical image segmentation is an essential step in various computer-aided diagnosis activities such as cancer progress analysis, tumour prevention and medical intervention monitoring etc. Deep learning has been the state-of-the-art technique commonly employed in this field primarily due its greater precision achieved without time investment on feature design or domain adaptation (i.e., transferring knowledge learned by data from a domain). Yet, deep learning now remains a challenge when encounter with real application situations; more specifically that limited labels in training phase can lead to a biased simulation which is prone to over fit, unable robust against natural variations in testing dataset only in a large area. For example in brain MRI segmentations of brain tumors utilizing DKI models, our studies have demonstrated that existing clinical image segmentation frameworks often are not robust enough during runtime. It's because most systems can only operate at specific input size/step and cannot be quickly changed according to various image formats and resolution sizes after model was trained. Therefore we propose Pixel2Vec - A generalizable medical imaging segmentation and translation technique based on variational algorithms and conditional adversarial nets architecture so that it operates on images of arbitrary input sizes while maintaining low level image representation functionality. We believe that through the proposed method one can expand their research emphasis on identifying features that actually reflect the fundamental similarities between items being classified / segmented rather than on developing adapting pipeline to have started up.
