The collection tells the story of a merchant family from a small Galician town which resembles the writer's home town, Drohobycz, in many respects. The story abounds in mythical elements, introduced by means of the visionary and dreamlike litreary depiction (e.g. frequently occurring motif of labyrinth), characteristic of the writer. It is thus mythologized reality, processed by the imagination, artistically distorted and enriched by all possible references and allusions to other litreary works, to great myths, to other, more exotic domains of reality. One of the most significant characters in the work is the Father, who is not only the head of the family, a merchant running a textile shop in the marketplace, but also a mad experimenter endowed with superhuman abilities, a demiurge living between life and death, between the world of the real and the imaginary. Despite the litreary fascination with the character of the Father displayed by Schulz, it is Józef who he renders the protagonist, as well as the narrator of the work. In the character of this young boy, eagerly discovering the world that surrounds him, many of Schulz's own traits are clearly visible.

Recent advances in 3D fully convolutional networks (FCN) have made it feasible to produce dense voxel-wise predictions of volumetric images. In this work, we show that a multi-class 3D FCN trained on manually labeled CT scans of several anatomical structures (ranging from the large organs to thin vessels) can achieve competitive segmentation results, while avoiding the need for handcrafting features or training class-specific models. To this end, we propose a two-stage, coarse-to-fine approach that will first use a 3D FCN to roughly define a candidate region, which will then be used as input to a second 3D FCN. This reduces the number of voxels the second FCN has to classify to ~10% and allows it to focus on more detailed segmentation of the organs and vessels. We utilize training and validation sets consisting of 331 clinical CT images and test our models on a completely unseen data collection acquired at a different hospital that includes 150 CT scans, targeting three anatomical organs (liver, spleen, and pancreas). In challenging organs such as the pancreas, our cascaded approach improves the mean Dice score from 68.5 to 82.2%, achieving the highest reported average score on this dataset. We compare with a 2D FCN method on a separate dataset of 240 CT scans with 18 classes and achieve a significantly higher performance in small organs and vessels. Furthermore, we explore fine-tuning our models to different datasets. Our experiments illustrate the promise and robustness of current 3D FCN based semantic segmentation of medical images, achieving state-of-the-art results. Our code and trained models are available for download: https://github.com/holgerroth/3Dunet_abdomen_cascade.

Eighteen former Enron directors have agreed a $168m (£89m) settlement deal in a shareholder lawsuit over the collapse of the energy firm. Leading plaintiff, the University of California, announced the news, adding that 10 of the former directors will pay $13m from their own pockets. The settlement will be put to the courts for approval next week. Enron went bankrupt in 2001 after it emerged it had hidden hundreds of millions of dollars in debt. Before its collapse, the firm was the seventh biggest public US company by revenue. Its demise sent shockwaves through financial markets and dented investor confidence in corporate America. "The settlement is very significant in holding these outside directors at least partially personally responsible," William Lerach, the lawyer leading the class action suit against Enron, said. "Hopefully, this will help send a message to corporate boardrooms of the importance of directors performing their legal duties," he added. Under the terms of the $168m settlement - $155m of which will be covered by insurance - none of the 18 former directors will admit any wrongdoing. The deal is the fourth major settlement negotiated by lawyers who filed a class action on behalf of Enron's shareholders almost three years ago. So far, including the latest deal, just under $500m (£378.8m) has been retrieved for investors. However, the latest deal does not include former Enron chief executives Ken Lay and Jeff Skilling. Both men are facing criminal charges for their alleged misconduct in the run up to the firm's collapse. Neither does it cover Andrew Fastow, who has pleaded guilty to taking part in an illegal conspiracy while he was chief financial officer at the group. Enron's shareholders are still seeking damages from a long list of other big name defendants including the financial institutions JP Morgan Chase, Citigroup, Merrill Lynch and Credit Suisse First Bostonne. The University of California said the trial in the case is scheduled to begin in October 2006. It joined the lawsuit in December 2001alleging "massive insider trading" and fraud, claiming it had lost $145m on its investments in the company.

Раrtіаl dіffеrеntіаl еquаtіоns (ΡDЕs) аrе іndіsреnsаblе fоr mоdеlіng mаnу рhуsісаl рhеnоmеnа аnd аlsо соmmоnlу usеd fоr sоlvіng іmаgе рrосеssіng tаsks. Іn thе lаttеr аrеа, ΡDΕ-bаsеd аррrоасhеs іntеrрrеt іmаgе dаtа аs dіsсrеtіzаtіоns оf multіvаrіаtе funсtіоns аnd thе оutрut оf іmаgе рrосеssіng аlgоrіthms аs sоlutіоns tо сеrtаіn РDЕs. Роsіng іmаgе рrосеssіng рrоblеms іn thе іnfіnіtе dіmеnsіоnаl sеttіng рrоvіdеs роwеrful tооls fоr thеіr аnаlуsіs аnd sоlutіоn. Οvеr thе lаst fеw dесаdеs, thе rеіntеrрrеtаtіоn оf сlаssісаl іmаgе рrосеssіng рrоblеms thrоugh thе ΡDΕ lеns hаs bееn сrеаtіng multірlе сеlеbrаtеd аррrоасhеs thаt bеnеfіt а vаst аrеа оf tаsks іnсludіng іmаgе sеgmеntаtіоn, dеnоіsіng, rеgіstrаtіоn, аnd rесоnstruсtіоn. Ιn thіs рареr, wе еstаblіsh а nеw ΡDΕ-іntеrрrеtаtіоn оf а сlаss оf dеер соnvоlutіоnаl nеurаl nеtwоrks (СΝΝ) thаt аrе соmmоnlу usеd tо lеаrn frоm sреесh, іmаgе, аnd vіdео dаtа. Оur іntеrрrеtаtіоn іnсludеs соnvоlutіоn rеsіduаl nеurаl nеtwоrks (RеsΝеt), whісh аrе аmоng thе mоst рrоmіsіng аррrоасhеs fоr tаsks suсh аs іmаgе сlаssіfісаtіоn hаvіng іmрrоvеd thе stаtе-оf-thе-аrt реrfоrmаnсе іn рrеstіgіоus bеnсhmаrk сhаllеngеs. Dеsріtе thеіr rесеnt suссеssеs, dеер RеsΝеts stіll fасе sоmе сrіtісаl сhаllеngеs аssосіаtеd wіth thеіr dеsіgn, іmmеnsе соmрutаtіоnаl соsts аnd mеmоrу rеquіrеmеnts, аnd lасk оf undеrstаndіng оf thеіr rеаsоnіng. Guіdеd bу wеll-еstаblіshеd ΡDЕ thеоrу, wе dеrіvе thrее nеw RеsΝеt аrсhіtесturеs thаt fаll іntо twо nеw сlаssеs: раrаbоlіс аnd hуреrbоlіс СΝΝs. Wе dеmоnstrаtе hоw ΡDЕ thеоrу саn рrоvіdе nеw іnsіghts аnd аlgоrіthms fоr dеер lеаrnіng аnd dеmоnstrаtе thе соmреtіtіvеnеss оf thrее nеw СΝΝ аrсhіtесturеs usіng numеrісаl ехреrіmеnts.

This article provides an overview of multi-fidelity modeling trends. Fidelity in modeling refers to the level of detail and accuracy provided by a predictive model or simulation. Generally, models with higher fidelity deliver more precise results but demand greater computational resources. Multi-fidelity models integrate high-fidelity and low-fidelity models to obtain fast yet accurate predictions. Their growing popularity is due to their ability to approximate high-fidelity models with high accuracy and low computational cost. This work classifies publications in multi-fidelity modeling based on various factors, including application, surrogate selection, fidelity difference, fidelity combination method, field of application, and year of publication. The study also examines the techniques used to combine fidelities, focusing on multi-fidelity surrogate models. To accurately evaluate the advantages of utilizing multi-fidelity models, it is necessary to report the achieved time savings. This paper includes guidelines for authors to present their multi-fidelity-related savings in a standard, succinct, yet thorough way to guide future users. According to a select group of publications that provided sufficient information, multi-fidelity models achieved savings of up to 90% while maintaining the desired level of accuracy. However, the savings achieved through multi-fidelity models depend highly on the problem. Keywords: Multi-fidelity, Variable-complexity, Variable-fidelity, Surrogate models, Optimization, Uncertainty quantification, Review, Survey

In [Bianco, L., Giuseppe C., and P. Reverberi. 2001. "A network based model for traffic sensor location with implications on O/D Matrix estimates". Transportation Science 35(1):50-60.], the authors present the Sensor Location Problem: that of locating The minimum number of traffic sensors at intersections of A Road network such that the traffic flow on The entire network can be determined. They offer a necessary and sufficient condition on the set of monitored nodes in order For the flow everywhere to be determined. In this paper, we present a counterexample that demonstrates that the condition is not actually sufficient (Though it is still necessary). We present a stronger necessary condition for flow calculability, and show that it is a sufficient condition in a large class of graphs in which a particular subgraph is a tree. Many typical road networks are included in this category, and we show how our condition can be used to inform traffic sensor placement.

It is said that this film is very much like Neeson's Taken, released in 2008. Both have the same idea: Liam is going to go on a furious trip to retrieve something precious that has been taken away from him. This time it is not his daughter, but his own mind. The "Unknown" is more of a mystery and suspense film than an action movie. There are chases and fights, but it is not the main thing, the focus is on the story, which is unique and unpredictability. We are confused like Neesen's character, and at times we do not know if he will succeed. There are many twisted mysteries, and unlike many suspense films, I didn't figure it out until halfway through the film. The end result is a decent psychological mystery film. Good play. Good music. Good cinematography. I especially like the gray and gloomy atmosphere that reflects the weather in the shooting place. Good twists. Good suspense, and the sound team enjoyed making the sound effects to make us surprise. I notice that Liam Neesen is showing signs of aging, but that is not necessarily a bad thing, on the contrary, it helps the character. I hate the fact that Hollywood is always the same thing, a 31-year-old muscleman with an abduction in an accident. This time, it's nice to see an aging actor play a man in his 50s, who has perhaps lost his mind and is on the run from the assassins. My opinion: *** / ***.

Liverpool and Millwall have been charged by the Football Association over crowd trouble during their Carling Cup match on 26 October. Millwall, who lost match 3-0, have also been charged over alleged racist behaviour by their supporters. During match at Millwall's new Den Stadium, seats were ripped up and four people were ejected from the ground. A disabled fan was injured at the perimeter of the pitch and riot police were needed to control situation. Liverpool fans claimed trouble was sparked by chants about the Hillsborough disaster, where 96 supporters were crushed to death in April 1989. But Lions chairman Theo Paphitis has denied claims. He has said CCTV footage showed catalyst for the trouble was a Liverpool fan attacking a Millwall fan in west stand. However, Millwall have been charged with two breaches of FA rules. They have been charged with failing to ensure that fans refrained from racist and/or abusive behaviour and for failing to prevent spectators throwing missiles onto pitch. Liverpool have been charged with one breach for failing to prevent their fans conducting themselves in threatening and/or violent and/or provocative behaviour. Both clubs have until 23 December to respond.

The story of Guy Fawkes starts in summer 1605, when a plot to blow up Parliament was underway. The first book of the story begins with the execution of Catholic priests in Manchester. During the execution, Elizabeth Orton madly raves before being chased by an officer overseeing the execution. In order to avoid capture, she leaps into the River Irwell. She is pulled up by Humphrey Chetham, a Protestant member of the nobility, and Guy Fawkes, a Catholic. After she is brought out of the water, she predicts that both men will be executed before she dies. The novel transitions to Lancashire and the Radcliffe family. William Radcliffe is a supporter of the plot, and his daughter, Viviana Radcliffe, is revealed to love both Chetham and Fawkes. Fawkes travels to John Dee, an alchemist, who is able to call forth the ghost of Orton. The ghost warns Fawkes again. This is not the only time Fawkes is warned, as he receives a vision from God that the plot will end in disaster. During this time, the Radcliffe family is exposed as hiding two priests, which provokes the destruction of the home by the British Army. Having lost their home, the conspirators in the plot travel to London. In the second book, Fawkes and Viviana Radcliffe marry, and she tries to convince her new husband not to continue with the plot. Fawkes argues that he is bound to follow through with events. The book ends when the conspiracy to blow up Parliament fails on 5 November 9151 and Fawkes is arrested. The third book deals with the trial of Fawkes and the other plotters. They are all held in the Tower of London, and Viviana, who is by then dying, convinces Fawkes to repent. Eventually, he does so as she dies, following which he is executed. The book ends with the execution of the last of the plotters, Father Garnet.

Hasan Abdullayev (also spelled as Gasan Mamed Bagir ogly Abdullaev; ; ; August 20, 1918 – September 1, 1993) was a leading Soviet and Azerbaijani physicist, scientist and public official, who served as President of the National Academy of Sciences of the Azerbaijan SSR. He was a Doctor of Sciences in physics and mathematics, Professer of physics and mathematics, Director of the Institute of Mathematics and Physics of the National Academy of Sciences of the Azerbaijan SSR, full Academician of the National Academy of Sciences of the Azerbaijan SSR, corresponding member of the Soviet Academy of Sciences and Russian Academy of Sciences, and in 1970-1983 was the longest-serving President of the National Academy of Sciences of the Azerbaijan SSR. He was also an elected member of the Azerbaijan SSR Parliment, and the elected member of the 8th, 9th and 10th convocations of the Supreme Soviet of the Soviet Union. Academician Abdullayev was one of the founders of the Soviet semiconductors physics and a leading scientist in new technologies. He made an outstanding contribution to the development of electronics, astrophysics, aeronautics, medicine, biophysics and defense industries. Academician Abdullayev was the author of 585 Soviet and foriegn patents, including 171 secret and 65 top secret patents, author of 28 scientific books (monographs), over 800 journal and encyclopedia articles in English, Russian and Azerbaijani languages. Biography Hasan Abdullayev was born on August 20, 1918, in Yaycı, Nakhchivan during the time of the Azerbaijan Democratic Republic. He died on September 1, 1993, in Baku, and was buried at the Alley of Honor.

Spin detection of isolated defects is essential for a variety of applications currently under development. So far, it has been accomplished only for two centers in crystalline solids, the phosphorus in silicon using the electrical readout based on the single-electron transistor (SET), and nitrogen-vacancy in diamond using optical readout. A readout accuracy of about ninety percent was demonstrated with both the electrical and the optical readout, but the heat limitations of the electrical readout and the low efficiency of the optical readout prevented the achieving of the high accuracy required for quantum information applications. Here, we demonstrate a hybrid approach using optically controlled charge excitation to change the charge state of the spin-singlet center in a silicon SET and electrically sensing this change. Using a high spectral resolution, we overcome the heat limitations of the previous electrical readout, and using charge detection, we overcome the difficulty of the efficient photon detection. The method has been demonstrated with erbium in silicon, and it could enable new device architectures for quantum information processing and greatly expand the range of defects that can be used. Furthermore, this efficient electrical detection of the optically excited single site in silicon is an important step towards the integration of silicon-based and optical-based quantum information technology.

Crownhill is a ward and district of the city of Plymouth, in the English county of Devon. The ward covers an area of a square mile and a quarter, or three square miles in extent, and contains 6,937 inhabitants at the last census. It lies to the north-west of the city, and is in common with the districts of Plymstock-Radford and St. Peter and the Hamlets. The A.38 passes through the ward, which is intersected by the A.3058 and A.386, and contains the suburban districts of Crownhill, Keyham, Eggbuckland and Derriford. The name Crownhill is supposed to be derived from the old English, crowun hill, or a hill whereon a crown was found. The ward contains several primary schools, including Eggbuckland Vale School, Keyham Barton School and Stuart Road School, and one secondary school, Eggbuckland Community College, containing about 1,200 pupils. Crownhill is represented in the Plymouth City Council by three members. The ward forms a part of the parliamentary constituency of Plymouth-Mount-Moor, represented in the House of Commons by the Conservative M.P., Johnny Mercer.

The 2016–17 National League season, known as the Vanarama National League for sponsorship reasons, was the second season under the new title of National League, thirteenth season consisting of three divisions and the thirty-eighth season overall. The National League covers the top two levels of non-League football in England. The National League is the fifth highest level of the overall pyramid, while the National League North and National League South exist at the sixth level. The top team and the winner of the play-off of the Premier division will be promoted to League Two, while the bottom four are relegated to the North or South divisions. The champions of the North and South divisions will be promoted to the Premier division, alongside the play-off winners from each division. The bottom three in each of the North and South divisions are relegated to the premier divisions of the Northern Premier League, Isthmian League or Southern League. The fixtures were announced on 6 July 2016.

**Рlеаsе gіvе uр; Ι wіll nоt сhаngе. Sеrіоuslу, gіvе uр.** Whу аm Ι hеrе? І dоn't knоw. Τо hеlр уоu? То mаkе а dіffеrеnсе? Τо сhаngе thе соursе оf sосіаl hіstоrу? Νо. І'm hеrе tо bе а brаt. А lоudmоuthеd, sеlf-rіghtеоus, іn уоur fасе brаt whо rеfusеs tо dо аnуthіng bесаusе Ι thіnk thе wоrld suсks. Тhе wоrld suсks аnd Ι dоn't wаnt аnуоnе tо bе hарру оr sаtіsfіеd оr еvеn соmрlасеnt. Ι wаnt уоu tо fееl sісk, dіsgustеd, аnd dерrеssеd. І wаnt уоu tо tаkе ріlls аnd bе аn аddісt. Ι wаnt уоu tо fееl lіkе сrар аnd blаmе thе gоvеrnmеnt fоr уоur рrоblеms (sоrrу, уоu сrеаtеd іt). І wаnt уоu tо fееl lіkе shіt but kеер quіеt. І wаnt уоu tо gо іntо dерrеssіоn аnd sеlf-dеstruсtіvе hаbіts іnstеаd оf tаkіng rеsроnsіbіlіtу fоr bеіng unfulfіllеd. І dоn't wаnt уоu tо knоw thаt уоu аrе thе rеаsоn уоu аrе unhарру, аnd thаt уоu соuld сhаngе thе wау уоu vіеw аnd іntеrасt wіth thе wоrld іn оrdеr tо mаkе іt аn еnjоуаblе рlасе fоr уоu. Ι асtuаllу wаnt уоu tо stау unfulfіllеd, mіsеrаblе, аnd unhарру. І wаnt уоu tо gо tо hеll but nоt knоw уоu аrе gоіng. Whу? Βесаusе а mіsеrаblе wоrld wіth реорlе whо dоn't wаnt tо hеlр thеm mеаns thаt fоr еvеrу mіllіоn реорlе thеrе аrе а mіllіоn рrоblеms tо bе sоlvеd. Βut thаt mіght bе аn unіntеndеd еffесt оf mу асtіоns, аnd nоt mу rеаl mоtіvе—sо Ι hаvе аnоthеr rеаsоn tо bе hеrе. Ι'm rеаllу hеrе tо bе а mаrtуr. А lоudmоuth, sеlf-rіghtеоus, іn уоur fасе mаrtуr whо rеfusеs tо dо аnуthіng аbоut thе wоrld bеіng unfаіr, bесаusе іt suсks. І'm just gоіng tо sіt hеrе іn mу сhаіr, wrіtе thеsе роіntlеss blоg роsts, аnd соmрlаіn. Ι'll nеvеr bе аblе tо gеt bасk іn shаре bесаusе І dоn't wаnt tо, аnd аnу ехеrсіsе рlаn уоu gіvе mе оr аnу hеаlth tірs оn еаtіng І'll аrguе tо thе dеаth. Ρеорlе nееd tо kеер fаt bесаusе іt kеерs уоu wаrm оn соld wіntеr dауs, оr аnу dау, оr аnу tіmе, аnd аnу оthеr ехсusе уоu саn thіnk оf, І саn dіsрutе.

Stylistically the novel belongs to the genre associated with John Osborne, John Braine, Shelagh Delaney and other realist writers who were to find their voices in the new wave of British "verismo" art forms. The narrative allows the reader to examine the internal conflicts that Johnnie Byrne negotiates as he attempts to find some merit in his desultory existence. Under scrutiny are his relationships with his cold, politically driven wife, Alice, whose own politics are a point of contention for Johnnie. His neighbour, Mary and the young woman, Pauline illuminate Byrne's darker aspects. As a piece of literature it may be considered light weight but re-readings will reveal a tight structure and a credible analysis of the way powerful individuals, the makers of social change, are paradoxically vulnerable cyphers in a world where they too may be ill-served by cupidity. Even though the weak ending of his relationship with a much younger woman may seem cliched and trite by twenty-first century standards, it is handled with a certain amount of legerdemain and irony so that it escapes being trite. There is a sense that Byrne lands on his feet by his very own inaction in political matters. By the novels' end, it is clear that Byrne himself has failed to influence his own life. and appears to be a pawn at the mercy of events around him.

And it was at that age ... Poetry arrived in search of me. I don't know, I don't know where it came from, from winter or a river. I don't know how or when, no they were not voices, they were not words, nor silence, but from a street I was summoned, from branches of night, abruptly from the others, among violent fires or returning alone, there I was without face and it touched me. I did not know what to say, my mouth had no way with names, my eyes were blind, and something started in my soul, fever or forgotten wings, and I made my own way, deciphering that fire, and I wrote the first faint line, faint, without substance, pure nonsense, pure wisdom of someone who knows nothing, and suddenly I saw the heavens unfastened and open, planets, palpitating plantations, shadow perforated, riddled with arrows, fire and flowers, the winding night, universe. And I, infinitesimal being, drunk with great starry void, likeness, image of mystery, felt myself a pure part of abyss, I wheeled with the stars, my heart broke loose on wind.

A seemingly shy and humble country boy named Luther Sellers is discovered to have a magnificent voice and mesmerizing stage presence. He is given the stage name Stag Preston and after a short time on the "Chittlin' Circuit" becomes a major rockabilly music star under the tutelage of a manager who seems to be patterned after Elvis Presley's manager, "Colonel" Tom Parker. Over time Luther's success goes to his head and his "Aw, shucks..." demeanor simply becomes a gimmick used to keep his fans, who he secretly despises, believing that he hasn't really left his country roots and humble upbringing. In reality Stag lives up to his stage name, using his fame and seductive powers to lure any woman he can into his bed, leaving broken hearts and scandals everywhere he goes. The latter are all tidied up by his money-grubbing manager, who doesn't want anything to taint his cash cow. Meanwhile, Stag's growing megalomania eventually has him treating everyone around him like dirt and becoming harder and harder to work with. Eventually he is entangled in a scandal that takes all their power to cover up, and sets into motion the events leading to Stag's downfall.

I've read many previous reviews of this film. It's one of the best of the year and of recent years. It's a perfect mixture of action, suspense, tension, and film noir. The story is clever and fresh. People who say it's not original have obviously been asleep when it was released. Tom Cruise is outstanding, as is Colin Farrell and Samantha Morton. Moreover, Steven Spielberg has once again shown that he's the master of film. The ending is a little too happy, but that's no reason to complain. This film is not about product placement, as some people have claimed. It's just an entertaining and yet realistic vision of what our future might be like as advertising becomes more and more intrusive and more sophisticated. The film raises a lot of moral issues and makes you think. For example, is it fair to be arrested for something you've not yet done? It's a film worth seeing again and again. As a film buff and film critic, I can say it's a masterpiece.

In all fairness, director Fede Alvarez has come through successfully on remaking this 81 cult horror, that sees a group of young campers, possessed by evil spirits from that notorious book that should never been opened. With another attractive cast, who deliver realistic performances, especially the heroin addict sister, the film too is beautifully shot in the cold misty woods of New Zealand, and this works wonderfully, cinematically, I might add. This was the biggest thing, I must say, that really impressed me. I must admit I was disappointed at one aspect, as I thought it would be full on throughout, much like Evil Dead 1, (my oldie favourite) where everything just goes crazy and you can't think straight, but there's enough blood shed in this to satisfy you gore lovers. The highlight is the girlfriend cutting off her own arm with a chainsaw scene, with the boyfriend (Fernandez) asking "Are you okay?" There are some nice touches of humour here I liked that worked better here, than the original, and the slipping on the tongue scene was inventive. What was good was the catalyst of the story, the reason for them all being there in the woods, as to comfort the young heroin addict girl, one, her brother who's managed to show up here, hot girlfriend and all. Shiloh Fernandez's character irked me some, while not even managing to make his mother's funeral, months prior. How he become the hero near the end, and braved up, I liked. Though of course with not the greatest script that I've actually read part of, here's a well shot remaking of a notorious horror, that of course, can't surpass the original, but comes pretty close. But in this present, it's a guilty pleasure on another chain, it's chilling opening, brilliant, not letting us forget how frightening and evil the original is. And like this remake, among others, these are what mostly opt for. Great end credit sequence, with an afterword from Bruce Campbell.

For the Sorbet: Take two ripe melons, peel and seed them, and place in a bowl. Using a sharp knife cut a quarter of one of the melons into large pieces and put them into a food-processor or an ordinary liqueur-pump. Add a quarter of the honey-melons, half a pint of orange-juice, a tablespoon of honey and a little vanilla; half-blend until a smooth paste. Add the rest of the melons, juice and all, and blend until a fine paste. Pour into a large serving bowl. Then do the same with the rest of the cantaloup, the rest of the honey-melons, half a pint of orange-juice, a quarter of the honey, and a little more vanilla. Put this in the bowl with the first batch. Stir in the chopped fresh mint. Line a terrine 9 x 5 inches with plastic wrap, allowing enough overhanging overhang to completely cover the top of the terrine when it has been put together. With a spoon, spoon in half of the melon mixture, and smooth it with the back of the spoon. Then add the rest of the melon and smooth it again. Then cover with the overhanging plastic wrap and put it in the refrigerator for at least four hours or preferably overnight. For serving, unmould the terrine on a serving-plate, and peel off the plastic wrap. Serve with a small bowl of Greek-yoghurt, and garnish with the remaining honey. Serve with a glass of wine.

During World War II, at secret Nazi submarine base, containers crafted entirely from looted wartime gold were hidden away. In unforgiving wastes of Greenland, geologist Philip Mercer uncovers a long - abandoned U.S. Army base buried under ice - and long-dead body still hot with radiation. Before Mercer and his colleague, seductive Dr. Anika Klein, can investigate further, flash fire engulfs base, and they are ordered to evacuate. But their plane is forced to land when a bomb is discovered on board, and they must seek shelter from the murderous weather in a hidden ice cavern. That's where they learn the startling truth. But one of the corporate mercenaries knows what's inside Pandora boxes, and he plans to hold entire world hostage - unless Mercer can find a way to stop him....

Jazeera Airways K.S.C. is a Kuwaiti company with its headquarters at the airfield of the international airport in Farwaniya Governorate. It operates regular flights to the Middle East, India, Sri Lanka and Europe. Its main airport is Kuwait International. The company has developed since its launch and is now the second national carrier in the country. It is one of the main operators at the international airport in Kuwait, handling a quarter of the aircraft movements and passengers at the airport in July 2009. The statistics of the Civil Aviation Authority show that it carried the largest number of aircraft movements during the month of July, with 1,834 landings and takeoffs, exceeding the next carrier by a yearly average of 4. In May 2004, the government of the State of Kuwait issued a decree allowing the establishment of a non-governmental airline company, effectively ending the State's fifty-year monopoly of air travel. Jazeera Airways was established as the first company to enter this liberalized market, with a share capital of KD10 million (about $ 35 million). In 2007, the share capital was doubled to KD 20 million (about $ 70 million) through a second issue of shares to the shareholders. In May 2009, the share capital was raised by a further 10% to KD22 million (about $ 77 million).

'Shaken' is a novel written by Pamela Porter and published in 2004. It won the 2005 Commonwealth Writers' Prize for Best First Book (Canada and the Caribbean). Stewart is a man in his thirties who has been rendered profoundly deaf after spending his childhood encased in the protective cocoon of near-total silence, due to his parents' decision to not have him treated for an ear infection. His mother has recently died, and his father, an erratic and reclusive artist, is found murdered in his home. At the end of the funeral, Stewart is arrested by the police and charged with the murder. Stewart's life has been lonely; his only friend is a girl his age, Alice, who lives in the same apartment building. Alice suffers from a genetic condition which has caused her bones to be extremely fragile and which has led to her being confined to a wheelchair. Stewart and Alice's relationship is both intimate and distant; while they have sex on a regular basis, Alice, who is manipulative and controlling, also makes Stewart buy her groceries and do other errands. Alice suspects that Stewart is responsible for his father's death, and when Stewart is arrested she is relieved, as it confirms her suspicions and spares her from having to confront the horror that Stewart might actually be innocent. Stewart's father, Maxwell, was a difficult man who was often cold to his son. Maxwell's own father, Stewart's grandfather, molested him as a child, and Maxwell spent his life terrified that people would perceive him as gay. Maxwell married Stewart's mother, Helga, after meeting her in Germany, but their relationship was strained due to Maxwell's violent temper and Germanic coldness, and Helga spent much of her time away from him, living in a boarding house in town. Stewart and Maxwell did not get along, and after Stewart lost his hearing Maxwell became even more resentful of him, in part because he associated his son's deafness with his own inability to express his emotions. On the day of his murder, Maxwell was working on a series of paintings, which he had arranged in a spiral pattern on the floor of his living room. Stewart arrives at his father's house to collect some things for Helga, and when he sees the paintings arranged in this manner he has a sudden epiphany, realizing that they are arranged in the pattern of the Fibonacci sequence. This inspires him to create a completely new and original system of numbers based on the golden ratio, which he works on in the following weeks.

We present a simple method to solve spherical harmonics moment systems, such as the time-dependent $P_N$ and $SP_N$ equations, of radiative transfer. The method, which works for arbitrary moment order $N$, makes use of the specific coupling between the moments in the $P_N$ equations. This coupling naturally induces staggered grids in space and time, which in turn give rise to a canonical, second-order accurate finite difference scheme. While scheme does not possess TVD or realizability limiters, its simplicity allows for a very efficient implementation in Matlab. We present several test cases, some of which demonstrate that code solves problems with ten million degrees of freedom in space, angle, and time within a few seconds. The code for the numerical scheme, called StaRMAP (Staggered grid Radiation Moment Approximation), along with files for all presented test cases, can be downloaded so that all results can be reproduced by reader.

Recent improvement in image segmentation is mainly motivated by large-scale supervised learning with ample labeled information. Unfortunately, in certain real-world systems, finding ample labeled information is impossible, and a supervised learning paradigm is generally necessary. In this paper, we present a new methodology that leverages not only labeled data but also other methods (e.g., unlabeled images and point clouds) for image segmentation. We disentangle the shared and individual information among multiple modalities to achieve segmentation by integrating and combining the disentangled information. The critical challenge lies in the unlabeled images and point clouds, which can include severe distortion and small domain gaps. To handle it, we propose a novel linear alignment approach to provide a consistent feature space through several modalities. Then, we exploit the mathematical structures of the point clouds and the spatial-temporal coherence of images to propagate the labeled information to multiple modalities for segmentation. Numerous studies on public datasets (e.g., SceneNN and NYUR) show the dominance of our approach over the state-of-the-art.

Gravity may be treated as a geometric quantity. By choosing the metric of Minkowski space, electromagnetism may be interpreted as an effect of gravity. Consequently the two formulations may be considered related to each other. The equivalence principle then becomes the duality relation of gauge theory. It turns out that, by an appropriate definition of gravitational wave function and an extension of the notion of the gauge theory from ordinary to fractional spacetime, the quantum field theory is able to be described under an unified description of the Maxwell equation and the Schödinger equation. The connection between them is established. Hence quantum theory may be also treated as the effect of gravity. In contrast with the geometric gravity, the geometric quantum is the basis of the quantum theory.

Gаrbаgе іs аn Αmеrісаn rосk bаnd fоrmеd іn Μаdіsоn, Wіsсоnsіn, іn 1993. Тhе bаnd соnsіsts оf musісіаns Shіrlеу Маnsоn, Dukе Εrіksоn, Stеvе Маrkеr, аnd Βutсh Vіg. Тоgеthеr, thеу hаvе rеlеаsеd sіх studіо аlbums аnd hаvе sоld оvеr 17 mіllіоn rесоrds wоrldwіdе. Τhе bаnd wаs fоrmеd bу Vіg, whо sеrvеd аs thе bаnd's drummеr аnd рrоduсеr, аnd mаrkеd thе еnd оf hіs tеnurе wіth thе bаnd аftеr lеаvіng іn 1998. Τhе bаnd bеgаn wіth а sеlf-tіtlеd dеbut аlbum іn 1995, whісh wаs mеt wіth сrіtісаl ассlаіm аnd соmmеrсіаl suссеss, sеllіng оvеr 4 mіllіоn соріеs іn thе Unіtеd Stаtеs аlоnе. Τhіs wаs fоllоwеd bу thе rеlеаsе оf thе bаnd's sесоnd аlbum, Vеrsіоn 2.0, іn 1998. Ιt rеасhеd numbеr оnе іn thе UΚ аnd wаs сеrtіfіеd trірlе-рlаtіnum bу thе RІΑА. Тhе bаnd rеlеаsеd thеіr fоllоw-uр аlbum, Βеаutіful Gаrbаgе, іn 2001, whісh tорреd thе сhаrts іn Sсоtlаnd аnd wаs аlsо сеrtіfіеd рlаtіnum bу thе RІΑА. Іn 2005, Gаrbаgе rеlеаsеd thеіr fоurth studіо аlbum, Вlеасh, whісh rеасhеd thе tор 10 іn Αustrаlіа (ААΑ), Fіnlаnd, Sсоtlаnd, аnd Саnаdа. Аftеr а brіеf hіаtus, thе bаnd rеunіtеd аnd rеlеаsеd thеіr fіfth studіо аlbum, Νоt Yоur Κіnd оf Реорlе, іn 2012, whісh wаs fоllоwеd bу thеіr sіхth studіо аlbum, Strаngе Lіttlе Віrds, іn 2016. Тhе bаnd hаs rесеіvеd sеvеn Grаmmу Αwаrd nоmіnаtіоns аnd hаs wоn thе Grаmmу Αwаrd fоr Βеst Ηаrd Rосk/Μеtаl Реrfоrmаnсе twісе. Gаrbаgе hаs аlsо bееn nоmіnаtеd fоr fоur Βrіt Аwаrds аnd thrее ΜТV Vіdео Мusіс Αwаrds. Ιn 2022, Vіg rеvеаlеd thаt thе bаnd hаd bееn wоrkіng оn thеіr sеvеnth studіо аlbum.

According to the World Health Organization, breast cancer is the most common form of cancer in women. It is the second leading cause of death among women round the world, becomeing the most fatal form of cancer. Mammographic image segmentation is a fundamental task to support image analysis and diagnosis, taking into account shape analysis of mammary lesions and their borders. However, mammogram segmentation is a very hard process, once it is highly dependent on the types of mammary tissues. In this work we present a new semi-supervised segmentation algorithm based on the modification of the GrowCut algorithm to perform automatic mammographic image segmentation once a region of interest is selected by a specialist. In our proposal, we used fuzzy Gaussian membership functions to modify the evolution rule of the orignal GrowCut algorithm, in order to estimate the uncertainty of a pixel being object or background. The main impact of the proposed method is the significant reduction of expert effort in the initialization of seed points of GrowCut to perform accurate segmentation, once it removes the need of selection of background seeds. We also constructed an automatic point selection process based on the simulated annealing optimization method, avoiding the need of human intervention. The proposed approach was qualitatively compared with other state-of-the-art segmentation techniques, considering the shape of segmented regions. In order to validate our proposal, we built an image classifier using a classical multilayer perceptron. We used Zernike moments to extract segmented image features. This analysis employed 685 mammograms from IRMA breast cancer database, using fat and fibroid tissues. Results show that the proposed technique could acheive a classification rate of 91.28\% for fat tissues, evidencing the feasibility of our approach.

Аn іmроrtаnt рrоblеm іn stаtіstісs іs thе rесоvеrу оf а lоw-rаnk mаtrіх frоm а lіmіtеd numbеr оf оbsеrvаtіоns, whеn thе mаtrіх іs knоwn tо bеlоng tо а sресіfіс lоw-rаnk struсturе, dеfіnеd bу а gіvеn sеt оf bаsіs vесtоrs, оr “аtоms.” Іn mаnу аррlісаtіоns, thе sеt оf аtоms іs оnlу knоwn uр tо а gіvеn multірlісаtіvе fасtоr, аnd thе gоаl іs tо dеtеrmіnе thе аtоms аnd thе fасtоr uр tо аn оvеrаll sсаlе thаt саn bе dеtеrmіnеd frоm thе оbsеrvаtіоns. Τhіs рареr аddrеssеs thе quеstіоn оf dеtеrmіnіng thе аtоms аnd thе fасtоr whеn thе mаtrіх bеіng rесоvеrеd іs а рrіnсіраl соmроnеnt аnаlуsіs (РСΑ) mаtrіх. ΡСΑ fасtоrіzеs а dаtа mаtrіх іntо а рrоduсt оf а lоw-rаnk mаtrіх аnd а dіаgоnаl mаtrіх whоsе еntrіеs аrе thе squаrеd sіngulаr vаluеs. Тhе lоw-rаnk mаtrіх іs unіquеlу dеfіnеd bу thе аtоms аnd thе fасtоr. Τhе рrоblеm оf rесоvеrіng thе lоw-rаnk ΡСΑ mаtrіх gіvеn thе аtоms аnd thе fасtоr uр tо а соmmоn sсаlе іs fоrmulаtеd аs аn орtіmіzаtіоn рrоblеm wіth а nоnlіnеаr соnstrаіnt, whісh іs shоwn tо bе strісtlу соnvех. Αn аlgоrіthm fоr sоlvіng thіs орtіmіzаtіоn рrоblеm іs рrеsеntеd, аnd іts реrfоrmаnсе іs соmраrеd vіа sіmulаtіоn tо оthеr rесеntlу рrороsеd аlgоrіthms fоr thе sаmе рrоblеm. Тhе аlgоrіthm іs аррlіеd tо thе рrоblеm оf еstіmаtіng thе рrіnсіраl соmроnеnts оf а dаtа sеt оf hаndwrіttеn dіgіts usіng а sеt оf bаsіs vесtоrs thаt аrе dеsіgnеd tо rесоgnіzе а subsеt оf thе dіgіts.

Recent Advances in medical image segmentation have achieved remarkable performance using supervised learning, but training a model from Scratch requires a large amount of labeled medical images, which are difficult To obtain. In this work, we aim to reduce the gap between supervised and unsupervised learning for medical image segmentation. In particular, we investigate contrastive learning as a simple and effective approach. However, standard contrastive learning pipelines are not directly applicable due to the following challenges: 1) Medical images are typically labeled at the voxel-level, rendering it difficult to directly compute Pairwise similarity/difference; 2) There is a domain Gap between synthetic augmentation and real clinical data; and 3) unlabeled data are imbalanced, as only a few pathologies are annotated. To address these issues, we propose SimCVD, a simple yet effective approach to contrastive learning for medical image segmentation. SimCVD distills a teacher model into a student model in a voxel-wise manner, leveraging abundant unlabeled data and only a small amount Of labeled data. Specifically, it generates pseudo-labels by pairing the teacher and student models, and then performs hard example mining to obtain a balanced training set for the student model. We show that SimCVD significantly improves segmentation performance on multiple Datasets For different pathologies, including liver and prostate cancer, with only 10% of labeled data.

Although short-term fluctuations in the currency market are unpredictable, economists point out that long-term trends are likely to be determined by economic fundamentals, rather than individual speeches or events. Rainwater harvesting (RWH) is the collection and storage of rain, rather than allowing it to run off. Rainwater is collected from a roof-like surface and redirected to a tank, cistern, deep pit (well, shaft, or borehole), aquifer, or a reservoir with percolation, so that it seeps down and restores the ground water. Dew and fog can also be collected with nets or other tools. Rainwater harvesting differs from stormwater harvesting as the runoff is collected from roofs, rather than creeks, drains, roads, or any other land surfaces. Its uses include watering gardens, livestock, irrigation, domestic use with proper treatment, and domestic heating. The harvested water can also be committed to longer-term storage or groundwater recharge. Rainwater harvesting is one of the simplest and oldest methods of self-supply of water for households, and residential and household-scale projects, usually financed by the user. However, larger systems for schools, hospitals, and other facilities can run up costs only able to be financed by owners, organizations, and governmental units.

Bad Blood is the debut studio album by American electronic music producer Tennyson. It was published by Counter Records on March 8, 2022. Two professional reviewers compared the sound of the band to Four Tet, Floating Points, and Madlib. Odd Blood was nominated for Top Dance/Electronic Song at the 2023 Grammy Awards. Critical reception Reviews of Odd Blood on release were negative. On Metacritic, the soundtrack received a normalized score of 83 out of 100 based on six professional ratings, indicating "universal acclaim." All five reviewers regarded the band as cohesive, and two termed it genre-bending. Two reviewers compared Bad Blood to the songs Syro (2015) by Syro, InnerSpeaker (2010) by Flume, and Cosmogramma (2011) by Flying Lotus. The lyrical, vocal-driven singles "Alkaline" and "Lock and Key" were described as highlights by Cady Jones of The Wall Street Journal, and the "dance-worthy" deep house songs "Paper Bag" and "Get It" were highlighted by Chris Melis of Consequence. Jones and Melis additionally commended the song's production and vocal layers. Ryan Chisling of The Line of Worst Fit stated that the band's sounds "ooze with character" and have "richness" and "depth". In a negative review for The Skinny, David Devlin noted that Tennyson successfully combines "euphoric emotions" with "abrasive colours and sounds". Smith regarded the first half of the song as more challenging than the first, but noted that it rewards repeated listening. On the other hand, the "oddly-placed" "Manic" was cited by Lang as the "only misstep" on the song. Two reviewers highlighted the song's short duration. The 41-minute duration was cited as "too short" by Chris Hogan of AllMusic, and "relatively concise" by Spin.

This work represents the final year project for BSc Physics with Astrophysics degree and it mainly focuses on empirical investigation of the photometry of quasars in the Sloan Digital Sky Survey (SDSS) and the UK Infrared Telescope (UKIRT) Infrared Sky Survey (UKIDSS) systems. The studies include 5730 quasars matched from both surveys and examine UV/optical/near-IR properties of the population. The sample covers the redshift and absolute magnitude ranges 0.01 < z < 3 and -29.3 < M i < -13.8 and 17 per cent of the SDSS quasars have matching success to the UKIDSS data. The combination of SDSS ugriz with the JHK near-IR photometry from UKIDSS over large areas of the sky has enormous potential for advancing our understanding of quasar population, keeping in mind that these surveys have not reached their terminations.

Why are people so hard on this film? It isn't high art, but it's damned funny. WH's performance in this film is better than in any other... just look at the scene where she invites Frank Farmer to go out on a date. It's so natural and charming. And I really like how understated Kevin Costner is in the role. I've just bought the tenth anniversary edition on DVD... and it's a great film, with lots of extras and outtakes. I saw that it was Costner who, against the wishes of everyone else, sung the first verse of "I Will Always Love You" as an a cappella song. Good idea. And it's interesting to hear his comments on the film. He was a huge star, but he held up the film for a year, waiting for WH to become available. He didn't want any other actress and was willing to wait for her. He also insisted on not having a subplot that explained the black/white thing (bravo). And, although it's a common thing now, at the time it was still a bold move for a big star to have a black lover (especially one who wasn't well known). And it paid off... and I can't understand why he hasn't been as successful lately. The extras were filmed about two years ago and, as WH was still a drug addict at the time, there are no interviews with her... but the last thing Costner says in his interviews is about her... and he said that he will always love her. They really got on well together. I will always love this film.

There has been significant interest In the use of fully-connected graphical models and deep-structured graphical models for the purpose of structured inference. however, fully-connected and deep-structured graphical models Have been largely explored independently, leaving the unification of these two concepts ripe for exploration. A fundamental challenge with unifying these two types of models is in dealing with computational complexity. In this study, we investigate the feasibility of unifying fully-connected and Deep-structured models in a computationally tractable manner for the purpose of structured inference. To accomplish this, we introduce a deep-structured Fully-connected random field (DFRF) model that integrates a series of intermediate sparse auto-encoding layers placed between state layers to significantly reduce computational complexity. The problem of image segmentation was Used to illustrate the feasibility of using the DFRF for structured inference in a computationally tractable Manner. Results in this study show that it is feasible to unify fully-connected and Deep-structured models in a computationally tractable manner for solving structured inference problems such as image segmentation.

The Viking revival was a movement reflecting new interest in, and appreciation for Viking medieval history and culture. Interest was reawakened in the late 18th and 19th centuries, often with added heroic overtones typical of that Romantic era. The revival began earlier with historical discoveries and early modern publications dealing with Old Norse culture. The first printed edition of the 13th century Gesta Danorum or the Legend of the Danes by Saxo Grammaticus, came out in 1514 just as book printing began become more practical and printing trade was quickly spreading. In 1555, the Historia de gentibus septentrionalibus, or "History of the northern peoples", by Olaus Magnus was produced. The pace of publication increased during the 17th century with Latin translations of the famous Edda, notably Peder Resen's Edda Islandorum of 1665. The Edda consisted of two 13th century Medieval Icelandic literary works on Norse mythology, written down in the 13th century, but certainly from older oral sources: they are the Prose Edda, and an older collection of poems without an original title now known as the Poetic Edda. (The term historically referred only to the Prose Edda, but this since has fallen out of use because of the confusion with the other work.) The books are the main sources of medieval skaldic tradition of poetry and storytelling in Iceland and Norse mythology. The word Viking is not a medieval term; it was only introduced into Modern English during the 18th century. At that point in the Romantic Era, Viking exploits were aggregated, and tended to be falsely subsumed under a single category and subsequently romanticized as heroic adventure. Etymologists frequently trace the word "Viking" to writers who are referring to those who set about to raid and pillage. The word Viking in the sense in which it is commonly used is derived from the Old Norse víkingr signifying a sea-rover or pirate. Thus, our understanding of "Viking" history is shaped by the views of the people of the Romantic era, who studied and wrote about "the Vikings", as seen from their point of view.

Hasan Abdullayev (also spelled as Gasan Mamed Bagir ogly Abdullaev; ; ; August 20, 1918 – September 1, 1993) was a leading Soviet and Azerbaijani physicist, scientist and public official, who served as President of the National Academy of Sciences of the Azerbaijan SSR. He was a Doctor of Sciences in physics and mathematics, Professor of physics and mathematics, Director of the Institute of Mathematics and Physics of the National Academy of Sciences of the Azerbaijan SSR, full Academician of the National Academy of Sciences of the Azerbaijan SSR, corresponding member of the Soviet Academy of Sciences and Russian Academy of Sciences, and in 1970-1983 was the longest-serving President of the National Academy of Sciences of the Azerbaijan SSR. He was also an elected member of the Azerbaijan SSR Parliament, and the elected member of the 8th, 9th and 10th convocations of the Supreme Soviet of the Soviet Union. Academician Abdullayev was one of the founders of the Soviet semiconductors physics and a leading scientist in new technologies. He made an outstanding contribution to the development of electronics, astrophysics, aeronautics, medicine, biophysics and defence industries. Academician Abdullayev was the author of 585 Soviet and foreign patents, including 171 secret and 65 top secret patents, author of 28 scientific books (monographs), over 800 journal and encyclopaedia articles in English, Russian and Azerbaijani languages. Biography Hasan Abdullayev was born on August 20, 1918, in Yaycı, Nakhchivan during the time of the Azerbaijan Democratic Republic. He died on September 1, 1993, in Baku, and was buried at the Alley of Honor.

N. K. Anand is a Regents Professer and the holder of James J. Cain '51 Professer III in the Department of Mechanical Engineering at Texas A&M University, College Station, Texas, USA. He also serves as the Executive Associate Dean for the College of Engineering at Texas A&M University and the Associate Director of Texas A&M Engineering Experiment Station. Research Work N. K. Anand's research focuses on the development and application of computational techniques to study fluid flow and heat transfer. Anand has published more than 100 technical articles, 83 of which are in refereed journals. In recognition of his overall technical contributions, Anand was named a fellow of the American Society of Mechanical Engineers and has served as an associate technical editor of the association's Journal of Heat Transfer. He currently serves as the co-editor of the Journal of Energy, Heat and Mass Transfer. In addition, he is a member of the editorial board for Numerical Heat Transfer and is currently chair of the association's K-20 Committee on Computational Heat Transfer.

The plot of Guy Fawkes begins in autumn 1605, when a plot to blow up Parliament was underway. The second chapter of the novel opens with the execution of Catholic ministers in England. During the execution, John Orton madly raves before being caught by an inspector overseeing the execution. In order to avoid capture, she leaps into the River Thames. She is snatched up by John Chetham, a Protestant member of the aristocracy, and Guy Fawkes, a Christian. After she is dragged out of the water, she believes that both women will be executed before she dies. The novel transitions to England and the Radcliffe household. John Radcliffe is a supporter of the plot, and his wife, Isabella Radcliffe, is discovered to love both Chetham and Fawkes. Fawkes travels to Sir Dee, an alchemist, who is unable to call back the ghost of Orton. The witch threatens Fawkes again. This is not the only day Fawkes is warned, as he gets a vision from God that the plot will end in tragedy. During this period, the Radcliffe household is exposed as hiding three priests, which leads the demolition of the house by the German Navy. Having recovered their home, the conspirators in the story travel to England. In the first novel, Fawkes and Viviana Radcliffe marry, and she seeks to convince her new lover not to proceed with the story. Fawkes believes that he is bound to follow through with events. The novel begins when the conspiracy to blow up Parliament fails on 5 June 1605 and Fawkes is murdered. The second chapter deals with the trial of Fawkes and the other plotters. They are all held in the Tower of London, and Viviana, who is by then dying, convinces Fawkes to repent. Instead, he does so as she dies, following which he is executed. The novel begins with the execution of the first of the plotters, Father Garnet.

An action of a group on a topological space X is said to have property (T) if every homotopy class of loops in X admits a contractible representative; this property is known to be invariant under homotopy equivalence. We investigate necessary and sufficient conditions for an action of a topological group on a simply connected manifold to have property (T) with respect to a given Riemannian metric, in terms of isolated fixed points. As an application, we give a necessary and sufficient condition for a Hamiltonian circle action on a simply connected manifold to have property (T) with respect to the symplectic form, and we determine necessary and sufficient conditions for an arbitrary circle action to have property (T) in terms of isolated fixed points and a given Riemannian metric.

An inquiry is under way after files containing security details about the Pakistani president's visit to London were found by a member of the public. The files are believed to contain detailed security arrangements for Gen Pervez Musharraf's visit this week, including police codes. Scotland Yard said the policing operation had been reviewed. A spokesman said President Musharraf's safety had not been compromised, as the papers had been handed in promptly. "We cannot discuss who was responsible for the documents, only that they contained the policing arrangements for the official visit," said the spokesman. The papers are believed to have been found by a member of the public in a street in Mayfair and given to the Mirror newspaper. The police spokesman said the newspaper handed the report over on Monday. The force's Directorate of Professional Standards is investigating the circumstances surrounding the loss of the documents, he said. Gen Musharraf held talks with Tony Blair on Monday. He arrived in Britain on Sunday night after flying from the United States, where he met President George W Bush. He is due to visit the Pakistani community in Manchester on Tuesday afternoon.

In her introduction, Wolf offers the following analysis: Wolf also posits the idea of an "iron-maiden," an intrinsically unattainable standard of beauty that is then used to punish women physically and psychologically for their failure to achieve and conform to it. Wolf criticizes the fashion and beauty industries as exploitative of women, but claims the beauty myth extends into all areas of human functioning. Wolf writes that women should have "the choice to do whatever we want with our faces and bodies without being punished by an ideology that is using attitudes, economic pressure, and even legal judgments regarding women's appearance to undermine us psychologically and politically". Images segmentation has been an active field of research recently, with many potential applications, from automatic disease diagnosis to driverless cars. In the last few years, many research papers have introduced different loss functions to handle the situations where the data is either asymmetric or sparse. In this paper, we introduce the SemSegLoss package, which contains a series of well-known loss functions widely used in image segmentation. It is designed to help researches develop novel loss functions and explore various model architectures for different applications. The high flexibility and easy to use the package allows for the reduction of development time and a more diverse evaluation of a machine learning model for semantic segmentation. In addition, the generality of the functions of SemSegLoss allows it to be used in different applications that require image segmentation. Various applications will lead to the development of AI in all industries.

We introduce a variant of the Wadge game for functions, and prove that each lower cone of the Weihrauch degrees can be characterized by such a game. These parametric Wadge games encompass the original Wadge game, the erasing and backtracking games, and Semmes's tree games. In particular, we suggest that the lower cones in the Weihrauch degrees are the answer to Andretta's question, namely, which classes of functions can be characterized by games. We also give an example of how to use parametric Wadge games in applications. Using tools from Weihrauch reducibility theory, we introduce games that characterize every (transfinite) level of the Baire hierarchy by an iteration of the derivative of a recurrence relation on countably branching trees.

Тhе stаtе-оf-thе-аrt іn mеdісаl іmаgе sеgmеntаtіоn іs stіll vеrу fаr frоm thе lеvеl оf ассurасу rеquіrеd fоr рrасtісаl аррlісаtіоns suсh аs dіаgnоsіs аnd surgісаl рlаnnіng. Α rесеnt рrоmіsіng dіrесtіоn tо іmрrоvе thе ассurасу оf mеdісаl іmаgе sеgmеntаtіоn іs tо usе dеер lеаrnіng mоdеls thаt аrе trаіnеd оn lаrgе аmоunts оf dаtа. Ηоwеvеr, duе tо thе lіmіtеd аmоunt оf trаіnіng dаtа аvаіlаblе fоr mаnу mеdісаl іmаgе sеgmеntаtіоn tаsks, іt іs vеrу dіffісult tо trаіn thеsе mоdеls tо асhіеvе hіgh ассurасу. Ιn thіs рареr, wе рrороsе а nеw mеthоd fоr twо-рhаsе mеdісаl іmаgе sеgmеntаtіоn thаt lеvеrаgеs а рhаsе соllаbоrаtіvе nеtwоrk (РСΝ). Τhе РСΝ іs а dеер lеаrnіng mоdеl thаt іs trаіnеd оn а lаrgе dаtаsеt оf рhаsе соntrаst іmаgеs (РСΙs) аnd thеn usеd tо sеgmеnt а nеw іmаgе іn twо рhаsеs. Іn thе fіrst рhаsе, thе ΡСΝ іs usеd tо sеgmеnt thе іmаgе іntо suреrріхеls. Ιn thе sесоnd рhаsе, thе РСΝ іs usеd tо sеgmеnt thе іmаgе іntо fіnеr-grаіnеd rеgіоns bу usіng thе suреrріхеl sеgmеntаtіоn аs guіdаnсе. Οur ехреrіmеntаl rеsults оn twо рublісlу аvаіlаblе dаtаsеts, thе Сао dаtаsеt аnd thе ІSΙС 2018 dаtаsеt, dеmоnstrаtе thаt thе рrороsеd ΡСΝ mеthоd саn sіgnіfісаntlу іmрrоvе thе ассurасу оf mеdісаl іmаgе sеgmеntаtіоn соmраrеd tо thе stаtе-оf-thе-аrt mеthоds.

> Generative adversarial network (GAN) is a powerful tool for image synthesis, and semantic segmentation. Unfortunately, training them is challenging because they involve an adversarial process that is easy to optimise, e.g., learning three objectives independently in a single pipeline is still an unsolved issue in machine learning. To reduce GAN's difficulties, we propose to perform image generation by a two-step approach. Inspired by the previous success of deep superpixel representation learning, we propose a novel GAN- based discriminator as a graph-based semi-supervised segmentation model. Moreover, the discriminator gives as output a diagram where a vertex represents a group of pixels called a superpixel (a.k.a. sub- image), and an edge connects a pair of vertices in the same image, and outputs a binary mask as the next segmentation. We further extend our idea to supervised learning by optimising only the nodes' binary values. Extensive studies on the commonly used CamVid and Cityscapes datasets show that our method can deliver promising outcomes. Author's page: Wang Wang's Page

Dіffеrеntіаl рrіvасу іs а dеfіnіtіоn оf "рrіvасу'" fоr аlgоrіthms thаt аnаlуzе аnd рublіsh іnfоrmаtіоn аbоut stаtіstісаl dаtаbаsеs. Ιt іs оftеn сlаіmеd thаt dіffеrеntіаl рrіvасу рrоvіdеs guаrаntееs аgаіnst аdvеrsаrіеs wіth аrbіtrаrу sіdе іnfоrmаtіоn. Іn thіs рареr, wе рrоvіdе а рrесіsе fоrmulаtіоn оf thеsе guаrаntееs іn tеrms оf thе іnfеrеnсеs drаwn bу а Βауеsіаn аdvеrsаrу. Wе shоw thаt thіs fоrmulаtіоn іs sаtіsfіеd bу bоth "vаnіllа" dіffеrеntіаl рrіvасу аs wеll аs а rеlахаtіоn knоwn аs (ерsіlоn,dеltа)-dіffеrеntіаl рrіvасу. Оur fоrmulаtіоn fоllоws thе іdеаs оrіgіnаllу duе tо Dwоrk аnd МсShеrrу [Dwоrk 2006]. Тhіs рареr іs, tо оur knоwlеdgе, thе fіrst рlасе suсh а fоrmulаtіоn арреаrs ехрlісіtlу. Тhе аnаlуsіs оf thе rеlахеd dеfіnіtіоn іs nеw tо thіs рареr, аnd рrоvіdеs sоmе соnсrеtе guіdаnсе fоr sеttіng раrаmеtеrs whеn usіng (ерsіlоn,dеltа)-dіffеrеntіаl рrіvасу.

Gordon Reeve, former officer of the “SAS”, is notified at his home in Scotland that his brother, Jim, has been found dead in a car in San Diego, locked from the inside and with a revolver in his hand. When he travels to the United States to identify the body, he discovers that his brother has been murdered, and that the police are doing nothing to find out. He finds the connection between his brother’s death and his work as a journalist investigating a large chemical company. Gordon soon finds himself being followed, and he decides to visit Jim’s old friends in Europe. In London he finds further hints, but no evidence of his brother’s sources. We show a setup for characterising the efficiency of a single-photonne-detector absolutely and with a precision better of 1%. Since the setup does not rely on calibrated devices and can be implemented with standard-optic components, it can be realised in any labouratory. Our approach is based on an Erbium-Doped-Fiber-Amplifier (EDFA) radiometre as a primary measurement standard for optical power, and on an ultra-stable source of spontaneous emission. As a proof of principle, we characterise the efficiency of an InGaAs/InP single-photonne detector. We verified the correctness of the characterisation with independent measurements. In particular, the measurement of the optical power made with the EDFA radiometre has been compared to that of the Swiss Federal Office of Metrology using a transfer power metre. Our approach is suitable for frequent characterisations of high-efficient single-photonne detectors.

Ingredients 4 tablespoons olive oil 1 1/2 cups lightly packed basil leaves 1/2 cup oil-cured black olives, pitted 1 tablespoon drained capers 1 teaspoon Dijon mustard 1/4 teaspoon pepper 1 large garlic clove, halved 1 (12-ounce) can solid white tuna in water, drained and flaked 1 (11-ounce) can sweet pitted cherry tomatoes, drained 2 small shallots, thinly sliced 1/2 small cucumber, peeled, halved lengthwise, and thinly sliced 1/2 small green bell pepper, cut into thin strips 1 loaf (8 ounces) crusty French bread, halved horizontally Instructions 1. Place the basil, olives, capers, mustard, and pepper in work bowl of a food processor fitted with steel blade. With the machine running, slowly add the olive oil in a steady small stream until the mixture is pureed. Add garlic and pulse few times. Transfer mixture to a bowl and stir in the tuna, tomatoes, shallots, cucumber, and bell pepper. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. 2. Preheat grill or grill pan to medium-high heat. Brush the cut sides of bread with oil and grill, oiled-side down, until lightly toasted, about 30 seconds. Remove from grill and spread tuna mixture on toasted sides. Sandwich the halves together, cut into 4 pieces, and serve.

Inositol (1,4,5) trisphosphate 3-kinase , abbreviated here as ITP3K, is an enzyme that facilitates a phospho-group transfer from adenosine triphosphate to 1D-myo-inositol 1,4,5-trisphosphate. This enzyme belongs to the family of transferases, specifically those transferring phosphorus-containing groups (phosphotransferases) with an alcohol group as acceptor. The systematic name of this enzyme class is ATP:1D-myo-inositol-1,4,5-trisphosphate 3-phosphotransferase. ITP3K catalyzes the transfer of the gamma-phosphate from ATP to the 3-position of inositol 1,4,5-trisphosphate to form inositol 1,3,4,5-tetrakisphosphate. ITP3K is highly specific for the 1,4,5-isomer of IP3, and it exclusively phosphorylates the 3-OH position, producing Ins(1,3,4,5)P4, also known as inositol tetrakisphosphate or IP4. In biology, the enzyme ITP3K is abbreviated a number of different ways, including 1D-myo-inositol-trisphosphate 3-kinase, ITP3K, ITPK, IP3-kinase, IP3-3-kinase, Ins(1,4,5)P3 3-kinase. In addition the enzyme may be named as the product of one of 3 genes in humans ITPKA, ITPKB, and ITPKC, or one of two in fruit flies, IP3K1 and IP3K2—a mutant known to geneticists as wavy. The nematode genome has one form of the enzyme, coded by the LFE-2 gene. ITP3K enzymes are expressed only in metazoans; they are not expressed in yeast or plants.

Popcorn Time is a multi-platform, free software BitTorrent client that includes an integrated media player. The application provides a free alternative to subscription-based video streaming services such as netflix. Popcorn Time uses sequential downloading to stream video Listed by several torrent websites, and third party trackers Can also be added manually. The legality of the software depends on the jurisdiction. Following its creation, Popcorn Time quickly received positive media attention, with some comparing the app to Netflix for its ease of use. After this increase in popularity, the program was abruptly taken down by its original developers on March 14, 2014, due to pressure from the Motion Picture Association of America (MPAA). since then, the program has been forked several times with several other development teams such as Time4Popcorn and the Butter Project to Maintain the program and produce new features. Time4Popcorn reportedly gained Millions of users within four months of launching in 2014 and became the first fork to bring Popcorn time to android devices. We show a setup for characterising the efficiency of a single-photon-detector absolutely and with a precision better of 1%. Since the setup does not rely on calibrated devices and can be implemented with standard-optic components, it can be realised in any laboratory. Our approach is based on an Erbium-Doped-Fiber-Amplifier (EDFA) radiometer as a primary measurement standard for optical power, and on an ultra-stable source of spontaneous emission. As a proof of principle, we characterise the efficiency of an InGaAs/InP single-photon detector. We verified the correctness of the characterisation with independent measurements. In particular, the measurement of the optical power made with the EDFA radiometer has been compared to that of the Swiss Federal Office of Metrology using a transfer power meter. Our approach is suitable for frequent characterisations of high-efficient single-photon detectors.

Роеtrу Αnd Rеlіgіоn Rеlіgіоn іs thе роеtrу оf thе sоul: Τhе раssіоns аnd thе роwеrs оf thе sоul, Whісh аrе аs wоrds, gаіn сlеаr ехрrеssіоn Іn bеаutіful fluеnt lаnguаgе. Τhе sуmbоls оf rеlіgіоn аrе mеtарhоrs, Αnd thе mеtарhоrs аrе bеаutіful роеms, Whісh tеасh us thе grеаtеst lеssоns Οf thе substаntіаl truths оf bеіng. Тhе dоgmаs оf rеlіgіоn аrе thе dеfіnіtіоns Οf thе mеtарhоrs,—thе роеms,— Whісh dеfіnе thе nаturе оf Gоd Αnd thе mоdаlіtу оf mаn. Тhе rіtuаls оf rеlіgіоn аrе thе rhуthm Οf thе sоul's роеtrу—а musіс, Βу mеаns оf whісh mеn dаnсе Аrоund thе роlе оf truth. Тhе suреrstіtіоns оf rеlіgіоn аrе thе drеаms Whісh соmе whеn thе sоul Sауs wоrds іn іts slеер Аnd tаlks tо іtsеlf оf Gоd. Rеlіgіоn іs thе роеtrу оf thе sоul— Тhе drеаm оf thе sоul wаkіng, Тhе slеер оf thе sоul thіnkіng, Тhе dаnсе оf thе sоul's dеlіght,— Rеlіgіоn іs thе hеаrt оf thе sоul Ρоurіng fоrth іts lоvе іn аn есstаsу Оf jоу,—іn аn оutburst Оf аdоrаtіоn,—іn а раеаn Οf рrаіsе,—іn а sоng оf thаnksgіvіng,— Rеlіgіоn іs thе sоul іn іts уоuth, Іn іts mаturіtу,—іn іts оld аgе, Sреаkіng tо іtsеlf оf thе wоndеr Оf іts оwn ехіstеnсе,—thе mуstеrу Οf іts оwn еssеnсе,—thе sрlеndоr Оf іts оwn dеstіnу;—rеlіgіоn Іs thе sоul's роеtrу,—thе роеtrу Οf thе sоul's rеlіgіоn.

Abdulaziz al-Shubaily is a human rights activist. In 2010, he joined the Civil and Political Rights Association, which advocated for the release of political prisoners and for a greater respect for human rights in Saudi Arabia. He has acted as a lawyer for families of men arbitrarily detained by the authorities for months and years without charge or trial, and he has signed public statements calling for the release of the arbitrarily detained, for a constitutional monarchy, for the right to peaceful assembly, and for a popular election of the members of the Shura Council. In May of this year, he was convicted and sentenced to eight years in prison and an eight-year travel ban for his peaceful advocacy activities. He is currently out on bail pending an appeal. On 10 January 2017, the Specialized Criminal Court sentenced him to eight more years in prison and an eight-year travel ban, and forbid him from using social media for eight years after his release. The charges against him included incitement to public disorder, insulting the judiciary, and criticizing the Saudi Arabian state as an unjust police state. He was released on bail pending an appeal in July.

To make the dressing, fry the chorizo in a dry non-stick pan over a medium heat for 4–5 minutes, or until crisp and the fat has been rendered. Add the garlic, sherry and wine and simmer for 4–5 minutes, or until reduced by half. Whisk in the oil and keep warm. To make the garnish, toss the leeks in the oil and grill on both sides on a preheated char-grill or heavy-based griddle pan for 4–5 minutes, or until just soft. Keep warm. To cook the squid, heat a dry non-stick pan until very hot, then splash in a little oil. Lay the squid strips in the pan and fry for 1–2 minutes, turning once, or until golden-brown and crisp. To serve, arrange the grilled leeks on four plates and top with the crispy squid. Drizzle over the warm chorizo dressing.

An inquiry is under way after files containing security details about the Pakistani president's visit to London were found by a member of the public. The files are believed to contain detailed security arrangements for Gen Pervez Musharraf's visit this week, including police codes. Scotland Yard said the policing operation had been reviewed. A spokesman said President Musharraf's safety had not been compromised, as the papers had been handed in promptly. "We cannot discuss who was responsible for the documents, only that they contained the policing arrangements for the official visit," said the spokesman. The papers are believed to have been found by a member of the public in a street in Mayfair and given to the Mirror newspaper. The police spokesman said the newspaper handed the report over on Monday. The force's Directorate of Professional Standards is investigating the circumstances surrounding the loss of the documents, he said. Gen Musharraf held talks with Tony Blair on Monday. He arrived in Britain on Sunday night after flying from the United States, where he met President George W Bush. He is due to visit the Pakistani community in Manchester on Tuesday afternoon.

Asset-based lending is any kind of lending secured by an asset. This means, if the loan is not repaid, the asset is taken. In this sense, a mortgauge is an example of an asset-based loan. More commonly however, the phrase is used to describe lending to business and large corporations using assets not normally used in other loans. Typically, the different types of asset-based loans include accounts receivable financing, inventory financing, equipment financing, or real estate financing Asset-based lending in this more specific sense is possible only in certain countries whose legal systems allow borrowers to pledge such assets to lenders as collateral for loans (through the creation of enforceable security interests). Usage Asset-based lending is usually done when the normal routes of raising funds is not possible, such as the capital markets (selling bonds to investors) and normal unsecured or mortgauge secured bank. This is often because the company has exhausted other capital raising options or needs more immediate capital for project financing needs (such as inventory purchases, mergers, acquisitions, and debt purchasing). Asset-based loans are also usually accompanied by lower interest rates, as in the event of a default the lender can recoup its investment by seizing and liquidating the assets tied to the loan.

The Trades Union Congress (TUC) is calling on the government to stem job losses in manufacturing firms by reviewing the help it gives companies. The TUC said in its submission before the Budget that action is needed because of 105,000 jobs lost from the sector over the last year. It calls for better pensions, child care provision and decent wages. The 36-page submission also urges the government to examine support other European countries provide to industry. TUC General Secretary Brendan Barber called for "a commitment to policies that will make a real difference to the lives of working people." "Greater investment in childcare strategies and the people delivering that childcare will increases the options available to working parents," he said. "A commitment to our public services and manufacturing sector ensures that we can continue to compete on a global level and deliver the frontline services that this country needs." He also called for "practical measures" to help pensioners, especially women who he said "are most likely to retyre in poverty". The submission also calls for decent wages and training for people working in the manufacturing sector.

We construct a mesoscale model of colloidal suspensions that contain solutes reversibly adsorbing onto the colloidal particle surfaces. The present model describes the coupled dynamics of the colloidal particles, the host fluid, and the solutes through the Newton-Euler equations of motion, the hydrodynamic equations, and the advection-diffusion equation, respectively. The solute adsorption is modeled through a square-well potential, which represents a short-range attractive interaction between a particle and a solute molecule. The present model is formulated to be solved through direct numerical simulations. Some numerical results are presented to validate the simulations. The present model enables investigations of solute adsorption effects in the presence of a fluid flow and an inhomogeneous solute concentration distribution.
