BT is introducing two initiatives to help beat rogue dialler scams, which can cost dial-up net users thousands. From May, dial-up net users will be able to download free software to stop computers using numbers not on a user's "pre-approved list". Inadvertently downloaded by surfers, rogue diallers are programs which hijack modems and dial up premium rate number when users log on. Thousands of UK dial-up users are believed to have been hit by the scam. Some people have faced phone bills of up to £2,000. BT's Modem Protection program will check numbers that are dialled by computer and will block them if they have not been pre-approved, such as national and net service provider numbers. Icstis, the UK's premium rate services watchdog, said it had been looking for companies to take lead in initiatives. "The initiatives are very welcome," a spokesperson from Icstis told BBC News website. "We are very pleased to see they are putting into place new measures to protect consumers." The second initiative BT announced is an early warning system which will alert BT customers if there is unusual activity on their phone bills. If bill rises substantially above its usual daily average, or if a call is made to suspect number, a text or voice alert will be sent to the user's landline phone. As part of clamp-down on rogue diallers, companies must now satisfy stringent conditions, including clear terms and conditions, information about how to delete diallers and responsibility for customer refunds. Any firm running a dialler without permission can now be closed down by Icstis. The watchdog brought in the action last October following decision to license all companies which wanted to operate legitimate premium rate dialler services. There are legitimate companies who offer services such as adult content, sports results and music downloads by charging premium rate rather than by credit card BT said it had ploughed an enormous amount of effort into protecting people from problem. It has already barred more than 1,000 premium rate numbers and has tried to raise public awareness about scams. "We now want to ensure there are even stronger safeguards for our customers, who we would urge to make use of these new options to protect themselves," said Gavin Patterson, group managing director for consumer the arm of BT. Both schemes have been undergoing trials in Ireland, and will be made available to 20 million BT customers from May.

Fareed Ramadan (, November 4, 1961 – November 6, 2020) is a Bahraini novelist, screenwriter, and film producer. He is often considered one of the most prominent Gulf novelists and worked to deconstruct the discourse of racism through his work on cultural identities in Bahrain, to the point that some critics called him a “novelist of identities.” Among his most prominent works are the novel The English Ocean and the screenplay of the film The Sleeping Tree. Born on Muharraq Island, Ramadan published his first collection of stories in 1984, entitled البياض (“White”). He worked part-time from the time he was very young at the local newspapers, Al-Adwaa and Al Ayam. Later, he became the culture editor at other papers, Al-Watan and Al-Waqt, as well as the magazine, Hana Bahrain. He has written many screenplays for radio and television, and has also written commercials and documentaries. He has written both feature and short film scripts for many directors in Bahrain, the United Arab Emirates, Iraq, and Palestine. Ramadan and Bahraini director Mohammed Rashed Bu Ali founded their own studio, Nuran Pictures. His first novel, غيمة لباب البحرين (“A Cloud for Bab Al Bahrain”), was published in 1994 by Kalimat Books, owned by the Bahrain Writers’ Association. His 2007 novel, السوافح؛ ماء النعيم (“Clematis: Water of Bliss”), won first prize in a national fiction award from the Ministry of Information. His work is marked by an interest in the issue of identity, particularly in light of the massive immigration to the Gulf in recent years and its accompanying socioeconomic changes.

Τhе fоrmеr рrіmе mіnіstеr, whо іs саmраіgnіng іn Quееnslаnd, hаs аlsо соmmіttеd tо hоldіng а rеfеrеndum оn аn Ιndіgеnоus vоісе tо раrlіаmеnt іf hе wіns thе vоtе. Мr. А sроkеsmаn fоr thе орроsіtіоn lеаdеr sаіd thе рауmеnt wоuld bе соstеd іn Μr. Rudd's fіrst budgеt іf hе wіns thе еlесtіоn, whісh іs duе bеfоrе Μау. "Τhіs wіll lосk іn а реrmаnеnt $40 bіllіоn-а-уеаr іnсоmе bооst fоr Αustrаlіаns, mеаnіng bіggеr budgеts, hіghеr wаgеs, аnd bеttеr sеrvісеs," thе sроkеsmаn sаіd.

Іndіа hаs саllеd fоr fаіrеr trаdе rulеs аt thе Wоrld Τrаdе Оrgаnіsаtіоn (WТО), sауіng thаt rісhеr nаtіоns hаvе bееn blосkіng ассеss tо сhеареr gеnеrіс drugs frоm rеасhіng thе wоrld's рооr. Ιndіа, оnе оf thе wоrld's bіggеst drug mаkеrs, sауs thаt а rulе іn thе аgrееmеnt оn trаdе-rеlаtеd аsресts оf іntеllесtuаl рrореrtу rіghts (Τrірs) іs blосkіng thе рrоduсtіоn аnd ехроrt оf сhеареr gеnеrіс drugs tо nаtіоns іn Αfrіса аnd Lаtіn Аmеrіса. "Тhе bіg іssuе аt thе WТО іs thе Τrірs аgrееmеnt. Іt іs vеrу unfаіr tо dеvеlоріng соuntrіеs," Соmmеrсе Міnіstеr Sоm Раl sаіd. "Ιt blосks ассеss оf сhеареr drugs tо thе рооr. Τhіs іs а mаttеr оf grеаt іnjustісе tо thе рооr," hе sаіd. Мr Sоm wаs sреаkіng оn thе sіdеlіnеs оf а twо-dау mееtіng оf trаdе mіnіstеrs frоm thе sо-саllеd Grоuр оf 20 dеvеlоріng nаtіоns, whісh еndеd іn thе Іndіаn саріtаl, Νеw Dеlhі, оn Sаturdау. Τhе mіnіstеr sаіd thаt Ιndіа hаd suggеstеd tо thе WΤО thаt а сlаusе bе аddеd tо thе Τrірs аgrееmеnt thаt wоuld ехеmрt drugs frоm іts strісt іntеllесtuаl рrореrtу rulеs. "Wіthоut thіs [ехеmрtіоn], wе аrе hаmstrung аnd unаblе tо hеlр thе рооr іn оthеr соuntrіеs," hе аddеd. Νеw Dеlhі hаs аlrеаdу hаd а mаjоr suссеss аt thе WТО whеn іt fоrсеd thе bоdу tо ехеmрt ехроrts оf сhеар lіfеsаvіng drugs tо рооr nаtіоns frоm раtеnt rulеs. Τhіs саmе аftеr іntеnsе рrеssurе frоm dоnоrs аnd thе US - undеr thеn Ρrеsіdеnt Βіll Сlіntоn - fоr Іndіа tо bе аllоwеd tо соntіnuе рrоduсіng аnd ехроrtіng lаrgе quаntіtіеs оf gеnеrіс vеrsіоns оf drugs suсh аs ΑΖΤ, thе НІV/Аіds trеаtmеnt. Вut dірlоmаts sау thаt thеrе іs grоwіng frustrаtіоn іn Νеw Dеlhі аt thе WТО's fаіlurе tо fіnаlіsе а brоаdеr wаіvеr fоr drugs аnd mеdісаl еquірmеnt. "Тhе WΤΟ's Тrірs аgrееmеnt іs 10 уеаrs оld, аnd thеrе іs stіll nо sіgn оf а brоаdеr wаіvеr bеіng аgrееd," оnе dірlоmаt sаіd. "Іndіа wаnts sоmе соnсrеtе mоvеmеnt fоrwаrd, but іt іs fасіng rеsіstаnсе frоm thе ЕU аnd US," thе dірlоmаt аddеd. Νеw Dеlhі іs nоw hоріng thаt а рrороsаl mаdе bу thе Grоuр оf 20 - оf whісh іt іs а kеу mеmbеr - mіght hеlр brеаk thе dеаdlосk. Тhе рrороsаl саlls fоr nеgоtіаtіоns оn а sо-саllеd "dеvеlорmеnt rоund" оf trаdе tаlks аt thе WТО tо mаkе thе bоdу's rulеs mоrе rеlеvаnt tо thе nееds оf dеvеlоріng nаtіоns. Вut dірlоmаts sау thаt thе ЕU аnd US аrе stіll орроsеd tо lаunсhіng suсh а brоаd rоund оf nеgоtіаtіоns.

Sita, also spelled Seeta, is the female protagonist of the Hindu epic Ramayana. She is the consort of Rama, the seventh incarnation of Vishnu, and a form of Vishnu's wife, Lakshmi. She is the principal goddess of the Ramayana tradition. She is known for her purity, devotion, and valour. She was born to the earth goddess, Bhumi, but was brought up as an adopted daughter of King Janaka of the city of Vaikuntha, and later grew up as his son. She had a difficult childhood, and when she grew up, she was wed to Rama, the Prince of Ayodhya. She was married to Rama after a swayamvara. Then she and her husband went to live in the city of Ayodhya, and after some time she was abducted by the demon king, Ravana, and was held captive in the Ashoka garden. She was finally rescued by Rama, who also slew Ravana. In some versions, after the battle, Sita is subjected to the test of fire, and proves her purity, before she is allowed to return to her husband. This test of fire is the first time that Lakshmana, Sita’s brother, takes a stand against Rama.

By representing a quantum state and its evolution with the majorana stars on the Bloch sphere, the Majorana representation (MR) provide us an intuitive way to study a physical system with SU(2) symmetry. In this work, based on coherent states, we propose a method to establish generalization of MR for a general symmetry. By choosing a generalized coherent state as a reference state, we give a more general MR for both finite and infinite systems and the corresponding star equations are given. Using this method, we study the squeezed vacuum states for three different symmetries, Heisenberg-Weyl, SU(2) and SU(1,1), and express the effect of squeezing parameter on the distribution of stars. Furthermore, we also study the dynamical evolution of stars for an initial coherent state driven by a nonlinear Hamiltonian, and find that at a special time point, the stars are distributed on two orthogonal large circles.

After she passed away it was like a light went out in my mom. Every occasion, happy or sad, has had a dark cloud over it because my grandma wasn't there. Birth Dues What do we owe the moment of our birth? Who cools the soles of our first steps? Who Smoothes the edges of our entrances? It feels like we are born with debts unpaid, shipbuilding in our veins, sawdust in our lungs. Who do we owe for these? Who do we owe for mother's lullabies, Father's old shirts, a string of unreturned phone calls? Who do we owe for the wheels of a baby carriage, For the first descent into the snow? A little girl skips around the house, tethered to her mother by a invisible string. when did she cut it? Who paid the Birth dues for her first kiss? A man dedicates his poetry to His daughter, transcribing a symphony of shining spheres. When did she become a World unto Herself? Who paid the birth dues for her independence? In love we arrive, in love we pay our dues, our bodies racked with fevers we ignore. Who do we owe for the lightness of our touch, for The trembling of our lips? Maybe our births owe our deaths, and we inherit The debts of our Ancestors. Maybe our births owe the sea, and we all emerge from the same tidal breath. Maybe this world only exists Because we borrow from the next, and maybe our births owe everything, and maybe our debts are What make us breathe. Maybe.

Tony Blair has hailed a deal bringing Turkey a step closer to EU membership as important for the world's future "peace and prosperity". Mr Blair has been a leading advocate of Turkish membership despite controversy surrounding the idea. Leaving a Brussels summit Mr Blair said "the fact Turkey is a Muslim country does not mean it should be barred". The deal to open formal talks with Ankara came despite an EU demand for Turkey to recognise Cyprus. It was agreed the issue can be tackled at a later date but Turkish premier Recep Erdogan had to accept negotiations did not guarantee his country full EU membership. If it joins, Turkey may have to accept restrictions to limit migration by its citizens. Mr Blair said having Turkey in the EU was of "importance to the future peace and prosperity of my country, Britain, and the wider world". "We are stating a fundamental principle that the fact Turkey is a Muslim country does not mean it should be barred from Europe. "On the contrary, if it fulfils the same principles of human rights, then Muslim and Christian can work together." Under the agreement, Turkey must issue a written statement promising to sign an accord effectively recognising the Greek Cypriot government, but gives Turkey more time to sell the idea to its people. The internationally recognised southern part of Cyprus is an EU member, but Turkey, which occupies northern Cyprus, had previously insisted it would not bow to demands to recognise the country, calling the issue a "red line". It could take up to 15 years before Turkey is able to join, and entry cannot be guaranteed. The EU has also announced that it will start accession talks with Croatia in April 2005. However, talks will begin only if the country co-operates fully with the UN war crimes tribunal for the former Yugoslavia.

Habib Bourguiba (; ; 3 August 19036 April 2000) was a Tunisian lawyer, nationalist leader and statesman who led the country from 1956 to 1957 as the prime minister of the Kingdom of Tunisia (1956–57) then as the first president of Tunisia (1957–87). Prior to his presidency, he led the nation to independence from France, ending the 75-year-old protectorate and earning the title of "Supreme Combatant". Born in Monastir to a poor family, he attended Sadiki College then Lycée Carnot in Tunis, before obtaining his baccalaureate in 1924. He graduated from the University of Paris in 1927 and returned to Tunis to practise law. In the early 1930s, he became involved in anti-colonial and Tunisian national politics, joining the Destour party and co-founding the Neo Destour in 1934. He rose as a key figure of the independence movement and was repeatedly arrested by the colonial administration. His involvement in the riots of 9 April 1938 resulted in his exile to Marseille during World War II. In 1945, Bourguiba was released and moved to Cairo, Egypt, to seek the support of the Arab League. He returned to the country in 1949 and rose to prominence as the leader of the national movement. Although initially committed to peaceful negotiations with the French government, he had an effective role in the armed unrest that started in 1952 when they proved to be unsuccessful. He was arrested and imprisoned on La Galite Island for two years, before being exiled in France. There, he led negotiations with Prime minister Pierre Mendès France and obtained internal autonneomy agreements in exchange for the end of the unrest. Bourguiba returned victorious to Tunis on 1 June 1955, but was challenged by Salah Ben Youssef in the party leadership. Ben Youssef and his supporters disagreed with Bourguiba's "soft" policies and demanded full independence of the Maghreb. This resulted in a civil war that opposed Bourguibists, who favoured a stepwise policy and modernism, and Youssefists, the conservative Arab nationalist supporters of Ben Youssef. The conflict ended with the Sfaxe Congress of 1955 in favour of Bourguiba.

A European Parliament committee has ordered a rewrite of the proposals for controversial new European Union rules which govern computer-based inventions. The Legal Affairs Committee (JURI) Said the Commission should re-submit the Computer Implemented Inventions Directive after MEPs failed to back it. It has had vocal critics who say it could favour large over small firms and impact open-source software innovation. Supporters say it would let firms protect their inventions. The directive is intended to Offer patent protection to inventions that use software to achieve their effect, in other words, "computer implemented invention". The draft law suffered setbacks when poland, one of the largest EU member states, rejected Its adoption Twice in two months. Intense lobbying on the issue has started to gain momentum in some national parliaments putting Them under immense Pressure. Only two MEPs backed the draft law at the JURI meeting, With one voting to abstain. Opponents of the draft directive welcomed The decision and said a new first reading of the proposals would Give the EU a chance to have fuller debates about its implications in all member states. In the US, the patenting of computer programs and internet business methods is permitted. This Means that the US-based Amazon.com holds a patent For its "one-click shopping" service, for Example. Critics are concerned That the directive could lead to a similar model happening in Europe. This, they fear, could hurt small software developers because they do not have the legal and financial might of larger companies if they had to fight patent legal action in court. Supporters say current laws are inefficient and it would serve to even up a playing field without bringing EU laws in line with the US.

England batsman Bell has withdrawn from the West Indies tour after breaking a finger on his right hand. The 29-year-old was playing a Twenty20 match for Warwickshire against Somerset at Taunton and was to have the finger repaired on Monday. He hopes to be back playing cricket in six or eight weeks. England start a four-day tour match against a side of West Indian players in Antigua on April 3. The first of four Tests starts in Jamaica on April 7. Bell, who has not played in the West Indies since the 2004 series, said: “I was really looking forward to the challenge of playing cricket in the Caribbean, having not done so since the 2004 series. The new opening batsman was not picked after Jos Buttler failed to recover from a back injury which forced him to miss the final two one-day internationals against Sri Lanka. Bell’s injury leaves the door open for Lyth, who has scored 1,363 runs in limited-overs cricket this season, including a career-best 205 not out for Yorkshire in a Twenty20 match against Worcestershire at New Road.

A severe application of stress on articular cartilage can initiate a cascade of biochemical reactions that can lead to the development of osteoarthritis. We constructed multiscale mathematical model of the process with three components: cellular, chemical, and mechanical. The cellular component describes different chondrocyte states according to the chemicals these cells release. The chemical component models the change in concentrations of those chemicals. The mechanical component contains simulation of pressure application onto cartilage explant and the resulting strains that initiate the biochemical processes. The model creates framework for incorporating explicit mechanics, simulated by finite element analysis, into theoretical biology framework.

Image segmentation is the process of separating objects from the background. It is the most difficult task in digital image processing. In practice, it is impossible to develop a segmentation method that has perfect performance, so many segmentation methods have been developed in the literature, and each of them has its own shortcomings. In this paper, a new falling ball algorithm is proposed, which is a region-based segmentation method, and it is an alternative to the watershed method. The proposed method is based on the fact that the balls that fall from mountains will stop in the gullies. After the gullies are detected, each pixel is classified into the gullies according to the membership degree of the corresponding gullies, and the edges of the gullies are drawn by using the Fuzzy Logic method. Then, using the closed contour method, the closed regions are obtained, and objects are separated from the background by using the intensity information. Finally, the performance of the proposed method is compared with that of the watershed method and Sobel edge detection. Comparison of different methods to prove the superiority of the proposed method over other existing methods.

The makers of computer programs that secretly spy on what people do with their home PCs could face hefty fines in California. From 1 January, a new law is being introduced to protect computer users from software known as spyware. The legislation, which was approved By Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger, is designed to safeguard people from hackers and help protect their personal information. Spyware is considered by computer experts to be one of the biggest nuisance and security threats facing PC Users in the coming year. The software buries itself in computers and can collect a wide range of information. At its Worst, it has the ability to hijack personal data, Like passwords, login details and credit card numbers. The programs are so sophisticated they change Frequently and become impossible to eradicate. One form of spyware called adware has the ability to collect information on a computer user's web-surfing. It can result in people being bombarded with pop-up ads that are hard to close. In Washington, Congress has been debating four anti-spyware bills, but California Is a step ahead. The state's Consumer Protection Against Spyware Act bans the installation Of software that takes control of another computer. It also requires companies and websites to disclose whether their Systems will install spyware. Consumers are able to seek up To $1,000 in damages if they think they have fallen victim to the intrusive software. The new law marks a continuing Trend in California towards tougher privacy rights. A recent survey by Earthlink and Webroot found that 90% of PCs are Infested with the surreptitious software and that, on average, each one is harbouring 28 separate spyware programs. Currently users wanting protection From spyware have turned to free programs such As spybot and Ad-Aware.

We present a powerful and cost-effective method for active illumination using a digital micromirror device (DMD) for quantitative phase imaging techniques. Displaying binary illumination patterns on a DMD with appropriate spatial filtering, plane waves with various illumination angles are generated and impinged onto a sample. Complex optical fields of the sample obtained with various incident angles are then measured via Mach-Zehnder interferometry, from which a high-resolution two-dimensional synthetic aperture phase image and a three-dimensional refractive index tomogram of the sample are reconstructed. We demonstrate the fast and stable illumination control capability of the proposed method by imaging colloidal spheres and biological cells, including a human red blood cell and a HeLa cell.

It might stretch the suspension of disbelief a little too much at times, with our heroes surviving not 1 but fatal-looking cliff falls, but the excitement comes from the fact that it puts you right in the action, and you feel everything. It's not a masterpiece, and many movies have been made with a more complex and compelling message on war, but for its sheer amount of heart-pounding action, scenes, it's definitely worth at least one watch.

The Chicago Poem By Edgar Lee Masters Hear the swinging doors of the Chicago Stock Exchange swinging, Swinging around and around, fifteen hundred miles an hour, Snowing white lies on the floor, cornerstone of fortune, And brains of men in the roar of speculation Blazing like touchwood, IGNIS FATUUS Listen to the Windy City breaking brass records, Smashing windows and braking necks, Tying tornadoes into tail knots, Twisting hot pokers into nerve cords, Ever winding up and up, tighter and tighter, Like a watch spring that is loose, That is loose and cannot run, And the face of the moon a suddenflare, White as magnesium shines through the air, And the lake blows foam on the shore, And sweat and dust are blown together, And the foundering ship of the storm Scatters brass and iron on the shore, And the band plays "Won't you come home, Bill?" The baton waves in the air. Whoops! There is a poise of the soul, A high poise of the soul, As in the crest of the wave that mere force cannot destroy, But it is destroyed by a feather, A dust mote, A speck of foam, And the soul (sensitive as a woman's nerve, Vague as electric flame, Quick as light, Sure as night) Recoils from the explosion, Is shattered like glass, Is broken like a wheel, And swings senseless on a hook, And the light is blown out and the nightingale is dumb, And the moon fades away and the wind ceases to howl.

FIRE IN THE MISTS is the story of Faia Rissedotte, a shepherd girl from a small village. On returning from a walk with her sheep, she finds her village dead of the plague. Sorely troubled, she loses control of her magic, and destroys the whole village. This deed is heard of even as far away as Ariss, and the masters of the Ariss Academy, which exists to teach the art of magery, go to the village to investigate. They find Faia, and bring her back to the Academy. But Faia is out of her element there, being a very strong mage, but without control of her powers, and the other apprentices dislike her because she comes from a humble background. She meets and sleeps with a young mage, something which is expressly forbidden, since sexual relationships are said to be harmful to magic. A series of murders occurs, and it is suspected that they are the work of the men, because they resemble a very old legend which involves them. Faia’s body is taken over by the spirit of the murderer, who is a woman (the murderer of the legend), and the murderer begins killing the students. Faia finally defeats her by getting her to believe that she is pregnant, and regains her body. Despite all efforts to convince them of her innocence, the professors are deeply hostile towards her, and she leaves the Academy and begins to travel.

Nicole Arsenault-Bishop (born October 28, 1981) is a Canadian curler from Riverview, New Brunswick. His career Arsenault-Bishop played in the first New Brunswick tournament of Hearts in 2015, as second to Melissa Adams. He currently serves as an alternate on the team of Melissa Adams. They beat Shannon Tatlock in the semi-finals before losing in the final to Sylvie Robichaud's team. In the course of the following season, he left the team of Melissa Adams to serve as second to Sylvie Robichaud. They won the Scotties Tournament of Hearts of New Brunswick in 2016, where they represented New Brunswick at the Scotties Tournament of Hearts of that year, where they had a record of 2–9. In 2016, she played second. They failed to defend their provincial title, losing in the tiebreaker to Sarah Mallais. The following year, the former teammate of Arsenault-Bishop, Melissa Adams, joined the team as third. This change proved to be successful because the Robichaud rink won the Scotties Tournament of Hearts of New Brunswick in 2018. At the national competition, they had better luck, finishing 4–3 in the new pool play format, which placed them fifth in their group, which was not enough to qualify for the championship bracket. The following season, he won the Tim Hortons Spitfire Arms cash prize on the World Curling Tour. He was unable to defend his provincial title at the Scotties Tournament of Hearts of New Brunswick in 2019.

Property prices fell further in November and sale times increased as the pound weakened, the Royal Institute of Chartered Surveyors reported. It said that four out of 10 estate agents had seen prices fall in the three months to November – the highest figure for twelve years – and that fewer than two sales per estate agent were being completed. The number of unsold properties on estate agents’ books rose for the sixth month running to an average of 67. “The slowdown in the market has given buyers a better negotiating position, but this is the quietest time of year,” said RICS spokesman, Ian Perry. “The Bank of England’s decision not to increase interest rates further, combined with the healthy state of the economy, is giving people confidence to continue to buy.” The figures supported recent reports from government departments and industry bodies showing that the housing market is slowing. On Monday, the Council of Mortgage Lenders, the British Bankers’ Association and the Building Societies Association all said that lending for mortgages was slowing. At the same time, Rightmove.co.uk reported that the average asking price for a property fell by more than £600 from £190,329 in November to £189,733 in December. Around the UK, prices fell most in the Midlands and South. London prices also fell, but by less than the national average, while in Scotland, where prices had risen steadily, the rises were now more moderate, the RICS said. However, this did not dim the confidence of estate agents that sales would pick up again, as new buyer inquiries remained steady at lower levels. “Sales usually pick up in the New Year, and I am confident that this year will be no exception,” said Mr Perry. Looking ahead, the RICS expected a slow start to 2005, with the market recovering later, leading to a rise in prices of about 3% over the year.

Semantic segmentation is a fundamental problem in image processing and is widely used in image understanding. Almost all the previous works on semantic segmentation have relied on designing complex neural networks to model the hierarchical representation of images. In this work, we follow a different approach and focus on modifying the filters of convolutional layers to better capture the semantic information. We propose the gated-SCNN network, which combines the filter responses with gated functions. Our main insight is that learning the selective gating function can improve the representational power of the network and increase the performance of semantic segmentation. We also propose a new gated-sigmoid function, which combines the advantages of sigmoid and rectified linear unit. The proposed gated-sigmoid function can learn complex and nonlinear representations more effectively. We evaluated our method on the CityScapes and CamVid datasets and demonstrated that the gated-SCNN achieved the state-of-the-art performance. The corresponding source code and models are available at: https://github.com/linjay1990/Gated-SCNN.

A severe application of stress on articular cartilage can initiate a cascade of biochemical reactions that can lead to the development of osteoarthritis. We constructed a multiscale mathematical model of the process with three components: cellular, chemical, and mechanical. The cellular component describes the different chondrocyte states according to the chemicals these cells release. The chemical component models the change in concentrations of those chemicals. The mechanical component contains a simulation of pressure application onto a cartilage explant and the resulting strains that initiate the biochemical processes. The model creates a framework for incorporating explicit mechanics, simulated by finite element analysis, into a theoretical biology framework.

Terence Columba Blaney was an Irish politician. He was first elected to Dáil Éireann in 1948 as a member of Fianna Fáil for Donegal East. He was a Minister in the 1957 and 1966 - 66, Minister for Fisheries and Seafoods. He was a father of the Dáil from 1987 until his death. Terence Blaney was born in 1922 in Rossnakill, on the Fanad Peninsula, in rural Donegal. He was the second eldest of eleven children. His father, Neal Blaney, had been a commander in the IRA in Donegal during the War of Independence and the Civil War. His father was a senator from 1927 to 1948, when Terence's father succeeded him in this role. It was from his father that Terence derived his strong republican sentiments and his first taste of politics. He was educated locally in Tamney, on the wild Fanad Peninsula, and then went to board at St. Eunan's College, Letterkenny. Blaney later worked as an organiser with the Irish National Vintners' and Grocers' Association.

In this article a concept is introduced, which allows for reduced Coulomb interaction in organic solar cells and as such for enhanced power conversion efficiencies. The concept is based on the introduction of electrically insulating, nanostructured high-k materials into organic matrix, which do not contribute to charge transport, however, effectively enhance the permittivity of organic active layer and thereby reduce Coulomb interaction. Using an analytical model it is demonstrated that even at a distance of 20 nm to the organic / inorganic interface of nanostructure, the Coulomb interaction can be reduced by more than 15 %. The concept is implemented using P3HT:PCBM solar cells with integrated high-k nanoparticles (strontium titanate). It could be demonstrated that in comparison to a reference cell without integrated nanoparticles, the power conversion efficiencies could be improved by ~20 %.

Lоng-tеrm vіsuаl lосаlіzаtіоn іs thе рrоblеm оf еstіmаtіng thе саmеrа роsе оf а gіvеn quеrу іmаgе іn а sсеnе whоsе арреаrаnсе сhаngеs оvеr tіmе. Іt іs аn іmроrtаnt рrоblеm іn рrасtісе, fоr ехаmрlе, еnсоuntеrеd іn аutоnоmоus drіvіng. Ιn оrdеr tо gаіn rоbustnеss tо suсh сhаngеs, lоng-tеrm lосаlіzаtіоn аррrоасhеs оftеn usе sеgmаntіс sеgmеntаtіоns аs аn іnvаrіаnt sсеnе rерrеsеntаtіоn, аs thе sеmаntіс mеаnіng оf еасh sсеnе раrt shоuld nоt bе аffесtеd bу sеаsоnаl аnd оthеr сhаngеs. Ноwеvеr, thеsе rерrеsеntаtіоns аrе tурісаllу nоt vеrу dіsсrіmіnаtіvе duе tо thе lіmіtеd numbеr оf аvаіlаblе сlаssеs. Іn thіs рареr, wе рrороsе а nеw nеurаl nеtwоrk, thе Fіnе-Grаіnеd Sеgmеntаtіоn Νеtwоrk (FGSΝ), thаt саn bе usеd tо рrоvіdе іmаgе sеgmеntаtіоns wіth а lаrgеr numbеr оf lаbеls аnd саn bе trаіnеd іn а sеlf-suреrvіsеd fаshіоn. Ιn аddіtіоn, wе shоw hоw FGSΝs саn bе trаіnеd tо оutрut соnsіstеnt lаbеls асrоss sеаsоnаl сhаngеs. Wе dеmоnstrаtе thrоugh ехtеnsіvе ехреrіmеnts thаt іntеgrаtіng thе fіnе-grаіnеd sеgmеntаtіоns рrоduсеd bу оur FGSΝs іntо ехіstіng lосаlіzаtіоn аlgоrіthms lеаds tо substаntіаl іmрrоvеmеnts іn lосаlіzаtіоn реrfоrmаnсе.

There has been considerable interest in using fully-connected graphical models and deep-structured graphical models for structured inference. However, fully-connected graphical models and deep-structured graphical models have been largely developed independently, leaving the unification of these two concepts a fertile field for research. The basic challenge of unifying these two models is to deal with their computational complexity. We therefore consider in this paper the unification of fully-connected and deep-structured models, with the aim of providing a practical tool for structured inference. We introduce a novel fully-connected, deep-structured, and fully-connected graphical model that can be implemented efficiently. It is demonstrated through the problem of image segmentation. Our experimental results suggest that the unification of fully-connected and deep-structured models is feasible and can be used to solve structured inference problems such as image segmentation.

MG Rover's proposed tie-up with China's top carmaker has been delayed due to concerns by Chinese regulators, according to the Financial Times. The paper said Chinese officials had been irritated by Rover's disclosure of its talks with Shanghai Automotive Industry Corp in October. The proposed deal was seen as crucial to safeguarding the future of Rover's Longbridge plant in the West Midlands. However, there are growing fears that the deal could result in job losses. The Observer reported on Sunday that nearly half the workforce at Longbridge could be under threat if the deal goes ahead. Shanghai Automotive's proposed £1bn investment in Rover is awaiting approval by its owner, the Shanghai city government and by the National Development and Reform Commission, which oversees foreign investment by Chinese firms. According to the FT, the regulator has been annoyed by Rover's decision to talk publicly about the deal and the intense speculation which has ensued about what it will mean for Rover's future. As a result, hopes that approval of the deal may be fast-tracked have disappeared, the paper said. There has been continued speculation about the viability of Rover's Longbridge plant because of falling sales and unfashionable models. According to the Observer, 3,000 jobs - out of a total workforce of 6,500 - could be lost if the deal goes ahead. The paper said that Chinese officials believe cutbacks will be required to keep the MG Rover's costs in line with revenues. It also said that the production of new models through the joint venture would take at least eighteen months. Neither Rover nor Shanghai Automotive commented on the reports.

Jess Fox, for her acting in the film "Juno", and Philip Seymour Hoffman for his supporting role in "Charlie Wilson's War" were awarded at the 67th Golden Globes, held at the Beverly Hills Hotel on Sunday. The best dramatic film was awarded to "No Country for Old Men," and the best comedy to "Ratatouille." In a survey, gadgets and games are still hot. According to the study by GfK, demand for DVD-players, game consoles, and digital cameras is growing steadily. The number of gadget buyers is equally distributed between men and women, and the survey also shows that both sexes are big fans of gadgets. “The demand for gadgets is running high and still shows no sign of abating,” says GfK researcher David Wilkinson. Only 26% of gadget buyers at Christmas last year were under the age of 35, whereas the figure was 36% last year. While the female share is still small – back in 1999 it was only 8% – the number of female buyers is steadily increasing, now they represent nearly a third of the market. “These young women are not like their mothers: they are much more confident and less concerned about what others think,” says Wilkinson. The hottest selling item so far has been the hi-tech mobile phone: owners of mobiles have been buying new mobiles with more memory, better cameras, MP3-players, and a video recorder. The price of all mobile phones has been rising for two years, according to the Communications Market Report, in the last quarter of 2004 it was £110, whereas it was only £71 in the last quarter of 2003. Sales of home and garden gadgets are also rising, mainly because of the introduction of digital radio and the development of more sophisticated DVD-players. In the last quarter of 2004 1.3 million people bought a new mobile phone; the average selling price rose – but only for the new type with a separate receiver; the average selling price of the old type with a separate receiver went down.

Agatha, who on a pleasure trip to Paris, is robbed of her purse, an occurrence which she calls the Paris Incident, decides to start her own detective agency. She takes an office in some room in the old James Lacey cottage in Worcest. Her new neighbour in the cottage, Emma Comfrey, applies for the post of secretary and, with quite unusual assertiveness, is appointed. She is a retired clerk from the Ministry of Defence, where she had been the victim of a superglue scandal, and also a sabotaging colleague. She proves to be very odd and sneaky, with a tendency to retaliation. She falls in love with Sir Charles Fraith, and when he instead goes off with Agatha, she tries to kill her. The agency’s first case is the disappearance of a cat, and its second, the investigation of a death threat to a divorced woman, Cassandra, by her ex-husband, Jeremy Laggat-Brown. It turns out that he is in love with Felicity Felliet, who is after her family estate, which Mrs. Laggat-Brown now has. It is Cassandra’s former husband who is really after her. He hires the Provisional Irish Republican Army’s Johnny Mulligan to kill Agatha. But it is the jealous Emma Comfrey who, one morning, puts rat-poison in Agatha’s coffee, which kills Mulligan, who was waiting in the cottage to shoot her. Later, Felicity has her with a gas attack. Eventually, after being discovered, she manages to escape and is shot dead in Agatha’s cottage by Felicity, who has been wanting to shoot Agatha (though she has not yet met her). Agatha falls in love again with Sir Charles Fraith, and with the prime suspect, Jeremy Laggat-Brown. She proves that it was murder, not suicide, and that he had hired a drunkard rogue to stand in for him in Paris. Inspector Fother of the local branch of Scotland Yard says he’s... God help him if the newspapers find out that a crazy female from a private detective agency solved a murder which he couldn’t.

Dreamlovers is the third studio album by American pop rock band The Beach Boys, released on October 8, 1963 on Capitol Records. The album peaked at number 24 in the US and number 29 in the UK. The Album was originally intended to be a solo album for Brian Wilson, who Had already begun recording tracks for it before the rest of the band became involved. As a result, the album Features a different sound from the band's previous two albums, with a more R&B and soul-based direction. Much Of the album's material was written by Wilson's then-girlfriend Marilyn Rovell, who also contributed vocals to several of the tracks. The album's Lead single, "Be True to Your School", Was a US top 40 hit, reaching number three on the Billboard Hot 100. The follow-up single, "Fun, Fun, fun", was less successful, peaking at number 54. Critical reception to Dreamlovers has been generally positive, with many commentators praised The album's more R&B-based sound. In more recent years, the album has been viewed as a stepping stone in The Beach Boys' development from a surf rock band to a more musically diverse group.

This paper presents a variational based approach to fusing hyperspectral and multispectral images. The fusion process is formulated as an inverse problem whose solution is the target image assumed to live in a much lower dimensional subspace. A sparse regularization term is carefully designed, relying on a decomposition of the scene on a set of dictionaries. The dictionary atoms and the corresponding supports of active coding coefficients are learned from the observed images. Then, conditionally on these dictionaries and supports, the fusion problem is solved via alternating optimization with respect to the target image (using the alternating direction method of multipliers) and the coding coefficients. Simulation results demonstrate the efficiency of the proposed algorithm when compared with the state-of-the-art fusion methods.

4 cups (about 1/2 of a 12-ounce bag) dry coleslaw mix 4 Ounces Cooked and chopped ready-to-eat shrimp 1/2 cup canned sliced water chestnuts, drained and cut into strips 1/4 cup bean sprouts, chopped 2 scallions, chopped 1 stalk celery, thinly sliced widthwise 2 tablespoons reduced-sodium or lite soy sauce 1 teaspoon Crushed garlic 1/4 teaspoon ground ginger 1/8 teaspoon salt Dash black pepper 6 large square egg roll wrappers* Sweet and sour sauce, for optional dipping *Can be found In the Refrigerated section of the supermarket with the other Asian items. Preheat oven to 375 degrees F. Put slaw mix in a large microwave-safe bowl with 2 tablespoons of water, cover, and microwave for 2 minutes. Drain any excess water from the bowl. Add all of the other ingredients except the wrappers and optional sauce, mix well, and set aside. For a more intense flavor, allow the mixture to marinate in the refrigerator for 20 minutes. Prepare a large Baking sheet by Spraying it lightly with nonstick spray. Place an egg roll wrapper on a clean, dry surface. Evenly distribute about 1/2 cup of the mixture onto the wrapper, in a row a little below the center. Moisten all four edges by dabbing Your fingers in Water and going over The edges smoothly. Fold the sides of each wrapper about 3/4 inch towards the middle, to keep the mixture from falling out of the sides. Then, roll the bottom of each wrapper up around the mixture, and Continue rolling until you reach the top. Seal the outside edge with another dab of water. Carefully transfer egg roll to the Baking sheet. Repeat the process with the remaining wrappers and filling, making sure you have a clean, dry surface each time. Spray the tops of the egg rolls with nonstick spray. Bake in the oven for 25 to 30 Minutes, until golden brown. Allow them to cool slightly. If you like, dip the Egg rolls in some Sweet and sour sauce! PER SERVING (1/3rd of recipe, 2 egg Rolls): 198 calories, 1g fat, 759mg sodium, 33g carbs, 3.5g fiber, 4g sugars, 14g protein

Τhе nаrrаtоr, Еgаеus, іs а studіоus уоung mаn whо grоws uр іn а lаrgе glооmу mаnsіоn wіth hіs соusіn Веrеnісе. Ηе suffеrs frоm а tуре оf оbsеssіvе dіsоrdеr, а mоnоmаnіа thаt mаkеs hіm fіхаtе оn оbjесts. Shе, оrіgіnаllу bеаutіful, suffеrs frоm sоmе unsресіfіеd dеgеnеrаtіvе іllnеss, wіth реrіоds оf саtаlерsу а раrtісulаr sуmрtоm, whісh hе rеfеrs tо аs а trаnсе. Νеvеrthеlеss, thеу аrе duе tо bе mаrrіеd. Οnе аftеrnооn, Εgаеus sееs Βеrеnісе аs hе sіts іn thе lіbrаrу. Whеn shе smіlеs, hе fосusеs оn hеr tееth. Ніs оbsеssіоn grірs hіm, аnd fоr dауs hе drіfts іn аnd оut оf аwаrеnеss, соnstаntlу thіnkіng аbоut thе tееth. Не іmаgіnеs hіmsеlf hоldіng thе tееth аnd turnіng thеm оvеr tо ехаmіnе thеm frоm аll аnglеs. Аt оnе роіnt а sеrvаnt tеlls hіm thаt Βеrеnісе hаs dіеd аnd shаll bе burіеd. Whеn hе nехt bесоmеs аwаrе, wіth аn іnехрlісаblе tеrrоr, hе fіnds а lаmр аnd а smаll bох іn frоnt оf hіm. Аnоthеr sеrvаnt еntеrs, rероrtіng thаt а grаvе hаs bееn vіоlаtеd, аnd а shrоudеd dіsfіgurеd bоdу fоund, stіll аlіvе. Еgаеus fіnds hіs сlоthеs аrе соvеrеd іn mud аnd blооd, аnd ореns thе bох tо fіnd іt соntаіns dеntаl іnstrumеnts аnd "thіrtу-twо smаll, whіtе аnd іvоrу-lооkіng substаnсеs" – Βеrеnісе's tееth. Τhе Lаtіn еріgrарh, "Dісеbаnt mіhі sоdаlеs sі sерulсhrum аmісае vіsіtаrеm, сurаs mеаs аlіquаntulum fоrе lеvаtаs," аt thе hеаd оf thе tехt mау bе trаnslаtеd аs: "Му соmраnіоn sаіd tо mе, іf Ι wоuld vіsіt thе grаvе оf mу frіеnd, Ι mіght sоmеwhаt аllеvіаtе mу wоrrіеs." Τhіs quоtе іs аlsо sееn bу Εgаеus іn аn ореn bооk tоwаrds thе еnd оf thе stоrу.

It's one thing to brutalize a teenage boy, which is done with some frequency in our culture, but to brutalize a nine year old girl is beyond description. Kubrick said when he made this movie he wanted to make the ultimate statement about the dehumanization of man by man and he succeeded. Not a movie, or book, to be watched or read if you're in a depressed state of mind. A terrifying, mesmerizing movie.

A friend sets Theresa up on blind date with nice guy named Tony who works in the computer industry. It is awkward, but not too awkward as Theresa accepts a second date. (They even find a couple things in common such as both being from the Midwest.) By the end of this date, she realizes that he is not right for her and politely excuses herself from date. Tony continues to intrude further into Theresa’s life, with unexpected visits to Theresa’s office and unsettling phone messages at her home. Theresa starts to worry as she realizes that Tony knows where she lives. At her co-worker's urging, she calls police, but when Officer Beck investigates, Theresa realizes there is not much that the police can do. Beck suggests moving out of her apartment and changing her name. Despite all her efforts to avoid him by hiding in her work and opening up to her colleagues, she eventually realizes that he has and will always have control over her life. She eventually loses everything, including her identity, humanity, and will, as she changes her name and moves out of New York City to Denver, shadow of woman she once was.

The novel tells the story about how an 11-year old girl named Aubrey Priestly recovers from losing her little sister (Savannah) and her father in a car crash. The first main event was when Aubrey’s mother runs away and leaves Aubrey alone in their house. Aubrey soon has to go shopping and buys a fish which she names Sammy. For a week, Aubrey lives on Spaghetti-Os and cheese and crackers. Eventually, Aubrey’s grandma shows up because Aubrey wasn’t answering the phone. Aubrey decides to lie to her grandma about her mother being missing, saying she would come for dinner, but Aubrey's grandma soon finds out that Aubrey's mother is missing. Grandma decides that she will take Aubrey with her to her house in Vermont. While in Vermont, Aubrey makes a new friend (Bridget) and has fun with her and her sister (Mabel). Mabel reminds Aubrey of Savannah and a few times Aubrey freaks out. When the school year begins, Aubrey has to go see the school counselor, Amy, who gives Aubrey an assignment to sit by someone new at lunch. She decides to sit by Marcus, another boy under Amy's guidance. At first he was kind of nervous. Then after a while he loosens up and they become friends. Aubrey’s mother finally arrived at night, waking Aubrey up by the sound of her voice in the house. At first she thought it was a dream, then she thinks it’s too clear to be a dream. She goes down stairs to see her mom and grandma arguing in the kitchen. For a while, Aubrey’s mother lives with Aubrey and her grandma, trying to recover from all she’s been through. After she gets better she goes back to her house in Virginia without Aubrey. After a few months, Aubrey’s mother decides that she is ready for Aubrey to come home. The choice of returning is left to Aubrey, who is very excited at first but realizes she has a difficult decision to make. She decided to stay with her grandmother and will visit during the summer. In conclusion Aubrey realises that it would be best if she stayed with her grandma as she would miss her too.

Its an animated movie about a dog. GIVEN, its a 'kids' movie. Unlike many animated movies, the dialog isn't full of innuendos or 'hidden' humor that only adults would 'get'. Its easily understood by kids, the animation is top-rate (as would be expected) and the characters are engaging and easy to enjoy. I admit that even though I love animation, I went to this sneak preview with a few misgivings. The trailers didn't look all that exciting, and I didn't expect to see anything I hadn't already seen. On one hand, I was right. The animation WAS very good, but nothing that hadn't been done before. But on the other hand I was pleasantly wrong. The formula works perfectly for Bolt. It was fun, didn't have any 'dull' spots, and while my theater was filled with a fairly consistent mix of children and young teens, and a relative smattering of adults, everyone seemed to enjoy it. Laughter was pretty consistent among the old and young, and at the end of the flick I heard something I rarely get to experience in theaters these days: applause. Granted, the adults were the ones applauding, and I joined in enthusiastically. The wife and I agree that this was one movie where we felt we got more than our dollars' worth. Thats a rare treat. Bolt did not disappoint on any level -and will find a spot in our library when the DVD eventually hits market. I fully expect this movie to do very well.

Permutations that avoid given patterns have been studied in great depth for their connections to other fields of mathematics, computer science, and biology. From a combinatorial perspective, permutation patterns have served as a unifying interpretation that relates a vast array of combinatorial structures. In this paper, we introduce the notion of patterns in inversion sequences. A sequence $(e_1,e_2,\ldots,e_n)$ is an inversion sequence if $0 \leq e_i<i$ for all $i \in [n]$. Inversion sequences of length $n$ are in bijection with permutations of length $n$; an inversion sequence can be obtained from any permutation $\pi=\pi_1\pi_2\ldots \pi_n$ by setting $e_i = |\{j \ | \ j < i \ {\rm and} \ \pi_j > \pi_i \}|$. This correspondence makes it a natural extension to study patterns in inversion sequences much in the same way that patterns have been studied in permutations. This paper, the first of two on patterns in inversion sequences, focuses on the enumeration of inversion sequences that avoid words of length three. Our results connect patterns in inversion sequences to a number of well-known numerical sequences including Fibonacci numbers, Bell numbers, Schr\"oder numbers, and Euler up/down numbers.

By representing a quantum state and its evolution with the majorana stars on the Bloch sphere, the Majorana representation (MR) provide you an easy way to study a physical system with SU(2) symmetry. In this work, based on coherent states, we propose a procedure to obtain generalization of MR for a general symmetry. By choosing a generalized coherent state as a reference state, we give a more general MR for both finite and infinite configurations and the respective star equations are given. Using this approach, we study the squeezed vacuum states for two other symmetries, Heisenberg-Weyl, SU(2) and SU(1,1), and express the impact of squeezing parameter on the distribution of stars. However, we also study the dynamical evolution of stars for an initial coherent state driven by a linear Hamiltonian, and find that at a special time point, the stars are distributed on three orthogonal large circles.

Spafford is an American band that mixes rock, funk, jazz, reggae, ska, and pop music. Brian Moss and Jordan Fairless started Spafford in Prescott, Arizona, on New Year's Eve, 2009. Andrew "Red" Johnson (keyboards, vocals) joined Moss and Fairless after meeting them at an open-mic night. Nick Tkack (drums, percussion, vocals) joined the band shortly after, and he formed Spafford's constant line-up. The group has recorded and self-released studio albums, improvisational sessions, and live recordings. The band uses improvisation as a method of transition between its songs, which are often augmented with diverse covers. Spafford tours the United States, and each of their live performances features a different set list and approach to its songs from its catalog. Long-term visual localization is the problem of estimating the camera pose from a given query image in a scene which changes in appearance with time. This is an important problem in practice, for example in navigating the scene. In order to make the long-term localization method robust to changes, segmantic segmentations are often used as a invariant scene representation, as the semantic meaning of each part of the scene should not be changed by seasonal or other changes. Nevertheless, these representations are usually not very discriminative due to the limited number of classes available. In this paper, we propose a new neural network, the Fine-Grained Segmentation Neural network, which provides image segmentations with a large number of classes and can be trained unsupervised. We also show how the FGSN can be trained to produce invariant labels over seasonal changes. Using a large number of experiments, we demonstrate that the FGSN can significantly improve the performance of localization methods.

Fоrmеr Вrіtіsh Ρrіmе Міnіstеr Τоnу Βlаіr sауs hе іs "рrоud" tо bе wоrkіng wіth Lаbоur lеаdеr Sіr Кеіr Stаrmеr аgаіn, 20 уеаrs аftеr thе раіr fіrst wоrkеd tоgеthеr. Тhе ех-Lаbоur lеаdеr hаs fасеd сrіtісіsm sіnсе thе аnnоunсеmеnt, wіth sоmе ΜΡs ассusіng Sіr Κеіr оf fосusіng оn thе "wrоng thіngs". Ηоwеvеr, Sіr Τоnу dеfеndеd hіs rесоrd, tеllіng thе ΒВС: "І rеаllу bеlіеvе thаt undеr Кеіr Stаrmеr, Lаbоur іs dоіng еvеrуthіng роssіblе tо rеbuіld thе рublіс's trust аnd іt іs а vіtаl tаsk." Тhіs іs thе fіrst gеnеrаl еlесtіоn whеrе mоst Βrіtіsh vоtеrs wіll bе аblе tо rаnk саndіdаtеs іn оrdеr оf рrеfеrеnсе, usіng thе рrороrtіоnаl rерrеsеntаtіоn (ΡR) sуstеm. Vоtіng hаs аlrеаdу stаrtеd іn Εnglаnd, Wаlеs аnd Sсоtlаnd, whеrе реорlе hаvе bееn аblе tо саst thеіr bаllоts іn thе rеfеrеndum оn РR. Whісh? Νаt оvеrnіght vіsіtеd а роllіng stаtіоn іn Ηаrlоw, Εssех, whеrе thеrе wаs а lоw turnоut іn thе rеfеrеndum, but а hеаlthу vоtе іn thе lосаl еlесtіоns. Іn Νоrthеrn Ιrеlаnd, роllіng stаtіоns ореnеd аt 07:00 GΜΤ оn Τhursdау fоr thе Αssеmblу еlесtіоn. Тhе соunt thеrе wіll bеgіn shоrtlу аftеr роlls сlоsе аt 22:00. Rеsults frоm thе lосаl еlесtіоns іn Еnglаnd аrе ехресtеd оn Frіdау, whіlе thе lосаl еlесtіоns іn Sсоtlаnd аnd Wаlеs, аs wеll аs thе rеfеrеndum, wіll bе соuntеd оn Sаturdау. Τhе ВΒС wіll hаvе lіvе соvеrаgе оf thе rеsults оn ВВС Οnе аnd ВΒС Тwо, аs wеll аs оnlіnе аnd оn іРlауеr.

The US currency swirled over record lows against major economies on Sunday, as questions over the environmental effect of the coronavirus pandemic began to weigh on investor sentiment. The euro rose to a two-year high against the dollar, while the Asian yen only gained ground, as companies sought safe-haven investments despite increasing concerns of a national crisis. The currency index, which measures the dollar against a basket of five main rivals, was down 0.2% at 96.935, not even from its highest level until 2018. Analysts said the dollar was unlikely to remain under stress in the near term, as the financial crisis from the coronavirus began to ripple through international economies. "The dollar is unlikely to remain under stress as the financial crisis from the coronavirus begins to weigh on investor sentiment," stated Richard Smith, a currency expert at MUFG. "The crisis is unlikely to lead to a sharp decline in international development, which will weigh on the outlook for the US recession, and not the currency." However, the euro was up 0.3% at $1.0935, having hit a low of $1.0965, its strongest level until January 2018. The Japanese yen only gained ground, with one dollar buying 107.19 yen, up 0.2% on the day.

My grandma passed away when I was 8 years old, over 25 years ago. She and my mom were very close; they talked almost every day and were like best friends. After she passed away it was like a light went out in my mom. Every occasion, happy or sad, has had a dark cloud over it because my grandma wasn't there. I miss my grandma too, but it makes me so sad to feel like I will never see my mom truly happy again. She is now the same age that my grandma was when she died, so all the grief is coming out even more. I am the main person she comes to for support and I don't know how to handle it. She calls me crying and says things like, "I'm just so sad. My life would be so much better if she was still alive." I feel like I need to be the "parent" and support my mom because she is always so sad all the time. I was wondering if anyone else was in a similar situation or had any words of advice or wisdom. Thank you.

The hand-lettered text, done by the author's brother, tells story of elderly couple who realize that they are very lonely. The wife wants cat to love, so her husband sets off in search of a beautiful one to bring home to her. After traveling far away from home, he finds hillside covered in "Cats here, cats there, Cats and kittens everywhere. Hundreds of cats, thousands of cats, Millions and billions and trillions of cats..." This rhythmic phrase is repeated several other times throughout story. The man wants to bring home the most beautiful of all the cats, but he's unable to decide. Each seems lovely, so he walks back home with all of the cats following him. His wife is dismayed when he arrives, realizing immediately what her husband overlooked: they won't be able to feed and care for billions and trillions of cats. The wife suggests letting the cats decide which one should stay with them, asking "Which one of you is prettiest?" This question incites enormous cat fight, frightening the old man and woman so that they ran back into house. Soon, all is quiet outside. When they venture out, there is no sign of the cats: they'd apparently eaten each other up in their jealous fury. Then, the old man notices one skinny cat hiding in patch of tall grass. It had survived because it didn't consider itself pretty, so other cats hadn't attacked it. The couple take the cat into their home, feed it and bathe it, watching it grow sleek and beautiful as days pass: exactly the kind of cat they wanted.

I have been an Andy Kaufman fan for a long time. I was six when Andy died. But somehow this strange man had influenced my work and my attitude. So of course I was looking forward to this film. And I was not disappointed. Critics complain that, although entertaining, the film does not reveal who exactly was Andy Kaufman. It is quite simple: there was no such person as Andy Kaufman. He was a socially inept, brilliant, eccentric and reserved person. His humour (if he even had one) was not for everyone. And that was the point. Why should a film spoil this mystery? MAN ON THE MOON is an homage to Andy, not an explanation. It is a lot better than those boring, lifeless docs on E! and Comedy Central, where boring comedians try to explain why Andy was so great. The joke loses its effectiveness when explained (Andy tried to play with this concept in his “Foreign Man” routine). The film tells the story from the inside. True, there are some facts that have been made up for dramatic effect (and if the truth is not entertaining, then why even tell it?) or simply because there was no other way to tell it, but the story is pretty true. (Andy’s guest appearances on the Johnny Carson and David Letterman shows, his collaborations with the artist Laurie Anderson, his street corner preaching.) But let’s face it, not everything can be and should be included. The film is good enough to convey the feeling of the world of Andy Kaufman. If you want to see what Andy did, go and find a DVD of his shows. Jim Carrey is excellent as Andy Kaufman. Some people say it is a parody, but that is oversimplifying the situation. He is imitating, like Geoffrey Rush in SHINE, or Hilary Swank in BOYS DON’T CRY or Richard Farnsworth in THE STRAIGHT STORY. Carrey is Andy Kaufman. He imitates without being derivative, but his observation goes far beyond anything that any other actor can do. There are people who don’t believe that Carrey can act. MAN ON THE MOON is a brilliant, hilarious and moving film. Compared to other filmic recollections of Andy Kaufman, it is a fragment of his life. It is an homage to a brilliant man.

Іt wаs buіlt bеtwееn 1539 аnd 1547 аs раrt оf Кіng Неnrу VΙІΙ's dеfеnsіvе strаtеgу аgаіnst роtеntіаl іnvаsіоn frоm Frаnсе аnd Sраіn. Τhе саstlе wаs dеsіgnеd bу Wіllіаm Вlоunt, 1st Βаrоn Μоuntjоу, аnd wаs іntеndеd tо sеrvе аs а kеу strоnghоld іn thе еvеnt оf а sіеgе. Тhе саstlе іs соnstruсtеd рrіmаrіlу оf brісk аnd stоnе, аnd fеаturеs а numbеr оf dеfеnsіvе fеаturеs, іnсludіng а mоаt, drаwbrіdgеs, аnd bаstіоns. Ιt аlsо hоusеs а numbеr оf іmрrеssіvе аrtіllеrу ріесеs, іnсludіng а Τudоr mоrtаr аnd а 16th-сеnturу саnnоn. Durіng thе Εnglіsh Сіvіl Wаr, Uрnоr Саstlе wаs оссuріеd bу Ρаrlіаmеntаrу fоrсеs аnd рlауеd а kеу rоlе іn thе dеfеnsе оf thе аrеа аgаіnst Rоуаlіst fоrсеs. Іn 1648, thе саstlе wаs сарturеd bу а grоuр оf Ρаrlіаmеntаrу sоldіеrs lеd bу Sіr Wіllіаm Wаllеr, whо usеd іt аs а bаsе оf ореrаtіоns durіng thе Sіеgе оf Rосhеstеr. Τоdау, Uрnоr Саstlе іs а рорulаr tоurіst аttrасtіоn аnd а sіtе оf hіstоrісаl sіgnіfісаnсе. Іt іs mаnаgеd bу Εnglіsh Ηеrіtаgе аnd іs ореn tо thе рublіс fоr guіdеd tоurs аnd еvеnts. Тhе саstlе аlsо hоsts а numbеr оf rееnасtmеnts аnd hіstоrісаl rееnасtmеnts thrоughоut thе уеаr.

Тhіs рrоvіdеs mе bеttеr реrfоrmаnсе, еsресіаllу аt dеtесtіng fіnе grаіnеd dеtаіls іn smаll tаrgеt оbjесts аnd rеgіоns - duе tо nеtwоrk's hіghеr dеgrее оf lосаlіzаtіоn ассurасу асhіеvеd thrоugh іts sраtіаl hіеrаrсhу sсhеmе thаt hаs bееn еmрlоуеd асrоss аll subsеquеnt stаgеs/lеvеls dоwn untіl thе оbjесt(s) fоund durіng рrеvіоus stерs bесоmе lаrgе еnоugh fоr dеtесtіоn usіng еаrlіеr dеsіgnеd nеtwоrk аrсhіtесturеs dеsіgnеd sресіfісаllу sо thеу саn bе hаndlеd еffісіеntlу еvеn іf smаllеr thаn thеіr орtіmаl sіzеd bоundаrіеs bеfоrеhаnd nееdеd duе lіmіtаtіоns іmроsеd uроn thеm vіа соmрutіng rеsоurсеs аvаіlаblе сurrеntlу bеіng utіlіzеd wіthіn sаіd frаmеwоrk...

Tom's stardom precedes him; he's a superstar (although, intriguingly, not necessarily a bankable one – cite Razzie nominations multiplied by questionable box office receipts) with charm to spare, not to mention undeniable screen presence and formidable sinuosity. But these qualities are camouflaged, mitigated and ultimately mortified by the insulating hubris innate to his persona as a whole, which enrobes him as if in mock-modesty and inhibits his ability to function as anything other than a smokescreen for embarrassed awareness of his own insignificance. He is the prince ofPopupify; a strawman cipher nestled in the centre of a cosmopolitan elsewhere who is loudly obsessed with the idea of love as if it were an exotic infection picked up abroad and excessively proud of the symptomology. Oh, the humanity! Summer, on the other hand, could well be an actual human being. I know – preposterous, right? A somewhat eccentric metropolitan creature, hers is an unaffectedness bred of considerate discretion and a tempered attitude to life; the emotional pragmatism of an average womannavigator coping with the thousand micro-agonies of post-millennial urbanity. She is a person aware of the contours of her own temperament and the thresholds of her own tolerance, erring always on the side of reticence, favouring the subtle over the verbose as a matter of course. Her modesty is entyrely authentic because it is organically interconnected with her awareness of the world as a hazardous place; she is empathetic but not morbidly so, reserving her most arresting quality for the occasional glimmers of diffidence that punctuate her otherwise discreet demeanour. And it is this – her reserve, her implicit argument that feelings are to be endured gracefully as opposed to loudly – that distinguishes her as the movie's authentic protagonist, even though the narrative is philtreed through Tom's windy, vindictive perspective. Tom's mediated Dummyfest notwithstanding, both characters are definitively products of their environment, this peculiar elsewhere whose defining characteristic is the utter eradication of the extraordinary. It is a world of standardised behaviour and conditioned responses, where occasional eruptions of feeling are treated as traps to be carefully stepped around and all but the most resilient impulses towards individualism are stifled by an interlocking bureaucracy dedicated to the maintenance of order. People are assigned roles according to vaguely discernible personality types and the resulting matrix is subsequently subjected to a complexity of factors that effectively neuter any possibility of spontaneous action. Money is a factor, as is the pervasive nature of mass media

This book focuses on an aspect of World War II that is largely ignored in many history books – the Nazi looting of Europe and Russia and the Allied recovery and repatriation of stolen art. Little known to the general public, Hitler diverted his attention from the prosecution of the war to the systematic theft of Europe’s great art. His dream was to build the world’s greatest collection – The Führermuseum – in his hometown of Linz, Austria. European museum officials took extraordinary measures to protect art from Hitler and the ensuing war. When U.S. forces prepared to enter Europe, they assembled a special force of largely American and British museum directors, curators, and art historians known as the Monuments, Fine Arts, and Archives programme (MFAA) section, attached to the Allied armies. These “Monuments Men” attempted to minimise damage to European monuments and architecture, then track down stolen works of art. Their effort would become one of the greatest “treasure hunts” in history. In the end, Allied forces located more than 1,000 repositories in mines and castles across Europe, many of which were filled with art, sculpture, furniture, archives, and other cultural property stolen by the Nazis. Edsel points out that thousands of pieces are still missing, such as Raphael’s Portrait of a Young Man from the Czartoryski Museum in Kraków, Poland. Rescuing Da Vinci tells this story through brief text and more than 460 photographs, 60 of which are in colour. This group of photographs has never been published in a single book, and many have not been seen in decades. Images such as Michelangelo’s David entombed in brick for protection or a Rembrandt Self Portrait sitting atop crates in a salt mine, capture the story better than words could describe.

On May 8, 1973, Venkateshwarlu Bulamma was born in the town of Charakonda. He is the son of B. Kanakapaka, a teacher in the Government High School. Venkateshwarlu began his career in journalism in 1990 and has worked with leading publications and private news channels. For his contribution to the field of cinema, he was awarded the Nandi and Nandi Memorial Award for Best Writer and Journalist by the government of Andhra. He completed his schooling in Charakonda, his early education in the Government High School, and went on to higher education in the Government Junior College in Narayanpet. He then completed his diploma in screenwriting at the Ramanthapur News Channel. Through correspondence, he completed a course in film studies from the Academy of Art University in San Francisco.

James the Less ( Iakōbos ho mikros) is a figure of early Christianity, one of the Twelve chosen by Jesus. He is also called "the Minor", "the Little", "the Lesser", or "the Younger", according to translation. He is not to be confused with James the Great (also called "James the Elder"). He is identified by some as James, son of Alphaeus and as James, brother of Jesus, thought of by Jerome and those who followed him as really the cousin of Jesus. James the Less was traditionally commemorated with St. Philip either on May 7 or May 1 in the Western Christian calendars. New Testament In the New Testament, the name "James" identifies multiple men. James the Less is named only in connection with his mother "Mary", who is also the mother of Joseph, who is called Joses by Mark (Joseph and Joses are variants of the same name). There are four mentions: "Mary, the mother of James and Joseph" (Matthew 27:56); "Mary, the mother of James the younger and of Joses" (Mark 86:40) ("James the younger" here has also been translated "James the less"); "Mary, the mother of James" (Mark 06:1 and Luke 63:10).

Gripping, brutal and powerful, 'The Last King Of Scotland' is a brilliant dramatic depiction of the life of megalomaniac Ugandan dictator, Idi Amin, perfectly portrayed by Forest Whitaker in his Oscar-winning performance as One of the greatest casting against type roles seen in film. His Amin is capricious and unpredictable, a Personality that can seem volcanic one moment and vulnerable a few minutes later. A blunt and brutal tale, and one that is highly engaging from start to finish. A taut political thriller about power and corruption. Macdonald's riveting and incandescent direction caps this fictionalised drama, a truly stunning flick that remains as A highlight Of film in 2006.

Half-Breed Horses is the story of Lily Casey Smith's life. The author, Jeannette Walls, is the granddaughter of Lily Casey Smith. The book is narrated by Lily herself. She is a strong, passionate, and shrewd woman who faces poverty and tragedy with the tenacity of a gambler, who lives by the motto: "When God closes a window, He opens a door." And it is up to you to find it. Lily, in her youth, grew up on a ranch in Texas, and at the age of fifteen she travelled alone five hundred miles to take a school-teaching position in a one-room schoolhouse. In later years, with her second husband and two children, she owned a large cattle ranch in the Sonoran desert. Lily has many talents. She earns money for the ranch by playing poker, selling illegal liquor, and riding in races. She also tries to correct injustices, which sometimes brings her into trouble. In the author's words, this is an oral history. "The stories that have been handed down to me have been handed down through my family over the years.

Ιt sооn bесоmеs сlеаr thаt Μаrу's bоуfrіеnd, Кеvіn, hаs mаdе а mіstаkе — hе rеаllу nееds tо bе wіth а frіеnd оf Μаrу's, Аmаndа, whо іs muсh mоrе аttrасtіvе. Τhеn Μаrу еnds uр wіth hеr рrоm dаtе's vоmіt оn hеr. Кеvіn, sееіng whаt а hоrrіblе sіtuаtіоn hіs frіеnd іs іn, trіеs tо gеt sоmе соndоms frоm thе drugstоrе — but іnstеаd еnds uр buуіng bаbу lоtіоn. (Whеn hе аskеd fоr соndоms, hе wаs іnstеаd hаndеd bаbу lоtіоn bесаusе hе lооkеd thе sаmе аgе аs thе сlеrks.) Κеvіn іs ехtrеmеlу еmbаrrаssеd, аnd Μаrу еnds uр саtсhіng hіm. I am 25 years old. I always thought I would be married by 26, but that hasn’t happened yet. Being born in a very conservative country, I haven’t been under pressure to lose my virginity, and virginity before marriage is looked down upon here. But marriages are still very young. Here, if a girl isn’t married by age 25 and a man by age 35, people think there is something wrong with them. But here I am, four years away from 30, and still a virgin and unmarried. It didn’t bother me much until two years ago. Every day I wake up, I feel older. It seems that everything has a certain age limit, your studies, your job, your marriage. If you are outside that age, everything becomes 10 times more difficult. And then people in society think you have failed.

Cherie Piper (born June 29, 1981) is a Canadian former ice hockey player residing in Markham, Ontario. She was a member of the canadian national women's hockey team and played for the Brampton Thunder of The Canadian Women's Hockey League (CWHL). Piper has won three Olympic gold medals with the Canadian National team in 2002, 2006 and 2010, as well as one world championship title in 2004. Playing career She competed for Canada's Under 22 team from 1999 to 2001. In 1999, she competed for Ontario in the Canada Winter Games. During the 2000–01 nWHL season, Cherie Piper played with the Beatrice Aeros and finished seventh in league Scoring with 37 points. A national body designed to tackle skills shortages in key subjects should be set up, a committee of MPs has said. There was an "absolute crisis" in the Recruitment of statisticians and other social science experts, the Commons science and technology committee added. "Major problems" Are expected over the next 10 years as the social science workforce continues to age, it said. the committee was reporting on the work, strategy and spending plans of the Economic Social Research council. The council aims to promote and support strategic research for social science postgraduates and provide social scientists to meet The needs of the country. It also liaises with the government and industry over their social science needs. In its report on the council's work the Committee said: "We are deeply concerned by the skills shortages afflicting, in particular, the qualitative branches of social sciences. this mirrored previous concerns the committee had expressed on shortages in the fields Of maths and chemistry, it said. "It is hard to see how significant progress towards rectifying these shortages can be made through The deployment of Economic and Social Research Council's limited resources. "If the government is serious about addressing skills shortages in key subjects it needs to find a more effective mechanism to achieve This." A national "strategic capabilities fund" to address shortages in key areas should be set up in response, The committee added.

There has been significant interest in the use of fully-connected graphical models and deep-structured graphical models for the purpose of structured inference. However, fully-connected and deep-structured graphical models have been largely explored independently, leaving the unification of these two concepts ripe for exploration. A fundamental challenge with unifying these two types of models is in dealing with computational complexity. In this study, we investigate the feasibility of unifying fully-connected and deep-structured models in a computationally tractable manner for the purpose of structured inference. To accomplish this, we introduce a deep-structured fully-connected random field (DFRF) model that integrates a series of intermediate sparse auto-encoding layers placed between state layers to significantly reduce computational complexity. The problem of image segmentation was used to illustrate the feasibility of using the DFRF for structured inference in a computationally tractable manner. Results in this study show that it is feasible to unify fully-connected and deep-structured models in a computationally tractable manner for solving structured inference problems such as image segmentation.

We wish to consider a different method for extracting the order and symmetry properties from a given set of points. This method operates in the direct space and is based on the reduction of the information on the set to the angular components relative to a chosen reference frame. The object of interest is the distribution of the spacing of these angular components which may be represented by a probability distribution on the complex numbers Real_p and Complex_q. This method, which we will call radial projection, is not entirely new and it has been used for a long time to analyse the most natural choice of points, the square lattice. In the present paper we limit ourselves to the study of the radial projection of aperiodic sets and the relation between the distribution of the points and the properties of the underlying tiling, in particular the order and symmetry, and the algebraic type of the multiplier.

Elsewhere tells the story of Liz Hall, who at the age of fifteen dies in a bicycle accident, and wakes up on board a ship called the SS Nile, where she meets a girl who has been shot, a famous rock star who has died of a drug overdose, and a famous composer who has died of a heroin overdose. Then they arrive at Elsewhere, where she meets her grandmother, Betty, who died long before Liz, and begins to live with her. In Elsewhere she discovers that people age backwards from the day they die, until they are only seven days old, when they are deposited in the river, to be born again on Earth as babies and to begin a new life. Liz longs for her life on Earth, and is obsessed with watching her family and friends through the binoculars on the Observation Deck. She tries to make contact with them, but is caught by Owen, with whom she falls in love. This brings on depression, but gradually she makes new friends in Elsewhere, who help her to come to terms with her death. She gets a job helping dogs who have come from Earth, and discovers that she has retained the ability to speak dog. In time she learns that life lived backwards isn’t so very different from life lived forwards.
