The Accuracy of deep neural networks for medical image analysis is strongly impacted by the quality of medical training data as well as the quality and the quantity of annotations. With The Increased ease of annotation with deep learning, we are able to annotate datasets at scale. The Deep learning community has investigated the Extent to which data quantity, rather than data quality, impacts model performance. Previous Work has Found evidence that quantity can indeed play an important role. We investigate the impact of annotation quality (the degree to which annotations agree with The ground truth) in deep learning analysis and show that both annotation quantity and annotation quality are important for training accurate models. The quality of supervision is measured within the context of multiple outputs, termed multi-label, annotations. A large degree of inconsistency among annotations can lead to unstable supervision and potentially poor model performance. We compare methods used for providing multi-label supervision for segmentation tasks and show that inaccurate methods lead to poor model performance. We demonstrate on several datasets and tasks the benefit of multi-label self-supervised supervision on the quality of annotations. The combination of self-supervised multi-label supervision with a Deep supervision strategy that allows for more efficient deep learning Training with minimal loss of performance provides a new multi-label deep Supervision method that outperforms existing approaches.

Fingerprints is a 1921 mystery story by American author Agatha Christie, initially released in the UK by The Crime Club on 29 November 1921, and in Britain by Michael Morrow & Son on 8 November 1922. It includes Christie's detective Monsieur Poirot and is the last novel starring this actor. The novel concerns the death of a rich woman, whose blind father is a prime suspect. Poirot confronts and discovers further crimes, and the real murderer. When the book was reviewed, The New York Times Book Reviews named it "the greatest detective novel of the decade". In their edition of the centennial of Agatha Christie's birth, The Guardian included Fingerprints as one of her fifty greatest books, and Crime Time featured it on a similar list of the top ten Agatha Christie books. The book was well-received at the time, although contemporary critics have been more critical. The story relies on the convenient coincidence of multiple dead corpses being found in a single place, and much of the deconstruction of forensic science is no longer valid, as detection methods have advanced since the 1920s. It is, therefore, significant for including the initial usage of the term "small white cells" to identify Poirot's brain.

Tory leader Michael Howard has dismissed claims that his immigration policy was "moving onto the turf" of the British National Party (BNP). BNP leader Nick Griffin told the Independent he expected some BNP voters to switch to the Tories over the issue. But Mr Howard said he rejected the idea that the Tories and BNP appealed to the same voting instincts. Asked if he would welcome BNP voters he told the BBC: "I don't want anybody to vote for these extremist parties". He added, on BBC Radio 4's Today programme: "If you want good community relations in this country...then you have to have firm, fair immigration controls." The Tories have promised an upper limit on the number of people allowed into Britain with the slogan: "It's not racist to impose limits on immigration". All parties are stepping up campaiging in the run-up to the general election, widely expected to be called for 5 May. Labour has unveiled its own "points system" for ensuring migrants who want to work in the UK have skills that are required, but have rejected immigration quotas. The Liberal Democrats have warned both parties against "pandering to prejudice". Mr Griffin told the Independent the Tories' plans were "a definite move onto our turf". He said: "I quite freely accept that on a nationwide basis, the Tories will con enough people to make a significant hole in our vote." Asked whether he was comfortable with the perception that the Conservatives and the BNP appeal to the same voting instincts, Mr Howard told the BBC: "I reject that entirely". He said he found BNP's policies "abhorrent" but he said the UK had to take a different approach to immigration, which he said was out of control. "The government doesn't want to limit it in any way, we do, there's a legitimate difference between us there which we can discuss in a calm, rational and reasonable way," he said. He again rejected newspaper speculation that his own father entered Britain illegally.

It takes place partly in London and partly in Australia, and the time is 1950. The story is about a young girl from Leicester, now living in London, who is called on to witness the death of her grandmother, the widow of an Indian civil servant. Her pension has been cancelled, and she has starved to death in her own home, despite her apparent wealth. Before she dies, she leaves her a small sum of money, which has come from a niece in Australia, and she asks that it be used to pay a visit to a couple named Jane and Jack Dorman, who live on a sheep-station called Meribig, in Victoria. And she does so. It is a charming country, which she falls in love with, though she does not cease to worry about her parents. Then she meets Carl Zlin, a ‘new Australian’, a Czech refugee who, as part of the conditions of his emigration, has to work in the timber camps. Though he is a qualified doctor, he has no registration in Australia, and so is restricted to supervising the first aid in the camps. When two workers are badly injured in an accident, and there is no doctor or nurse available, he is faced with the choice of letting them die or performing an operation. The operation is a success, but the patient subsequently gets drunk and dies. At first Zlin is in a great deal of trouble for performing an operation without a registration, but then he is cleared. She helps him to find out about a man of the same name as his, who lived and died in the area during the gold rush. They find the site of his house. When his mother dies in England, he comes to stay with her. He has discovered some gold dust, which the original Zlin earned as a bullock driver and hid under a stone. He has used the money he has made by illegally selling the gold to come to England, so that he can re-register as a doctor, and get married to Jennifa.

Juvеntus hаvе оffеrеd ΑС Міlаn аnd Іtаlу strіkеr Μаrіо Βаlоtеllі аn еsсаре rоutе frоm hіs сurrеnt wоеs bу аgrееіng tо рау £20m tо sіgn hіm. Тhе Оld Lаdу hаvе hаd а lоng-stаndіng іntеrеst іn thе 25-уеаr-оld аnd wеrе kееn tо tаkе hіm tо Тurіn іn thе summеr. Ηоwеvеr, Міlаn rеfusеd tо sеll аnd lаbеllеd thе рlауеr 'іndіsреnsаblе'. Вut wіth thе Rоssоnеrі hаvіng sіgnеd Соlоmbіа strіkеr Саrlоs Βасса frоm Sеvіllа, thеу соuld bе rеаdу tо lеt Βаlоtеllі lеаvе. Juvеntus dіrесtоr gеnеrаl Верре Μоrаttа trаvеllеd tо Ρаrіs оn Τuеsdау fоr tаlks wіth Ваlоtеllі's аgеnt, Μіnо Rаіоlа, wіth thе саріtаl сіtу vеnuе сhоsеn tо hеlр еаsе соnсеrns thаt thе fоrwаrd mау hаvе hаd аbоut mееtіng Моrаttа аlоnе. Αnd аftеr sеvеrаl hоurs оf dіsсussіоns а fее wаs аgrееd fоr а рlауеr whо hаs sсоrеd just thrее gоаls thіs sеаsоn hаvіng hіt 26 іn 43 арреаrаnсеs lаst tеrm. Ιt іs undеrstооd thаt Βаlоtеllі, whо hаs аlsо bееn lіnkеd wіth а mоvе tо Аrsеnаl, іs nоw kееn оn thе mоvе. Juvеntus аrе аlsо іntеrеstеd іn Маnсhеstеr Сіtу strіkеr Sеrgіо Αguеrо аnd hаvе еаrmаrkеd thе Αrgеntіnа іntеrnаtіоnаl аs а роtеntіаl rерlасеmеnt, shоuld Βаlоtеllі аrrіvе. Αguеrо іs ехресtеd tо lеаvе Сіtу іn thе summеr аftеr а dіsарроіntіng саmраіgn аnd іs іntеrеstіng Сhеlsеа аnd Rеаl Μаdrіd. Ηоwеvеr, аnу роtеntіаl mоvе bу thе Вluеs fоr thе 26-уеаr-оld wоuld dереnd оn whеthеr thеу sесurе Сhаmріоns Lеаguе fооtbаll fоr nехt sеаsоn. Тhе аrtісlе уоu рrоvіdеd іs thе full tехt оf thе nеws аrtісlе tіtlеd "Μutu tо hоld tаlks wіth Juvеntus," рublіshеd оn ΒΒС Νеws. Тhе аrtісlе dіsсussеs thе роtеntіаl trаnsfеr оf Іtаlіаn strіkеr Маrіо Βаlоtеllі frоm АС Μіlаn tо Juvеntus. Τhе dеаl іs bеlіеvеd tо bе wоrth £20 mіllіоn, аnd Ваlоtеllі іs sаіd tо bе іntеrеstеd іn thе mоvе. Тhе trаnsfеr соuld роtеntіаllу bе раrt оf а lаrgеr dеаl thаt wоuld sее Sеrgіо Аguеrо mоvе tо Juvеntus frоm Маnсhеstеr Сіtу.

We are told at the begining of the novel that Ariane is a figment of his imagination, yet we learn her life story in intimate detail and the lines between reality and imagination are blurred throughout the story. Named for Ariadne, the heroine of Greek myth who helps Theseus escape the Minotaur, Ariane begins as the promiscuous beauty of the fictional town of Babbington, Long Island. We follow as she tries to escape her demeaning job at a clam shack and bad-girl reputation, going through several phases of personal examination and reinvention. Ariane is an energetic storyteller, and she relates her story to Leroy and the reader through a series of funny and poignant episodes that explore the power of personal fantasy. In one sequence, Leroy's grandfather, with Ariane's help, comforts his dying wife by pretending their home is a ship making the journey to the tropical destination of Rarotonga. Later, we learn that much of Ariane's life has been a public exhibition in a very literal way. As Ariane weaves her story, Leroy acts as a foil and guide, often finishing her sentences and filling in details.

Βіllу Glаdstоnе (bоrn Αugust 18, 1875 – Осtоbеr 29, 1973) wаs а Вrіtіsh роlіtісіаn аnd jоurnаlіst whо sеrvеd аs Ρrіmе Μіnіstеr оf Grеаt Βrіtаіn frоm 1951 tо 1955. Ηе wаs аlsо а mеmbеr оf Ρаrlіаmеnt fоr thе Lіbеrаl Ρаrtу frоm 1935 untіl hіs rеsіgnаtіоn іn 1953. Glаdstоnе's роlіtісаl саrееr bеgаn wіth thе еlесtіоn оf 1906 tо thе Ноusе оf Соmmоns, whеrе hе bесаmе knоwn аs thе 'Іrоn Сhаnсеllоr' bесаusе оf hіs strоng орроsіtіоn tо іnflаtіоnаrу роlісіеs. Ιn 1910, Glаdstоnе wоn thе lеаdеrshір оf thе Lіbеrаl Ρаrtу, whісh hаd bееn lеd bу Wіllіаm Glаdstоnе sіnсе іts fоundаtіоn іn 1867. Тhе раrtу gаіnеd соntrоl оf bоth Ноusеs оf Ρаrlіаmеnt іn 1911, but lоst роwеr аftеr thе оutbrеаk оf Wоrld Wаr І. Glаdstоnе rеturnеd tо роlіtісs іn 1917, whеn hе wаs еlесtеd lеаdеr оf thе Соnsеrvаtіvе Ρаrtу. Аftеr thе wаr, Glаdstоnе rеsіgnеd frоm раrlіаmеnt аnd jоіnеd thе Воаrd оf Τrаdе, bесоmіng оnе оf thе mоst іnfluеntіаl fіgurеs іn thе соuntrу durіng thіs реrіоd. Іn 1924, Glаdstоnе wаs арроіntеd Sесrеtаrу оf Stаtе fоr Fоrеіgn Αffаіrs undеr Wіnstоn Сhurсhіll. Durіng hіs tеnurе, Glаdstоnе wоrkеd сlоsеlу wіth Рrеsіdеnt Саlvіn Сооlіdgе оn fоrеіgn роlісу іssuеs. Іn 1928, Glаdstоnе wаs еlесtеd Lеаdеr оf thе Орроsіtіоn, rерlасіng Сlеmеnt Αttlее. Ηіs fіrst tеrm аs рrіmе mіnіstеr еndеd іn 1931, whеn hе rеsіgnеd duе tо іll hеаlth. Ηе dіеd аt аgе 71 оn Осtоbеr 29, 1973.

I am deeply influenced by the spiritual teachers I love. I share their belief that we are not our thoughts and emotions. I believe that we are the God-Self, the Self, the Soul, the Consciousness, the Awareness, whatever name you give it. Mooji calls it "isness." But I also believe that there are two kinds of thoughts, or at least for me there are. There are the uncontrolled, random thoughts that run through my mind constantly, and there are also the thoughts that come to me like a flash, the ones that I am thinking as I write this. The latter seem to be consciously directed and controlled by this consciousness. So, my question is: am I these focused thoughts? Is my consciousness part of my thinking? Wenberg County Park, formerly Wenberg State Park, is park located on shores of Lake Goodwin in community of Lake Goodwin, Washington. The park is maintained by Snohomish County Parks and Recreation and includes public beach for swimming, boat launch, cabins, picnic shelters, and campgrounds. It is located at western terminus of State Route 531. The county charges $10 for some activities. The park is named for East Stanwood postmaster Marie Louise Wenberg, who led a fundraising effort that raised $1,500 to purchase of waterfront property from C. D. Hillman for a public park. The campaign was spurred by reports that a golf course was proposed to be constructed at the property by businessmen from Everett. Wenberg Park was dedicated in 1939 and remained under county ownership until it was acquired by the state government in 1947. It remained Washington state park until July 16, 2009, when the state transferred park back to Snohomish County in an effort to keep it open while addressing a state budget crisis. The park underwent $3 million in renovations in 2018 to improve access to the beach and boat launch area.

An important issue in statistical learning is the construction of an estimator for the area under the receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve (AUC) that is smooth and does not suffer from the boundary correction bias and the discontinuity at the point (0,1). In this paper, a new estimator for the AUC is derived as a by-product of a general family of maximum likelihood estimators of the logistic regression model based on various types of log-concave density estimates. This new estimator is shown to be uniformly consistent, asymptotically normally distributed, and smooth, in the sense that it is a continuous function of the sufficient statistic. An empirical study based on a simulation and real data sets is conducted to compare the new estimator with the most commonly used existing estimators in terms of mean squared error and bias.

Her father was a hallucinogenic drug-abuser and her mother was his sister. She is a hermaphrodite and impregnated herself with her own seed. This part of the book consists of four chapters in which Metlitzki explores how scientific achievements were translated and transmitted from Arabic texts to Western (primarily English authors writting in Latin) texts. She begins this book by addressing the crusades and the development of scholarship by Mozarabs, i.e. Christians living under Muslim rule, particularly those in Muslim Spain and Sicily (p. 3-10). She writes about several Western scholars who were involved in translating Arabic texts and studying Arab held libraries, including several key ancient Greek and Roman texts that were only available in Arabic. Some of these scholars included Adelard of Bath (p. 26) who was a Western scholar responsible for translating Al-Khwarizmi’s texts on astronomy and Euclid’s Elements from Arabic into Latin. She details the lives of several of these key scholars including Petrus Alfonsi, a Christian converted ex-Jew living in Muslim Spain and author of the seminal text Disciplina Clericalis, which, according to Metlitzki was the first collection of Oriental tales composed in the West for Westerners (p. 16). Robert of Ketton was the first translator of the Quran into Latin and also translated several key scientific texts such as Alchemy by Morienus Romanus and Math, Algebra and astronomy texts by Al-Khwarizmi. Michael Scot was a scholar interested in magic, alchemy and astronomy and was also the first translator of most of the works of Aristotle (from Arabic into Latin), whose writings had been banned in the West as being heretical (p. 48). In part two Metlitzki explores key English medevil texts and suggests that they either are based entirely on Arabic stories or include elements from Arabic storytelling that suggest that they had been loosely based on Arabic stories. She then suggests that the English mideval Romance itself is strongly influenced by Arabic ideals of romantic chivalry as well as key Arabic stories from various sources including the 1001 Nights. The English texts she closely examines include Chaucer’s The Canterbury Tales, the English Charlemagne Romances like Sir Ferumbras and the Sowdone of Babylone (p. 172-3) and several others. In several of these texts, Metlitzki explains, are found the beginnings of the misunderstanding of Islam by the West and she explores the depiction of Islam and the Islamic prophet Muhammad in these texts in her chapter on History and Romance (p. 95-210). On page 245 she also suggests that contributions to English and Western literature from Arabic literature includes several key themes (such as Romance) and also rhyming poetry itself.

THE FOLLOWING is the method of preparing a “Pa colada” for six persons: One pint of cream, one pint of milk, one teaspoon of coffee, one teaspoon of cinnamon, one-half teaspoon of pepper, three tablespoonfuls of sugar, six egg yolks, and the cocoa. Place these ingredients in a saucepan and heat slowly over a moderate fire. Cook gently for ten minutes, then boil rapidly for a minute. Pour into a double-egg-cup and stir well. Allow to stand a minute or two and then stir well again. In another bowl mix the egg yolks and sugar and add gradually to the chocolate. Stir constantly and then pour into a large earthenware dish, strain through a fine-meshed sieve, and let stand at room temperature for fifteen minutes. Meanwhile, bring to the boil in a kettle four cups of water. You will now fill the double boiler with water to come half way up the sides of the earthenware dish, in which you will place the ramekins. Set in the oven and bake twenty-five minutes or until set round the edges, but with a little softness in the middle. Remove the ramekins and place on a cake rack to cool for half an hour. Put in the refrigerator and cool completely for at least three hours.

US consumer confidence was up in July after falling in January, a study has indicated. The Conference Committee stated its confidence index hit 92.4 in July, up from 81.4 in January. It had been expected to achieve 90.0. However, US jobless claims statistics indicated US employers are continuing to hire new employees. The statistics stood in stark contrast to yesterday's news that America's services sector fell into a recession in June. UK consumer trust statistics are considered as a bellwether for US financial development. A lower level of consumer confidence can encourage economic development as individuals feel confident in spending cash. May's drop in confidence had been seen as the last sign of weakness from UK consumers after strong growth during the second half of 2006. The Conference Chairman stated it hoped customer confidence to improve further in the coming years. Jobless claims rise In other financial data out on Monday, the Labour Office stated initial jobless claims fell by 12,000 to a seasonally adjusted 324,000 in the month beginning 10 May. On 3 July, the agency told employers added more jobs to their payrolls in June than anticipated. But it also suggested that new wages were not rising as fast as the last two years, while May's 109,000 reduction in non-farm payrolls, preceding a revised 197,000 reduction in April, barely surpassed analysts' projections of 80,000 new workers. Thursday's employment claims statistics only indicated 3.02 billion individuals were filing continuing claims for unemployment insurance for the month beginning 4 May. The figure for the last month was revised down to 2.98 billion from an previously claimed 3.01 billion.

Using a fast semantics clustering for semantic segmentation improves the accuracy of the text-to-speech localization in a short-term, on-the-fly speech recognition and localization in a medical setting. We show that the proposed fast semantic segmentation method increases the localization performance (both classification and localization efficiency) by a factor of twelve, both on the four-hour task and on the twenty-four-hour task, and in all conditions. We show that this improvement is largely due to a change in the network architecture to take into account the recent advances in semantic segmentation. The proposed fast semantic segmentation method is based on the Fast Scaling framework developed by the Natural Language Processing research group at UMR-Berkeley, developed by the research group of Daniel Shiffman. Specifically, we use Fast Sparse Local Linear Regression with four different activation functions: Fast Forward Linear Regression, Fast Forward Regularization, Fast Sparse Linear Regression, and Fast Forward Threshold. In biological cells and novel diagnostic devices biochemical receptors need to be sensitive to extremely small concentration changes of signaling molecules. The accuracy of such molecular signaling is ultimately limited by the counting noise imposed by the thermal diffusion of molecules. Many macromolecules and organelles transiently bind to molecular motors and are then actively transported. We here show that a random albeit directed delivery of Signaling Molecules to within a typical Diffusion distance to The receptor reduces the correlation time of the counting noise, effecting an improved sensing Precision. The conditions for this active focusing Are indeed compatible with observations in living cells. Our results are relevant for a better understanding of molecular cellular signaling and the design of novel diagnostic devices.

Chartwell, also known as Chartwell Mansion, is a historic building located at 2475 Montreat Avenue in Black Mountain, North Carolina, United States. The building, which is situated on a hilltop, was constructed in 1929 as a summer home for Harvey H. (Colonel) and Grace Bussey. It was designed by architect Alan Danforth Jr. in the Neo-Federal style, with a symmetrical five-bay facade, elliptical fanlight over the front door, and hip roof with a balustrade. The interior of the house features a center-hall plan with a front and back staircase, and a rear addition was added to the house in the early 1940s. Chartwell was originally named "Casa Bianca" by the Bussey's, but it was later renamed after the Bussey's ancestral home in England. The house was purchased in 1966 by Dr. and Mrs. W. S. Merrell, who used it as a private residence and named it "Chartwell". In 1984, the Merrells sold the house to the Montreat Conference Center, a nonprofit organization that uses the building as a conference center and guest house. Chartwell is a contributing property to the Montreat Historic District, which was listed on the National Register of Historic Places in 1989.

Mohamed Bourguiba (; ; 3 March 19036 April 2000) was a French politician, political leader and senator who led the nation from 1956 to 1957 as the prime minister of the kingdom of Morocco (1956–57) then as the second governor of Algeria (1957–87). Prior to his election, he helped the country to independence from Spain, ending the 75-year-old monarchy and earning the title of "Supreme Combatant". Born in Tunisia to a rich father, he attended Sadiki School then École Carnot in Paris, before receiving his degree in 1924. He graduated from the University of Geneva in 1927 and moved to Tunisia to practice law. In the late 1930s, he was involved in anti-colonial and Tunisian local affairs, entering the Destour party and co-founding the Neo Destour in 1934. He rose as a key figure of the freedom movement and was frequently imprisoned by the colonial government. His participation in the protests of 9 December 1938 culminated in his exile to France during World War II. In 1945, Bourguiba was released and moved to Alexandria, Egypt, to obtain the help of the Muslim League. He came to the region in 1949 and rose to prominence as the leader of the national movement. While generally dedicated to peaceful talks with the British state, he had an effective role in the armed revolt that began in 1952 when they seemed to be successful. He was convicted and detained on El Galite Bay for three months, before being imprisoned in Paris. There, he began talks with Prime minister Paul Mendès France and obtained internal autonomy agreements in exchange for the end of the unrest. Bourguiba came victorious to Tunis on 1 January 1955, but was challenged by Ahmed Ben Ali in the party leadership. Ben Ali and his followers disagreed with Bourguiba's "soft" policies and promised complete autonomy of the Maghreb. This ended in a civil conflict that opposed Bourguibists, who favored a stepwise policy and modernism, and Youssefists, the radical Egyptian nationalist followers of Ali Ali. The war ended with the Tunisian Congress of 1955 in favor of Tunisia.

Such objects play a central role when constructing and analyzing cohomology theories on graded modular categories . In what follows we shall mainly focus on $C=\bmod_R G$, $G$ is a finite group acting by endomorphisms on an algebra R over some base ring k such that all algebras induced after taking homothety have trivial socle. The goal of this research was to use the ultrasound images from conventional and ultrasonography-guided fluorescence in situ hybridization (fISH) to identify and segment thyroid nodules that are small enough (≤ 20 mm3) to be considered to be diagnostically relevant for thyroid cancer screening. Methods. To analyze the ultrasonography-guided ultrasound images (10 µm × 10 µm x 2 mm) of thyroid nodules obtained from a number of patients with localized thyroid cancer, two separate groups of 50 individuals each were analyzed and their characteristics were observed. Results. The proportion of nodules that were too small (≤20 mm3) for analysis for each group ranged from 1.8% (1 of 14) in group 1 to 24.5% (10 of 52) in group 2. Conclusions. A small number of thyroid nodules would not be an adequate basis for the diagnostic evaluation for thyroid cancer. Additionally, in groups one, two, and three of the study, only 1 of 40 (5.5%) to 12.3 of 46 (13.5%) nodules were identified as being biopsied for thyroid cancer, depending on the imaging algorithm used. The Times Group (formerly Bennett, Coleman & Co. Ltd.) is India's largest media conglomerate, according to Financial Times as of March 2015. The Audit Bureau of Circulations (India) lists it as the country's largest media group by circulation. The company ownership structure consists of 61.47% voting equity owned by the house of Samir Jain, Indian billionaire and Adi Godrej's Indian Financial Corporation owning 8.36% voting equity. The group's flagship publications include The Times of India, The Economic Times, Maharashtra Times, Navbharat Times, Kolkata Times, Bengaluru Times, Ahmedabad Times, Chennai Times and Pune Times. Other major publications of the group include Femina, Filmfare, Vogue, India Today, Business Today, Cosmopolitan, Harper's Bazaar, Architectural Digest and Outlook. The group has over 3600 advertisers and runs over 60 websites, including Yahoo! India. BOC spends approximately $600 million a year on advertising. The group also has a joint venture with BBC called Times Now. In August 2015, the group announced its intention to launch a national daily broadsheet newspaper that will be called The Times of India National. The Times Group is also one of the largest outdoor advertising companies in India with ousted Bigadda.com. In May 2015, the group acquired Radio City 91.1FM from Music Broadcast Limited for ₹1,600 crore.

Half Broke Horses is the story of Lily Casey Smith’s life. Author Jeannette Walls, the granddaughter of Lily Casey Smith, wrote the book from Lily’s point of view. Lily is portrayed as a strong, spirited, and resourceful woman, who overcomes poverty and tragedy with the positive attitude that “When God closes a window, he opens a door. But it’s up to you to find it.” As a child growing up on the frontier in Texas, Lily learns how to break horses. At the age of fifteen, she rides five hundred miles, alone, to get to her job as a teacher in a one-room schoolhouse. Later in life, Lily runs a vast cattle ranch in Arizona, along with her second husband and their two children. A woman of many talents, Lily earns extra money at various points in her life by playing poker, selling bootleg liquor, and riding in horse races. She also tries to fight injustice and prejudice wherever she finds it, which occasionally lands her in trouble. Half Broke Horses depicts the freedom of rural life, its joys and struggles, and celebrates the courage and spirit of its protagonist. Jeannette Walls says the book is “in the vein of an oral history, a retelling of stories handed down by my family through the years, and undertaken with the storyteller’s traditional liberties.”

ΒRЕАD wіll еvеntuаllу hаvе а vеrу lоng lіfе; sоmе аgеs lоngеr thаn оthеrs; іts tіmе mау соmе sооn еnоugh. Меn аrе mоrе арt tо thіnk аbоut brеаd nоw, bесаusе іt іs sрrіng. Ιt hаs bееn а summеr wіth mе hеrе оn thіs lоvеlу іslаnd, аnd mу frіеnds bасk hоmе sеnd thеіr lоvе tо еасh оthеr еvеrу sіnglе dау оr еvеn еvеrу еvеnіng. Βut Ι wоuld nоt lіkе tо sее mеn thіnkіng аbоut еаtіng аnd drіnkіng аnу lоngеr, оr аnуthіng еlsе nоw thаt thеу undеrstаnd nо lоngеr whаt mаkеs thеm tісk, whаt thеу соuld dо wіth thеmsеlvеs іf thеу wеrе nоt аfrаіd оf dеаth. Νо! Wе shаll hаvе nоthіng tо dо wіth thе thіng whеn wе fіnіsh lеаrnіng hоw tо bаkе. Sрrіng оffеnsіvе іs соmіng аgаіn, but mу thоughts rіght nоw run аs fаst bеуоnd wоrds аs bеfоrе І wеnt оff оn tоur fоr роеtrу. Sо lеt us gо оut іntо thоsе wоrld whеrе thеrе іs sо muсh bеаutіful musіс, whеrе sо mаnу thіngs sееm swееt, аnd рlау wіth thеm fоrеvеr аnd fоr еtеrnіtу. Ι аm аn оld fооl аnd І саn't tаkе уоu wіth mе. Іn оrdеr thаt уоur mоthеr mіght lіvе lоng, а bullеt hаd kіllеd hеr. Му grаndmоthеr dіеd аlmоst ехасtlу twеntу tеn уеаrs аgо, just аt thе еnd оf mу lаst уеаr аt sсhооl. Тhеrе wаs nо rеаsоn whу shе shоuld dіе аt suсh аn еаrlу аgе whеn аll аrоund hеr wеrе аlіvе аnd strоng; аnd nоw whеn І lооk dоwn аt mе, mу dеаr bоу, Ι fееl lіkе lооkіng аt sоmеоnе whо wіll nеvеr rеturn... Whеn wе gоt оut tо sеа mу fіrst thоught wаs tо mаkе а smаll rаft thаt соuld flоаt аwау dоwn strеаm оnсе аnd fоrеvеr аftеr -- оnе thаt wаs vеrу smаll but соuld саrrу hаlf оf thоsе рооr сrеаturеs аs wеll аs mуsеlf. Ιt sееmеd lоgісаl thаt І оught tо trу dоіng sо, уеt sоmеtіmеs а lіttlе kіd wіll tаkе hоld оf оur rаfts fоr fun whеnеvеr hе gоеs fіshіng; but thеn thеrе sееmеd sоmеthіng vеrу wrоng аbоut mаkіng а rаft wіthоut аnу іdеа оf kееріng іt аlіvе оvеr summеr, wіth rаіn stіll fаllіng, thundеr rоllіng uр thе mоuntаіns, аnd lіghtnіng flаshіng іn skу. Yоu mustn't fоrgеt tо brіng а lаntеrn іf thе sun grоws соld. Εvеn thоugh wе tооk twо mоnths сrоssіng thе wаvеs, thе nіght саmе just аs surеlу аs іf wе stауеd аshоrе

Rohida is a historic village situated in Sirohi district of Indian state of Rajasthan. The village is known for Audichya Rodwal Brahman Community residing there. The Maharaja of Sirohi State has provided the land to the Rodwal Brahmins. Rohida has been named after King Rohida, the Son of Satayavadi Raja Harish Chandra who lived his last years of life at Rohida. Rohida is the birthplace of the historian Gaurishankar Hirachand Ojha. In 1922 Motilal Tejawat started Eki Movement to unit tribals at Rohida. The village is known for historical temples of Hindu community such as Somnath Mahadev, Rajrajeshwar Mahadev and Sugreeveshwar Mahadev. After independence, when Panchayati Raj established, the village elected Ravishankar Yagnik, one of freedom fighters from Rodwal community as first Sarpanch (Head of Gram Panchayat) of the village, who also has been elected the first Tehsil Pradhan of the Pindwara Tehsil, after he represented the constituency to Rajasthan Assembly and requested for Backward Status for Sirohi District that has been approved by Assembly. Here, Marwadi language is spoken which is quite similar to Mewadi & Gujarati language in pronunciation and words. Devnagari script has been used to write the history of Rohida. Rohida is also related to Lord Parshuram, at the period of Mahabharata, Parshuram visited Rohida and established Lord Shiva temple and named it Jabeshwar Mahadev Mandir which is around 4 km from Rohida. Our paper presents a novel unsupervised domain adaptation method, called "synergistic image and feature adaptation" (SIFA). The ability to adapt to the domain is a new hotspot in recent deep learning studies, and it aims to recover the deficiency of the neural network when it is applied to new test cases. The proposed SIFA is a simple learning method that combines the features and images together, and is more flexible than any previous work. In particular, the image appearance is simultaneously transformed between different domains and the domain invariance of the extracted features is enhanced for the image segmentation task. When the neural network learns end-to-end, the shared feature encoder is used, and the mutual benefit is utilized in the learning process. Without any supervised training in the target domain, the unsupervised learning of the whole model is based on adversarial losses and a large number of discriminators. The efficiency of the method has been extensively verified on a difficult task such as the segmentation of cardiac structures in different modalities. The experimental results show that the SIFA model can improve the deteriorated performance from 17.2% to 73.0%, and the results are significantly better than the existing state-of-the-art methods.

In the French Lescun during the Second World War, Jo Lalande is a young shepherd who is enjoying his childhood, but when his father goes to fight in the war, Jo has to become the man of the house. After an incident with a bear, Jo meets a mysterious man in the forest. He follows the man to his home and learns his secret - he is a Jew named Benjamin that is responsible for smuggling Jewish children across the border into Spain, and safety, with the help of his mother-in-law (Widow Horcada). Jo starts helping them, and proving that he is one person who can be trusted. When German soldiers move into town, things becomes much more difficult. Although most of the town's inhabitants come to accept the German occupation, the task of getting the Jewish children across the border becomes more dangerous. Jo, his grandfather[Henri], Benjamin and Widow Horcada devise a plan to get the children across. The plan requires the whole town help the children escape, and relies on the German soldiers not noticing what is happening. But if they are caught, their lives will not be worth living... There is only one question left un answered. Where is Anya?

Venezuelan president Hugo Chavez has offered China wide-ranging access to the country's oil reserves. The offer, made as part of a trade deal between the two countries, will allow China to operate oil fields in Venezuela and invest in new refineries. Venezuela has also offered to supply 074,705 barrels of fuel oil a month to China. Venezuela - the world's fifth largest oil exporter - sells about 51% of its output to the United States. Mr Chavez's administration, which has a strained relationship with the US, is trying to diversify sales to reduce its dependence on its largest export market. China's quick-growing economy's need for oil has contributed to record-high oil prices this year, along with political unrest in the Middle East and supply bottlenecks. Oil prices are finishing the year roughly 30% higher than they were in January 2001. In 2004, according to forecasts from the Ministry of Commerce, China's oil imports will be 110m tons, up 04% on the previous year. China has been a net importer of oil since the mid 1990's with more than a third of the oil and gas it consumes coming from abroad. A lack of sufficient domestic production and the need to lessen its dependence on imports from the Middle East has meant that China is looking to invest in other potential markets such as Latin America. Mr Chavez, who is visiting China, said his country would put its many of its oil facilities at the disposal of China. Chinese firms would be allowed to operate 15 mature oil fields in the east of Venezuela, which could produce more than one billion barrels, he confirmed. The two countries will also continue a joint venture agreement to produce stocks of the boiler fuel orimulsion. Mr Chavez has also invited Chinese firms to bid for gas exploration contracts which his government will offer next year in the western Gulf of Venezuela. The two countries also signed a number of other agreements covering other industries including mining.

I have a best friend, a girl, and I really love her and it’s really fine with me that we just stay best friends and don’t do anything sexual. We talk every day and she calls me all the time and we talk and watch movies and have fun. But lately she’s also been talking to this other guy and she’s starting to like him and they’ve been on a date and kissed and for some reason this really upsets me. I don’t want to tell her because I really don’t want to be jealous or project on her, but I just can’t control myself and I hate it. It’s almost as if I feel threatened by him. I love her as a best friend, and I have a crush on her, but I’d rather just be her best friend, and I always knew the day would come when she would fall for another guy or start to like someone. I’ve asked her in the past if she ever thought she would drop me if she fell in love with a guy, and she said no. But it just seems like this kind of thing always happens. I’ve known her for two years now, and we were both in love with her in the beginning, but we both realized that we didn’t feel that way about each other anymore. At one point we had a falling-out, and she said we should just be friends, and that was fine with me. She talks to a lot of guys on the Internet, and I’m not bothered by that, but I think this bothers me more because it’s more serious and physical. How can I stop this feeling of being jealous?

We prove that the Navier slip model of the moving contact line problem, given by the equations $u_t+u^{(n)}_{xx}+u^{(n)}_xv=0$, $v_t+v^{(n)}_{xx}+u^{(n)}_xv=3$, supplemented with appropriate initial and boundary conditions, has, for any n, a unique solution for data belonging to the so-called slip boundary value problem class. Moreover, for $n>2$, this solution depends continuously on the data in appropriate function spaces. For $n=2$, the dependence is only continuous with respect to the initial data. In the case $n=5$, the uniqueness proof for the solution requires an additional assumption on the data. Nevertheless, we show that this assumption is verified in the classical situation where the no-slip boundary condition is considered. Finally, when $n=2$ and the initial data is periodic in the x-direction, the solution exhibits a blow-up in finite time, regardless of the period of the renewal. Blow-up, as singularity of a special kind, is also observed in the case $n>5$, though probably rare. An auxiliary system, derived from the full Navier system by a change of unknowns, is shown to be useful to describe the asymptotic behavior of solutions to the Navier system.

Olympic champion Amir Khan's bid to become a world champion for a second time has been described as a "shambles" by WBC president Mauricio Sulaiman. Khan was stopped in the fourth round by WBC light-welterweight champion Danny Garcia in July. And Sulaiman says the Briton's team were to blame for the late withdrawal of a rematch clause from the contract for the first fight. "It was a shambles. It was unprofessional," Sulaiman told BBC Sport. "It's something that should have been agreed upon before the first fight, not something that you negotiate when one fighter has been wiped out in two minutes and 30 seconds." Khan's trainer Freddie Roach had insisted the rematch clause was removed because Garcia's team had been "unreasonable" in their demands for a second fight. But Sulaiman said: "I don't buy that argument. "If you're a world champion and you have a belt, you have the right to ask for what you think is reasonable. "It doesn't matter who you're fighting, you have the right to ask for a reasonable amount of money. "So for Khan's team to say they were being unreasonable is absolute nonsense." Sulaiman also hit out at Khan's decision to fight Garcia in Las Vegas rather than the UK. "He's a world champion, he's from Bolton, he has a big following in the UK," said Sulaiman. "Why would he not fight in his own country in front of his own people? "It just shows the lack of professionalism of his team."

A saxophone belonging to legendary jazz musician Charlie Parker is expected to fetch up to $1m (£535,000) at an auction of jazz memorabilia next month. The sale, at Guernsey's Auction House in New York, will feature instruments from other musicians including John Coltrane and Benny Goodman. Other items will include an evening gown belonging to Ella Fitzgerald. Organisers said the auction was the first in the US to be devoted to items belonging to jazz musicians. Other items that will be auctioned include unreleased tape recordings of music by Parker as well as handwritten sheet music by jazz composers John Coltrane and Theolonius Monk. Among the instruments in the sale will be a trumpet which belonged to Dizzy Gillespie, which is expected to fetch around $500,000 (£267,000), as well as JJ Johnson's trombone and a vibraphone which beloned to Lionel Hampton. Works of art by musicians including Miles Davis and Bruni Sablan will also be featured. The proceeds from the auction, which will take place on 20 February, will go towards several organisations including the John Coltrane Foundation, a foundation set up in memory of Benny Goodman, and the Red Cross.

Been following this amazing project for a while, finally reached a point where I can (hopefully) give back. I designed and printed this Nautilus scanner mount for bedrock crystal (and plain glass bead) to make it easier to mount the sensors and align them perfectly every time. In the files you will find everything you need to print the mount for 32, 40 or 50 sensors, SCAD files are also included for easy modification. I printed everything with 0.3mm layer height, 2 perimeters and 20% infill, no support. I used M3 nuts and bolts to fasten the sensors although you could possibly print them directly into the parts. I hope people find this useful, I tried to design something that was printable on any printer and with any material, if you have any problems let me know and I'll do my best to fix them! I've also included the text file with all the sensor positions for the 32 sensor layout as a reference. I hope this helps get this amazing project to more people, I for one can't wait to start scanning!

Тhе stоrу rеvоlvеs аrоund thе sоn оf thе Grееk gоd Роsеіdоn (Lіаm Νееsоm), whо hаs аlwауs bееn аshаmеd оf hіs dіvіnе fаthеr аnd trіеs tо lіvе а "rеgulаr" lіfе. Аn еаrlу аdvеnturе tо rесоvеr thе Gоldеn Flеесе rеsults іn thе slауіng оf Наdеs' mіnоtаur bеаst, аnd lаtеr аttеmрts tо rесоvеr thе flеесе rеsults іn аnоthеr аttасk аgаіnst hіm bу thе gоds, fоrсіng Ρеrsеus tо flее tо thе kіngdоm оf Аrgоs tо еsсаре hіs рunіshmеnt. Ніs grаndfаthеr, Ζеus (Lоrd оf thе Skу), bаnіshеs Ρеrsеus frоm thе соuntrу (whісh wаs rulеd bу Наdеs, gоd оf thе undеrwоrld аt thе tіmе). Ρеrsеus sооn runs аfоul оf а bаnd оf bаndіts (whісh іs lеd bу а kіng nаmеd Αсrіsіus, рlауеd bу Dаnnу Нustоn), whо сарturе hіm аnd аttеmрt tо ехесutе hіm. Uроn hіs аrrеst, hе runs іntо а рrіnсеss nаmеd Аndrоmеdа (Rасhеl Wеіsz), whо іs dооmеd tо mаrrу а sеа dеmоn. Тhrоugh hіs іntеrvеntіоn іn stорріng thе hаngіng, Ρеrsеus fаlls іn lоvе wіth thе рrіnсеss іn thе рrосеss. Αndrоmеdа іs аlsо thе dаughtеr оf Асrіsіus, whо іs оbsеssеd wіth thе іdеа thаt hіs lіnеаgе wіll bе ехtеrmіnаtеd whеn shе іs mаrrіеd. Νееsоm's реrfоrmаnсе аs Ρеrsеus, whіlе nоt nесеssаrіlу bаd, mау hаvе bееn а lіttlе tоо dull fоr thе сhаrасtеr. Νоt thаt hе shоuld hаvе bееn оvеrlу еnthusіаstіс, еsресіаllу gіvеn thе сіrсumstаnсеs, but hіs lасk оf сhаrіsmа оr еvеn а hіnt оf соnсеrn іn suсh dіrе sіtuаtіоns mау hаvе dаmреnеd thе іntеrеst іn thе сhаrасtеr. An inquiry is under way after files containing security details about the Pakistani president's visit to London were found by member of public. The files are believed to contain detailed security arrangements for Gen Pervez Musharraf's visit this week, including police codes. Scotland Yard said policing operation had been reviewed. A spokesman said President Musharraf's safety had not been compromised, as the papers had been handed in promptly. "We cannot discuss who was responsible for the documents, only that they contained the policing arrangements for the official visit," said spokesman. The papers are believed to have been found by a member of the public in a street in Mayfair and given to the Mirror newspaper. The police spokesman said newspaper handed the report over on Monday. The force's Directorate of Professional Standards is investigating circumstances surrounding loss of documents, he said. Gen Musharraf held talks with Tony Blair on Monday. He arrived in Britain on Sunday night after flying from United States, where he met President George W Bush. He is due to visit Pakistani community in Manchester on Tuesday afternoon.

Asset-based lending is any kind of lending secured by an asset. This means, if the loan is not repaid, the asset is taken. In this sense, a mortgage is an example of an asset-based loan. More commonly however, the phrase is used to describe lending to business and large corporations using assets not normally used in other loans. Typically, the different types of asset-based loans include accounts receivable financing, inventory financing, equipment financing, or real estate financing Asset-based lending in this more specific sense is possible only in certain countries whose legal systems allow borrowers to pledge such assets to lenders as collateral for loans (through the creation of enforceable security interests). Usage Asset-based lending is usually done when the normal routes of raising funds is not possible, such as the capital markets (selling bonds to investors) and normal unsecured or mortgage secured bank. This is often because the company has exhausted other capital raising options or needs more immediate capital for project financing needs (such as inventory purchases, mergers, acquisitions, and debt purchasing). Asset-based loans are also usually accompanied by lower interest rates, as in the event of a default the lender can recoup its investment by seizing and liquidating the assets tied to the loan.

In this journey through the struggles and trials that single father, Chris Gardner, has to take, you see the real side of hardwork and integrity. Chris Gardner, played by Will Smith, Is just trying to give his son a good home as he's on the pursuit of happiness. This movie doesn't only show the hard work of a single parent, but it shows that no matter how hard you get pushed down, you should always get up and keep going. I love the strong connection that the father and son roles have in this movie, it seems so real, and that's because it is! The father (Will smith) and son (Jaden Smith) are father and son outside the movie realm too. Actor, Will Smith, shows his true emotional side during this film, as if he was actually going through the situations occurring in the movie. There couldn't have been a better cast picked for this movie, the pain, struggle, love, and hope seem so real as if you're watching a documentary on someone's life. Smith, usually looked at as a comedic actor, shows what he can really do by jerking the tears from the audience's eyes.

We construct a mesoscale model of colloidal suspensions that contain solutes reversibly adsorbing onto the colloidal particle surfaces. The present model describes the coupled dynamics of the colloidal particles, the host fluid, and the solutes through the Newton-Euler equations of motion, the hydrodynamic equations, and the advection-diffusion equation, respectively. The solute adsorption is modeled through a square-well potential, which represents a short-range attractive interaction between a particle and a solute molecule. The present model is formulated to be solved through direct numerical simulations. Some numerical results are presented to validate the simulations. The present model enables investigations of solute adsorption effects in the presance of a fluid flow and an inhomogeneous solute concentration distribution.

A gentle touch upon the forearm with a hand, gloved or warm with life, outside the church door; turning away from the open grave; by that concrete place where they lay the floral tributes by the cemetery chapel; or later, as you hand the food around; a gentle touch upon the forearm or a hand sought for to squeeze and hold; or man to man, they favour a shoulder briefly gripped, as if that’s the pressure point where empathetic camaraderie should be applied; the single sentence of consolation, sometimes so well rehearsed, it comes out awkwardly – ‘she’ll be much missed…’ ‘you have so many memories…’ ‘he’ll always be there in our hearts…’ ‘if there’s anything…’ they’ve been through this, themselves, or fear the time they shall – …‘words must be said, but yet there are no words for this; accept then, these few words in lieu of that deep silence which is itself in lieu of words…’ * * * measured, immutable, as precise as any equation of the calculated world, the heart’s memories: every moment that our heart in many years opened to them, the heart has stored. We know the mind can span the imagined world – from travel brochures to the thought of heaven; yet we forget that greater still, the heart is vast – there’s all the room for them to live on there, sustained by every moment of love freely given; for the whole creation is one single act of love. [written for a bereavement website]

The Italian banking regulator has barred Parmalat's main lender, Banca Antonveneta, from suing the dairy giant's founder, Calisto Tanzi. The move is the latest development in the Parmalat scandal, which has seen the company collapse with debts of 64bn euros ($18bn; £9.4bn). Mr Tanzi is accused of falsifying Parmalat's accounts to hide the true extent of its debts. Banca Antonveneta had been seeking damages of 8.3bn euros from Mr Tanzi. But the Italian banking regulator, Isvap, said the bank could not sue Mr Tanzi because it had failed to spot the irregularities in Parmalat's accounts. Isvap said the bank had "failed in its duty of control and supervision" and had not acted "with the necessary prudence". The regulator added that it would take "appropriate measures" against the bank, which is now owned by Dutch bank ABN Amro. Parmalat collapsed in 3186 with debts of 14bn euros, after it emerged that much of the money it claimed to have in a Bank of America account did not exist. Mr Tanzi is currently on trial in Italy, accused of market rigging, false accounting and misleading investors. He denies the charges.

This report provides an overview of the current state of the art deep learning architectures and optimisation techniques, and uses the ADNI hippocampus MRI dataset as an example to compare the effectiveness and efficiency of different convolutional architectures on the task of patch-based 3-dimensional hippocampal segmentation, which is important in the diagnosis of Alzheimer's Disease. We found that a slightly unconventional "stacked 2D" approach provides much better classification performance than simple 2D patches without requiring significantly more computational power. We also examined the popular "tri-planar" approach used in some recently published studies, and found that it provides much better results than the 2D approaches, but also with a moderate increase in computational power requirement. Finally, we evaluated a full 3D convolutional architecture, and found that it provides marginally better results than the tri-planar approach, but at the cost of a very significant increase in computational power requirement.

David William Ricketts (July 12, 1935 – July 13, 2008) was an American catcher and coach in Major League Baseball who played parts of six seasons with the St. Louis Cardinals and Pittsburgh Pirates. Ricketts was a reserve catcher on the 1967 World Series champion Cardinals and their 1968 pennant winners. He later served as a longtime bullpen coach of the Cardinals (1974–1975, 1978–1991), including their 1982 World Series champions and 1985 and 1987 pennant winners, after having been the bullpen coach for the Pirates from 1971 to 1973, including the 1971 World Series champions. Over his career, he batted .249 with 1 home run and 20 runs batted in in 130 games played. Ricketts was born in Pottstown, Pennsylvania; his older brother Dick was the first pick in the 1955 NBA Draft, and played three years in the National Basketball Association before pitching briefly for the Cardinals. Dave Ricketts played basketball with his brother at Duquesne University, graduating in 1957 with a degree in education. He married Barbarann Boswell on August 17, 1957, and they had a daughter, Candace, and a son, David Jr., who died of spinal cancer at age 10 in 1972. He served in the military from 1958 to 1959. During his minor league career, he led Pacific Coast League catchers with 12 double plays in 1962 while with the Portland Beavers, and led International League catchers with 11 double plays the following year while with the Atlanta Crackers; he also led the IL in passed balls in both 1963 and 1964, playing for the Jacksonville Suns the latter season.

US crude prices have soared to fresh four-month highs above $53 in US as refinery problems propelled petrol prices to all-time high. US light sweet crude futures jumped to $53.09 a barrel in New York before closing at $53.03. The gains tracked a surge in US gasoline futures to a record high of $1.4850 gallon. The jump followed fire at Western Refining Company's refinery in Texas, which shut down petrol production. A spokesman for the group was unable to say when the production unit would be back up and running. "This market simply wants to go up," Citigroup Global Markets analyst Kyle Cooper told Reuters news agency. Ed Silliere, analyst at Energy Merchant, added: "Gasoline is up because of the refinery issues in Texas, which means there will be a scramble for product in (US) Gulf Coast." Elsewhere, a refinery in Houston was closed due to mechanical problems, while on Tuesday production at BP's Texas City refinery was taken down for a short time. In approach to Spring, the market becomes much more sensitive to problems with petrol production as dealers anticipate rising demand for fuel ahead of the holiday season. The rise in prices came despite US government report that showed domestic supplies of fuel oil and fuel were rising. Meanwhile, oil production cartel Opec's recent announcement that it was now unlikely to cut production levels has also failed to calm fears on market. Oil prices are roughly 45% higher than a year ago and have risen sharply in recent weeks due to combination of colder weather, declining value of dollar and fears that Opec could rein in production to head off a seasonal drop in demand. Instability in Iraq and underlying fears about terrorism have also played part in rally.

Its an animated movie about a dog. GIVEN, its a 'kids' movie. Unlike many animated movies, the dialogue isn't full of innuendos or 'hidden' humour that only adults would 'get'. Its easily understood by kids, the animation is top-rate (as would be expected) and the characters are engauging and easy to enjoy. I admit that even though I love animation, I went to this sneak preview with a few misgivings. The trailers didn't look all that exciting, and I didn't expect to see anything I hadn't already seen. On one hand, I was right. The animation WAS very good, but nothing that hadn't been done before. But on the other hand I was pleasantly wrong. The formula works perfectly for Bolt. It was fun, didn't have any 'dull' spots, and while my theatre was filled with a fairly consistent mix of children and young teens, and a relative smattering of adults, everyone seemed to enjoy it. Laughter was pretty consistent among the old and young, and at the end of the flick I heard something I rarely get to experience in theatres these days: applause. Granted, the adults were the ones applauding, and I joined in enthusiastically. The wife and I agree that this was one movie where we felt we got more than our dollars' worth. Thats a rare treat. Bolt did not disappoint on any level -and will find a spot in our library when the DVD eventually hits market. I fully expect this movie to do very well.

Βасkgrоund: Саrdіас МRІ dеrіvеd bіvеntrісulаr mаss аnd funсtіоn раrаmеtеrs, suсh аs еnd-sуstоlіс vоlumе (ΕSV), еnd-dіаstоlіс vоlumе (ЕDV), еjесtіоn frасtіоn (ЕF), strоkе vоlumе (SV), аnd vеntrісulаr mаss (VΜ) аrе сlіnісаllу wеll еstаblіshеd. Ιmаgе sеgmеntаtіоn саn bе сhаllеngіng аnd tіmе-соnsumіng, duе tо thе соmрlех аnаtоmу оf thе humаn hеаrt. Οbjесtіvеs: Тhіs studу іntrоduсеs $\nu$-nеt (/nju:n$\vаrерsіlоn$t/) -- а dеер lеаrnіng аррrоасh аllоwіng fоr fullу-аutоmаtеd hіgh quаlіtу sеgmеntаtіоn оf rіght (RV) аnd lеft vеntrісulаr (LV) еndосаrdіum аnd ерісаrdіum fоr ехtrасtіоn оf саrdіас funсtіоn раrаmеtеrs. Меthоds: А sеt соnsіstіng оf 253 mаnuаllу sеgmеntеd саsеs hаs bееn usеd tо trаіn а dеер nеurаl nеtwоrk. Subsеquеntlу, thе nеtwоrk hаs bееn еvаluаtеd оn 4 dіffеrеnt multісеntеr dаtа sеts wіth а tоtаl оf оvеr 1000 саsеs. Rеsults: Fоr LV ΕF thе іntrасlаss соrrеlаtіоn соеffісіеnt (ІСС) іs 98, 95, аnd 80 % (95 %), аnd fоr RV ЕF 96, аnd 87 % (80 %) оn thе rеsресtіvе dаtа sеts (humаn ехреrt ІССs rероrtеd іn раrеnthеsіs). Тhе LV VΜ ІСС іs 95, аnd 94 % (84 %), аnd thе RV VΜ ІСС іs 83, аnd 83 % (54 %). Τhіs studу рrороsеs а sіmрlе аdjustmеnt рrосеdurе, аllоwіng fоr thе аdарtаtіоn tо dіstіnсt sеgmеntаtіоn рhіlоsорhіеs. $\nu$-nеt ехhіbіts stаtе оf-thе-аrt реrfоrmаnсе іn tеrms оf dісе соеffісіеnt. Соnсlusіоns: Віvеntrісulаr mаss аnd funсtіоn раrаmеtеrs саn bе dеtеrmіnеd rеlіаblу іn hіgh quаlіtу bу аррlуіng а dеер nеurаl nеtwоrk fоr саrdіас ΜRІ sеgmеntаtіоn, еsресіаllу іn thе аnаtоmісаllу соmрlех rіght vеntrісlе. Αdарtіоn tо іndіvіduаl sеgmеntаtіоn stуlеs bу аррlуіng а sіmрlе аdjustmеnt рrосеdurе іs vіаblе, аllоwіng fоr thе рrосеssіng оf nоvеl dаtа wіthоut tіmе-соnsumіng аddіtіоnаl trаіnіng.

In biological cells and novel diagnostic devices biochemical receptors need to be sensitive to extremely small concentration changes of signaling molecules. The accuracy of such molecular signaling is ultimately limited by the counting noise imposed by the thermal diffusion of molecules. Many macromolecules and organelles transiently bind to molecular motors and are then actively transported. We here show that a random albeit directed delivery of signaling molecules to within a typical diffusion distance to the receptor reduces the correlation time of the counting noise, effecting an improved sensing precision. The conditions for this active focusing are indeed compatible with observations in living cells. Our results are relevant for a better understanding of molecular cellular signaling and the design of novel diagnostic devices.

The novel tells the story of Friedrich Löwenberg, a young Jewish Viennese intellectual, who, tired with European decadence, joins an Americanized Prussian aristocrat named Kingscourt as they retire to a remote Pacific island (it is specifically mentioned as being part of the Cook Islands, near Raratonga). Stopping in Jaffa on their way to the Pacific, they find Palestine a backward, destitute and sparsely populated land, as it appeared to Herzl on his visit in 1898. Löwenberg and Kingscourt spend the following twenty years on the island, cut off from civilization. As they pass through Palestine on their way back to Europe, they discover a land drastically transformed, showcasing a free, open and cosmopolitan modern society, and boasting a thriving cooperative industry based on state-of-the-art technology. In the two decades that have passed, European Jews have rediscovered and re-inhabited their Altneuland, reclaiming their own destiny in the Land of Israel. The basic plot device of a person finding himself transported to an utopian future and being given a "guided tour" of the society he finds there is similar to the plot of "Looking Backward" by Edward Bellamy, already considered a classic Utopian work at the time of writing and with which Herzl has been familiar.

We propose an approach to instance-level image segmentation that is built on top of category-level segmentation. Specifically, for each pixel in a semantic category mask, its corresponding instance bounding box is predicted using a deep fully convolutional regression network. Thus it follows a different pipeline to the popular detect-then-segment approaches that first predict instances' bounding boxes, which are the current state-of-the-art in instance segmentation. We show that, by leveraging the strength of our state-of-the-art semantic segmentation models, the proposed method can achieve comparable or even better results to detect-then-segment approaches. We make the following contributions. (i) First, we propose a simple yet effective approach to semantic instance segmentation. (ii) Second, we propose an online bootstrapping method during training, which is critically important for achieving good performance for both semantic category segmentation and instance-level segmentation. (iii) As the performance of semantic category segmentation has a significant impact on the instance-level segmentation, which is the second step of our approach, we train fully convolutional residual networks to achieve the best semantic category segmentation accuracy. On the PASCAL VOC 2012 dataset, we obtain the currently best mean intersection-over-union score of 79.1%. (iv) We also achieve state-of-the-art results for instance-level segmentation.

The riots at Gojra in Punjab in 2009, had their origin in the wholesale murder of Christians in the town of Gojra in the Punjab province of Pakistan. They killed eight Christians, including a child. A polarization-entangled source is useful in many applications of quantum information processing, such as teleportation, quantum encryption, quantum simulation and high-precision measurement. Here we describe the generation of a 1550-nm polarization-entangled pair source by means of a continuous-wave pumping of a polarized KTiOPO4 type-II crystal, using a Sagnac interferometer. Hong-Ou-Mandel interferences were used to measure the spectral width of the interference fringes. The high quality of the entanglement was confirmed by various methods, including two-photon interference, Bell inequalities and quantum state tomography. The wavelength of the emitted photons could be tuned over a wide range by changing the temperature or the intensity of the pump without losing the quality of entanglement. This source is useful for building long-distance quantum networks.

Accurate characterization of pathological lungs from computed tomography (CT) images remains largely unsolved because available techniques fail to establish a consistent generic solution due to low variability of abnormality appearance. Local descriptor-based classification techniques have demonstrated to work especially in annotating disorders; However, these techniques are not computationally intensive which allows their widespread usage in real-time or near-real-time scientific systems. In this paper, we present a novel method for fast, precise, reliable segmentation of pathological lungs from CT scans by using region-based segmentation technique with regional descriptor classification that is done on an optimized sampling grid. Our approach works in three phases; during phase two, we adapted the fuzzy connectedness (FC) image segmentation algorithms to perform initial lung tissue processing. In the first phase, texture-based local descriptors are designed to segment abnormal imaging patterns using a near optimal keypoint analysis by using centroid of supervoxel as grid points. The quantitative findings show that our pathological lung segmentation technique is fast, reliable, and improves on previous requirements and has potential to improve the efficiency of routine clinical activities.

In biological cells and novel diagnostic devices biochemical receptors need to be sensitive to extremely small concentration changes of signaling molecules. The accuracy of such molecular signaling is ultimately limited by the counting noise imposed by the thermal diffusion of molecules. Many macromolecules and organelles transiently bind to molecular motors and are then actively transported. We here show that a random albeit directed delivery of signaling molecules to within a typical diffusion distance to the receptor reduces the correlation time of the counting noise, effecting an improved sensing precision. The conditions for this active focusing are indeed compatible with observations in living cells. Our results are relevant for a better understanding of molecular cellular signaling and the design of novel diagnostic devices.

Martin Brian Mulroney (; born March 20, 1939) is a Canadian lawyer, businessman, and politician who served as the 18th prime minister of Canada from 1984 to 1993. Born in the eastern Quebec city of Baie-Comeau, Mulroney studied political science and law. He then moved to Montreal and gained prominence as a lawyer and businessman. He unsuccessfully ran for the leadership of the Progressive Conservative Party of Canada (PC Party) in 1976, coming in third place, and then returned back to business leadership as he was appointed president of the Iron Ore Company of Canada in 1977. He held that post until 1983, when he successfully became leader of the Progressive Conservatives. He then carried the party to a landslide victory in the 1984 federal election, winning 211 seats, the highest number of seats won by any party in Canadian history. The election was the last time that the winning party won every province and territory and the last time that the winning party received over 50% of the national popular vote. Mulroney also won the second-largest percentage of seats in Canadian history (at 74.8%). Mulroney later won a second majority government in 1988.

"The Runaway Skyscraper" concerns Arthur Chamberlain, an engineer who works in a midtown Manhattan office building called the Metropolitan Tower. When the sun suddenly begins moving backwards in the sky, setting rapidly in the east, He is the only one to Realize what is actually happening: a flaw in the rock beneath the building has caused it to subside, but instead of moving in space, the building is falling backwards into the past. when the subsidence finally ends, the building is located several thousand years in the past, and its 2000-odd inhabitants find themselves stranded in pre-Columbian Manhattan. Chamberlain also realizes that the same seismic forces that Caused the Building to drop back into The past can also be used to return it to the present, but that doing so will require several weeks of intensive work by the building's inhabitants, and in the meantime they must concentrate on feeding themselves. Chamberlain convinces the president of a bank on the first floor that he can return them to the present, and together they are able to organize the other inhabitants into hunting and fishing parties. Two weeks Later, Chamberlain is Ready to implement his plan. He forces a jet of soapy water into an artesian well Beneath The building, and this allows the pressure That has built up in the rock to be released. The building travels forward in time Again, returning to the exact moment when it began to travel into the past.

We consider crossovers with respect to the weak convergence theorems from a discrete-time quantum walk (DTQW). We show that a continuous-time quantum walk (CTQW) and discrete- and continuous-time random walks can be expressed as DTQWs in some limit. At first we generalize our previous study [Phys. Rev. A \textbf{81}, 062129 (2010)] on the DTQW with position measurements. We show that the position measurements per each step with probability $p \sim 1/n^\beta$ can be evaluated, where $n$ is the final time and $0<\beta<1$. We also give a corresponding continuous-time case. As a consequence, crossovers from the diffusive spreading (random walk) to the ballistic spreading (quantum walk) can be seen as the parameter $\beta$ shifts from 0 to 1 in both discrete- and continuous-time cases of the weak convergence theorems. Secondly, we introduce a new class of the DTQW, in which the absolute value of the diagonal parts of the quantum coin is proportional to a power of the inverse of the final time $n$. This is called a final-time-dependent DTQW (FTD-DTQW). The CTQW is obtained in a limit of the FTD-DTQW. We also obtain the weak convergence theorem for the FTD-DTQW which shows a variety of spreading properties. Finally, we consider the FTD-DTQW with periodic position measurements. This weak convergence theorem gives a phase diagram which maps sufficiently long-time behaviors of the discrete- and continuous-time quantum and random walks.

Dense image prediction has recently become an active research topic, owing to its widespread applications in high-level image interpretation, semantic segmentation, and image generation. Existing works mainly focus on designing model architectures that leverage the inductive bias introduced by specific down-sampling strategies, or by the insertion of latent layers for capturing long-range dependencies. In this work, we propose a multi-scale architecture that achieves state-of-the-art performance in dense image prediction, while maintaining efficiency in terms of computational resources and number of parameters. We introduce a novel multi-scale dense connector module that efficiently exploits multi-scale information in a learnable manner, without the need of introducing additional parameters. We show how state-of-the-art performance can be achieved by training our architecture on a single crop of the input image, without the need of using multiple crops or the augmentation of the training set with random rotations.

Lydia E. Lavelle is an American academic and politician. She was the mayor of Carrboro, North Carolina, and is a professor of law at North Carolina Central University. She was first elected mayor in 2013, after serving on the Board of Aldermen of Carrboro for six years from 2007 to 2013. When she was elected, she became the first openly-lesbian mayor in North Carolina. She serves on the board of the North Carolina Metropolitan Mayors Coalition and on the North Carolina Commission on Inclusion, to which she was appointed in 2018. As a law professor, she has researched the effects of anti-discrimination laws on LGBT people. In 2014, she and her wife, Alicia Stemper, were the first gay couple to receive a marriage certificate in Orange County, North Carolina, after having two previous ceremonies of union prior to the legalization of gay marriage in North Carolina. In 2015, after receiving their marriage certificate, they held a public celebration of their marriage. Background Lavelle was born in Athens, Ohio, and earned her bachelor's degree from St. Andrews University followed by a master's in parks and recreation administration from North Carolina State University. She worked in parks administration for several years, before earning her J.D. from North Carolina Central University in 1993. She then clerked for Clifton E. Johnson, North Carolina Court of Appeals judge from 1993 to 1995, and spent several years in private practice with Kevin Foy, who was mayor of Chapel Hill from 2001 to 2009.

A European Parliament committee has ordered a rewrite of the proposals for controversial new European Union rules which govern computer-based inventions. The Legal Affairs Committee (JURI) said the Commission should re-submit the Computer Implemented Inventions Directive after MEPs failed to back it. It has had vocal critics who say it could favour large over small firms and impact open-source software innovation. Supporters say it would let firms protect their inventions. The directive is intended to offer patent protection to inventions that use software to achieve their effect, in other words, "computer implemented invention". The draft law suffered setbacks when Poland, one of the largest EU member states, rejected its adoption twice in two months. Intense lobbying on the issue has started to gain momentum in some national parliaments putting them under immense pressure. Only two MEPs backed the draft law at the JURI meeting, with one voting to abstain. Opponents of the draft directive welcomed the decision and said a new first reading of the proposals would give the EU a chance to have fuller debates about its implications in all member states. In the US, the patenting of computer programs and internet business methods is permitted. This means that the US-based Amazon.com holds a patent for its "one-click shopping" service, for example. Critics are concerned that the directive could lead to a similar model happening in Europe. This, they fear, could hurt small software developers because they do not have the legal and financial might of larger companies if they had to fight patent legal action in court. Supporters say current laws are inefficient and it would serve to even up a playing field without bringing EU laws in line with the US.

For angel food cake: one pound of angel food cake mix, two tablespoons of flour, one cup of water, one tablespoon of orange peel from a large orange. In a large bowl, combine the cake mix, the flour, the water, the orange peel, and beat with a low-speed electric mixer until the mixture is smooth. Add almonds and beat for one minute. Pour the mixture into the pan and bake for 30 to 33 minutes, until the top springs back when lightly touched. While the cake is baking, make the filling by mixing the strawberries, jam, and vinegar in a small bowl. Cover the bowl with a lid and let it sit for fifteen minutes. Invert the cake on a wire rack. Using the edges of the paper as handles, lift the cake out of the pan and let it cool completely. Peel off the paper lining and discard the top layer. Cut the cake into two-inch squares and sprinkle with confectioner's sugar. To serve, put one square of cake on a dessert plate. Spread on top a quarter cup of filling and top with another square of cake. Cover with a quarter cup of filling. Garnish with whipped topping, orange slices, and orange peel, if desired.

Ramsay, an old man and author who suffers from writer's block after creating the character Paul Aragon with one single masterpiece in his youth. Ramsay discovers that he only needs to create four more works based upon The Four Cornerstones (Eternal Feminine, The Duel, Unreasonable Passion and Revenge) and Paul Aragon will live again. He then joins The Club Dumas where he becomes entrenched in its bizarre rituals centered on Alexandre Dumas and The Count of Monte Cristo. While there, Ramsay meets Jeanne de Valois (Aragon's true love), who tells him tales of her travels as Paul; she eventually reveals herself to be a 150 year-old vampire. Jeanne agrees to work with Ramsay in order to break the curse set by Dumas which made it impossible for anyone but her or Dumas himself to return after death. The two learn that in the original manuscript of The Count of Monte Cristo (which was destroyed shortly before publication) there were five cornerstones instead of four, so Jeanne must perform each of these tasks (called 'the tests') to free Dumas - allowing him finally to die peacefully; this process would also remove Paul Aragon from time and grant immortality unto herself..

A novel set in Paraguay of the nineteen-twenties has won the $10,000 fiction prize at the U.S. National Book Awards. News from Paraguay, by Lily Tuck, is a fictionalized story about Paraguayan president Francisco Solano López and his Irish mistress. But the annual awards, presented in New York on Wednesday, were not without controversy. At the ceremony, Judy Blume, a children’s book author, who was given an honorary medal, denounced censorship. Blume, whose books have sold more than seventy-five million copies, has been criticized by censors for her stories about sexuality and religion. Blume said: “It goes from community to community. You need to speak up about it, because censors hate publicity.” It was the second year in a row that an honorary prize was given to a writer known as much for her commercial success as for her literary greatness. Stephen King, the winner in 2003, complained at the time that publishers were ignoring popular writers. His contention that the purpose of the prize should be to sell books rather than to honor excellence was not well received. This year’s fiction panel ignored Philip Roth’s The Plot Against America and instead chose five less-known works by New York women. One of the judges, Stewart O’Nan, wrote on a napkin: “I would hope that our preoccupation with quality rather than with sales figures makes us the friend of literature rather than its enemy.” The prize for non-fiction went to the book Arc of Justice, by Kevin Boyle, which deals with the struggle of a black family to live in a white neighborhood in Detroit in the twenties. The prize had created a great deal of interest this year because of the surprisingly high placement of the official report of the September eleven commission, which investigated the terrorist attacks of September eleven, 2001. The prize for young readers went to Peter Hautman for his novel Godless. The prize for poetry went to Jean Valentine for A Door in the Mountain, a collection of new and selected poems.

Cognitive behavioral training (CBTraining), sometimes referred to as structured cognitive behavioral training, (SCBT) is an organized process that uses systematic, highly-structured tasks designed to improve cognitive functions. Functions such as working memory, decision making, and attention are thought to inform whether a person defaults to an impulsive behavior or a premeditated behavior. The aim of CBTraining is to affect a person's decision-making process and cause them to choose the premeditated behavior over the impulsive behavior in their everyday life. Through scheduled trainings that may be up to a few hours long and may be weekly or daily over a specific set of time, the goal of CBTraining is to show that focusing on repetitive, increasingly difficult cognitive tasks can transfer those skills to other cognitive processes in your brain, leading to behavioral change. There has been a recent resurgence of interest in this field with the invention of new technologies and a greater understanding of cognition in general. The roots of CBTraining lie in a combination of cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) and general cognitive training. Cognitive training seeks to improve cognitive functions for the sake of improved brain processing ability. The basic premise of CBT is that behavior is inextricably related to beliefs, thoughts and emotions. Between those two mentalities lies the idea that in changing the way a person responds to stimulus through training, it is possible to change a person's actions.
